key: Type A-02

key:
To know means to understand.
We successfully extracted the archetype and materialized it, and the observer reshaped it into a weapon.
This is why we highly regarded the act of observation.
The eye sockets of the hollow skull stare into sins, and the crown of thorns casts blame.
Those who are willing to spill blood for the greater good will be readily given approval for its use.
Though this weapon is not as strong as other E.G.O weapons in our possession, it provides psychological comfort to the wielder.
However, it is useless to those who do not know justice.
value:
认知即是理解。
我们成功提取了原型并将其物质化，观察者将其重塑为武器。
这就是我们高度重视观察行为的原因。
空洞颅骨的眼眶凝视着罪孽，荆棘之冠投下责难。
那些愿意为了大义而流血的人，将轻易获得使用它的许可。
尽管这把武器不如我们持有的其他E.G.O武器强大，但它能为装备者提供心理上的慰藉。
然而，它对那些不懂正义的人毫无用处。

key: Type B-02

key:
Conventional firearms were ineffective against Abnormalities; using them was as futile as cutting water with a knife.
That was when we asked ourselves: “If Abnormalities are materialized from the unconsciousness, it may be possible to extract a piece of it back from them and turn it into a weapon.”
Results varied depending on the observer.
The crown of thorns will sometimes protect the wielder’s soul.
The thorns may momentarily hurt as they anchor your soul to reality.
This suit will be no better than rags to those who have no sense of guilt.
value:
常规火器对异想体无效；使用它们如同以刀砍水。
那时我们自问："既然异想体是从无意识中物质化的，或许可以从它们身上提取一部分，将其转化为武器。"
结果因观察者而异。
荆棘之冠有时会保护装备者的灵魂。
尖刺在将你的灵魂锚定于现实时，可能会带来短暂的刺痛。
这件护甲对那些毫无罪恶感的人来说，不过是破布而已。

key: Red Eyes
value: 赤瞳

key:
The Spider Bud had dozens of eyes, and its children were always hungry.
This tenacity carried over to the E.G.O, demonstrating an outstanding ability to track down targets.
The eyes shone in the dark, searching for prey to feed to its spiderlings. The weapon emits a glowing red aura to find victims in the darkness.
One should maintain caution, as the wielder can become possessed by the spider should they look into its alluring eyes for too long.
value:
蜘蛛蓓蕾有数十只眼睛，它的孩子们总是饥肠辘辘。
这种坚韧延续到了E.G.O上，展现出追踪目标的出色能力。
眼睛在黑暗中闪耀，搜寻猎物来喂饱它的蜘蛛幼崽。这把武器散发出红色的光芒，在黑暗中寻找受害者。
装备者应当保持警惕，因为若长时间凝视它那迷人的眼睛，可能会被蜘蛛附身。

key: Movement Speed +2.5 when suppressing if wielder has 2+ Fortitude

key:
Its hunting instincts cannot be suppressed.
This persistent and cruel weapon shows no mercy to friend and foe alike.
The wielder might become possessed by the spider if they gaze into its eyes for too long.
The eyes on the equipment gaze into the target, even in darkness.
value:
它的狩猎本能无法被抑制。
这把残忍而执着的武器对友军和敌人都毫不留情。
若长时间凝视它的眼睛，装备者可能会被蜘蛛附身。
装备上的眼睛即使在黑暗中也凝视着目标。

key: Horn
value: 角

key:
The green-eyed beauty's favorite flower was the dahlia; “Your love makes me happy.”
The lady's happiness came to an end with the budding of those unsightly horns. The dahlia’s unfulfilled meaning was borne as a seed in this E.G.O, carrying a lingering emotion.
No matter how many times the equipment is produced, the bud never withers.
As the horn digs deep into the enemy's heart, it will turn blood red to show off the glamor that she couldn't in her life.
value:
绿眼美人最爱的花是大丽花；"你的爱让我快乐。"
随着那些难看的角萌发，这位女士的幸福走到了尽头。大丽花未竟的花语作为种子孕育在这件E.G.O中，带着挥之不去的情感。
无论制作多少次，蓓蕾永不凋零。
当角深深刺入敌人的心脏时，它会变得血红，炫耀她生前未能展现的魅力。

key:
As hideous horns blossomed from her forehead, her happiness withered away. The unfulfilled language of her beloved dahlias was borne as a seed in this equipment.
The flowers tell the tale of the splendor she had in her life, as well as the pitiful end to it.
A flower that reached its full bloom through hate would not wither even after numerous extractions.
Since the flower had concluded its tale long ago, its scent is gone.
value:
丑陋的角从她额头绽放，她的幸福枯萎了。她心爱大丽花未竟的话语作为种子孕育在这件装备中。
花朵诉说着她生前的辉煌，以及那可悲的结局。
一朵因恨而盛开的花，即使经过无数次提取也不会凋零。
既然花早已说完了它的故事，它的芬芳也就消失了。

key: Screaming Wedge
value: 哀嚎楔

key:
Hair has grown on the crossbow as if to express that the woman’s dejection will never be forgotten.
The sound of the projectile splitting the air is reminiscent of her piercing scream.
Those who wield this must be careful, as her hair can tangle the wielder's hands and drag them into an endless path of sorrow.
Only iron-willed employees with a cold-blooded disposition can use this without letting the deep-rooted sorrow weave its strands around their heart.
value:
弩上长出了毛发，仿佛在诉说那女子的悲伤永远不会被忘记。
弹射物划破空气的声音，让人想起她那刺耳的尖叫。
使用这把武器的人必须小心，因为她的头发会缠住装备者的手，将他们拖入无尽的悲伤之路。
只有冷血铁腕的员工才能使用它，而不让那根深蒂固的悲伤将丝线缠绕在自己心头。

key: 50% chance to take 5 SP damage with each attack if wielder’s Fortitude and Prudence Levels are lower than 3
value: 若装备者坚韧与谨慎等级低于3，每次攻击有50%几率受到5点SP伤害

key:
Her resentment is tightly bound to it as if to express that it is not to be cast away so easily.
When the projectile pierces the heart of an enemy, it will be forever tangled in the knot of dejection.
A warm heart and cool head are required to resist the deep-rooted sorrow.
value:
她的怨恨紧紧束缚其上，仿佛在说它不会被轻易丢弃。
当弹射物刺穿敌人的心脏时，将永远纠缠在悲伤的结中。
抵抗根深蒂固的悲伤需要温暖的心和冷静的头脑。

key: Fourth Match Flame
value: 第四根火柴

key: Type A-03
value: A-03型

key:
The fire roars and burns like the first flame.
The light of the match will not go out until it has burned away happiness, warmth, light, and all the other good things of the world; there's no need to worry about it being quenched.
The experiments with lighting the matches could not be completed without collateral damage.
Those who are burned will feel infinite hatred towards the world until the last flicker of their consciousness is snuffed out.
value:
火焰咆哮，像最初的火焰一样燃烧。
火柴的光芒不会熄灭，直到它燃尽幸福、温暖、光明以及世间一切美好之物；不必担心它会被熄灭。
点燃火柴的实验不可能不造成附带损害。
被烧着的人将对世界感到无尽的憎恨，直到最后一丝意识被掐灭。

key:
The archetype was already charred from the moment of extraction.
Although the exterior is scorched, it has no adverse effects on the E.G.O's performance.
The ashy design reminds one of the hatred against all the merry things in the world and the desire to burn it all.
However, no one knows whether it is actually fireproof as the design suggests.
value:
原型从被提取的那一刻起就已焦黑。
虽然外表焦黑，但对E.G.O的性能没有不良影响。
灰烬般的设计让人想起对世间一切欢乐之物的憎恨，以及将其全部燃尽的渴望。
然而，没有人知道它是否真的像设计所暗示的那样防火。

key: Regret
value: 悔恨

key:
Bearing unlimited possibility to change humanity's future, confidential research began in the underground.
The researchers laid down all sense of dignity, but they did not feel guilty as they had the greater good to pursue.
Even the merciful Carmen condoned the project.
Enemies crushed by this regret can never return to their normal life.
Before swinging this weapon, expressing one’s condolences for the demise of the inmate who couldn't even have a funeral would be nice.
value:
怀着改变人类未来的无限可能，秘密研究在地下开始了。
研究者们放下了所有尊严，但他们并不感到愧疚，因为他们追求的是更大的善。
就连仁慈的卡门也默许了这个项目。
被这份悔恨碾碎的敌人，永远无法回到正常生活。
挥动这把武器之前，为先民——那个连葬礼都没有的囚犯——表达哀悼或许是件好事。

key:
Bearing unlimited possibility to change humanity's future, confidential research began in the underground.
The dignity of a straitjacketed death row inmate wasn't something worth keeping intact, so no one felt guilty for him even as his brain rotted.
Now the straitjacket is nothing but an accessory to the hatred and anger that remains.
Employees who feel a constricting pain while wearing this suit must undergo a thorough psychological examination.
value:
怀着改变人类未来的无限可能，秘密研究在地下开始了。
一个身穿束缚衣的死刑犯的尊严并不值得保全，所以即使他的大脑腐烂了，也没人替他感到愧疚。
如今束缚衣不过是残留的憎恨与愤怒的附属品。
穿着这件护甲时感到绞痛的员工，必须接受彻底的心理检查。

key: Fragments from Somewhere
value: 某处的碎片

key:
Do not attempt to understand it, just use it.
The spear often tries to lead the wielder into a long and endless realm of mind, but they must try to not be swayed by it.
It took a different form every time it was produced, but we managed to stabilize the gestalt after a lot of effort and trouble.
There is a rumor that this spear emits a bright light when it hears an echo from another world.
value:
不要试图理解它，只用它就好。
这把长矛常常试图将装备者引入漫长无尽的精神领域，但他们必须努力不被它左右。
每次制作时它都呈现不同形态，但经过大量努力后我们终于稳定了这一完形。
有传言说，这把长矛听到来自另一个世界的回响时会发出明亮的光芒。

key:
Do not attempt to understand it, just use it.
Sometimes, the wielder may see things we have long forgotten.
However, the details of these cannot be specified, as each employee seems to see something different.
It took a different form every time it was produced, but we managed to stabilize the gestalt after a lot of effort and trouble.
value:
不要试图理解它，只用它就好。
有时，装备者会看到我们早已遗忘的事物。
然而，具体内容无法说明，因为每个员工看到的似乎都不同。
每次制作时它都呈现不同形态，但经过大量努力后我们终于稳定了这一完形。

key: Christmas
value: 圣诞

key:
It is patched with heavy leather of unknown origin.
The colorful leather pieces remind one of a festive holiday that is now long forgotten.
The stitches are carefully woven, but for whom or for what, exactly, is unclear.
It is not elegant, but you can feel the devotion of its creator.
What is truly under the leather is classified, but that secrecy only makes the weapon all the more powerful.
value:
它用来源不明的厚皮革打了补丁。
五颜六色的皮革碎片让人想起一个早已被遗忘的节日。
针脚细密，但究竟为谁、为何而缝，尚不清楚。
它并不优雅，但你能感受到制作者的虔诚。
皮革之下究竟是什么属于机密，但这份神秘感只会让武器更加强大。

key:
The colorful leather pieces remind one of a festive holiday that is now long forgotten.
The origin of the material cannot be disclosed to unauthorized personnel.
Does it still keep the dream of being a nice kid, deserving of gifts?
The wielder may feel an urge to give out gifts to random people.
value:
五颜六色的皮革碎片让人想起一个早已被遗忘的节日。
材料来源不得向未经授权的人员披露。
它是否仍怀着做个好孩子、配得上礼物的梦想？
装备者可能会产生向陌生人分发礼物的冲动。

key: Sanguine Desire
value: 血色欲望

key:
Its tenacity couldn't be exterminated even after the legs were cut off, and it bored its way through the woods to come back to us.
Most employees have heard a single word of the tragedy of the past.
The axe may seem light, but the wielder musn't forget that it has hurt countless people as a consequence of poor choices.
The weapon is stronger when used by an employee with strong conviction.
However, the moment you're blinded by desire, there is no way to wake up from the dreamlike throes of obsession.
value:
即使双腿被砍断，它的韧性也无法被消灭，它穿过树林回到了我们身边。
大多数员工都听说过那过去悲剧的只言片语。
这把斧头看似轻盈，但装备者切不可忘记，由于糟糕的选择，它已经伤害了无数人。
由信念坚定的员工使用时，这把武器更加强大。
然而，一旦你被欲望蒙蔽，就无法从那梦幻般的执念之苦中醒来。

key: Increases Max. and Min. Attack Power inversely proportional to wielder’s Temperance Level and take SP damage equal to 4% of Max. SP on each attack if wielder's Temperance level is less than 3.
value: 最大/最小攻击力与装备者节制等级成反比；若节制等级低于3，每次攻击受到相当于最大SP 4%的SP伤害

key:
Its tenacity couldn't be exterminated even after the legs were cut off, and it bored its way through the woods to come back to us.
The lace looks like it would fit with a formal dress, just as when it was worn by a girl in the distant past who had a beautiful smile.
Someday, she may make her way to a grand ballroom with bloody shoes on.
Make sure to stay alert so as not to repeat the tragedy.
value:
即使双腿被砍断，它的韧性也无法被消灭，它穿过树林回到了我们身边。
蕾丝看起来很配正式礼服，就像遥远过去那个笑容美丽的女孩所穿的那样。
总有一天，她会穿着血鞋走向宏伟的舞厅。
务必保持警惕，以免悲剧重演。

value: 研磨者Mk4

key:
The sharp sawtooth of the grinder makes a clean cut through its enemy.
Its operation is simple and straightforward, but that doesn't necessarily make it easy to wield.
As machines have no morals of their own, there was no clear boundary between good and evil.
This disregard for value is precisely reflected by the weapon’s reliable dicing force.
People used to be afraid of machines in the beginning, but a mechanical rebellion soon became a myth of the past in our world.
value:
研磨者锋利的锯齿干净利落地切开敌人。
它的操作简单直接，但这并不意味着它容易使用。
由于机器本身没有道德，善恶之间没有明确界限。
这种对价值的漠视，恰好体现在武器可靠的切割力上。
起初人们害怕机器，但机械叛乱在我们的世界里早已成为过去的神话。

key:
The otherwise sleek coat is covered with bloodstains of an unknown origin.
Some employees may brag about the bloodstain as a symbol of courage, but it has been there since the archetype was extracted.
Perhaps it is the commemoration of all the tragedies of the past and the future.
People used to be afraid of machines in the beginning, but a mechanical rebellion soon became a myth of the past in our world.
value:
原本光洁的外套上布满了来源不明的血迹。
有些员工可能会夸耀那血迹是勇气的象征，但它从原型被提取时就在那里了。
也许它是对过去和未来所有悲剧的纪念。
起初人们害怕机器，但机械叛乱在我们的世界里早已成为过去的神话。

key: Bear Paws
value: 熊爪

key:
The stuffing spilling out of it hangs miserably as if to represent the innocence that was forgotten over time.
Its adorable appearance makes it something that might even appeal to a child as a gift.
It's evident that using this equipment recklessly will cause it to tear, so extra caution is needed.
Some sympathetic employees felt sorry for it and asked for it to be repaired, however the outcome of the repairs was unforeseeable, so the proposal was rejected.
Do not underestimate the weapon’s power because of its fluffy exterior.
value:
从里面露出的填充物凄惨地垂着，仿佛代表着被时间遗忘的天真。
它可爱的外表使它甚至可能作为礼物吸引孩子。
显然鲁莽地使用这件装备会导致它撕裂，因此需要格外小心。
一些有同情心的员工为它感到难过，要求修理它，但修理结果不可预测，因此提议被拒绝了。
不要因为它毛茸茸的外表而低估武器的力量。

key:
The equipment is made of a material that may have been fluffy once, but now it just looks shabby.
As with any other E.G.O, any attempt to stitch it up is ill advised.
The memory that began with a warm embrace ended with abandonment.
The stuffing spilling out of it hangs miserably as if to represent the innocence that was forgotten over time.
value:
这件装备由一种曾经可能很柔软的材料制成，但现在看起来很破旧。
与其他E.G.O一样，任何缝合它的尝试都不明智。
一个从温暖拥抱开始的记忆，以被抛弃告终。
从里面露出的填充物凄惨地垂着，仿佛代表着被时间遗忘的天真。

value: 微笑

key:
It has the pale faces of nameless employees and a giant mouth on it.
Upon striking with the weapon, the monstrous mouth opens wide to devour the target, its hunger insatiable.
value:
它上面有无名员工苍白的面孔和一张巨大的嘴。
用武器打击时，那张巨口大张着吞噬目标，永远无法满足。

key:
The armor is studded with familiar faces. The wearer suddenly feels the weight of death.
The dead will protect the wearer from enemy attacks, so it should be okay to feel safe.
Rarely, a painful moan can be heard, but it's best to ignore it as there's nothing you can do for it.
value:
护甲上嵌着熟悉的面孔。穿戴者突然感到死亡的重量。
死者会保护穿戴者免受敌人攻击，因此大可以安心。
偶尔会听到痛苦的呻吟，但最好忽略它，因为你对此无能为力。

key: Recover HP when passing over an employee's dead body
value: 经过员工尸体时回复HP

key:
Each time an attack target dies, Fortitude and Justice will rise by 3
Decrease the target’s Movement Speed on normal attack
Decrease every enemy's Movement Speed in the same room on performing a special attack
value:
每次攻击目标死亡时，坚韧与正义 +3
普通攻击时降低目标移动速度
使用特殊攻击时降低同房间所有敌人的移动速度

key: Black Swan
value: 黑天鹅

key:
Believing that it would turn white, the black swan wanted to lift the curse by weaving together nettles. All that was left is a worn parasol it once treasured.
It yearned to have a dream it would never wake up from, but reality was cruel as ever.
value:
黑天鹅相信只要编织荨麻就能变回白色，从而解除诅咒。它所留下的只有一把曾经珍视的旧阳伞。
它渴望做一个永远不会醒来的梦，但现实一如既往地残酷。

key:
In the dense smoke, they lived from day to day, worn to a shadow.
Whenever she felt exhausted from the agony and struggle, she looked at her brooch, a memento of the past, to stifle her feelings.
The waterweed that grows under the dirty lake is as damp as a black swan's feathers.
value:
在浓烟中，他们苟延残喘，日渐消瘦。
每当她因痛苦和挣扎而精疲力竭时，她就看着胸针——一件过去的纪念物——来压抑情感。
肮脏湖底生长的水草像黑天鹅的羽毛一样潮湿。

key: When attacked, the damage has a chance of being reflected
value: 被攻击时，有几率反弹伤害

key: Ecstasy
value: 狂喜

key:
The armor's sleeve has sparse needle marks on it.
The colorful pattern is fancy, quite akin to a child's costume.
value:
护甲的袖子上有稀疏的针痕。
五颜六色的图案花里胡哨，很像小孩的戏服。

key: The colorful pattern is vivid, similar to a child's plaything.
value: 五颜六色的图案鲜艳夺目，像是孩子的玩物。

key: Gaze
value: 凝视

key:
The gaze from the keyhole is fixed on its target without ever stopping. No one knows what it wanted to peep at so dearly.
As long as this is equipped, ambush won't be a concern.
value:
钥匙孔中的目光牢牢锁定目标，从未停歇。没人知道它那么想看的究竟是什么。
只要装备这件武器，就不必担心伏击。

key: Exuviae
value: 蜕壳

key:
Its slippery surface may be disturbing to some employees, but its scales are multi-layered, suitable for protection against external threats.
Even if it is torn, its superior regenerative abilities will soon repair the damage.
value:
它滑腻的表面可能让某些员工感到不适，但它的鳞片是多层的，适合抵御外部威胁。
即使被撕裂，其优越的再生能力很快就会修复损伤。

key: The slick sensation when holding this E.G.O may disturb some employees.
value: 握持这件E.G.O时的滑腻感可能会打扰某些员工。

key: Heaven
value: 天堂

key:
Just contain it in your sight.
As it spreads its wings for an old god, a heaven just for you burrows its way.
value:
只需将它纳入你的视野。
当它为一位旧神展开翅膀时，一个专属于你的天堂便会破土而出。

key: Noise
value: 噪音

key:
Instead of a clear shape, its form is purely composed of an electromagnetic phenomenon.
When this E.G.O is equipped, various screams will resound along with an eerie ringing. The noises take you back to the very moment of the day that everyone had forgotten.
value:
它没有清晰的形状，形态完全由电磁现象构成。
装备这件E.G.O时，各种尖叫会伴随着诡异的铃声响起。那些声响将你带回所有人都已遗忘的那一天。

key: Logging
value: 采伐

key:
A versatile equipment made to cut down trees and people alike.
Perhaps sharpening the axe was the one thing it didn't neglect. The blade is always shiny.
value:
一种多功能装备，既可以砍树也可以砍人。
或许磨砺斧头是它唯一没有忽略的事。刀刃永远光亮。

key: Wingbeat
value: 振翅

key:
Graced by the fairies, the weapon radiates a pale light.
Despite its cute shape, the E.G.O. itself is rather heavy.
value:
受精灵祝福，这把武器散发出苍白的光芒。
尽管外形可爱，这件E.G.O本身却相当沉重。

key:
The sprouting wings are as mischievous as fairy pranks.
Those two pairs of flimsy wings will obviously never move. Wearing this E.G.O may make it easier to receive the care of the fairies.
value:
萌发的翅膀像精灵的恶作剧一样调皮。
那两对薄纱般的翅膀显然永远不会动。穿上这件E.G.O或许更容易得到精灵的照料。

key: Lantern
value: 提灯

key:
The luminous organ shines brilliantly, making it useful for lighting up the dark.
It's also great as a lure.
Though teeth sticking out of some spots of the equipment is a rather frightening sight.
value:
发光器官明亮闪耀，可用于照亮黑暗。
作为诱饵也很棒。
不过装备某些部位露出的牙齿相当吓人。

key: CENSORED
value: （已屏蔽）

key:
(CENSORED) has the ability to (CENSORED), but this is a horrendous sight for those watching.
Looking at the E.G.O for more than 3 seconds will make you sick.
value:
（已屏蔽）拥有（已屏蔽）的能力，但这对观看者来说是可怕的景象。
注视这件E.G.O超过3秒会让你感到恶心。

key: Recover 40% of damage taken when hit
value: 被击中时回复所受伤害的40%

key: Harvest
value: 收获

key:
The last legacy of the man who sought wisdom.
The rake tilled the human brain instead of farmland.
How many of the wise people among us have lost their lives to this rake?
value:
那位寻求智慧之人最后的遗产。
耙子犁的不是农田，而是人脑。
我们之中有多少智者死于这把耙子之下？

key: Diffraction
value: 衍射

key:
To see this E.G.O, one must thoroughly concentrate.
You can ignore the ridiculous advice that you can see it with your mind.
It may be in your best interest to calculate the radius when you swing, given that it is invisible.
Many employees have sustained injuries from erroneous calculation.
value:
要看到这件E.G.O，必须全神贯注。
你可以忽略"用心灵就能看到它"这种荒谬建议。
既然它是隐形的，挥舞时计算好半径或许符合你的最大利益。
许多员工因计算错误而受伤。

key: Our Galaxy
value: 我们的银河

key:
The pebble dropped into your hand sparkles, sways, tickles, and eventually becomes the universe.
“There's a universe inside a pebble. When the child cries, the stars in the galaxy light the void. In your universe, am I to be found?”
value:
落入你掌心的鹅卵石闪烁、摇曳、轻痒，最终化为宇宙。
"一颗鹅卵石里有一个宇宙。当孩子哭泣时，银河中的星光照亮虚空。在你的宇宙里，能找到我吗？"

key: Increase the amount of healing from the token of friendship
value: 增加友谊信物的回复量

key: Today’s Expression
value: 今日表情

key:
Many different expressions are padded on the equipment like patches.
The inability to show one's face is perhaps a form of shyness.
When throbbing emotions surge up from time to time, it's best to simply cover the face.
value:
装备上像补丁一样缝着许多不同的表情。
无法露出自己的面容或许是一种害羞。
当悸动的情感不时涌上来时，最好直接遮住脸。

key: Sound of a Star
value: 星之声

key:
The star shines brighter as our despair gathers.
The weapon's small, evocative sphere fires a warm ray.
In the light, everything is equal.
value:
我们的绝望越聚集，星星就越明亮。
武器上那个唤起回忆的小球发射出温暖的光线。
在光之下，万物平等。

key: Attack power adjusts in accordance with the employee's current SP status
value: 攻击力根据员工当前SP状态调整

key:
At the heart of the armor is a shard that emits an arcane gleam.
The gentle glow feels somehow more brilliant than a flashing light.
If you look carefully, you can see the place we will all have to return to someday.
value:
护甲中央是一块散发着神秘光芒的碎片。
那柔和的光芒不知为何比闪烁的灯光更加璀璨。
如果你仔细看，就能看到我们终有一天都要回去的地方。

key: Heal other employees in the same room every so often
value: 每隔一段时间治疗同房间的其他员工

key: Pleasure
value: 欢愉

key:
If you grasp for pleasure you cannot endure, you will end up losing yourself.
When the powder that falls from the thorns becomes known to the world, people may forever sink into the swamp of intoxication.
value:
如果你追求无法承受的欢愉，最终会失去自我。
当荆棘上落下的粉末被世人知晓，人们可能永远沉溺于陶醉的沼泽之中。

key: Can cause additional WHITE damage to target for a certain amount of time
value: 在一定时间内对目标造成额外WHITE伤害

key: Harmony
value: 和谐

key:
It may look like a deteriorating machine at first glance, but the music it makes captures its audience more than any other instrument could.
The wielder must dedicate himself in return.
After all, art is a devil's gift, born from despair and suffering.
Never stop performing until the body crumbles to dust.
value:
乍一看可能像一台破旧的机器，但它奏出的音乐比任何乐器都更能俘获听众。
装备者必须全身心投入作为回报。
毕竟，艺术是魔鬼的礼物，诞生于绝望与苦难之中。
在身体化为尘埃之前，永不停歇地演奏。

key: Increase weapon damage by 30% by consuming 10% of the wielder’s current HP when the wielder has more than 10% of their Max. HP
value: 当装备者最大HP高于10%时，消耗当前HP的10%，使武器伤害提升30%

key: Crimson Scar
value: 绯红伤痕

key:
With steel in one hand and gunpowder in the other, there's nothing to fear in this place.
It's more important to deliver a decisive strike in blind hatred without hesitation than to hold on to insecure courage.
Let's hope this ever-so-lovely fairy tale will come to an end someday.
value:
一手持钢，一手持火药，在这地方便无所畏惧。
与其抱住不确定的勇气，不如在盲目的憎恨中毫不犹豫地给予决定性一击。
希望这个如此可爱的童话终有一天会结束。

key:
Weapon damage +50% when the employee's HP is lower than 50%
However, if the employee attacks in that state, it may cause collateral damage to employees in range
value:
员工HP低于50%时，武器伤害 +50%
然而，若员工在该状态下攻击，可能会对范围内的员工造成附带伤害

key:
The wolf's death is the one and only thing the red-hooded mercenary can truly enjoy.
It seems only darkness awaits those who find the value of their lives in nothing but destruction.
Sometimes, it’s good to let go of old hatred, just let that weight off your shoulders.
value:
狼的死亡是红兜帽佣兵唯一能真正享受的事。
那些将生命价值仅寄托于毁灭之中的人，等待他们的似乎只有黑暗。
有时候，放下旧日的仇恨，让那份重担从肩上卸下也好。

key: Movement Speed +30% when suppressing
value: 镇压时移动速度 +30%

key: HP +2; Movement Speed +2; Attack Speed +2
value: HP +2；移动速度 +2；攻击速度 +2

key: Cobalt Scar
value: 钴蓝伤痕

key:
The weapon resembles the claws of a vicious wolf.
Once upon a time, these claws would cut open the bellies of numerous creatures and tear apart their guts.
It flays the target's flesh and makes them bleed nonstop.
value:
这把武器像恶狼的利爪。
曾几何时，这些利爪会剖开无数生物的腹部，撕碎它们的内脏。
它剥下目标的血肉，使其流血不止。

key:
Can cause additional RED damage for a certain amount of time
Weapon damage +50% when the employee's HP is less than 50%
However, if the employee attacks in that state, it may cause collateral damage to employees in range
value:
在一定时间内造成额外RED伤害
员工HP低于50%时，武器伤害 +50%
然而，若员工在该状态下攻击，可能会对范围内的员工造成附带伤害

key:
The armor is torn up with countless traces that recount the history of the unending battle.
As all wounds heal up and become nothing in the end, this equipment will dull the damages, even if it won't protect you from them completely.
value:
护甲上布满无数痕迹，诉说着无尽战斗的历史。
正如所有伤口最终都会愈合消失，这件装备即使不能完全保护你免受伤害，也能减轻损伤。

key: HP +4; Movement Speed +2; Attack Speed +2
value: HP +4；移动速度 +2；攻击速度 +2

key: Sheep’s Clothing
value: 羊皮外衣

key:
HP +9; SP -3
…That’s why I could slash the wolf’s belly, and return safely back here!
value:
HP +9；SP -3
……这就是为什么我能剖开狼的肚子，然后平安回到这里！

key: Spore
value: 孢子

key:
A spear covered in spores and affection.
It lights the employee's heart, shines like a star, and steadily tames them.
The longing is even more miserable as it is intangible.
value:
一杆覆盖着孢子与爱意的枪矛。
它点亮员工的心，如星辰般闪耀，稳步驯服他们。
正因这份渴望无形无质，才更加令人痛苦。

key: 25% chance to make the target more vulnerable to WHITE damage
value: 25%几率使目标对WHITE伤害更加脆弱

key:
“If you can only perceive the Abnormality as a giant mushroom, that's because you're seeing with clouded eyes.”
When stars light the night sky, its true form will be revealed.
For me, it has been a blessing to realize the hidden beauty of this gleam.
value:
"如果你只能把异想体看作一朵巨大的蘑菇，那是因为你用浑浊的眼睛在看。"
当星星照亮夜空时，它的真面目将显现。
对我而言，能领悟到这光芒中隐藏的美已是一种祝福。

key: Lamp
value: 灯

key:
For every creature it saved, Big Bird's eyes gained another in number.
The radiant pride is apparent on the armor.
Dozens of blazing eyes always stare into one spot.
value:
大鸟每拯救一个生物，眼睛就多出一只。
那件护甲上洋溢着耀眼的骄傲。
数十只灼热的眼睛始终凝视着同一个方向。

key:
Big Bird's eyes gained another in number for every creature it saved.
On this weapon, the radiant pride is apparent.
value:
大鸟每拯救一个生物，眼睛就多出一只。
这件武器上洋溢着耀眼的骄傲。

key: Twilight
value: 黄昏

key:
Just like how the ever-watching eyes, the scale that could measure any and all sin, and the beak that could swallow everything protected the peace of the Black Forest...
The wielder of this armament may also bring peace as they did.
value:
正如那永远注视的眼睛、能称量一切罪孽的天平、以及能吞噬万物的喙曾守护黑森林的和平……
这件装备的持有者或许也能像它们一样带来和平。

key:
Only equippable if the employee has Fortitude, Prudence, Temperance, and Justice above 110
Inflicts all four types of damage (R, W, B, and P) with special attack pattern at regular intervals
If an employee wears this equipment, Apocalypse Bird will be unable to appear
value:
仅可由坚韧、谨慎、节制、正义均高于110的员工装备
每隔一段时间以特殊攻击模式造成全部四种伤害（R、W、B、P）
若员工装备此护甲，天启鸟将无法出现

key:
The three birds united their efforts to defeat the beast.
This could stop countless incidents, but you’ll have to be prepared to step into the Black Forest…
value:
三只鸟合力击败了那头野兽。
这可以阻止无数事件，但你必须做好踏入黑森林的准备……

key:
The lower the HP of an employee with the corresponding weapon, the greater the damage
All enemies in the same room receive BLACK damage every 5 seconds
The effect of equipping all E.G.O parts of the Apocalypse Bird: The damage type of the special ability is extended to RWBP
If an employee wears this equipment, Apocalypse Bird will be unable to appear
value:
装备对应武器的员工HP越低，伤害越高
同房间所有敌人每5秒受到BLACK伤害
装备天启鸟全部E.G.O部件的效果：特殊能力的伤害类型扩展为RWBP
若员工装备此护甲，天启鸟将无法出现

key: Through the Dark Twilight
value: 穿越黑暗黄昏

key:
HP +7; SP +7; Success Rate +7; Work Speed +7; Movement Speed +7; Attack Speed +7
The twilight was endured, and we now face towards dawn. Has the birds' twittering in the forest finally stopped?
value:
HP +7；SP +7；成功率 +7；工作速度 +7；移动速度 +7；攻击速度 +7
我们熬过了黄昏，如今面向黎明。林中的鸟鸣终于停歇了吗？

key: Engulfing Dream
value: 吞噬之梦

key:
We must be awake at all times.
Not even sweet dreams in a sound sleep are allowed here; this weapon shall wake those who swim in such illusions.
And when the crying stops, dawn will break.
value:
我们必须时刻保持清醒。
就连沉睡中的美梦也不被允许；这把武器将唤醒那些沉溺于幻象之人。
当哭泣停止时，黎明便会到来。

key:
The soft wool is so warm and cozy, it makes you drowsy.
The more entrancing it is, the bigger the disappointment will be when dawn breaks.
The longing grows so deep when I wake at the crack of dawn, yet all I can do is wait for you with my eyes closed.
You, who will never come.
value:
柔软的羊毛温暖舒适，令人昏昏欲睡。
它越迷人，黎明到来时的失望就越大。
当我在黎明时分醒来，思念愈发深沉，可我只能闭着眼睛等你。
你啊，永远不会来了。

key: SP +4
value: SP +4

key: Cherry Blossoms
value: 樱花

key:
Petals scatter from the fan like afterimages, longing for the view of the flowers that withered away as soon as they bloomed.
The spring breeze clad in cherry blossom petals is still cold and painful.
Do not miss me, for I shall return as buds when winter leaves.
value:
花瓣如残影般从扇面散落，渴望着那绽放后随即凋零的花景。
裹着樱花瓣的春风依旧寒冷而刺痛。
不要思念我，因为当冬天离开时，我会以蓓蕾的形式归来。

key:
This E.G.O, fit for a flower viewing, makes the hearts of those who look at it flutter like a spring day.
When the cherry trees are in full bloom, let us take a rest from life by watching those petals scatter.
Sitting under the tree’s shadow makes you feel like these gloomy days will flutter away like the petals of a flower.
value:
这件适合赏花的E.G.O，让看到它的人心如春日般悸动。
当樱花盛开时，让我们从生活中歇一歇，看着花瓣飘落。
坐在树荫下，你会觉得这些阴郁的日子也会像花瓣一样飘然逝去。

key: In the Name of Love and Hate
value: 以爱与憎之名

key:
A magic wand surging with the lovely energy of a magical girl.
The holy light can cleanse the body and mind of every villain, and they shall be born anew.
Set ablaze, they won't want to wake up ever again.
The shape of love that wanted to protect everyone soon began to corrode the mind in the form of obsession.
When she tried to rectify it, everything was over.
value:
一根涌动着魔法少女可爱能量的魔杖。
圣光可以净化每个恶人的身心，他们将重获新生。
被点燃后，他们再也不想醒来。
那想要保护一切的爱的形态，很快便以执念的形式开始侵蚀心灵。
当她试图纠正时，一切都已结束。

key:
Each attack has a random damage type (R, W, B, or P)
Depending on the type of the damage, recover HP and SP of employees hit by the weapon’s projectiles
value:
每次攻击随机造成一种伤害类型（R、W、B或P）
根据伤害类型，回复被武器弹射物击中的员工的HP和SP

key:
A magical one-piece dress imbued with the love and justice of a magical girl.
Wearing it may ignite your spirit of justice and the desire to protect the world.
Then you'll hear the sound of hatred, sinking deeper than love.
What to do?
She vowed to love everything in the world, but all that was left was a collapsing heart.
value:
一件注入了魔法少女爱与正义的连体裙。
穿上它可能会点燃你的正义精神和保护世界的欲望。
然后你会听到憎恨的声音，比爱沉得更深。
该怎么办？
她曾发誓爱世间万物，但最后只剩下一颗崩塌的心。

key: Discord
value: 不和

key:
A falchion edge shadowed by the world's discord.
Every life is trapped in the cycle of reincarnation.
The power of birth, and the power of death. Those powers are neither good nor evil; they are just the way life is.
value:
一把被世间不和阴影笼罩的弯刀。
每个生命都被困在轮回之中。
生之力，与死之力。这些力量既非善也非恶；它们就是生命本来的样子。

key:
A coat shadowed by the world's discord. This shade protects the wearer from various external harm.
However, all damage that is blocked by it may be inflicted on someone else somewhere in the world, for everything must stay in balance.
value:
一件被世间不和阴影笼罩的外套。这阴影保护穿戴者免受各种外部伤害。
然而，被它挡下的所有伤害可能会施加给世界上其他某个地方的人，因为万物必须保持平衡。

key: Feather of Honor
value: 荣耀之羽

key:
The feather strikes with vivid flame.
It is not weak, nor faint.
The flame pierces the body and melts the frost of the heart.
It is the Firebird’s wish that people do not forever lose their passion.
value:
羽毛以鲜艳的火焰击打。
它不弱，也不微弱。
火焰穿透身体，融化心中的寒霜。
火鸟的愿望是人们不要永远失去热情。

key:
The flame could not reach the heart before combustion ended.
It is bright as if it were burning, but once you touch it, you will realize that it is not hot at all.
Burn yourself in awe.
value:
火焰在燃烧结束前无法抵达心脏。
它明亮得像在燃烧，但一旦触摸，你会发现它一点也不热。
在敬畏中燃烧自己吧。

key: Paradise Lost
value: 失乐园

key: Behold: you stood at the door and knocked, and it was opened to you. I come from the end, and I am here to stay for but a moment. At the same time, I am the one who kindled the light to face the world. My loved ones, who now eagerly desire the greater gifts; I will show you the most excellent way.
value: 看哪：你站在门前叩门，门就为你开了。 我来自终结，在此只作短暂停留。 与此同时，我那点燃了光明以面对世界的人。 我的挚爱们啊，如今你们热切渴望更美的恩赐；我将指给你们那至善的道路。

key: My loved ones, do not worry; I have heard your prayers. Have you not yet realized that pain is but a speck to a determined mind? You pray unto me to prove my miracles. That you may believe in me, and that by believing you may have life in my name; I shall show you the power.
value: 我的挚爱们啊，不要忧虑；我已听到你们的祈祷。 你们还不明白吗，对于坚定的心灵而言，痛苦不过微尘？ 你们向我祈祷，要我彰显奇迹。 好让你们信我，且因信得生；我要将权能显给你们看。

key:

value: 粉色

key:
Pink is considered to be the color of warmth and love, but is that true?
Can guns really bring peace and love?
value:
粉色被认为是温暖与爱的颜色，但真的是这样吗？
枪真的能带来和平与爱吗？

key:
A pink military uniform.
Its pockets allow the wearer to carry various types of ammunition.
It soothes the wearer; they say pink provides psychological comfort to many people.
value:
一套粉色军装。
口袋让穿戴者可以携带各种弹药。
它抚慰穿戴者；据说粉色能给许多人带来心理安慰。

装备对应异想体护甲时，该异想体武器伤害 +15%

key: SO CUTE!!!
value: 好可爱!!!

key:
One may think, “How can a weapon drawn from such a cute Abnormality be any good?”
However, the claws are actually quite durable and sharp.
Beware that the beast inside you may awaken if you use this weapon too much...
Oh but the soft jelly-like pawbs feel vewwy nice to touch.
value:
有人可能会想："从这么可爱的异想体里提取的武器能好到哪去？"
然而，这些爪子实际上相当耐用且锋利。
小心，如果你过度使用这把武器，你内心的野兽可能会觉醒……
不过那软弹弹的肉垫摸起来确实超舒服的。

key: Amita
value: 阿弥陀

key:
A cane used by monks for when they travel away from their temple.
It is commonly used to measure the depth of a body of water or to drive animals or insects away.
The rings attached to the cane represent the middle way and the Six Paramitas.
Anyone can become a Buddha by washing away the anguish and delusion in their heart.
At least, that was what he wanted to believe.
value:
一根僧侣远行时使用的手杖。
通常用于测量水深或驱赶虫兽。
手杖上的环代表中道与六度。
任何人都能通过洗去心中的苦恼与妄念而成佛。
至少，他愿意如此相信。

key:
The old and ragged robes of a monk that shows his dedication.
This plain and simple wear, worn with patches is a sign of the monk’s practice of asceticism.
You can smell old dirt and fire if you put your nose close enough.
value:
僧侣破旧的长袍，彰显着他的虔诚。
这件打满补丁的朴素衣着是僧侣苦行修行的标志。
把鼻子凑近些，你能闻到旧尘与火的味道。

key: Adoration
value: 爱慕

key:
A big mug filled with mysterious slime that never runs out.
It’s the byproduct of some horrid experiment in a certain laboratory that eventually failed.
People who touch this slime complain of a strange sensation on their skin, but it won’t stop there.
value:
一个大杯子，里面装满永远用不完的神秘黏液。
那是某个实验室最终失败的可怕实验的副产品。
接触这黏液的人会抱怨皮肤上有种奇怪的感觉，但事情不会就此结束。

key:
Reduces the Movement Speed of the target by 30% for 3 seconds
Target takes additional B damage for a certain amount of time
value:
使目标移动速度降低30%，持续3秒
在一定时间内目标受到额外B伤害

key:
It is not as unpleasant to wear as it is to look at.
In fact, it seems to give you an illusion of comfort and bravery.
Be cautious because once you get too used to keeping the suit on, the viscosity of the slime might hold onto the wearer and become too sticky to let go.
value:
它穿起来不像看起来那么难受。
事实上，它似乎给你一种舒适与勇敢的错觉。
要小心，一旦你太习惯穿着这件护甲，黏液的粘性可能会抓住穿戴者，黏得无法挣脱。

key: Hypocrisy
value: 伪善

key:
All things natural are bound to turn to dust someday.
Thus, this evergreen crossbow has to be far apart from mother nature.
The tree turned out to be riddled with hypocrisy and deception; those who wear its blessing act in the name of bravery and faith.
However, be warned that nature does not know the difference between a blessing and a curse.
value:
一切自然之物终有一天都会化为尘土。
因此，这把常青藤弩必须远离大自然。
那棵树原来充满了伪善与欺骗；穿着它祝福的人以勇气与信仰之名行事。
然而请注意，大自然并不区分祝福与诅咒。

key: Moonlight
value: 月光

key:
A cane for outdoor activity; one of the mementos of a lady who dedicated her soul to a sonata that remained at her deathbed when she flew to the moon.
The serpentine ornament is loyal to the original owner’s taste.
The snake’s open mouth represents the endless yearning for music.
It temporarily invites the user to the world of trance.
value:
一根用于户外活动的手杖；属于那位将灵魂奉献给奏鸣曲、在飞向月亮时仍把曲子留在病榻上的女士的遗物之一。
蛇形装饰忠实于原主人的品味。
蛇张开的嘴代表对音乐无尽的渴望。
它暂时将使用者引入恍惚之境。

key: Would you like to expand {0}?
value: 是否扩建{0}？

key: Good day, manager! Would you like to expand the Control Department?
value: 日安，主管！您要扩建控制部吗？

key: Hello manager! Each day you will need to expand one department! Are you ready to open up the Control Department and begin managing Abnormalities?
value: 你好，主管！每天您都需要扩建一个部门！准备好开放控制部，开始管理异想体了吗？

key: Greetings manager. Would you like to expand the Information Department and prepare for management?
value: 您好，主管。您要扩建情报部并准备开始管理吗？

key: I am in charge of the Information Team and its department. I'll give you a proper greeting later. Are you planning to open up the Information Department before starting the day?
value: 我负责情报组及其部门。稍后我会正式问候您。您打算在开始本日工作前开放情报部吗？

key: Hey, you sure you wanna expand Safety before the day starts?
value: 嘿，你确定要在开始今天工作前扩建安保部？

key: Hey, I’m, uh… the guy in charge of the Safety Team. We can exchange names later. Wanna open up my department and skip over to managing?
value: 嘿，我是……呃……负责安保组的。我们稍后再交换名字。要开放我的部门开始管理吗？

key: Do you want to expand the Training Department and get going with management? I’m sure it’ll be very useful, manager!
value: 您要扩建培训部开始管理工作吗？相信这会很有用的，主管！

key: Hello manager, I’m in charge of the Training Team! Are you thinking of opening up my department today?
value: 你好，主管，我负责培训组！你今天打算开放我的部门吗？

key: So are you going to expand the Central Command Department today?
value: 那你今天要扩建中央本部吗？

key: Good day manager, we are in charge of the Central Command Team. Will our department be opened up today?
value: 日安，主管，我们负责中央本部组。我们的部门今天会开放吗？

key: Thinking of expanding Disciplinary today? If you are, let’s do it quickly.
value: 今天想扩建惩戒部？如果是的话，我们快点吧。

key: I’m the head of Disciplinary. You opening up my department today?
value: 我是惩戒部的负责人。你今天开放我的部门吗？

key: Gonna expand Welfare today and head onto managing the Abnormalities? Don’t worry, I’m not pushing you or anything. Just chill and take your time…
value: 今天要扩建福利部开始管理异想体吗？别担心，我不是在催你。放轻松，慢慢来……

key: Morning to you, my good manager sir. I’m in charge of Welfare. Are you going to be opening up my department today?
value: 早上好，我亲爱的主管先生。我负责福利部。您今天要开放我的部门吗？

key: So you desire to broaden the Extraction Department?
value: 您想要扩建研发部吗？

key: How nice to see you again. As you can see, I’ve been placed as the leader of the Extraction Team. I’m sure we’ll meet again soon.
value: 很高兴再次见到您。如您所见，我已被任命为研发组的负责人。相信我们很快还会再见的。

key: Hello again. Will you be unfolding more of the Records Team?
value: 又见面了。您要开放更多记录组的区域吗？

key: Good morning. Here is where the Records Department will be situated, if you decide to open it. In this place, we record and control everything.
value: 早上好。如果您决定开放记录部，这里就是它的所在地。在这里，我们记录并控制一切。

key: Your Goal as the Manager
value: 你作为主管的目标

key: 1. You are in the role of the manager of Lobotomy Corporation.
value: 1. 你将担任脑叶公司的主管。

key: 2. Your job is to safely manage Abnormalities and produce an energy source known as ‘Enkephalin’.
value: 2. 你的工作是安全管理异想体，并生产一种名为"脑啡肽"的能源。

key: 3. You will have a daily quota that must be met each day in order to progress onto the next day.
value: 3. 每天你都有一个必须完成的配额，才能进入下一天。

key: The Agents are your subordinates, who follow your orders to work with Abnormalities. They are your hands, so to speak.
value: 员工是你的下属，听从你的指令与异想体互动。可以说，他们就是你的双手。

key: Agent Virtues
value: 员工四美德

key: The ‘HP’ of your Agents will increase as their Fortitude increases. An Agent’s Fortitude will increase any time they perform Instinct Work.
value: 员工的"HP"会随着坚韧提升而增加。员工每次进行本能工作时，坚韧都会提升。

key: HP (Health Points): The physical strength and vitality of an Agent; if this drops to zero, they will die.
value: HP（生命值）：员工的体力与活力；若降为零，他们就会死亡。

key: The ‘SP’ of your Agents will increase as their Prudence increases. An Agent’s Prudence will increase any time they perform Insight Work.
value: 员工的"SP"会随着谨慎提升而增加。员工每次进行洞察工作时，谨慎都会提升。

key: SP (Sanity Points): The mental strength and stability of an Agent; if this drops to zero, they will panic.
value: SP（精神值）：员工的精神力量与稳定性；若降为零，他们就会陷入恐慌。

key: The ‘Work Speed’ and ‘Success Rate’ of your Agents will increase as their Temperance increases. An Agent’s Temperance will increase any time they perform Attachment Work.
value: 员工的"工作速度"和"成功率"会随着节制提升而增加。员工每次进行依附工作时，节制都会提升。

key: Work Speed: The rate at which an Agent completes the Work Process with an Abnormality.
value: 工作速度：员工完成与异想体工作流程的速率。

key: Success Rate: The ability of an Agent to succeed in their work, produce more Positive Enkephalin, and take less damage during the Work Process.
value: 成功率：员工成功完成工作、产出更多正向脑啡肽、并在工作流程中受到更少伤害的能力。

key: The ‘Attack Speed’ and ‘Movement Speed’ of your Agents will increase as their Justice increases. An Agent’s Justice will increase any time they perform Repression Work.
value: 员工的"攻击速度"和"移动速度"会随着正义提升而增加。员工每次进行压迫工作时，正义都会提升。

key: Attack Speed: The rate at which an Agent attacks with their equipped E.G.O.
value: 攻击速度：员工使用装备的E.G.O进行攻击的速率。

key: Movement Speed: The speed at which an Agent moves from one place to another.
value: 移动速度：员工从一处移动到另一处的速度。

key: Agent Levels
value: 员工等级

key: Agents begin at Level 1 and can be promoted up to Level 5. The higher an Agent’s level, the greater skill and Virtues they have.
value: 员工初始为1级，最高可晋升至5级。员工等级越高，技能和美德越强。

key: Each Virtue also has a Level from 1 to 5.
value: 每项美德也有1至5级。

key: Agent Promotions
value: 员工晋升

key: When stats rise to a certain threshold from working, the level of their Virtue will increase at the end of the day.
value: 当属性因工作提升到一定阈值时，美德等级会在当日结束时提升。

key: The level of a Virtue corresponds to the level of the related Work the Agent can do.
value: 美德等级对应员工可进行的相关工作等级。

key: The Agent’s level is based on the sum of the levels of their Virtues; an Agent’s level will increase alongside their Virtues.
value: 员工等级基于其美德等级之和；员工等级会随美德一同提升。

key: Work Types
value: 工作类型

key: There are four (4) types of Work that can be performed with the Abnormalities. For each individual Abnormality, you will need to find the most appropriate type of Work, and steadily proceed to produce energy.
value: 与异想体共有四(4)种工作。对于每个异想体，你需要找到最合适的工作类型，稳步推进以产出能源。

key: A work to satiate physiological needs; it requires physical contact. As it involves touching the Abnormality frequently, Agents will need to display a high level of bravery and Fortitude to perform high level Instinct Work. Employees who conduct this work will benefit from increased HP.
value: 一种满足生理需求的工作；需要身体接触。由于频繁接触异想体，员工需要展现出高度的勇气与坚韧才能进行高等级本能工作。进行此项工作的员工将获得HP提升。

key: A work to improve the Abnormality’s living conditions. As it involves realizing what environment each Abnormality favors the most and making appropriate adjustments to ensure optimal conditions, meticulous observation is required; Agents need to show a high level of intellect and Prudence to perform high level Insight Work. Employees who conduct this work will benefit from increased SP.
value: 一种改善异想体居住环境的工作。由于需要了解每个异想体最喜欢的环境并做出适当调整以确保最佳条件，需要细致观察；员工需要展现出高度的智力与谨慎才能进行高等级洞察工作。进行此项工作的员工将获得SP提升。

key: A work to satiate social needs. All Abnormalities carry desires and a will, and as such social needs are included. As this work involves acting as a playmate or companion, great care is required as only limited interaction is allowed; to avoid crossing the line, Agents need to show a high level of caution and Temperance to perform high level Attachment Work. Employees who conduct this work will benefit from increased Work Speed and Success Rates.
value: 一种满足社交需求的工作。所有异想体都有欲望和意志，因此也有社交需求。由于这项工作涉及扮演玩伴或同伴，需要格外小心，因为只允许有限的互动；为了避免越界，员工需要展现出高度的谨慎与节制才能进行高等级依附工作。进行此项工作的员工将获得工作速度和成功率提升。

key: A work to restrain existence. While the other works focus on handling desires, this one stifles them. As this work involves regulating various emotions and desires, careful and objective decision making as well as strong rationality is needed to control the pace of the work; Agents need to show a high level of Justice—the ability to make definite judgements—to perform high level Repression work. Employees who conduct this work will benefit from increased Attack and Movement Speed.
value: 一种压制存在的工作。其他工作专注于处理欲望，而这项工作则是扼杀欲望。由于这项工作涉及调节各种情绪和欲望，需要谨慎客观的决策以及强大的理性来控制工作节奏；员工需要展现出高度的正义——即做出明确判断的能力——才能进行高等级压迫工作。进行此项工作的员工将获得攻击和移动速度提升。

key: Abnormalities are entities that emerge from the depths of humanity’s deep and ancient dreams: the Collective Unconscious. We can extract Enkephalin from them with careful and appropriate management.
value: 异想体是从人类深邃古老的梦境——集体无意识——深处浮现的实体。通过谨慎恰当的管理，我们可以从中提取脑啡肽。

key: Please be aware that no Abnormality can ever truly be considered safe.
value: 请注意，没有任何异想体可以被认为是真正安全的。

key: Please refer to the Risk Level titles below when managing Abnormalities.
value: 管理异想体时请参考下方的风险等级标题。

key: A Containment Unit
value: 一个收容单元

key: With little to no aggression, ZAYIN Abnormalities will cause the least harm to your Agents. Their damage tends to be minuscule, and they may have a positive effect on the employees.
value: ZAYIN异想体攻击性极低，对你的员工造成的伤害最小。它们的伤害往往微乎其微，甚至可能对员工产生正面影响。

key: These Abnormalities can inflict varying degrees of injury to your employees. However, as long as your employees follow the proper managerial guidelines, they will not cause much damage.
value: 这些异想体会对你的员工造成不同程度的伤害。然而，只要你的员工遵循正确的管理指南，它们就不会造成太大破坏。

key: Abnormalities of this class can easily kill a number of employees. You will have to pay twice as much attention as you do for a ZAYIN or TETH. If the situation goes wrong, several employees could be lost in bloodshed. There’s no need to be concerned though; with your excellent management, they will be in control.
value: 此等级的异想体可以轻易杀死多名员工。你必须比对待ZAYIN或TETH加倍注意。如果情况失控，可能会有多名员工在血泊中丧生。不过不必担心；以你出色的管理能力，它们会在掌控之中。

key: These are high risk and carry devastating force. Most will be hostile toward employees, and the death toll could reach into the dozens.
value: 这些风险极高，拥有毁灭性的力量。大多数会对员工抱有敌意，死亡人数可能达到数十人。

key: The most dangerous. You should devote as much concentration and attention as possible to this Risk Level. You’ll be thankful if the Abnormality is suppressed without ravaging entire departments. (Please do not take our warning as an exaggeration.)
value: 最危险的。你应该为此风险等级投入尽可能多的专注力和注意力。如果异想体没有摧毁整个部门就被镇压，你就该谢天谢地了。（请不要把我们的警告当成夸张。）

key: Attack Types
value: 攻击类型

key: The Abnormalities have four types of attacks:
value: 异想体有四种攻击类型：

key: RED
value: RED

key: This type relates to physical damage. When RED damage is dealt, the HP of the receiver will be reduced.
value: 此类型与物理伤害相关。受到RED伤害时，接收者的HP会减少。

key: WHITE
value: WHITE

key: While RED represents physical damage, WHITE represents psychological damage. When WHITE damage is dealt, the SP of the employee on the receiving end will be reduced.
value: RED代表物理伤害，WHITE则代表精神伤害。受到WHITE伤害时，接收方员工的SP会减少。

key: BLACK
value: BLACK

key: A complex of physical and psychological damages. When BLACK damage is dealt, both the HP and SP of the employee on the receiving end will be reduced.
value: 物理与精神伤害的复合。受到BLACK伤害时，接收方员工的HP和SP都会减少。

key: PALE
value: PALE

key: Death itself. PALE shaves away the soul. Even the toughest body and wisest mind will not matter; all are equal in the face of death. When PALE damage is dealt, HP will be reduced in proportion to the maximum HP of the employee on the receiving end.
value: 死亡本身。PALE削去灵魂。再强健的身体和再睿智的心灵都无济于事；在死亡面前人人平等。受到PALE伤害时，HP将按接收方员工最大HP的比例减少。

key: E.G.O
value: E.G.O

key: E.G.O (Extermination of Geometrical Organ) refers to the equipment produced to confront Abnormalities.
value: E.G.O（灭杀几何器官）指为对抗异想体而制作的装备。

key: We have E.G.O Weapons as a means of offense, and E.G.O Suits as defensive equipment.
value: 我们有E.G.O武器作为攻击手段，以及E.G.O护甲作为防御装备。

key: E.G.O can be extracted from Abnormalities that have been managed up to a certain Observation Level.
value: E.G.O可以从观察等级达到一定程度的异想体中提取。

key: As E.G.O is forged using “archetypes” extracted from Abnormalities, they can inflict or resist RWBP damage types, which cannot be reproduced normally.
value: 由于E.G.O使用从异想体提取的"原型"锻造，它们可以造成或抵抗正常情况下无法复制的RWBP伤害类型。

key: Each E.G.O has a grade from ZAYIN to ALEPH. One thing you should know is that the higher the E.G.O’s grade, the more effective it becomes. E.G.O with a higher grade will have higher attack and defense power against certain attack types.
value: 每件E.G.O都有一个从ZAYIN到ALEPH的等级。你需要知道的是，E.G.O等级越高，效果越强。高等级E.G.O对特定攻击类型有更高的攻防能力。

key: The ATK - DEF Mechanism
value: 攻防机制

key: E.G.O with a high grade will benefit from increased damage and defense against Abnormalities of a lower risk level.
value: 高等级E.G.O对低风险等级异想体造成的伤害和防御都会提升。

key: Conversely, E.G.O with a low grade will deal less and take more damage against an Abnormality with a high risk level.
value: 反之，低等级E.G.O对高风险等级异想体造成的伤害更少，受到的伤害更多。

key: Deployment UI
value: 部署界面

key: Viewing Highest Level Ordeal
value: 查看最高等级考验

key: Here you will be able to see the highest level of Ordeal that may appear during the current workday.
value: 在这里你可以看到当前工作日可能出现的最高等级考验。

key: Ordeals will manifest as the workday progresses.
value: 考验将随着工作日推进而显现。

key: LOB Points
value: LOB点数

key: LOB are points you will acquire as you complete each day.
value: LOB是你完成每一天后获得的点数。

key: LOB is used for hiring and fortifying Agents.
value: LOB用于雇佣和强化员工。

key: The E.G.O List
value: E.G.O列表

key: This button will open the E.G.O List.
value: 此按钮将打开E.G.O列表。

key: Hiring
value: 雇佣

key: This button is for hiring new Agents.
value: 此按钮用于雇佣新员工。

key: Missions
value: 任务

key: Each department will display the missions that can be attempted for the day.
value: 每个部门将显示当日可挑战的任务。

key: If you clear a department’s mission, you will be able to conduct specialized research projects.
value: 如果你完成了部门的任务，就可以进行专项研究项目。

key: Contained Abnormalities
value: 已收容异想体

key: Here you will see the Abnormalities currently placed within the department.
value: 在这里你可以看到当前部署在部门内的异想体。

key: Abnormalities whose Encyclopedias do not yet have Basic Information unlocked will be displayed as a question mark (?).
value: 图鉴尚未解锁基本信息的异想体将显示为问号（?）。

key: Department Description
value: 部门描述

key: This button will allow you to view the description and role that pertain to the department and its team.
value: 此按钮允许你查看与部门及其团队相关的描述和职能。

key: Research
value: 研究

key: This button will allow you to view the completed research projects of the department.
value: 此按钮允许你查看部门已完成的研究项目。

key: Research will be very helpful for Abnormality management.
value: 研究对异想体管理非常有帮助。

key: You can hire a new Agent by clicking the HIRE button.
value: 你可以通过点击雇佣按钮来雇佣新员工。

key: To hire a default random employee, simply click the HIRE button again.
value: 要雇佣默认随机员工，只需再次点击雇佣按钮。

key: Default employees only require 1 LOB to be hired.
value: 默认员工雇佣仅需1 LOB。

key: Changing Virtue Levels
value: 调整美德等级

key: You can adjust the level of each Virtue by clicking on the arrows.
value: 你可以通过点击箭头调整每项美德的等级。

key: Additional LOB will be charged for raising a Virtue level.
value: 提升美德等级将消耗额外的LOB。

key: Higher Virtue levels will require more LOB.
value: 美德等级越高，所需LOB越多。

key: Customizing Appearance
value: 自定义外观

key: You can spend an additional 1 LOB to customize the appearance of a new hire.
value: 你可以花费额外1 LOB来自定义新雇佣员工的外观。

key: Agents who are already a part of your facility can be fortified using LOB by clicking this button.
value: 已在设施内的员工可以通过点击此按钮使用LOB进行强化。

key: Deployed and undeployed Agents can be clicked on to view more information.
value: 点击已部署和未部署的员工可查看更多信息。

key: Fortifying an already hired Agent uses the same menu as adjusting the Virtue levels of a new hire.
value: 强化已雇佣员工使用与调整新员工美德等级相同的菜单。

key: You can open the E.G.O List by simply clicking on the corresponding button.
value: 你只需点击对应按钮即可打开E.G.O列表。

key: E.G.O Weapons are equipment that enhance one's offensive capabilities.
value: E.G.O武器是强化攻击能力的装备。

key: The RWBP type of the E.G.O
value: E.G.O的RWBP类型

key: The range of possible damage values the E.G.O can inflict
value: E.G.O可造成的伤害值范围

key: The speed at which attacks are delivered
value: 攻击的速度

key: Attack Range
value: 攻击距离

key: The distance necessary to land a blow with the E.G.O
value: 使用E.G.O击中目标所需的距离

key: E.G.O Suits are equipment that enhance one's defensive capabilities.
value: E.G.O护甲是强化防御能力的装备。

key: The E.G.O’s defensive multiplier against each attack type
value: E.G.O对各攻击类型的防御倍率

key: If the multiplier is lower than 1.0, then the E.G.O will be effective against the corresponding attack type
value: 若倍率低于1.0，则E.GO对对应攻击类型有效

key: Likewise, if it is higher than 1.0, then the E.G.O will be vulnerable against the corresponding attack type
value: 同样，若倍率高于1.0，则E.G.O对对应攻击类型脆弱

key: E.G.O Sorting
value: E.G.O排序

key: You can view E.G.O of a specific grade by clicking on the grade’s corresponding tab.
value: 你可以通过点击对应等级标签来查看特定等级的E.G.O。

key: This will display the detailed descriptions and any special abilities of the E.G.O.
value: 这里将显示E.G.O的详细描述和特殊能力。

key: Some E.G.O may require certain Virtue levels or general Agent level.
value: 某些E.G.O可能需要特定美德等级或员工总等级。

key: E.G.O Gifts
value: E.G.O饰品

key: Agents have a chance to acquire this form of E.G.O upon completion of a Work Process, or occasionally, via the fulfilment of special criteria. It will affect the various stats of an Agent.
value: 员工有几率在完成工作流程后获得这种E.G.O，或偶尔通过满足特殊条件获得。它会影响员工的各项属性。

key: Select the facility Layer.
value: 选择设施楼层。

key: Select the desired Agent.
value: 选择想要的员工。

key: Click on an E.G.O slot. The E.G.O cannot be equipped if the Agent does not meet the requirements.
value: 点击E.G.O槽位。若员工不满足条件，则无法装备E.G.O。

key: Here you will be able to see the E.G.O the Agent has currently equipped.
value: 在这里你可以看到员工当前装备的E.G.O。

key: Deploying Employees
value: 部署员工

key: Click and hold on an Agent.
value: 点击并按住一名员工。

key: Drag and drop the Agent onto the department in which you wish to deploy them.
value: 将员工拖拽到你希望部署的部门上。

key: Management UI
value: 管理界面

key: PE-Box Quota
value: PE-Box配额

key: To complete the day, you must gather the specified amount of PE-Boxes. This gauge will fill each time PE-Boxes are produced after the completion of a Work Process with an Abnormality.
value: 要完成当日，你必须收集指定数量的PE-Box。每次与异想体完成工作流程后产出PE-Box时，此计量条就会填充。

key: The Qliphoth Meltdown Gauge
value: 逆卡巴拉熔毁计量条

key: This gauge predicts the next upcoming Qliphoth Meltdown; it represents the passage of time through the workday’s various Qliphoth Meltdowns and Ordeals. Every time an Agent enters a Containment Unit to begin work, this gauge will increase by 1 tick. If the gauge is completely filled, a Qliphoth Meltdown will occur, or an Ordeal will manifest.
value: 此计量条预测下一次即将发生的逆卡巴拉熔毁；它代表工作日中各种逆卡巴拉熔毁和考验的时间推进。每次员工进入收容单元开始工作时，此计量条增加1格。若计量条完全填满，将发生逆卡巴拉熔毁，或显现考验。

key: Mission List
value: 任务列表

key: This is your list of missions that can be attempted during the workday.
value: 这是你当日可挑战的任务列表。

key: Speed Adjustment
value: 速度调节

key: These buttons can be used to pause and control the flow of time in the facility.
value: 这些按钮可用于暂停和控制设施内的时间流速。

key: The Work Log
value: 工作日志

key: This will display the history of work that has been done through the course of the day, along with casualties and panics.
value: 这里将显示当日已完成的工作历史，以及伤亡和恐慌情况。

key: Department Regenerator Gauge
value: 部门回复计量条

key: Whenever this gauge fills, the HP and SP of the employees in the Main Room of the department will be restored. However, this gauge will not function while an Abnormality is present in the room.
value: 每次此计量条填满时，部门主房间内员工的HP和SP将被回复。然而，当房间内有异想体时，此计量条不生效。

key: Basic Controls
value: 基本操作

key: Camera Controls
value: 镜头控制

key: You can use the Right Mouse Button to click and drag the camera’s position.
value: 你可以使用鼠标右键点击并拖拽来移动镜头位置。

key: The WASD Keys can be used to move the camera towards the corresponding positions.
value: WASD键可用于将镜头向对应方向移动。

key: The camera can be zoomed in and out with the Mouse Wheel. (The F and G Keys can also be used.)
value: 镜头可以用鼠标滚轮缩放。（F和G键也可使用。）

key: Time Controls
value: 时间控制

key: Slow Time: Q
value: 减速时间：Q

key: Accelerate Time: E
value: 加速时间：E

key: Pause Time: SPACEBAR
value: 暂停时间：空格键

key: Agents can still receive orders while time is on pause, and will follow them once it resumes.
value: 暂停时间时员工仍可接收指令，并在时间恢复后执行。

key: Viewing Agent Info
value: 查看员工信息

key: You can see the relevant information of an Agent by hovering the mouse cursor over them. If you click on the Agent, the UI that displays the info will be affixed until something else is clicked on.
value: 将鼠标悬停在员工身上即可查看其相关信息。点击员工后，信息界面将固定显示，直到点击其他地方。

key: Click on an Agent you wish to move. If you desire to move a group of Agents, click and drag to select them.
value: 点击你想移动的员工。若想移动一组员工，点击并拖拽进行框选。

key: With the selected Agent(s), right-click the location for them to move to.
value: 选中员工后，右键点击他们要移动到的位置。

key: Recalling Agents
value: 召回员工

key: This button will recall Agents who are not in the Main Room of the department back to it. (This function needs to be unlocked via the corresponding Control Team research.)
value: 此按钮将把不在部门主房间的员工召回主房间。（此功能需要通过对应的控制部研究解锁。）

key: The Order UI
value: 指令界面

key: Abnormality Risk Level
value: 异想体风险等级

key: The maximum number of E-Boxes that can be produced per Work with the Abnormality.
value: 每次与该异想体工作可产出的最大E-Box数量。

key: Different work result ranges according to PE-Box count.
value: 根据PE-Box数量的不同工作结果范围。

key: Attack type and damage range during work.
value: 工作期间的攻击类型和伤害范围。

key: Department Agent List (To have employees work in departments other than their own, the corresponding Control Team research will need to be completed.)
value: 部门员工列表（要让员工在其他部门工作，需要完成对应的控制部研究。）

key: Employee Info
value: 员工信息

key: The likelihood of producing PE-Boxes.
value: 产出PE-Box的可能性。

key: The amount of time it will take the Agent to complete the Work Process.
value: 员工完成工作流程所需的时间。

key: Step 1: Left Click on the Containment Unit
value: 步骤1：左键点击收容单元

key: Step 2: Select the Work Type
value: 步骤2：选择工作类型

key: Step 3: Choose an Agent
value: 步骤3：选择一名员工

key: Step 1: Click and drag to select a group
value: 步骤1：点击并拖拽框选一组

key: Step 2: Right Click on the unit
value: 步骤2：右键点击收容单元

key: Step 3: Select the Work Type
value: 步骤3：选择工作类型

key: Step 4: Choose from your selected group
value: 步骤4：从选中的组中选择

key: Containment UI
value: 收容界面

key: Risk Level
value: 风险等级

key: Qliphoth Counter
value: 逆卡巴拉计数器

key: Current number of unique PE-Boxes.
value: 当前独特PE-Box数量。

key: The PE-Boxes produced in the previous work.
value: 上次工作产出的PE-Box。

key: As the work progresses, the Abnormality will produce a PE-Box (Positive Enkephalin Box) or a NE-Box (Negative Enkephalin Box). Only PE-Boxes can be refined and processed into energy.
value: 随着工作推进，异想体将产出PE-Box（正向脑啡肽盒）或NE-Box（负向脑啡肽盒）。只有PE-Box能被精炼处理为能源。

key: Your goal as the manager is to find out how to safely produce as many PE-Boxes as possible from the Abnormalities.
value: 你作为主管的目标是找出如何安全地从异想体中尽可能多地产出PE-Box。

key: The manner in which we do so is quite simple:
value: 我们的做法非常简单：

key: After receiving an order from the manager, an Agent will proceed to the designated Containment Unit.
value: 收到主管指令后，员工将前往指定的收容单元。

key: Each time an Agent enters a Containment Unit, the Qliphoth Meltdown Gauge will increase by 1 tick. If you need to know more about this gauge, please refer to the section about Qliphoth Meltdowns.
value: 每次员工进入收容单元，逆卡巴拉熔毁计量条增加1格。如需了解更多关于此计量条的信息，请参考逆卡巴拉熔毁章节。

key: Please make sure to keep in mind that some Abnormalities may immediately attack when an Agent enters the Containment Unit if the managerial guidelines are not complied with.
value: 请务必牢记，如果不遵守管理指南，某些异想体可能会在员工进入收容单元时立即发动攻击。

key: Fear Damage
value: 恐惧伤害

key: When an employee comes across an Abnormality, they may be struck with fear, causing some amount of mental damage.
value: 当员工遇到异想体时，可能会受到惊吓，造成一定量的精神伤害。

key: Abnormalities of higher risk levels will deal more mental damage to Agents of lower levels.
value: 更高风险等级的异想体会对低等级员工造成更多精神伤害。

key: This mental damage will also occur during encounters with Abnormalities that have left their Containment Unit.
value: 在遇到已离开收容单元的异想体时，也会产生这种精神伤害。

key: The Success Rate
value: 成功率

key: Each Abnormality will have different success rates for different Work Types. Therefore, depending on the chosen type, the outcome of the Work Process may change.
value: 每个异想体对不同工作类型有不同的成功率。因此，根据所选类型，工作流程的结果可能会改变。

key: The Success Rate is determined by the Virtue level corresponding to the type of work being done, along with the employee’s Success Rate stat (Temperance).
value: 成功率由与所做工作类型对应的美德等级，以及员工的成功率属性（节制）决定。

key: The Success Rate determines whether a PE-Box or NE-Box is produced.
value: 成功率决定产出PE-Box还是NE-Box。

key: Success and Failure during the Work Process
value: 工作流程中的成功与失败

key: If there is Success…
value: 若成功……

key: The Abnormality will produce a PE-Box.
value: 异想体将产出一个PE-Box。

key: If there is Failure…
value: 若失败……

key: The Abnormality will produce a NE-Box.
value: 异想体将产出一个NE-Box。

key: Each time a NE-Box is produced, the Abnormality will attack the employee.
value: 每次产出NE-Box时，异想体都会攻击员工。

key: If an Agent’s HP or SP hits zero during the Work Process, they will die or panic.
value: 如果员工在工作流程中HP或SP归零，他们将死亡或恐慌。

key: If such an instance occurs, the Work Process will end prematurely and the remaining E-Boxes will be produced as NE-Boxes.
value: 如果发生这种情况，工作流程将提前结束，剩余的E-Box将作为NE-Box产出。

key: The E-Box Gauge will fill corresponding to the produced PE-Boxes.
value: E-Box计量条将根据产出的PE-Box填充。

key: The final number of PE-Boxes will determine the result status of the work. There are 3 ranges of result: Bad, Normal, and Good.
value: 最终PE-Box数量将决定工作的结果状态。结果分为3个范围：坏、普通、好。

key: Produced PE-Boxes will then be stored as unique PE-Boxes for the Abnormality. Unique PE-Boxes can be used to unlock more of the Abnormality Encyclopedia and produce E.G.O.
value: 产出的PE-Box将作为该异想体的独特PE-Box存储。独特PE-Box可用于解锁更多异想体图鉴并制作E.G.O。

key: The Qliphoth Counter of Abnormalities may decrease if they are managed incorrectly, typically due to a Bad work result or violated managerial guideline.
value: 异想体的逆卡巴拉计数器可能因管理不当而减少，通常是由于工作结果为坏或违反管理指南。

key: The Qliphoth Counter can be found on the UI of the Containment Unit.
value: 逆卡巴拉计数器可在收容单元界面上找到。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter reaches 0, the Abnormality will escape its Containment Unit or use its special abilities.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，异想体将逃离收容单元或使用其特殊能力。

key: Please be careful as to ensure no Qliphoth Counter reaches 0.
value: 请注意确保没有逆卡巴拉计数器归零。

key: Work-Count Penalties
value: 工作次数惩罚

key: The Success Rate of work with WAW and ALEPH Abnormalities will decrease as the count of works completed with them increases.
value: 与WAW和ALEPH异想体的工作成功率会随着完成次数增加而降低。

key: Containment Units with Qliphoth Overloads will display the current amount of reduction in Success Rate. This reduction will also be reflected in the Order UI.
value: 发生逆卡巴拉过载的收容单元将显示当前成功率减少量。此减少量也会反映在指令界面中。

key: Containment Units with Qliphoth Overloads will return to normal when a Qliphoth Meltdown occurs. When this Meltdown occurs, all reduced success rates will be restored to their original values.
value: 发生逆卡巴拉过载的收容单元将在逆卡巴拉熔毁发生时恢复正常。熔毁发生时，所有降低的成功率将恢复原值。

key: Meltdown Level
value: 熔毁等级

key: Every time a Qliphoth Meltdown occurs, this level will rise.
value: 每次逆卡巴拉熔毁发生时，此等级都会上升。

key: Each time an Agent enters a Containment Unit, the Qliphoth Meltdown Gauge will increase by 1 tick.
value: 每次员工进入收容单元，逆卡巴拉熔毁计量条增加1格。

key: When the gauge is filled, a Qliphoth Meltdown will occur throughout the facility.
value: 当计量条填满时，整个设施将发生逆卡巴拉熔毁。

key: As the Meltdown Level rises, so too does the number of affected Containment Units.
value: 随着熔毁等级上升，受影响的收容单元数量也会增加。

key: Meltdown Alarms
value: 熔毁警报

key: An alarm timer will be shown on all Containment Units undergoing a Qliphoth Meltdown. This timer will gradually decrease.
value: 所有正在经历逆卡巴拉熔毁的收容单元上将显示警报计时器。此计时器将逐渐减少。

key: When this timer hits 0, the Qliphoth Counter of the Abnormality within the Containment Unit will become 0, and the unique PE-Box count will decrease.
value: 当此计时器归零时，收容单元内异想体的逆卡巴拉计数器将变为0，独特PE-Box数量将减少。

key: Meltdown Countermeasures
value: 熔毁对策

key: The Qliphoth Meltdown dissipates as soon as an Agent enters the Containment Unit.
value: 员工一进入收容单元，逆卡巴拉熔毁即消散。

key: The Qliphoth Meltdown gauge will not rise when Containment Units under Meltdown are entered.
value: 进入正在熔毁的收容单元时，逆卡巴拉熔毁计量条不会上升。

key: However, the reduced success rate from Qliphoth Overloads will still be reflected in the work.
value: 然而，逆卡巴拉过载导致的成功率降低仍会反映在工作中。

key: At certain levels of Qliphoth Meltdowns, an Ordeal will manifest instead of Containment Unit Meltdowns occurring.
value: 在特定逆卡巴拉熔毁等级下，将显现考验而非收容单元熔毁。

key: ‘Ordeals’ are a form of Abnormality that is unrefined. Ordeals come in four risk levels, corresponding to the times of day: Dawn, Noon, Dusk, and Midnight. As the level of Qliphoth Meltdowns increases, higher levels of Ordeals will manifest.
value: "考验"是一种未经精炼的异想体形态。考验有四个风险等级，对应一天中的时间：黎明、正午、黄昏和午夜。随着逆卡巴拉熔毁等级提升，更高等级的考验将显现。

key: Ordeals will hinder the management of Abnormalities in a variety of ways. However, as Ordeals are also a form of Abnormality, they can be suppressed just the same by ordering your Agents. To learn more about suppressing Ordeals and Abnormalities, please see the section ‘Suppressing Abnormalities’.
value: 考验会以各种方式妨碍异想体管理。然而，由于考验也是异想体的一种形式，它们同样可以通过指令员工来镇压。要了解更多关于镇压考验和异想体的信息，请参阅"镇压异想体"章节。

key: You can open the Encyclopedia window by clicking on the Containment Unit nameplate of the Abnormality.
value: 你可以通过点击异想体收容单元的铭牌来打开图鉴窗口。

key: Abnormality Story
value: 异想体故事

key: This section will display the story of the Abnormality. The story will be updated with each Observation Level.
value: 此部分将显示异想体的故事。故事将随着每个观察等级更新。

key: Abnormality Information
value: 异想体信息

key: This is the Basic Information for working with the Abnormality.
value: 这是与异想体工作的基本信息。

key: The Success Rates of each Work Type
value: 各工作类型的成功率

key: The Qliphoth Counter, and RWBP resistances if the Abnormality escapes.
value: 逆卡巴拉计数器，以及异想体外逃时的RWBP抗性。

key: The E.G.O that can be produced or obtained at the current Observation Level.
value: 在当前观察等级可制作或获得的E.G.O。

key: Using your unique PE-Boxes
value: 使用你的独特PE-Box

key: You can unlock more of the Encyclopedia by spending an Abnormality’s unique PE-Boxes.
value: 你可以通过消耗异想体的独特PE-Box来解锁更多图鉴内容。

key: When all the information in a category is unlocked, the Observation Level will increase.
value: 当一个分类下的所有信息都解锁后，观察等级将提升。

key: An Agent has a low chance of acquiring an E.G.O Gift when completing the Work Process with an Abnormality after reaching a certain Observation Level. E.G.O Gifts affect an Agent’s stats.
value: 在达到特定观察等级后，员工与异想体完成工作流程时有几率获得E.G.O饰品。E.G.O饰品影响员工属性。

key: E.G.O Production
value: E.G.O制作

key: Reaching the requisite Observation Level of an Abnormality will allow the production of the Abnormality’s corresponding E.G.O. Most E.G.O production requires unique PE-Boxes.
value: 达到异想体的必要观察等级后，即可制作该异想体对应的E.G.O。大多数E.G.O制作需要独特PE-Box。

key: Unlike most Abnormalities, Tools are Abnormalities that emphasize a concept of “usage” instead of “management”.
value: 与大多数异想体不同，工具是强调"使用"概念而非"管理"的异想体。

key: Tool Abnormality Classifications
value: 工具异想体分类

key: 1. Single Use: Agents utilize this Tool with an immediate effect.
value: 1. 单次使用：员工使用此工具后立即生效。

key: 2. Equippable: Agents must equip this Tool to gain its effect.
value: 2. 可装备：员工必须装备此工具才能获得其效果。

key: 3. Channeled Use: Agents must continually use this Tool to gain its effect.
value: 3. 引导使用：员工必须持续使用此工具才能获得其效果。

key: Every 5 days, starting from your 4th (Day 4, Day 9, etc.), a new Tool Abnormality will be extracted.
value: 从第4天开始，每5天（第4天、第9天等）将提取一个新的工具异想体。

key: 1. Click the Containment Unit of the Tool Abnormality to open the Order UI, then send an Agent to use it.
value: 1. 点击工具异想体的收容单元打开指令界面，然后派遣一名员工去使用。

key: 2. The Agent will equip or use the Tool Abnormality.
value: 2. 员工将装备或使用该工具异想体。

key: 3. The Agent can be ordered to stop usage of a channeled use Tool or return an equippable Tool by clicking again on the Containment Unit.
value: 3. 可以通过再次点击收容单元来指令员工停止使用引导型工具或归还可装备工具。

key: Tool Observation
value: 工具观察

key: The Encyclopedia of a Tool Abnormality will automatically update in accordance to the number of uses or total time used.
value: 工具异想体的图鉴将根据使用次数或总使用时间自动更新。

key: If the Qliphoth Counter of an Escaping Abnormality reaches 0, the Abnormality will leave its Containment Unit.
value: 如果出逃异想体的逆卡巴拉计数器归零，该异想体将离开其收容单元。

key: The Qliphoth Counter can decrease not just due to a Bad work result, but also from violation of management methods.
value: 逆卡巴拉计数器不仅会因工作结果为坏而减少，也会因违反管理方法而减少。

key: Escaping Abnormalities need to be suppressed quickly. To learn more about suppressing Abnormalities, please see the section ‘Suppressing Abnormalities’.
value: 出逃异想体需要尽快被镇压。要了解更多关于镇压异想体的信息，请参阅"镇压异想体"章节。

key: Employee Death and Panic
value: 员工死亡与恐慌

key: Any employee whose HP drops to 0 due to damage from a RED, BLACK, or PALE attack will die.
value: 任何因RED、BLACK或PALE攻击伤害导致HP归零的员工都会死亡。

key: If an Agent dies, their equipped E.G.O will be destroyed.
value: 如果员工死亡，其装备的E.G.O将被摧毁。

key: 1. Any employee whose SP drops to 0 due to damage from a WHITE or BLACK attack will panic.
value: 1. 任何因WHITE或BLACK攻击伤害导致SP归零的员工都会恐慌。

key: 2. Panicking Agents can be brought back to sanity when they have recovered their SP fully from healing attacks with WHITE or BLACK E.G.O.
value: 2. 恐慌中的员工在通过WHITE或BLACK E.G.O的回复攻击完全恢复SP后可恢复理智。

key: If the workday ends while an Agent is still in panic, they will be disposed of.
value: 如果工作日结束时员工仍处于恐慌状态，他们将被处置。

key: Emergency Levels
value: 紧急等级

key: If an Abnormality escapes, or employees die or panic, an alarm will sound depending on the severity of the situation.
value: 如果异想体外逃，或员工死亡或恐慌，警报将根据情况严重程度响起。

key: First Trumpet
value: 第一号角

key: An Abnormality has breached and poses a minor threat to the facility and its employees.
value: 异想体突破收容，对设施及其员工构成轻微威胁。

key: Second Trumpet
value: 第二号角

key: It’s not too late to improve the situation. A competent manager can handle this much. Of course, it will cost several employees.
value: 现在改善情况还为时未晚。一个称职的主管能处理这种程度。当然，会付出几名员工的代价。

key: Third Trumpet
value: 第三号角

key: It would be a miracle if you recover from this situation. Most employees have died, and it will be nigh impossible to suppress the breaching Abnormalities.
value: 如果你能从这种情况中恢复过来，那将是个奇迹。大多数员工已经死亡，镇压出逃异想体几乎不可能。

key: Suppression UI
value: 镇压界面

key: Defense Types
value: 防御类型

key: The defensive multipliers against attacks done to it.
value: 对受到攻击的防御倍率。

key: Using E.G.O that the Abnormality is weak to (defensive multipliers of 1.0 or more) will allow suppression to be easier.
value: 使用异想体较弱（防御倍率1.0或以上）的E.G.O会使镇压更容易。

key: Agent Status
value: 员工状态

key: Your Agents’ HP, SP, and E.G.O can be checked here.
value: 在这里你可以查看员工的HP、SP和E.G.O。

key: 1. Click on the escaping Abnormality or its Containment Unit.
value: 1. 点击出逃的异想体或其收容单元。

key: 2. Select the Agents you want to send to suppress it. Once a certain Control Team research is complete, other departments can easily aid in the suppression.
value: 2. 选择你要派去镇压它的员工。完成特定控制部研究后，其他部门可以轻松协助镇压。

key: 3. You can cancel the suppression order of any Agent by clicking on them if they are already suppressing.
value: 3. 如果员工已在镇压中，你可以通过点击他们来取消任何员工的镇压指令。

key: 1. Select the Agents who you wish to suppress by clicking (and dragging).
value: 1. 点击（并拖拽）选择你想要派去镇压的员工。

key: 2. With your selected Agent(s), right-click on the escaping Abnormality.
value: 2. 选中员工后，右键点击出逃的异想体。

key: What is a Managerial Bullet?
value: 什么是主管子弹？

key: Managerial Bullets will be unlocked by completing research in the Middle Layer’s departments.
value: 主管子弹将通过完成中层部门的研究来解锁。

key: The quantity of bullets available will be influenced by the number of ticks needed to fill the Qliphoth Meltdown Gauge.
value: 可用子弹数量受填满逆卡巴拉熔毁计量条所需格数影响。

key: Once all bullets are expended, they will not be reloaded until a Qliphoth Meltdown has occurred. When the Qliphoth Meltdown occurs, the bullet count will be fully reloaded.
value: 所有子弹耗尽后，在逆卡巴拉熔毁发生前不会重新装填。逆卡巴拉熔毁发生时，子弹数量将完全重新装填。

key: Using a Bullet
value: 使用子弹

key: 1. Click on the Bullet UI or press the corresponding Number Key (1-8) to load the bullet.
value: 1. 点击子弹界面或按对应数字键（1-8）来装填子弹。

key: 2. Once the bullet is loaded, the mouse cursor will change to the bullet’s corresponding crosshair.
value: 2. 子弹装填后，鼠标光标将变为子弹对应的准星。

key: 3. Aim the cursor over the target and click the mouse to fire the bullet.
value: 3. 将光标瞄准目标并点击鼠标发射子弹。

key: 4. To unload the bullet, click on the Bullet UI or press the Number Key again.
value: 4. 要卸载子弹，再次点击子弹界面或按数字键。

key: End of the Day
value: 一日之终

key: The results card will show what missions have been cleared.
value: 结果卡片将显示已完成的任务。

key: Increases in Virtues and levels of each Agent will be shown.
value: 各员工的美德和等级提升将显示。

key: Every time you end the Day, you will receive LOB in accordance to how well you did.
value: 每次结束一天，你将根据表现获得LOB。

key: The greater the number of Remaining Agents, the higher the rank and more LOB will be acquired.
value: 剩余员工数量越多，排名越高，获得的LOB越多。

key: If the Day ends while an Abnormality is escaping, there will be a penalty upon the amount of LOB earned.
value: 如果一天结束时异想体仍在外逃，获得的LOB将受到惩罚。

key: Choosing to Proceed
value: 选择继续

key: After the Day is finished, you can choose whether to move on to the next Day or retry the current Day.
value: 一天结束后，你可以选择进入下一天或重试当前天。

key: If you choose to retry the Day, all lost Agents and E.G.O will be recovered. However, any progress toward Observations and E.G.O made that Day will be gone.
value: 如果你选择重试当天，所有损失的员工和E.G.O将被恢复。然而，当天的观察和E.G.O进展将消失。

key: The Memory Repository
value: 记忆库

key: The Memory Repository will be imprinted every 5 Days. (Day 1, Day 6, Day 11, and so on.)
value: 记忆库每5天刻印一次。（第1天、第6天、第11天，依此类推。）

key: Unlike retrying a single Day, rewinding to the Memory Repository will maintain all unlocked Observations and gained E.G.O. However, department expansion and extracted Abnormalities will regress to the state of the imprinted Day.
value: 与重试单天不同，倒带回记忆库将保留所有已解锁的观察和已获得的E.G.O。然而，部门扩建和已提取的异想体将回退到刻印日的状态。

key: You can elect to rewind to the Memory Repository in the ESC-Button Menu.
value: 你可以在ESC按钮菜单中选择倒带回记忆库。

key: Abnormality Extraction
value: 异想体提取

key: Each time you advance to the next Day, you will need to choose what Abnormality to extract.
value: 每次进入下一天时，你需要选择提取哪个异想体。

key: Ensure you carefully read the Extraction Quote of each Abnormality before choosing.
value: 选择前请务必仔细阅读每个异想体的提取引文。

key: Opening and Expanding
value: 开放与扩建

key: Every time you advance to the next Day, you will need to choose what department to expand for the newly extracted Abnormality’s Containment Unit.
value: 每次进入下一天时，你需要选择为新提取的异想体收容单元扩建哪个部门。

key: Each time you expand a department, its Expansion Level will increase.
value: 每次扩建部门，其扩建等级都会提升。

key: When the Expansion Levels of all current departments reach the maximum, new departments will become available for opening.
value: 当所有当前部门的扩建等级达到最大值时，新部门将可开放。

key: In cases where two departments can be opened at the same time, either department can be opened and expanded at your choosing without the need to maximize the Expansion Level of the other.
value: 在可同时开放两个部门的情况下，你可以选择开放和扩建任一部门，无需将另一个部门的扩建等级最大化。

key: The higher an Abnormality’s risk level, the more difficult it will be to manage.
value: 异想体风险等级越高，管理难度越大。

key: Department Functions
value: 部门职能

key: This button will display the department’s special functions.
value: 此按钮将显示部门的特殊职能。

key: If every Agent of one department is in another department of which they do not belong, a countdown will start.
value: 如果一个部门的所有员工都在他们不属于的另一个部门，倒计时将开始。

key: For a given department, if all Agents are absent and the countdown hits zero, every Clerk in that department will panic.
value: 对于给定部门，如果所有员工都不在且倒计时归零，该部门的所有职员将恐慌。

key: Clerk Benefits are applied accordingly to the current number of surviving Clerks in the departments. The benefit applied will vary for each department.
value: 职员福利根据部门内当前存活职员数量相应应用。各部门的福利不同。

key: The effectiveness of the benefit will increase as the department expands. Higher levels will have better effects.
value: 福利效果随部门扩建而增强。等级越高效果越好。

key: Clerk Benefit Levels
value: 职员福利等级

key: Level 3: 100%~80% of the department’s Clerks are alive; Expansion Level 5
value: 3级：部门职员存活100%~80%；扩建等级5

key: Level 2: 80%~50% of the department’s Clerks are alive; Expansion Level 3+
value: 2级：部门职员存活80%~50%；扩建等级3+

key: Level 1: 50%~30% of the department’s Clerks are alive; Expansion Level 1+
value: 1级：部门职员存活50%~30%；扩建等级1+

key: As Clerks die or panic during the workday, the percentage of Clerks alive will decrease, and as a result, the Clerk Benefit Level may decrease.
value: 随着工作日中职员死亡或恐慌，存活职员百分比将下降，因此职员福利等级可能降低。

key: If the number of Clerks alive in the department reaches zero, the Clerk Benefit will be shut off for the department.
value: 如果部门内存活职员数归零，该部门的职员福利将关闭。

key: Agents gain benefits for the number of days they have been in their department.
value: 员工因在部门内的天数而获得福利。

key: Continued Service Benefits will vary for each department. Agents who have gained such a benefit are gifted with a special title and a unique signifying armband.
value: 续聘福利因部门而异。获得此福利的员工将获得特殊头衔和独特的象征臂章。

key: However, if an Agent that has gained a Continued Service Benefit is transferred to another department, the effects, armband, and title will all be removed.
value: 然而，如果获得续聘福利的员工被调到其他部门，效果、臂章和头衔都将被移除。

key: Continued Service Benefit Levels
value: 续聘福利等级

key: Level 1: 1~2 Days of Service
value: 1级：任职1~2天

key: Level 2: 3~6 Days of Service
value: 2级：任职3~6天

key: Level 3: 7+ Days of Service
value: 3级：任职7天以上

key: Additionally, an even more unique armband and benefits will be granted to a single Agent in the department who has worked the longest among their peers for more than 7 days.
value: 此外，部门中在同事间工作时间最长（超过7天）的一名员工将获得更加独特的臂章和福利。

key: If all Agents from a department die, the Success Rate of all Containment Units in the department will decrease by a significant degree.
value: 如果一个部门的所有员工都死亡，该部门所有收容单元的成功率将大幅下降。

key: If all Agents die, every Clerk in that department will immediately commit suicide and the Clerk Benefit for the department will be lost.
value: 如果所有员工死亡，该部门的每个职员都将立即自杀，该部门的职员福利将丧失。

key: 3. The behaviour a panicking Agent will take is determined by the Agent’s highest Virtue.
value: 3. 恐慌员工的行为由其最高美德决定。

key: Fortitude → Murder
value: 坚韧 → 行凶

key: Prudence → Suicide
value: 谨慎 → 自杀

key: Temperance → Wandering
value: 节制 → 游荡

key: Justice → Compromising Containment Units
value: 正义 → 破坏收容单元
