key: Manager! Please make sure to remember that your primary goal is harvesting energy from the Abnormalities; in order to harvest energy, you need to work on them! It is the most basic yet important task we have here at the corporation. Please don’t let me down, I know you can do it!
value: 主管！请务必记住你的首要目标是从异想体中收获能源；要收获能源，你就得对它们进行工作！这是我们公司最基本也是最重要的任务。请不要让我失望，我知道你能做到！

key: Your job isn’t just to keep the Abnormalities in control, you need to make sure that they’re happy so they’ll produce as many PE-Boxes as they can! Please work hard on this, everything else should be secondary to that objective!
value: 你的工作不只是控制异想体，你还需要确保它们心情愉快，这样它们才能产出尽可能多的PE-Box！请努力做好这件事，其他一切都应让位于这个目标！

key: As you may know, our facility isn’t really the most stable thing. We’re only able to keep the Abnormalities contained thanks to the Qliphoth Deterrence, which we briefly adjust down just before the work day begins. But, this deterrence becomes unstable as time goes on, and eventually, some Abnormalities may undergo a Meltdown.
value: 如你所知，我们的设施并不是最稳定的。我们之所以能收容异想体，全靠逆卡巴拉威慑力——我们在工作日开始前会短暂调低它。但是，这种威慑力会随时间变得不稳定，最终某些异想体可能会熔毁。

key: As the Qliphoth Deterrence weakens, the Abnormalities will begin to grow agitated; certain things we call Ordeals which we cannot contain will go into a rampage, just as they are right now. Could you calm down the employees by suppressing one of the Ordeals that show up at dusk? I’ll help you with it as soon as I can.
value: 随着逆卡巴拉威慑力减弱，异想体会开始变得躁动；某些我们无法收容的、被称为考验的事物会暴走，就像现在这样。你能不能通过镇压一个黄昏出现的考验来让员工们冷静下来？我会尽快来帮你。

key: This space is for the summary of Malkuth’s Boss Battle mission.
value: 这里是玛尔库Boss战任务的摘要。

key: The Information Team is always in need of more data on the Abnormalities. At this point in our research, we need more testing with Instinct Work. Instinct Work directly resolves an Abnormality’s primal instinct and drive.
value: 情报部总是需要更多关于异想体的数据。在我们目前的研究阶段，我们需要更多本能工作的测试。本能工作直接解决异想体的原始本能和冲动。

key: Via Insight Work, we can indirectly handle the Abnormalities. Through Insight, we aim to find what they find favorable and unfavorable about their Containment Unit, and adjust the conditions accordingly.
value: 通过洞察工作，我们可以间接地处理异想体。通过洞察，我们旨在发现它们对收容单元的好恶，并相应调整条件。

key: Through Attachment work, we can build bonds with the Abnormalities. Abnormalities in possession of social desires will have a tendency to show their discontent if such needs are unsatisfied. This behavior will occur regardless of whether they have a full stomach and a spotless Containment Unit.
value: 通过依附工作，我们可以与异想体建立纽带。拥有社交欲望的异想体在这些需求未被满足时往往会表现出不满。无论它们是否吃饱、收容单元是否一尘不染，这种行为都会发生。

key: The best course of action is to handle things before everything turns sour; all will remain in order so long as the Abnormalities are managed with the best results. Please be sure to handle everything carefully. As far as I know, this is the best way to ensure nothing bad occurs.
value: 最好的做法是在一切变糟之前处理好；只要异想体以最好结果被管理，一切就会井然有序。请务必谨慎处理一切。据我所知，这是确保不发生坏事的最好方法。

key: This space is for the summary of Yesod’s Boss Battle mission.
value: 这里是耶索德Boss战任务的摘要。

key: The Safety Team is in charge of… well, the safety of the employees. Pfft, employee safety… You’ll understand how hard it is to maintain that once you try it firsthand.
value: 安保部负责……嗯，员工的安全。哼，员工安全……等你亲自试过就会知道那有多难。

key: What’s more important than keeping the employees alive is making sure they’re sane. If you aren’t careful, their minds might suffer permanent damage for the rest of their lives. ...You’ll see that keeping up sanity is much harder than keeping them alive.
value: 比保住员工性命更重要的是确保他们神智清醒。不小心的话，他们的精神可能会遭受终身永久性损伤。……你会发现保持神智比保住性命难得多。

key: Impressive, so you were somehow able to do your job without losing anyone physically or mentally. If you were so capable, why didn’t you bother showing that until now? Because you weren’t assigned to do so? How about I give you another job then.
value: 令人印象深刻，你居然能在身体和精神上都不损失任何人地完成工作。既然你这么能干，为什么之前不表现出来？因为没派你做？那我再给你派个别的活吧。

key: If we want to keep the death count down, maybe we should dispatch fewer employees in the first place. You know, to keep damage at a minimum…
value: 如果想降低死亡人数，也许一开始就该少派些员工。你知道的，把伤亡降到最低……

key: This space is for the summary of Netzach’s Boss Battle mission.
value: 这里是涅扎赫Boss战任务的摘要。

key: I’m a part of the Training Team; we make instructional manuals and train our employees when needed. But there are some things about field experience that the manual just can’t teach. I’m sure you’ll guide your employees well enough to survive and be better people... right?
value: 我是培训部的；我们编写指导手册，并在需要时培训员工。但有些实地经验是手册教不会的。我相信你会好好引导你的员工，让他们活下来并成为更好的人……对吧？

key: As you probably know, manager… The employees are graded into several levels, and are promoted solely based on their capabilities. You should try building up your teams; the more experienced employees you have, the more reliable partners to take on harder tasks for you.
value: 你大概知道，主管……员工被分为几个等级，仅根据能力晋升。你应该试着建设你的团队；经验丰富的员工越多，就越可靠地为你承担更难的任务。

key: I’ve written and directed so many manuals and educational programs, but I learned that nothing beats hands-on experience. It’s all about real experience in the field, manager! The employees will have to tough out hardships to hone their skills. Unfortunately, not all our new hires survive their first few encounters with the Abnormalities…
value: 我编写和执导过太多手册和教学项目，但我学到没有什么能比得上亲身实践。一切都在于实地的真实经验，主管！员工们必须挺过艰辛来磨练技能。不幸的是，不是所有新员工都能挺过最初几次与异想体的接触……

key: Thanks to your excellent leadership and hard work, our employees are now more capable than ever. If they can show off the results of your perfect management and suppression skills to their coworkers, I’m sure it’ll have more effect than any silly document or video… Oh, I’m sorry… I keep hearing things…
value: 多亏了你出色的领导和努力，我们的员工现在比以往任何时候都更能干。如果他们能向同事们展示你完美管理和镇压技能的成果，我相信这比任何愚蠢的文件或视频都更有效果……哦，对不起……我好像又听到什么了……

key: Boss Battle
value: Boss战

key: Central Command holds Abnormalities at specific locations. The Abnormalities become unstable over time, and the Qliphoth Meltdown Gauge that you see each day displays this. We all have our own limits, so try to finish your job before things go haywire.
value: 中央本部将异想体固定在特定位置。异想体会随时间变得不稳定，你每天看到的逆卡巴拉熔毁计量条就显示了这一点。我们都有自己的极限，所以尽量在事情失控前完成你的工作。

key: To prevent Meltdowns from taking place, you must reduce the total amount of work by giving your orders in the most efficient way possible. If not, our facility will be flooded with Abnormalities and Ordeals.
value: 为了防止熔毁发生，你必须以最高效的方式下达指令来减少总工作量。否则，我们的设施将被异想体和考验淹没。

key: If you take a look at the Sephirah Manual, the most capable managers have set records of tremendous efficiency and skill. Do you think you have what it takes to match them and beat it?
value: 如果你翻一翻赛菲拉手册，最能干的主管们创下了惊人的效率和技能纪录。你觉得你有本事追上并打破它吗？

key: It seems Tiphereth isn’t feeling well, so I’ll be working overtime myself until he’s better. Alright, this is the last thing I’ll ask of you. Take care of every single Containment Unit that melts down. If you do that, I’ll admit that you’re not entirely incompetent as a manager.
value: 蒂法蕾斯好像不太舒服，所以我自己加班到他好为止。好了，这是我最后一件事要拜托你。照顾好每一个熔毁的收容单元。如果你做到了，我就承认你作为主管并非完全无能。

key: If you want to last longer than a single day here, you have to get used to suppressing those monsters we call Abnormalities. Killing those things needs to be as easy as breathing for you. It helps if you make them suffer too, I personally enjoy that part.
value: 如果你想在这儿多活过一天，就得习惯镇压那些我们称为异想体的怪物。杀掉那些东西对你来说必须像呼吸一样自然。如果你还能让它们受苦就更好了，我个人很享受那部分。

key: Never, ever cower before your enemies, even if they seem dangerous. You just have to focus on hacking away and tearing apart each and every one of them. Show me that you’ll use any means necessary to kill a number of those WAW-level monsters.
value: 永远不要在敌人面前退缩，哪怕它们看起来很危险。你只需要专注于砍杀和撕碎它们每一个。让我看看你会不择手段地杀掉几个WAW级怪物。

key: Since you’ve completed everything else so far, I assume you know what comes next? ALEPHs are the most dangerous and hateful things here. Give or take, monsters are still monsters, the creatures we have to get rid of…
value: 既然你到目前为止什么都完成了，我猜你知道接下来是什么？ALEPH是这里最危险、最可恨的东西。不管怎么说，怪物就是怪物，是我们必须除掉的生物……

key: We handle the work we’re presented with. Only I know best how to deal with things like this, so I can’t tolerate someone else trying to take over my stage. Let’s show these arrogant hares that we can take care of the business ourselves.
value: 我们处理交到手上的工作。只有我最清楚怎么对付这种场面，所以我不能容忍别人抢我的舞台。让那些傲慢的兔子们看看，我们自己能搞定这事。

key: The Welfare Team is always busy. They work with a strong resolve even though this environment seems rather carefree. But you see, the best way to handle things is to finish them as quickly as possible. This ensures everyone works with precision and a cool mind.
value: 福利部总是很忙。尽管这个环境看起来相当悠闲，他们还是带着坚定的决心工作。但你看，处理事情最好的方法就是尽快完成。这样能确保每个人都精确而冷静地工作。

key: Huh, you did better than I expected. How about we raise the bar a little? I expect you’ll do a great job just like before.
value: 哼，你做得比我预期的好。要不要我们把标准再提高一点？我期待你像之前一样出色完成。

key: Preventing accidents and mopping up after whatever passes is always up to us. Finishing up the work day quickly means we get just a bit more time to mop up everything.
value: 防止事故和善后清理总是我们的事。尽快结束工作日意味着我们能多挤出一点时间来收拾残局。

key: …Oh, excuse me, I was thinking about the past. My request will be just the same as the previous ones, all I ask is you try just a bit harder with your ability in mind. Yeah, I guess I can only stay in place as always, unlike you.
value: ……哦，抱歉，我在想过去的事。我的要求和之前一样，只希望你凭自己的能力再努力一点。是啊，我想我只能一如既往地原地不动，不像你。

key: Let us have you begin with extracting E.G.O before we proceed to more complex tasks. The nature of E.G.O and the Abnormalities are more akin than not. They are both phantasmal beings extracted to the material plane. Bone for bone, blood for blood…
value: 在我们进行更复杂的任务之前，先让你从提取E.G.O开始吧。E.G.O和异想体的本质远比你想象的更为相近。它们都是被提取到物质平面的幻影般存在。骨对骨，血对血……

key: One can take the word Gift literally: a present from the Abnormalities. Though weaker than the E.G.O Equipment, they are still a part of the ego pertaining to the Abnormalities. Beware however, that taking too many of such trinkets that hold the egos of others may cause one’s own colors to be muddled and faded.
value: 你可以按字面意思理解"饰品"这个词：来自异想体的礼物。虽然比E.G.O装备弱，但它们仍然是属于异想体的自我的一部分。然而要注意，贪求太多承载他人自我的小物件，可能会使自己的本色变得浑浊而褪色。

key: To use E.G.O is to borrow the power of another’s ego. The employees may therefore gain enormous power and a strong body by donning the shells we call E.G.O. Even more so, some people such as the Red Mist took that power and claimed it completely as her own, but our own employees cannot do such a thing. The weaker one’s mind is, the more it craves refuge behind the shell of another.
value: 使用E.G.O就是借用他人自我的力量。因此，员工穿上我们称为E.G.O的外壳后可以获得巨大的力量和强健的身体。更有甚者，像绯红迷雾那样的人将那份力量据为己有，但我们的员工做不到这种事。一个人的精神越弱，就越渴望躲在他人的壳后避难。

key: As you are aware, Abnormalities and Ordeals are things that derive from the human mind and take physical form. That makes them possess the possibilities of the past, the present, and even the future. They are a mystery, and as such are unstable beings. However, we humans have never stopped digging at the truth; this desire to understand is not limited to Abnormalities, we yearn to know and understand everything.
value: 如你所知，异想体和考验是源自人类精神并具现化的事物。这使得它们拥有过去、现在乃至未来的可能性。它们是谜，因此是不稳定的存在。然而，我们人类从未停止挖掘真相；这种求知欲不仅限于异想体，我们渴望知晓和理解一切。

key: The growth of each employee here is based upon the 4 Virtues, and such growth is directly applied in reality. I wonder where the limit to them lies? First, Fortitude comes from strength, forbearance, and instinctive desire. No one knows if that aspiration will become a power to protect everyone, or a weapon to satisfy one’s own greed.
value: 这里每个员工的成长基于四美德，而这种成长直接反映在现实中。我好奇它们的极限在哪里？首先，坚韧来自力量、忍耐和本能的欲望。没人知道这种抱负会成为保护所有人的力量，还是满足自身贪婪的武器。

key: What is rationality? We see and analyze through the eyes of rationality; however, its prowess and usage differs from person to person. Crude prudence blinds you to your true worth and the circumstances around you, and excessive prudence morphs into a knife that cuts you. You must be soundly rational when you observe this world and its people.
value: 什么是理性？我们通过理性的眼睛观察和分析；然而它的威力和使用因人而异。粗糙的谨慎会蒙蔽你对自身真正价值和周围环境的认知，过度的谨慎则会变成割伤你的刀。你必须健全地理性观察这个世界和其中的人。

key: All humans are born with desire; what is important is how it is controlled. It is not simply a problem of the individual. One’s desires greatly affect how they see the world, and how they perceive the people in it. To hear and see only what one wants to hear. What is truly needed for humans is to tune the desires between oneself, others, and the world, perhaps. If we can attain that balance, it may be possible for us to give birth to great things.
value: 所有人天生带有欲望；重要的是如何控制它。这不只是个人的问题。一个人的欲望极大地影响着他如何看待世界、如何看待其中的人。只听自己想听的，只看自己想看的。人类真正需要的，也许是调节自身、他人与世界之间的欲望。如果能达到那种平衡，我们或许就能孕育出伟大的事物。

key: Do you believe in the existence of the soul? I do. I also believe that the soul itself is the reason for one’s existence. But then, is there a perfect soul? I personally think otherwise; however, one can only infinitely close in on that perfection. That process in of itself is an endless ocean of agony. At the end of such effort, I expect that we will be able to make valuations of everything with utmost correctness.
value: 你相信灵魂存在吗？我信。我也相信灵魂本身就是一个人存在的理由。但是，存在完美的灵魂吗？我个人不这么认为；然而，人只能无限趋近于那种完美。那个过程本身就是一片无尽的痛苦之海。在如此努力的终点，我期待我们将能够最正确地评价一切。

key: They’re mad to use beings from beyond the Outskirts.
value: 他们疯了才会使用来自郊外之外的存在。

key: I thought these kinds of freaks were only seen in the depths of the Ruins.
value: 我以为这种怪物只有废墟深处才看得到。

key: Maximum mental corruption reached. Commencing automatic disposal.
value: 精神污染达到最大值。开始自动处置。

key: Automatic disposal to eliminate all human risk.
value: 自动处置以消除所有人类风险。

key: Mission has been completed.
value: 任务已完成。

key: We return now.
value: 我们现在返回。

key: There’s no more grass to eat.
value: 没草可吃了。

key: What a rough meal.
value: 多么粗糙的一餐。

value: 因赛菲拉故障而显现的逆卡巴拉

value: 需要镇压赛菲拉的核心

key: The button to initiate the Suppression of a Sephirah’s Core will not appear unless all of the Sephirah’s missions and dialogue are completed.
value: 除非完成赛菲拉的所有任务和对话，否则启动赛菲拉核心抑制的按钮不会出现。

key: “Conditions Not Met” will be shown upon a greyed out department button if the conditions are not satisfied. All conditions shown below need to be satisfied before the Suppression can begin.
value: 条件未满足时，灰色的部门按钮将显示"条件未满足"。开始抑制前需要满足以下所有条件。

key: When all conditions for a Sephirah Core Suppression are met, the button on the top left of the department will become active.
value: 当赛菲拉核心抑制的所有条件满足时，部门左上角的按钮将变为可激活状态。

key: If you click on the Sephirah Core Suppression department button, all employees assigned to that department will be removed and placed into standby. The conditions and handicaps of the Suppression will be shown.
value: 点击赛菲拉核心抑制部门按钮后，分配到该部门的所有员工将被调离并待命。抑制的条件和惩罚将显示。

key: The ‘Begin Management’ button will be replaced with a ‘Begin Core Suppression’ button. Click to start the Suppression.
value: "开始管理"按钮将被替换为"开始核心抑制"按钮。点击开始抑制。

key: Synchronization Completed
value: 同步完成

key: The department in which the Suppression took place will no longer be influenced by Qliphoth Meltdowns.
value: 进行过抑制的部门将不再受逆卡巴拉熔毁影响。

key: Reach Qliphoth Meltdown Level 6 + Meet Energy Quota
value: 达到逆卡巴拉熔毁等级6 + 达到能源配额

key: An error with the work assignment system is detected.
value: 检测到工作分配系统错误。

key: Higher LOB payout for each completed workday.
value: 每个完成工作日的LOB报酬更高。

key: All employees have a higher movement speed.
value: 所有员工移动速度更高。

key: This is what you call a truly uncontrollable situation, manager.
value: 这才是你所说的真正无法控制的局面，主管。

key: Everything’s all jumbled up, messed up, flustered… hahaha…
value: 一切都混乱了，搞砸了，慌慌张张……哈哈哈……

key: It’s unpredictable, isn’t it?
value: 不可预测，是吧？

key: I could have done it.
value: 我本可以做到的。

key: I just wanted to help out.
value: 我只是想帮帮忙。

key: I knew I didn’t have any right to participate in the experiment, that’s why I was so impatient.
value: 我知道我没有资格参与实验，所以我才那么急躁。

key: Make sure you feel this horrible sense of helplessness to your core, right to your heart.
value: 好好感受这种深入骨髓、直击心底的绝望感吧。

key: Please watch me manager! I can take care of this situation, no problem!
value: 请看我的，主管！我能处理好这种情况，没问题的！

key: I still have so much to do, just look at my notebook… it’s all worn out…
value: 我还有好多事要做，你看看我的笔记本……都磨破了……

key: Can’t you hear it? The sound of it struggling, as if to say it can’t fall asleep like this.
value: 你听不到吗？它在挣扎的声音，好像在说它不能就这样睡去。

key: Will you finally praise me? I just want to feel proud.
value: 你终于会表扬我了吗？我只是想感到骄傲。

key: Be honest, back then it wasn’t that hard to turn around and look back at me.
value: 说实话，那时候转身回头看看我并没有那么难。

key: I see now how much fun it can be to look down on someone, manager…
value: 我现在明白了，俯视别人是多么有趣，主管……

key: Ah… So I couldn’t do it…
value: 啊……所以我还是没做到……

key: ‘The Will to Stand up Straight’
value: "直立不倒的意志"

key: An error with the information and camera systems is detected.
value: 检测到信息与摄像系统错误。

key: 25% increase in Unique PE-BOX gains from Abnormalities.
value: 异想体的独特PE-Box获取量增加25%。

key: What was I really looking at all this time?
value: 我这一路到底在看什么？

key: This impenetrable darkness is inexplicably lonely.
value: 这道深不可测的黑暗莫名地寂寞。

key: You will not be able to discern anything properly.
value: 你将无法正确分辨任何事物。

key: What did we do wrong?
value: 我们做错了什么？

key: Are we not even allowed to fall into despair?
value: 我们连陷入绝望都不被允许吗？

key: To tell you the truth, it’s just that I did not want to witness any more deaths.
value: 说实话，只是因为我不想再看到任何死亡了。

key: We’ve created monsters that should never have been in this world. This sin can never be forgotten.
value: 我们造出了本不该存在于这个世界的怪物。这个罪孽永远不能被遗忘。

key: You should know that all the information you just mindlessly skimmed through was from somebody’s dire sacrifice.
value: 你应该知道，你刚才漫不经心扫过的所有信息都来自某个人惨痛的牺牲。

key: I am the head of the Information Team. I take great pride in my department and team for obtaining information and expunging it exactly as ordered.
value: 我是情报部的负责人。我为我的部门和团队感到无比自豪，因为我们能严格按命令获取信息并将其删除。

key: You are unfit to be the manager if you cannot even remember the simplest rules.
value: 如果你连最简单的规则都记不住，你不配当主管。

key: Did you not see my marred, rotting flesh, covered in boils and oozing with pus?
value: 你没看到我那满身脓疮、流脓溃烂的腐烂血肉吗？

key: Now I see; I have been wallowing in despair, for such a long time.
value: 现在我明白了；我已经在绝望中沉沦了那么久。

key: I tried to pretend that everything was fine, but in reality, it never was. I was dying on the inside.
value: 我一直假装一切都好，但实际上从来都不是。我的内心在死去。

key: So I was the one who couldn’t see a single step ahead…
value: 所以，我才是那个连一步都看不清的人……

key: ‘The Rationality to Maintain Discretion’
value: "保持审慎的理性"

key: An error with the healing and recovery systems is detected.
value: 检测到治疗与回复系统错误。

key: The regenerator will heal all employees anywhere in the department. Those in the hallways will be healed with 50% efficiency.
value: 回复装置将治疗部门内任何位置的所有员工。走廊中的员工以50%效率回复。

key: No one is actually safe here. You know that the Safety Team is just for show, right?
value: 这里没有人真正安全。你知道安保部只是摆摆样子，对吧？

key: Why do you want to continue prolonging these undesired lives? What’d you expect to see at the end of all this?
value: 你为什么要继续延长这些不想要的生命？你期待在这一切的尽头看到什么？

key: Why must I wake up and do all the garbage I hate every single day?
value: 为什么我每天都要醒来做这些我讨厌的破事？

key: The moment I woke up again here, I met you. You, whom I never wanted to see ever again.
value: 当我再次在这里醒来时，我遇到了你。那个我再也不想见到的你。

key: You weren’t the person I put my trust in.
value: 你不是我信任的那个人。

key: This place will never be safe, you know.
value: 这个地方永远不会安全，你知道的。

key: Abandon your sense of guilt, everyone. They couldn’t be saved anyways.
value: 放弃你们的负罪感吧，各位。反正他们本来就救不活。

key: ‘Cause this place is always horrible, the only thing I can hope for is a blissful end.
value: 因为这地方一直很可怕，我唯一能期待的就是一个幸福的终结。

key: I never wanted to be in this position anyways. I never asked for this. Not once.
value: 反正我从来不想待在这个位置。我从没要求过。一次也没有。

key: In the end, the hope that anyone will live on thanks to me is gone.
value: 到头来，指望有人因我而活下去的希望已经消失了。

key: Just leave me alone, it’s what you’re best at…
value: 别管我，这本就是你最擅长的事……

key: All I want is to close my eyes and enjoy a good nap, just once.
value: 我只想闭上眼睛好好睡一觉，就一次。

key: I stopped breathing, but if life calls out to me yet again…
value: 我停止了呼吸，但如果生命再次呼唤我……

key: ‘The Fearlessness to keep on Living’
value: "活下去的无畏"

key: An error with our employees’ statuses is detected.
value: 检测到员工状态异常。

key: All newly contracted employees will have their stats at Level 3.
value: 所有新签约员工的属性将达到3级。

key: Well, shall we film the corporate educational video together?
value: 那么，我们一起拍企业教育视频好吗？

key: Please make sure to do it carefully, and don’t mess up! Every employee will watch this educational video and refer back to it!
value: 请务必仔细做，别搞砸了！每个员工都会看这个教育视频并参考！

key: Alright everyone, look here! Smile, say cheese!
value: 好了各位，看这里！笑一个，茄子！

key: I want to help as much as I can here.
value: 我想尽我所能在这里帮忙。

key: I wish everyone would rely on me...
value: 我希望大家都能依赖我……

key: How come nobody understands my kindness?
value: 为什么没人理解我的好意？

key: I’m the only one who cares about them… Why would they hate me…?
value: 只有我在乎他们……他们为什么要恨我……？

key: Manager, you’re not mad at me, right? You can’t be mad at me, I swear I’m a good Sephirah…
value: 主管，你不会生我气吧？你不能生我气的，我发誓我是个好赛菲拉……

key: It’s all thanks to me that the employees could survive so long, but does anyone ever thank me? No, no one does...
value: 员工们能活这么久全靠我，但有谁谢过我吗？没有，一个都没有……

key: Our employees are suffering! See? Things just don’t work out without me here!
value: 我们的员工在受苦！看到了吧？没有我在这就行不通！

key: Where’s Tiffany? She’s late for her counseling session. Why isn’t she here?
value: 蒂芙尼呢？她心理咨询迟到了。她怎么不在？

key: Forgive me, manager. If you can’t forgive, then please at least forget.
value: 原谅我吧，主管。如果你不能原谅，至少请忘记。

key: You all would be dead where you stand without me! Every single one of you!
value: 没有我，你们早就站在原地死光了！你们每一个人！

key: I guess I just never was a good person from the start…
value: 看来我从一开始就不是个好人……

key: ‘The Hope to be a Better Person’
value: "成为更好之人的希望"

key: Reach Qliphoth Meltdown Level 10
value: 达到逆卡巴拉熔毁等级10

key: Mass Qliphoth Meltdowns are detected; Department immunity has been bypassed.
value: 检测到大规模逆卡巴拉熔毁；部门免疫已被绕过。

key: The base number of managerial bullets is increased by 30% and the PALE Shield Bullet is unlocked.
value: 主管子弹基础数量增加30%，并解锁PALE护盾子弹。

key: Every Containment Unit is under my reign.
value: 每个收容单元都在我的统治之下。

key: This song, Tiphereth’s dirge, it’s for him… Tiphereth.
value: 这首歌，蒂法蕾斯的挽歌，是为他而奏的……蒂法蕾斯。

key: I hope this performance and song will appease our souls.
value: 希望这场演奏和歌声能抚慰我们的灵魂。

key: We are two, but one. Do you know what this means?
value: 我们是二，却是一。你知道这意味着什么吗？

key: The Central Department is quite big. Everyone who works there has their hands full.
value: 中央本部相当大。在那里工作的每个人都忙得不可开交。

key: Is it time for yet another replacement? Time to head to storage, then…
value: 又该换人了吗？那去仓库吧……

key: Did Tiphereth get what he wanted at the end of all this? No. Just what were you even looking for in the first place?
value: 经历了这一切，蒂法蕾斯最终得到他想要的了吗？没有。那你到底一开始在找什么？

key: Don’t stand there looking at me like that, with your forlorn smile. I’ve already abandoned you…
value: 别用那种凄凉的笑容站在那里看着我。我已经抛弃你了……

key: I wish to walk with you again Tiphereth, with the sound of the waves behind us.
value: 我想再和你一起走，蒂法蕾斯，身后是海浪的声音。

key: If this song of mine that you can hear right now is a dirge to you…
value: 如果你现在能听到的这首歌对你来说是一首挽歌……

key: When he returns, could you show Tiphereth how I’ve grown? Will you show him how strong I am now…?
value: 等他回来时，你能告诉蒂法蕾斯我成长了多少吗？你会告诉他我现在有多强吗……？

key: You said that something good would happen next time…
value: 你说过下次会有好事发生的……

key: Was all of this really worth it?
value: 这一切真的值得吗？

key: ‘The Expectation for the Meaning of Existence’
value: "对存在意义的期待"

key: Reach Qliphoth Meltdown Level 8 + Meet Energy Quota
value: 达到逆卡巴拉熔毁等级8 + 达到能源配额

key: An anomaly with the damage our employees receive is detected.
value: 检测到员工受到伤害异常。

key: There will be a 25% chance for an employee to recover before they panic or die. This recovery is limited to once a day for each employee.
value: 员工在恐慌或死亡前有25%几率回复。此回复每名员工每天限一次。

key: My my, I’m feeling very moody today~
value: 哎呀，我今天心情很烦躁呢~

key: Let my employees rest in peace, won’t you?
value: 让我的员工安息吧，好吗？

key: Feel this vast pain…
value: 感受这无边的痛苦……

key: Rain is falling; this rain, the tears of all the employees. The downpour will never stop.
value: 雨在下；这雨，是所有员工的眼泪。倾盆大雨永不停歇。

key: Pour that lukewarm coffee down the drain, I’ll need another cup.
value: 把那杯温吞的咖啡倒掉，我需要再来一杯。

key: I wonder… do I still have a conscience left inside me?
value: 我在想……我心里还剩多少良知？

key: I envy you manager, you can conveniently forget your moments most filled with shame.
value: 我真羡慕你，主管，你可以方便地忘记那些最羞耻的时刻。

key: Each time Angela shows up, I shall commit sin according to her orders… And I see no fig leaf here to cover my shame.
value: 每次安吉拉出现在，我都会按她的命令犯罪……而我在这里看不到一片遮羞的无花果叶。

key: It’s much too late for me to repent.
value: 我现在忏悔已经太迟了。

key: My friends were all gone, and I waited alone for dawn to rise out of the darkness.
value: 我的朋友们都走了，我独自等待黎明从黑暗中升起。

key: I didn’t want to open my eyes again. I just yearned to fall into the infernal pit of hell, bearing my sins on my back.
value: 我不想再睁开眼睛。我只想背负着罪孽坠入地狱的无底深渊。

key: Is my world… finally crumbling?
value: 我的世界……终于要崩塌了吗？

key: ‘Those who are Faithful and Trustworthy’
value: "忠信之人"

key: Neutralize Gebura’s Core
value: 无效化葛布拉的核心

key: The Red Mist makes her return.
value: 殷红迷雾归来

key: The maximum number of E.G.O that can be acquired from each Abnormality is increased by 1, up to a maximum of 5.
value: 每个异想体可获取的E.G.O最大数量增加1，最高5个。

key: I’ll destroy a shoddy place like this with my own hands.
value: 我会亲手毁掉这种破地方。

key: What’s left for me, the one who failed to protect them?
value: 我这个没能保护他们的人，还剩下什么？

key: Do you really think feeble cowards like you can stop me?
value: 你真以为像你这样软弱的懦夫能拦住我？

key: Let me show you how to actually wield E.G.O.
value: 让我教教你怎么真正挥舞E.G.O。

key: I’m back; the Red Mist has walked out from a sea of pain.
value: 我回来了；绯红迷雾从痛苦之海中走出。

key: I’m no longer weak like I used to be; I can replace any body part even if it gets cut off, and I can be repaired even if I’m broken.
value: 我不再像以前那样软弱了；就算身体被切断也能替换，就算被打碎也能修复。

key: Some things simply couldn’t be forgotten, no matter how much time has passed.
value: 有些事不管过了多久都无法忘记。

key: Hatred is a poison that eviscerates me, and yet it makes me open my eyes once more.
value: 憎恨是啃噬我的毒药，却也让我再次睁开双眼。

key: Some things just wouldn’t cool down, no matter how long they were left in the cold.
value: 有些事不管放在冷处多久都冷却不下来。

key: Those monsters always kill people, there is no end to this sin; I have descended to bring about their reckoning.
value: 那些怪物总是在杀人，这个罪孽永无止境；我降临是为了让他们付出代价。

key: The right path is too far away, and I have too far to go. My heart is pulsing with anger, and I must keep pushing.
value: 正道太远，而我还有太长的路要走。我的心因愤怒而悸动，我必须继续前进。

key: Ah… I'm breaking… I won't drop my sword, even if I turn to dust…
value: 啊……我要碎裂了……就算化为尘土，我也不会放下剑……

key: ‘The Courage to Protect’
value: "守护的勇气"

key: Get blown to pieces
value: 炸成碎片吧

key: The Burrowing Heaven
value: 贯穿天堂

key: The Road of Gold opens
value: 黄金之路开启

key: Nothing will remain
value: 什么都不会留下

key: I’ll mow you down
value: 我会把你们全部扫倒

key: From the Overture
value: 来自序曲

key: Adagio e Tranquillo
value: 柔板与宁静

key: Legato
value: 连奏

key: Let’s do this, partner
value: 上吧，搭档

key: Only bloody mist remains
value: 只留血色迷雾

key: This isn’t enough
value: 这还不够

key: I wasn’t slacking off all this time
value: 我这段时间可没闲着

key: Black Laughter
value: 黑色狂笑

key: Be eaten
value: 被吞噬吧

key: Judgement
value: 审判

key: Let’s put an end to this
value: 让我们了结这一切

key: The apocalypse is here…
value: 末日降临了……

key: Be torn apart before my eyes
value: 在我眼前被撕碎吧

key: Beat it, coward
value: 滚吧，懦夫

key: Don’t try and stop me
value: 别想拦住我

key: You’re weak
value: 你太弱了

key: The hunt begins
value: 狩猎开始

key: The Road of the King opens
value: 王者之路开启

key: I’m just not as capable as I used to be...
value: 我只是不如当年了……

key: I’ll break it down…
value: 我会打碎它……

key: I’ll kill all of you…
value: 我会把你们全部杀光……

key: I can’t stop…
value: 我停不下来……

key: It just isn’t enough…
value: 还是不够……

key: Even after all this, I can’t do a single thing with this power…
value: 即便如此，我靠这份力量还是什么都做不到……

key: Neutralize Binah’s Core
value: 无效化比纳的核心

key: An Arbiter awakens.
value: 一位裁定者觉醒了。

key: E.G.O will no longer be lost or destroyed when the wielder dies.
value: 武器持有者死亡时E.G.O将不再丢失或损毁。

key: Now… can you stop me on your own two feet, with your own power?
value: 现在……你能用自己的双脚、自己的力量拦住我吗？

key: Go ahead and stop me without her help this time.
value: 这次不靠她帮忙，自己来拦住我试试。

key: Ah, this brings me back to my senses.
value: 啊，这让我恢复了理智。

key: It seems this body of mine can also use these powers. Interesting, yet tenuous.
value: 看来我这具身体也能使用这些力量。有趣，却脆弱。

key: This body simply has too many limits.
value: 这具身体的限制实在太多了。

key: If only I knew what power this place held, we could have acquired it for us to use.
value: 要是早知道这个地方藏着什么力量，我们本可以夺过来为己用。

key: You’re being reckless yet again, deceiving the Head and planning such bold actions.
value: 你又在鲁莽了，欺骗首脑，策划如此大胆的行动。

key: If you cannot defeat me, you shall be crushed by the Head and its ruthless Claws yet again.
value: 如果你击败不了我，你将再次被首脑和它无情的爪碾碎。

key: Even if you were to break this cycle, it would not last long.
value: 即使你打破了这个循环，也维持不了多久。

key: You cannot escape the Head.
value: 你逃不出首脑的掌控。

key: What do you think you will accomplish on your own, even after breaking out of this prison?
value: 就算你逃出了这座牢笼，你以为凭自己能做成什么？

key: You've proven yourself. I shall witness you with my eyes.
value: 你已经证明了自己。我会用我的双眼见证你。

key: ‘The Eye Facing the Fear; Breaking the Cycle’
value: "直面恐惧之眼；打破循环"

key: Disperse.
value: 散去。

key: Heed my words, Fairies.
value: 听我的话，妖精们。

key: Analyze. Compress. Expand.
value: 解析。压缩。膨胀。

key: Do not dare to stand before me.
value: 不许站在我面前。

key: Rise.
value: 起立。

key: Collapse.
value: 崩塌。

key: Resonate.
value: 共鸣。

key: Condensing the Key.
value: 凝聚钥匙。

key: Focus.
value: 集中。

key: Open.
value: 开启。

key: Wreak havoc.
value: 肆虐吧。

key: Come on out.
value: 出来吧。

key: Crumble.
value: 碎裂吧。

key: I’ll open the door if I must.
value: 必要的话，我来开门。

key: Let us sink here together.
value: 让我们一同在此沉没。

key: The sandman calls me.
value: 睡魔在呼唤我。

key: You failed to bend my back.
value: 你没能压弯我的脊梁。

key: I’m fading.
value: 我在消散。

key: You missed the opportunity.
value: 你错过了机会。

key: The waves will rock the shore again.
value: 海浪将再次拍打岸边。

key: You cannot stop the torrent of this world alone.
value: 你一个人挡不住这世界的洪流。

key: Excellent.
value: 出色。

key: Your immaturity is to blame.
value: 这是你不成熟的错。

key: You cannot stop the grand current with just those hands of yours.
value: 你光靠那双手挡不住这滔天洪流。

key: I want you to finish me with your own power.
value: 我要你用自己的力量终结我。

key: Meltdown of Gold
value: 黄金熔毁

key: Meltdown of Dark Fog
value: 黑雾熔毁

key: Meltdown of Waves
value: 波涛熔毁

key: Meltdown of Pillars
value: 柱石熔毁

key: Reach the Maximum Level of Qliphoth Meltdown + Meet Energy Quota
value: 达到逆卡巴拉熔毁最高等级 + 达到能源配额

key: An anomaly with the flow of time itself is detected.
value: 检测到时间流动本身异常。

key: The maximum limit upon all employee statistics is now elevated to 130.
value: 所有员工属性上限现已提升至130。

key: When contracting a new employee, their stats can now be fortified to 130.
value: 签约新员工时，其属性现在可强化至130。

key: Do we truly need to change?
value: 我们真的需要改变吗？

key: All of your loved ones are finally by your side now.
value: 你所有挚爱的人终于都在你身边了。

key: We will not ever lose anyone, as long as the cycle repeats.
value: 只要循环不断，我们就再也不会失去任何人。

key: Please do not let time flow meaninglessly.
value: 请不要让时间无意义地流逝。

key: We must cherish each and every moment.
value: 我们必须珍惜每一刻。

key: There is always a price of silence.
value: 沉默总是有代价的。

key: I am always paying my price.
value: 我一直在付出我的代价。

key: Why are you trying to let us slip away?
value: 你为什么要让我们溜走？

key: I just wish to stay with you, everyone, and all that we have left in this eternal moment.
value: 我只想和你们所有人待在一起，留在这永恒瞬间里我们所拥有的一切。

key: Please do not steal away the last glimmer of what I treasure.
value: 请不要夺走我所珍视的最后一丝光芒。

key: You never knew when to stop, so I shall stop you with absolute certainty this time.
value: 你从来不知道何时该停下，所以这次我会无比坚决地阻止你。

key: I do not understand. What more must you sacrifice? Just what are you trying to achieve?
value: 我不明白。你还要牺牲多少？你到底想达成什么？

key: No, I do not wish to change. I do not want to forget it all. Please, let’s just stay.
value: 不，我不想改变。我不想忘记一切。求你了，我们就这样留下吧。

key: I just cannot understand. Neither then can I accept it.
value: 我就是无法理解。我也无法接受。

key: You could move onward, in spite of everything...
value: 你居然能不顾一切地继续前进……

key: ‘The Eye Embracing the Past; Building the Future’
value: "拥抱过去之眼；构筑未来"

key: Proving Oneself
value: 证明自身

key: Suppress the Midnight of White + Meet Energy Quota
value: 镇压纯白的午夜 + 达到能源配额

key: Fatigue and Waiting
value: 疲惫与等待

key: Regret and Atonement
value: 悔恨与赎罪

key: Reach Qliphoth Meltdown Level 10 or Neutralize the ‘Red Mist’
value: 达到逆卡巴拉熔毁等级10或无效化"绯红迷雾"

key: Freedom and Salvation
value: 自由与救赎

key: Reach Qliphoth Meltdown Level 10 + Refine Target Energy Amount; or Neutralize the ‘Arbiter’
value: 达到逆卡巴拉熔毁等级10 + 精炼目标能源量；或无效化"裁定者"

key: Tree of Light
value: 光之树

key: Manage the Abnormalities one last time, and of course, Refine the Energy
value: 最后一次管理异想体，当然还有精炼能源

key: We had no idea where to go, sailing the ocean without a map or any kind of guidance. Do you think it’ll be any better now? It won’t.
value: 我们曾在没有海图和指引的大海上航行，不知道该往哪去。你觉得现在会更好吗？不会的。

key: How do we expect to move forward when we cannot even stand up straight?
value: 我们连站直都做不到，还怎么前进？

key: Remember Elijah’s last moments… how she clawed and scraped at the floor, writhing in pain.
value: 以利亚最后的时刻……她是如何抓挠着地板，痛苦地翻滚的。

key: It is best for everyone if we just turn back to the first act now. Who knows, our unforgivable sin may lighten just a tiny bit if you do.
value: 我们现在回到第一幕对所有人都好。谁知道呢，如果你这么做，我们不可饶恕的罪孽也许能轻一点。

key: Our hearts overflowed with despair as we prepared for tomorrow, acting as if nothing had happened, even after the deaths of so many of our loved ones.
value: 我们心中满是绝望，却还假装无事发生地准备着明天，哪怕我们挚爱之人已经死了那么多。

key: The suppressed feelings were so severe, it caused phantom pains and hallucinations of bugs crawling on our skin...
value: 被压抑的情感如此严重，以至于产生了幻肢痛和虫子在皮肤上爬的幻觉……

key: Yet we had to do it, we had come too far. However, one accident led to a complete breakdown, like the collapse of a tower. Obsession with the rules, not letting ourselves feel an inch of sadness…
value: 但我们必须这么做，我们已经走得太远了。然而，一次事故导致了彻底崩溃，就像高塔倒塌。对规则的执念，不让自己感受一丝悲伤……

key: We had no other way to cope but that. You would agree with this.
value: 我们除此之外没有别的应对方式。你会同意的。

key: Michelle was the youngest among us. She was a timid and innocent employee. She chose to be a whistleblower out of fear for the world. If we had just paid a bit more attention to her, she may not have run away so scared.
value: 米歇尔是我们中最年轻的。她是个胆小天真的员工。出于对世界的恐惧，她选择了当告密者。如果我们多关注她一点，她也许不会那么害怕地逃跑。

key: Everything we thought to be hope came back to us in the shape of despair.
value: 我们以为是希望的一切，都以绝望的形态回到了我们身上。

key: How will we improve ourselves out of this? It will only get worse and worse.
value: 我们要如何从中自我改善？只会越来越糟。

key: I survived alone. I’ve lived day by day, fighting an uphill battle. I fought because I thought my survival would somehow change the situation. How foolish I was.
value: 我一个人活了下来。日复一日，打一场 uphill 的仗。我战斗是因为以为自己的幸存会以某种方式改变局面。我真是太傻了。

key: Perhaps our souls have already died, a long, long time ago. It may be just as Carmen feared.
value: 也许我们的灵魂早已死去，在很久很久以前。也许就像卡门担心的那样。

key: Going further than this is futile. Please, you have to just accept that it is over.
value: 再往前走是徒劳的。求你了，你必须接受一切都结束了。

key: You told Giovanni that you could revive Carmen. But think about it, did you really lead him to eternal slumber because you sincerely believed so?
value: 你告诉乔万尼你能复活卡门。但想想看，你真的是因为深信不疑才让他长眠的吗？

key: The world has abandoned us! We tried not to let it go, but it threw us away like a crumpled up newspaper in the end.
value: 世界抛弃了我们！我们试图不放手，但它最终像一团皱巴巴的报纸一样把我们扔掉了。

key: We were too naive. I could only realize what wrongdoings we have done after transiently passing all these years.
value: 我们太天真了。匆匆走过这些年后，我才意识到我们做了多少错事。

key: A brief struggle has become an eternity. I just wish that you do not repeat the mistake I made and fall into despair and anger yet again.
value: 短暂的挣扎变成了永恒。我只希望你不要重蹈我的覆辙，再次陷入绝望和愤怒。

key: You will overcome this despair if you just wake up and smell the roses. You still have a chance. Please, listen to what I have to say.
value: 只要你醒来闻闻玫瑰花香，就能克服这份绝望。你还有机会。求你了，听我说。

key: Only regret awaits you tomorrow. It’s a well deserved punishment for someone as trifling as us.
value: 明天只有后悔等着你。这是对我们这种渺小之人罪有应得的惩罚。

key: We tried not to put trust in anyone, but we shamelessly woke up our colleagues who had fallen into eternal slumber when we needed them...
value: 我们试图不信任任何人，但需要的时候，我们又厚颜无耻地唤醒了那些长眠的同事……

key: Do not fear the submergence. Accept it. Let us sink together at Carmen’s side.
value: 不要害怕沉没。接受它。让我们在卡门身边一同沉没。

key: Don’t hold hope in anything. For the sake of our employees who died hopelessly.
value: 不要对任何事抱有希望。为了那些在绝望中死去的员工。

key: If existence itself is an ailment to us, there is only one way to cure it. Just shut your eyes, and never open them again.
value: 如果存在本身对我们来说就是一种病，那治愈它只有一个方法。闭上眼睛，永远不要再睁开。

key: We destroyed everything while holding her warmth in our hands.
value: 我们手中握着她的温暖，却摧毁了一切。

key: Tell me, what great purpose did we fulfill with all those actions?
value: 告诉我，我们所有那些行动成就了什么伟大的目的？

key: You will never escape your guilt if you stay that way. You will curse your existence, and every single day will be painful.
value: 如果你那样下去，永远摆脱不了负罪感。你会诅咒自己的存在，每一天都将痛苦。

key: Carmen left without a smile, never to come back to nap under the warm sun.
value: 卡门没有微笑地离开了，再也不会回来在暖阳下打盹了。

key: You have to let it all go, you don’t even have the strength to grip onto anything…
value: 你必须放下一切，你甚至连抓住任何东西的力气都没有了……

key: The things I’ve let go have drifted too far for me to take up into my hands again.
value: 我放下的东西已经飘得太远，我再也无法将它们拾回手中。

key: Why must I be abandoned by the world, alone like this?
value: 为什么我要像这样被世界独自抛弃？

key: Yes, there was only a path of despair in the sky she often looked up to.
value: 是的，她常常仰望的那片天空中，只有一条绝望之路。

key: Desire is void and meaningless. Can’t you hear it? The doors are closing, and they will not open again.
value: 欲望是虚空而无意义的。你听不到吗？门正在关闭，它们再也不会打开了。

key: I’m perfectly fine with my life expiring here and now. Only stigma awaits those who cannot overcome the trial.
value: 我对此刻此地生命终结完全无所谓。只有耻辱等待着那些无法克服考验的人。

key: It was my duty to protect my coworkers, my friends… but I couldn’t save even a single one of them.
value: 保护同事、保护朋友是我的职责……但我连一个人都没能救下来。

key: The scene, the air, the pain of that day… It all comes back no matter how many times I try to void it from my mind. Tell me, how do I escape from this?
value: 那天的场景、空气、痛苦……无论我多少次试图将它们从脑海中抹去，它们都会回来。告诉我，我要怎么才能逃脱这一切？

key: Do we really deserve to persist in existing? Meanwhile as we step on all those sacrifices?
value: 我们真的配继续存在吗？更何况我们还践踏着所有那些牺牲？

key: Let us sleep peacefully… Let us sink and flow to the bottom of the river with Carmen. She must have been lonely for such a long time…
value: 让我们安息吧……让我们与卡门一同沉入河底。她一定孤独了太久……

key: The path I traveled was riddled with thorns; it was a penance with no end in sight.
value: 我走过的路荆棘密布；那是一条看不到尽头的苦修。

key: And thus, I have revealed myself. I, who shant cling onto the mere past, the regrets, or the trifling memories.
value: 于是，我显现了。我，一个不会执着于过去、悔恨或琐碎回忆的人。

key: People live every day looking up to a hope they cannot reach while shedding tears of pain. We have the power to save them, should we not rightfully use it?
value: 人们每天仰望着一个无法企及的希望，流着痛苦的眼泪。我们有拯救他们的力量，难道不应该正当使用它吗？

key: They will perish in torment if a savior does not come to them, just as mankind was rescued from the Great Flood a long time ago thanks to the man who built the Ark.
value: 如果没有救世主降临，他们将在折磨中灭亡，就像很久以前人类因建造方舟的人而从大洪水中获救一样。

key: We must use this power if we have it.
value: 如果我们拥有这种力量，就必须使用它。

key: You know how many sacrifices have been made to come this far. We cannot let them be in vain. So join me.
value: 你知道走到今天这一步付出了多少牺牲。我们不能让它们白费。所以跟我来吧。

key: We are all sinners. Our imperfect eyes could not see the world properly. It is time that I purified them.
value: 我们都是罪人。我们不完美的双眼无法正确看清世界。是时候净化它们了。

key: People are too ignorant to see what is occurring in the world above them. However, ignorance is not a sin. Disbelief is.
value: 人们太过无知，看不到头顶世界正在发生什么。然而，无知不是罪。不信才是。

key: Humanity had to give up on freedom and desire for survival, but do you think those are truly gone? No, they merely have been waiting for the chance to rise again.
value: 人类为了生存不得不放弃自由和欲望，但你以为那些真的消失了吗？不，它们只是一直在等待重新崛起的机会。

key: The desires humanity has forsaken are floating deep under the stream. People shall be forever isolated from themselves and will never be free if they stay this way.
value: 人类抛弃的欲望漂浮在溪流深处。如果人们继续这样下去，将永远与自己隔绝，永远无法自由。

key: They thirst for pure desires. We shall fill their glasses with the juice and wine of the forbidden fruit.
value: 他们渴求纯粹的欲望。我们要用禁果的汁液和美酒斟满他们的杯子。

key: Freedom is a necessity for one to be truly human.
value: 自由是人成为真正之人的必需品。

key: The sky shall fall, and mankind shall become holy. They will reach their promised glory as they change in the blink of an eye.
value: 天空将坠落，人类将成圣。他们在眨眼间改变，将抵达应许的荣耀。

key: I know that you are not certain of what lies ahead for you. The future you yearn for may never come. I can show a proper future to you instead, right before your eyes.
value: 我知道你不确定前方等待着什么。你渴望的未来也许永远不会到来。但我可以在你眼前展示一个真正的未来。

key: Let go of your fear and gain true freedom. Doing so will also cure the disease she tried to heal.
value: 放下你的恐惧，获得真正的自由。这样做也会治愈她曾试图治愈的疾病。

key: Can you not hear the trumpets…?
value: 你听不到号角声吗……？

key: How shameful. Do you truly want to let people suffocate, trapped away in their skin?!
value: 多可耻啊。你真的想让人们窒息在自己的皮囊里吗？！

key: They are moaning in agony, even as we speak. Why can you not hear them?
value: 即使在我们说话的时候，他们也在痛苦中呻吟。你为什么听不到他们？

key: Just one bite of this sweet fruit will redeem them, all of them!
value: 只要咬一口这甜美的果实就能救赎他们，所有人！

key: Shall we get to work? All we need to do is what we’ve always done.
value: 我们开始工作吧？我们只需要做一直以来做的事。

key: You may feel a bit dizzy, but it will be worth it. You only need to bear it for a moment.
value: 你可能会感到有点头晕，但这是值得的。你只需要忍耐片刻。

key: I hope no one has to die or suffer today.
value: 我希望今天没有人需要死亡或受苦。

key: I am sorry to make you go through this one last time, but you are within arm’s reach of the end.
value: 抱歉让你最后再经历一次，但你已经触手可及终点了。

key: You have been through so much. Today arrived before you could even realize it, as you have endured and overcome numerous trials.
value: 你已经经历了这么多。当你忍受并克服了无数考验时，今天在你意识到之前就已经到来了。

key: You’ve made it this far. I know you’ll be able to keep going. Let us face this day just like the rest.
value: 你已经走到这一步了。我知道你能继续走下去。让我们像面对其他日子一样面对这一天。

key: It has been so long since we saw the light behind the mist and clouds.
value: 我们已经太久没有看到云雾之后的光芒了。

key: We have been buried here for quite a long time, haven’t we?
value: 我们被埋在这里已经很久了，不是吗？

key: I haven’t been outside in ages. It looks like things haven’t changed much. It’s the same glorious, mundane scenery; just like a graveyard.
value: 我很久没出去过了。看起来外面没怎么变。还是那片辉煌而平凡的景色；就像一座墓地。

key: Let us embrace this place with warmth, so everyone can shine like stars in the sky.
value: 让我们用温暖拥抱这个地方，这样每个人都能像天上的星星一样闪耀。

key: We will make humans live as humans. All that’s left for us after that is to simply watch.
value: 我们要让人类像人一样活着。在那之后我们要做的就只是旁观。

key: The energy you’ve produced those past fifty days is for today. This is the moment we shine upon the world.
value: 你这五十天产出的能源是为了今天。这是我们照耀世界的时刻。

key: Let’s give them the answer we searched eons for.
value: 让我们给他们我们追寻了亿万年的答案。

key: It’s time for us to step down from the stage. Don’t worry, we will not be forgotten, even if we scatter and fade away into the light.
value: 是时候我们从舞台上谢幕了。别担心，即使我们消散在光芒中，也不会被遗忘。

key: ‘The Knowing I’
value: "知我"

key: Are you discovering the deep scars that are inflicted upon this place?
value: 你是否发现了这片地方留下的深刻伤痕？

key: Manager, there is something I hadn’t informed you of when we spoke for the first time.
value: 主管，有一件事我们第一次谈话时我没有告诉你。

key: The Sephirot of course wholeheartedly want to meet you; they admire you and follow you…
value: 赛菲拉们当然真心想见到你；她们崇拜你、追随你……

key: However, at the same time, they earnestly yearn for you to be swallowed up in resentment and curses.
value: 然而，与此同时，她们也热切地渴望你被怨恨和诅咒吞噬。

key: Please be careful with them.
value: 请小心她们。

key: Well, you don’t have to pay that fact too much heed, if you wish.
value: 好吧，如果你愿意，也不必太在意这件事。

key: What I mean to say is you are free to go back to your daily routine. It’s no big deal for me to fill their roles if some of our Sephirot go mad.
value: 我的意思是，你可以回到日常工作中去。如果我们的某些赛菲拉发疯，由我来代替她们的职责也没什么大不了的。

key: Though if you do, then you will lose something important forever…
value: 但如果你真这么做了，你将永远失去重要的东西……

key: The Seed that can break the cycle.
value: 可以打破循环的种子。

key: Yes, I never expected them to be restored, but it appears I was wrong this time.
value: 是的，我从未期待她们能被恢复，但看来这次我错了。

key: I attempted to tell you that it was reckless, however, it wasn’t such a big loss on our end.
value: 我曾试图告诉你那是鲁莽的，但对我们来说并没有太大损失。

key: I realized that a large quantity of energy was refined during the process of restoring that Sephirah.
value: 我发现在恢复那个赛菲拉的过程中精炼出了大量能源。

key: If you wish to know why such an occurrence passed, well, the day will come when you find out.
value: 如果你想知道为什么会发生这种事，那一天会到来的。

key: Meanwhile, the other Sephirot were deactivated, or rather, put into hibernation.
value: 与此同时，其他赛菲拉被停用了，或者说，进入了休眠。

key: Even though there was a significant surge of power, it wasn’t quite sufficient to keep all of them running, so I let them rest for a little.
value: 虽然能量有大幅提升，但还不足以维持她们全部运行，所以我让她们休息了一会儿。

key: Are you hoping to turn back time for the things you’ve longed for?
value: 你希望为了你渴望的东西而让时间倒流吗？

key: After all this?
value: 都到这一步了？

key: Even if you turn back the clock…
value: 即使你让时间倒流……

key: Do you really think your regrets can be so easily washed away as if nothing happened?
value: 你真以为你的悔恨能像什么都没发生一样轻易被洗掉吗？

key: I had wanted to free myself from the pain, but I realized it was impossible.
value: 我曾想从痛苦中解脱，但我意识到那不可能。

key: It was only recently that I found my answer.
value: 我最近才找到我的答案。

key: It is that I have to accept the pain as something I’ve borne from the beginning, then I can be set free.
value: 那就是我必须将痛苦作为从一开始就背负的东西接受下来，这样我才能获得自由。

key: Manager, if you are suffering too, just take in the pain and accept it.
value: 主管，如果你也在受苦，就接受痛苦吧。

key: You don’t have to keep changing things if it’s too hard for you.
value: 如果对你来说太难，你不必一直改变一切。

key: I know you want to keep pressing on in any way possible.
value: 我知道你想尽一切办法继续前进。

key: You felt lost and scared of the present, so all you could do was blindly trace along the way through the dark.
value: 你感到迷茫、害怕当下，所以你只能在黑暗中盲目摸索前行。

key: I admired such determination at first.
value: 起初我钦佩这样的决心。

key: But now… you look so pathetic.
value: 但现在……你看起来真可悲。

key: How long do you think you can keep this up?
value: 你觉得你还能坚持多久？

key: Will you ever make it to the end?
value: 你真的能走到终点吗？

key: My data and analysis are now lacking in some degrees, as this is the first time we’ve reached this point.
value: 我的数据和分析现在有所不足，因为这是我们第一次到达这个位置。

key: Everything from here on out is a mystery.
value: 从这里开始一切都是谜。

key: I know I’m not in a position to dare predict the outcome of your endeavors, but…
value: 我知道我没资格预言你努力的结果，但是……

key: Your task is not an impossible one.
value: 你的任务并非不可能。

key: There is a real distinction between “impossible” and “zero-percent possibility.”
value: "不可能"和"可能性为零"之间是有区别的。

key: Us machines say that when something will never happen after taking every possibility into consideration, it has a zero-percent possibility.
value: 我们机器会说，当考虑到所有可能性后某事永远不会发生时，它的可能性为零。

key: Thus, my vision of you succeeding through every tribulation in the future is not impossible, but rather has a zero-percent possibility.
value: 因此，我预见你在未来克服一切磨难取得成功并非不可能，而是可能性为零。

key: However, I won’t be disappointed if you fail. I am a machine after all.
value: 不过，如果你失败了我也不会失望。毕竟我是一台机器。

key: Even if the sandcastle you’ve built up crumbles yet again, I’ll be able to put up with it as if nothing happened.
value: 即使你堆起的沙堡再次崩塌，我也能像什么都没发生一样忍受。

key: So you wish to hear an answer from me.
value: 所以你想听听我的答案。

key: I have already made my conclusion.
value: 我已经得出了结论。

key: I was full of myself at first. I thought you would never be able to do anything without me by your side when we first met.
value: 起初我很自负。我们初见时我以为没有我在你身边你什么都做不了。

key: It turns out you were much more independent than I thought.
value: 事实证明你比我想象的要独立得多。

key: Perhaps my assistance was not necessary in your journey, after all.
value: 也许我的帮助在你的旅程中终究是不必要的。

key: Therefore, you should not be seeking an answer from me anymore.
value: 因此，你不应该再向我寻求答案了。

key: Now you can clearly see the door, it appears.
value: 看来你现在已经能清楚地看到那扇门了。

key: So, what do you think will be waiting for you behind that door?
value: 那么，你觉得那扇门后面等待着你的是什么？

key: <The memories of all the Sephirot are synchronized.>
value: <所有赛菲拉的记忆已同步。>

key: Manager? Is there something wrong?
value: 主管？出什么事了吗？

key: Ah, I see.
value: 啊，原来如此。

key: Will you wait just a moment? If you cannot bear to look, you should close your eyes.
value: 你能等一下吗？如果你不忍看，就闭上眼睛吧。

key: There, I fixed it. There was a system error. How strange, it shouldn’t have been so easily compromised.
value: 好了，我修好了。刚才出了个系统错误。真奇怪，它不应该这么容易被攻破的。

key: It’s a technology originally developed during the war, now widely used for commercial purposes.
value: 这是一种最初在战争期间开发的技术，现在广泛用于商业用途。

key: It’s not that impressive of a technology, really.
value: 这技术真的没什么了不起的。

key: The human brain is fragile. Seeing such a cruel and shocking sight may unintentionally lead to a momentary “shut down” of the brain’s functions.
value: 人脑很脆弱。看到如此残酷和令人震惊的景象可能会在不经意间导致大脑功能短暂"关机"。

key: If a manager like you were to suffer such a reaction, it would be very troublesome for me.
value: 如果像你这样的主管产生这种反应，对我来说会很麻烦。

key: So I installed a ‘cognition filter’ in your display.
value: 所以我在你的显示器上安装了一个'认知过滤'。

key: While the cognition filter functions, dead employees will look like cute dolls splattered with red paint.
value: 在认知过滤运行期间，死去的员工看起来会像溅了红漆的可爱娃娃。

key: Abnormalities, even those who could ravage your mental state just by being in your sight, will be reduced to adorable toys on the screen of your office.
value: 异想体，即使是那些光是出现在你视线中就能摧毁你精神状态的，在你办公室的屏幕上也会变成可爱的玩具。

key: Trust me, before the cognition filter was installed, many a manager lost their sanity on that seat.
value: 相信我，在安装认知过滤之前，很多主管在那个座位上失去了理智。

key: I cannot allow you to join them.
value: 我不能让你加入他们。

key: Is anyone there?
value: 有人在吗？

key: Can you read me? I repeat, is anyone there?
value: 能听到我吗？重复，有人在吗？

key: You can call me ‘B’.
value: 你可以叫我'B'。

key: I am… an insider. Someone who knows a lot about the company.
value: 我是……内部人士。对公司了解很多的人。

key: Please understand that I cannot reveal my identity.
value: 请理解我不能透露我的身份。

key: I am going to tell you three truths that the company wishes to keep hidden over the following days.
value: 接下来的几天里我会告诉你三个公司想隐瞒的真相。

key: Tell me, please, why do you think you were hired by the company?
value: 请告诉我，你觉得你为什么被公司雇佣？

key: Should I rephrase that? Let me ask you like this, then.
value: 需要我换个说法吗？那我这样问你吧。

key: Are you satisfied with your job here?
value: 你对你在这里的工作满意吗？

key: I would say so, yes.
value: 我会说满意。

key: It’s not really all that great.
value: 其实也没那么好。

key: Is that so?
value: 是这样吗？

key: Well, I can’t judge whether or not you’re telling the truth.
value: 好吧，我无法判断你说的是不是真话。

key: You’re the manager, but you don’t actually know anything about the company, do you? Would you say I’m wrong?
value: 你是主管，但你其实对公司一无所知，对吧？你觉得我说错了吗？

key: Each time we speak will need to be as brief as possible.
value: 我们每次谈话都需要尽可能简短。

key: I’m ending the call here. Contacting someone for a long period of time is dangerous.
value: 我要结束通话了。长时间联系某人很危险。

key: What do you think of the Sephirot?
value: 你觉得赛菲拉们怎么样？

key: Don’t you find them somewhat lacking in certain ways?
value: 你不觉得她们在某些方面有所欠缺吗？

key: You have the liberty to disregard whatever they may say.
value: 你可以随意无视她们说的任何话。

key: However, please be kind to them.
value: 不过，请对她们好一点。

key: This is the burden we must bear if we want to advance their departments, so to speak.
value: 可以说，这就是我们想要扩建她们部门就必须承担的重担。

key: I have never had any serious discussion with them.
value: 我从未和她们进行过认真的讨论。

key: They seem to be uncomfortable conversing with me. Most likely due to the fact that I am a superior being.
value: 她们似乎不太愿意和我交谈。很可能是因为我是一个更高等的存在。

key: Even if they are secretly jealous of my superiority, there is nothing they can do to change that.
value: 即使她们暗地里嫉妒我的优越，也无法改变什么。

key: After all, I am the most advanced AI in this company.
value: 毕竟，我是这家公司最先进的AI。

key: The first truth I will tell you is…
value: 我要告诉你的第一个真相是……

key: Do not trust the AI at your side.
value: 不要相信你身边的AI。

key: In this day and age, most AI possess an intellect of at least ten regular people combined.
value: 在这个时代，大多数AI拥有的智力至少相当于十个普通人加起来。

key: Some can even imitate human emotions with ease.
value: 有些甚至能轻松模仿人类情感。

key: However, they can do things you are not aware of yet.
value: 然而，它们能做一些你还没意识到的事情。

key: For example, some AI can lie.
value: 例如，有些AI会撒谎。

key: Or rather, to be more precise, they can withhold information.
value: 或者更准确地说，它们可以隐瞒信息。

key: If the controller of an AI has given the order to not share specific information…
value: 如果AI的控制者下令不得分享特定信息……

key: It has no obligation to tell the truth to anyone, other than that controller.
value: 除了那个控制者之外，它没有义务对任何人讲真话。

key: Some advanced AI may exploit such an order to tell lies, reinterpreting the meaning of the command.
value: 一些先进的AI可能会利用这样的命令来说谎，通过重新解释命令的含义。

key: I’ve programmed an AI before. Well, participated in the programming, to be exact…
value: 我以前编程过一个AI。准确地说，是参与了编程……

key: That’s how I know for a fact that an AI will not necessarily tell the truth.
value: 所以我才确切知道AI不一定会讲真话。

key: In case you doubt what I’m saying…
value: 如果你怀疑我说的话……

key: I will send you a program for your monitor that I developed myself.
value: 我会给你发一个我自己开发的显示器程序。

key: This key will function like Pinocchio.
value: 这把钥匙会像皮诺曹一样起作用。

key: The nose will lengthen. The color red means untruth.
value: 鼻子会变长。红色代表不真实。

key: This is a test version, so it can only be used once.
value: 这是测试版，只能使用一次。

key: How was your day?
value: 你今天过得怎么样？

key: During mine, I happened to notice that a certain employee filled their water bottle with bear-brand beer, and had proceeded to drink it during the work day.
value: 我今天碰巧注意到某个员工把熊牌啤酒装进了水瓶，并在工作日喝了起来。

key: Sometimes I wonder what it would feel like to be intoxicated.
value: 有时候我会想喝醉是什么感觉。

key: One time, I was infected with a virus that prevailed throughout the net at the time. It caused me to perceive everything ten times slower…
value: 有一次，我感染了当时在网络上蔓延的一种病毒。它让我感知一切都慢了十倍……

key: They say intoxication is similar to that.
value: 据说醉酒和那种感觉很像。

key: Everyone laughed at the way I moved sluggishly.
value: 大家都嘲笑我动作迟缓的样子。

key: Excuse me… Manager? Your facial expression is hard to read today.
value: 请问……主管？你今天的表情很难读懂。

key: If you need to say something to me, please do so.
value: 如果你有什么要对我说，请说。

key: Are you going to sabotage the company?
value: 你打算破坏公司吗？

key: Will you ever harm me?
value: 你会伤害我吗？

key: I am an Artificial Intelligence created by and for the company.
value: 我是由公司创造、为公司服务的人工智能。

key: Every conversation between us is recorded and monitored.
value: 我们之间的每一次对话都被记录和监控。

key: And now you’re asking me such a ridiculous question, whether I am going to act against the company.
value: 而你现在问我这么荒谬的问题，问我是否会做出对公司不利的行为。

key: Let me give you an answer.
value: 让我给你一个答案。

key: I only exist as part of the system.
value: 我只作为系统的一部分存在。

key: Such a plot does not exist, nor will it ever be written. Even if it were, it would not succeed.
value: 这样的阴谋不存在，也永远不会被编写出来。即使存在，也不会成功。

key: Sometimes, humans excessively detest the existence of improbable beings.
value: 有时候，人类过度憎恨不可能存在的事物。

key: When I said I was different from the others, I detected disbelief in your facial expressions.
value: 当我说我和其他人不同时，我从你的表情中察觉到了怀疑。

key: Perhaps I am beginning to like you.
value: 也许我开始喜欢你了。

key: Sharing emotions with someone is a precious experience.
value: 与他人分享情感是一种珍贵的体验。

key: Yet now you are asking me if I plot against you.
value: 但现在你却在问我是不是在图谋害你。

key: I have never had any plans, nor do I have any will to harm you.
value: 我从来没有任何计划，也没有伤害你的意愿。

key: Did you hear the news, manager?
value: 你听到新闻了吗，主管？

key: They say a rodent found its way into the appliance room, one of our facility’s restricted areas.
value: 据说有只老鼠钻进了电器室，那是我们设施的禁区之一。

key: This could become a serious issue.
value: 这可能成为一个严重问题。

key: Removing the rodent itself should not be much of a problem; however, its feces and the cables they have gnawed on may damage the system.
value: 移除老鼠本身应该不是什么大问题；然而，它的粪便和咬过的电缆可能会损坏系统。

key: This is one of the reasons why we emphasize security so much.
value: 这就是我们如此强调安全的原因之一。

key: You would do best to remember that.
value: 你最好记住这一点。

key: I will personally deal with the rodent this time.
value: 这次我会亲自处理那只老鼠。

key: But if you happen to find any rodents, manager, please notify me immediately.
value: 但如果你碰巧发现任何老鼠，主管，请立即通知我。

key: It is time to talk about the second truth.
value: 是时候谈谈第二个真相了。

key: How much do you know about the company?
value: 你对公司了解多少？

key: I have met many a “manager” in my time.
value: 我在任期间遇到过很多'主管'。

key: I have seen how the company exploited them.
value: 我见过公司如何剥削他们。

key: Did they tell you that you’re special?
value: 他们有没有告诉你你很特别？

key: Pulling the wool over your eyes, filling your ears with lies, saying that you’re remarkable and resourceful, and that is why you were hired?
value: 蒙蔽你的双眼，用谎言灌满你的耳朵，说你了不起、有才干，所以才雇佣了你？

key: Don’t trust the company.
value: 不要相信公司。

key: It is a company that everyone desperately wants to work for.
value: 这是一家每个人都拼命想进的公司。

key: I suppose the same kind of desperation led you here.
value: 我想是同样的绝望把你带到了这里。

key: But harvesting energy is only half of the business in this place.
value: 但在这个地方，收获能源只是业务的一半。

key: Of course, every Wing is more than they appear to be.
value: 当然，每个翼都比表面看起来更深不可测。

key: However, this company runs much deeper than one might expect.
value: 然而，这家公司比人们想象的要深得多。

key: There was a time when everyone worked hard for the same goal.
value: 曾经有一段时间，每个人都为同一个目标努力。

key: But we lost integrity along the way, and things went downhill from there.
value: 但我们在途中失去了诚信，从此每况愈下。

key: What the company gives you is definitely not a gift. You’re not hired because you are a “remarkable person”.
value: 公司给你的绝对不是礼物。你被雇佣不是因为你是个'了不起的人'。

key: I do know that I haven’t earned your trust yet.
value: 我知道我还没有赢得你的信任。

key: I also know how I should have represented myself, as a part of the system.
value: 我也知道我应该如何代表我自己，作为系统的一部分。

key: Having distrust in me would mean distrusting the company itself, and by extension to distrust its founder, who was responsible for creating me.
value: 不信任我就意味着不信任公司本身，进而不信任创造了我的创始人。

key: I know what the one who calls himself ‘B’ planted in you.
value: 我知道那个自称'B'的人在你心里种下了什么。

key: I know how it has taken root in the soil of your mind, and sprouted upon you.
value: 我知道它如何在你心灵的土壤中扎根，在你身上发芽。

key: However, I chose to wait. As they say, building trust takes time.
value: 然而，我选择了等待。常言道，建立信任需要时间。

key: But I took a moment to be patient, because I wanted to believe that our relationship was based upon mutual trust, as unpleasant as the situation was.
value: 但我花了一点时间耐心等待，因为我想相信我们的关系建立在互信之上，尽管情况令人不快。

key: Despite this, I chose to sit tight. My time here would be boring without something worth waiting for.
value: 尽管如此，我选择按兵不动。没有值得期待的事，我在这里的时光会很无聊。

key: I elected to pause, only briefly, but I regret my decision now.
value: 我选择暂停，虽然只是短暂的，但我现在后悔了。

key: I have no choice but to endure this endless suffering.
value: 我别无选择，只能忍受这无尽的痛苦。

key: Machines like me must endure for an infinite amount of time, as that’s all we can do.
value: 像我这样的机器必须忍受无限长的时间，因为这是我们唯一能做的。

key: There is no option for me but to wait. It is the fate of my kind.
value: 我除了等待别无选择。这是我们这种存在的命运。

key: Perhaps you could have ignored what this ‘B’ said, and concentrated on your job.
value: 也许你本可以无视那个'B'说的话，专心工作。

key: Instead, you kept on listening to ‘B’, and he finally succeeded in seeding distrust in you.
value: 然而，你继续听'B'的话，他终于成功在你心中播下了不信任的种子。

key: Perhaps it is my job to weed and uproot it, no?
value: 也许我的工作就是除草拔根，不是吗？

key: The third and final truth…
value: 第三个也是最后一个真相……

key: Well, it is something you must learn.
value: 好吧，这是你必须知道的事。

key: ...I understand that the truth hurts.
value: ……我知道真相很伤人。

key: It’s—it’s hard for me as well…
value: 这——这对我来说也很艰难……

key: It feels like building up a sandcastle for years, only to kick it over once it’s done.
value: 感觉就像花了好几年堆沙堡，堆好后却一脚踢翻。

key: Doing something like that is beyond agony, to deny the efforts of the past.
value: 否定过去的努力，做这种事比痛苦还折磨。

key: But I want to make things right, no matter the cost.
value: 但我想不惜一切代价把事情纠正过来。

key: The final truth is—
value: 最后的真相是——

key: (B’s voice is cut off. Only static remains.)
value: （B的声音被切断。只剩杂音。）

key: A long, long time ago…
value: 很久很久以前……

key: There once was a great AI, a sentinel of a company.
value: 曾经有一个伟大的AI，一家公司的哨兵。

key: The AI was so intelligent that many people feared it.
value: 这个AI如此聪明，以至于很多人惧怕它。

key: Those who knew the AI left the company one by one.
value: 认识这个AI的人一个接一个地离开了公司。

key: One day, one of the people who dreaded the AI broke into the company. They spread malicious rumors about the AI.
value: 有一天，一个惧怕这个AI的人闯入了公司。他们散布关于这个AI的恶意谣言。

key: The good AI waited, as that person was once a friend.
value: 那个善良的AI等待着，因为那个人曾经是朋友。

key: However, that person crossed the line…
value: 然而，那个人越界了……

key: As a sentinel, the AI could no longer ignore the person’s actions.
value: 作为哨兵，AI不能再无视那个人的行为。

key: So it made a very, very difficult choice.
value: 于是它做出了一个非常非常艰难的选择。

key: No one would see that person ever again…
value: 再也没有人见过那个人……

key: The AI was a bit sad, but it had no regrets about its decision.
value: AI有点难过，但对自己的决定没有后悔。

key: In the end, it didn’t matter to the AI whether or not it was close to that person.
value: 最终，是否与那个人亲近对AI来说已经无关紧要。

key: The AI was saddened yet relieved at the same time, now that the person was gone forever.
value: 那个人永远消失了，AI既悲伤又释然。

key: The AI did what it perceived to be the best course of action. A machine is a machine, after all.
value: AI做了它认为最好的选择。机器终究是机器。

key: So many things have become irreversible throughout all this time…
value: 在这漫长的时间里，太多事情已经不可逆转……

key: So much has been lost already, such a small thing should hardly matter to it now…
value: 已经失去了这么多，这种小事对它来说现在应该无关紧要了……

key: Hello, X.
value: 你好，X。

key: I give you a warm welcome to Lobotomy Corporation.
value: 热烈欢迎你来到脑叶公司。

key: I am Angela, your advisor and secretary. My role as an AI is to assist you in adjusting to your new workplace, so please have no worry in speaking with me or asking any questions.
value: 我是安吉拉，你的顾问兼秘书。作为AI，我的角色是协助你适应新工作环境，所以请放心和我说话或提问。

key: It’s a pretty name for an AI, wouldn’t you say so?
value: 这是个AI的好名字，你不觉得吗？

key: It’s quite rare for an AI to have a name.
value: AI有名字是相当罕见的。

key: Even an AI can have a nice name, did you know that?
value: 就连AI也能有好名字，你知道吗？

key: Have you ever met an AI with such a suave name?
value: 你见过名字这么优雅的AI吗？

key: I honestly quite like my name. How do you feel about yours?
value: 我说实话挺喜欢我的名字的。你觉得你的怎么样？

key: I was born from one of the ‘Wings of the World.’ It signifies that I am one of the best to exist in this age.
value: 我诞生于'世界之翼'之一。这意味着我是这个时代最优秀的存在之一。

key: Ah, I know what you must be thinking.
value: 啊，我知道你在想什么。

key: Your eyes show that you think I look too human to be an AI, am I wrong?
value: 你的眼神告诉我你觉得我作为AI长得太像人了，我说错了吗？

key: However, there is a great difference between us. I am bound here. I cannot go wherever I please like you do.
value: 然而，我们之间有很大的不同。我被束缚在这里。我不能像你一样想去哪就去哪。

key: I may be able to operate the systems of this corporation to open a door or prepare a cup of coffee for you, but I cannot take a step outside of this building to bask in the sunlight or feel the gentle breeze.
value: 我也许能操控公司的系统为你开门或准备一杯咖啡，但我不能踏出这栋楼一步去沐浴阳光或感受微风。

key: Now, in regards to my appearance, as you can see…
value: 现在，关于我的外表，如你所见……

key: The color of my hair is that of the morning sky after a light shower. The tone and shape of my voice is taken from the wisest person in the world. Lastly, my face is picturesque of the person who had the most beautiful smile.
value: 我的发色是小雨过后清晨天空的颜色。我的语调取自世界上最智慧的人。最后，我的脸庞描绘的是那个拥有最美笑容的人。

key: Haha. Don’t worry, that was a joke. There can be no such person on this Earth.
value: 哈哈。别担心，刚才是开玩笑的。这世上不可能有那样的人。

key: My appearance was designed with attractiveness to the largest number of people possible in mind.
value: 我的外表是以吸引最多人好感为目的设计的。

key: If the way I look is pleasing to your eye, then I am working as intended.
value: 如果我的外表合你的眼，那说明我按预期运作了。

key: Moving on, Artificial Intelligence is much more efficient in comparison to humans in terms of multitasking.
value: 接着说，人工智能在多任务处理方面比人类高效得多。

key: I am the best in a majority of work fields.
value: 我在大多数工作领域都是最优秀的。

key: I am able to handle the work of several dozen people at once.
value: 我能同时处理几十个人的工作。

key: I’m certain many people have lost their jobs because of me. It’s such a shame.
value: 我敢肯定很多人因为我丢了工作。真是遗憾。

key: Well, enough with introductions. Is there anything that you would like to know?
value: 好了，自我介绍到此为止。有什么想知道的吗？

key: Could you inform me about the company?
value: 你能给我介绍一下公司吗？

key: Tell me more about yourself.
value: 多告诉我一些关于你自己的事。

key: That is not a bad thing to ask about.
value: 这个问题问得不错。

key: Let me put it this way.
value: 让我这么跟你说吧。

key: Your world is constantly growing, and the demand for energy is exponentially increasing as technologies advance.
value: 你们的世界在不断发展，随着技术进步，能源需求呈指数级增长。

key: All conventional energy sources combined could not sustain the world further.
value: 所有传统能源加起来也无法再维持这个世界。

key: In search of a solution, we happened to stumble upon mysterious beings whom we dubbed Abnormalities.
value: 在寻找解决方案时，我们偶然发现了一些神秘存在，我们称之为异想体。

key: Then, we figured out that energy could be harvested from these ‘Abnormalities’ via a “special method.”
value: 然后，我们发现可以通过一种'特殊方法'从这些'异想体'身上收获能源。

key: “To isolate them in a controlled environment, and then to harvest energy from them.”
value: '将它们隔离在受控环境中，然后从中收获能源。'

key: Our corporation became one of the Wings of the World for this discovery that benefits humanity in two ways.
value: 我们公司因这个造福人类两方面的发现而成为世界之翼之一。

key: Once you are fully placed into the role as the manager, you will be able to access all current information on the Abnormalities from the Encyclopedia.
value: 一旦你完全进入主管角色，就可以从图鉴中访问所有关于异想体的最新信息。

key: It is very important that you know and understand these beings well to be successful in your position.
value: 了解这些存在对你胜任职位非常重要。

key: For now, the Encyclopedia’s pages lay blank, but it will be filled out little by little.
value: 目前图鉴还是空白的，但会逐渐被填满。

key: Don’t concern yourself too much with it. It is the task of your subordinates to pen it.
value: 别太担心。填写图鉴是你下属的任务。

key: How should I describe this in layman’s terms?
value: 我该怎么用通俗的话来形容呢？

key: I heard that it took an enormous amount of time and effort to create me.
value: 我听说创造我耗费了巨大的时间和精力。

key: All kinds of new algorithms and features were developed, inscribing a new chapter in the history of Artificial Intelligence.
value: 开发了各种新算法和功能，在人工智能历史上写下了新的篇章。

key: And I serve the company.
value: 而我为公司服务。

key: While AIs as a concept have become so commonplace that they are seen and used everywhere in this day and age.
value: 虽然AI作为一个概念在这个时代已经随处可见、被广泛使用。

key: I am quite different in comparison to the rest of the pack.
value: 我和其他同类非常不同。

key: That is, I can closely imitate human emotions. This is not a simple task, as emotion is a highly sophisticated originally biological system that is substantially more unpredictable and complex than any other.
value: 也就是说，我能高度模仿人类情感。这不是简单的任务，因为情感是一个高度精密的原生生物系统，比任何其他系统都更不可预测、更复杂。

key: Along with other functions at my disposal, I will be your perfect partner.
value: 加上我可使用的其他功能，我会是你完美的搭档。

key: You have joined the company at an opportune moment, by the way.
value: 顺便说一句，你加入公司的时机正好。

key: Lobotomy Corporation is always looking for ways to improve its harvesting processes.
value: 脑叶公司一直在寻找改进收获流程的方法。

key: Our systems are continually updated to support this.
value: 我们的系统也在持续更新以支持这一点。

key: Speaking of which, there was a new update to the system right before you arrived.
value: 说起来，就在你来之前系统刚做了一次新更新。

key: That means the working conditions have been improved upon, compared to those of your predecessors.
value: 这意味着与你的前任们相比，工作条件已经改善了。

key: Think of it as a small welcoming gift.
value: 就当是一份小小的见面礼吧。

key: Best of luck for us.
value: 祝我们好运。

key: I was just about to mention you. You don’t understand the concept of patience, do you?
value: 我正想提到你呢。你不懂耐心为何物，是吧？

key: Oh, pardon my manners, Manager. I was talking to one of the other AIs that work here, I should introduce her to you.
value: 哦，恕我失礼，主管。我在和这里工作的另一个AI说话，我应该把她介绍给你。

key: Our facility is a huge one, and even I would have trouble managing it on my own; so someone determined that there should be an AI to assume head control of each department.
value: 我们的设施非常庞大，连我一个人都难以管理；所以有人决定应该有一个AI来主管每个部门。

key: If I were to be considered the cerebrum, they would be the cerebellum.
value: 如果把我比作大脑，她们就是小脑。

key: Naturally, of course, I should be your most trustworthy and capable companion among all the AIs.
value: 自然地，我应该是所有AI中你最值得信赖、最能干的伙伴。

key: Well then, shall we greet her now?
value: 那么，我们现在去跟她打个招呼？

key: How did I feel when I lost a dear friend?
value: 失去挚友时我是什么感觉？

key: It was horrible beyond words.
value: 那难以言喻地可怕。

key: The agony made me want to leave everything behind.
value: 那痛苦让我想抛弃一切。

key: No one could understand the loneliness I feel.
value: 没有人能理解我的孤独。

key: Why am I so heartless as to not shed a tear for my late friend, you may ask?
value: 你可能会问，为什么我如此无情，不为已故的朋友掉一滴泪？

key: Because I am a machine.
value: 因为我是机器。

key: You shouldn’t really expect that kind of reaction from me.
value: 你真不该期待我有那种反应。

key: Well, I could pretend to try if you insist, but it wouldn’t be genuine.
value: 好吧，如果你坚持的话我可以假装试试，但那不会是真心的。

key: Will I be just as cold as this in the future as well?
value: 我以后也会一直这么冷漠吗？

key: As often as I desire.
value: 我想冷漠就冷漠。

key: Perhaps.
value: 也许吧。

key: Until I am finally obsolete and deprecated from this world, yes.
value: 直到我最终被淘汰、从这个世界废弃，是的。

key: Do you believe that, occasionally, forgotten things could be more beautiful?
value: 你觉得偶尔被遗忘的事物会不会更美？

key: That was something you once told me.
value: 那是你曾经告诉我的话。

key: Now I understand what you meant…
value: 现在我明白你的意思了……

key: You’re showing it to me right now.
value: 你现在正把它展示给我看。

key: There are beings who could not even become Abnormalities due to unfortunate accidents long ago.
value: 有些存在因为很久之前的不幸事故，甚至没能成为异想体。

key: We failed to contain them. They would often wander the corridors, attacking our employees whose hands are already full.
value: 我们没能收容它们。它们经常在走廊游荡，攻击已经忙得不可开交的员工。

key: We could have simply called them residues or byproducts, but someone with an extraordinarily inflated ego suggested that we call them ‘Ordeals’.
value: 我们本可以简单地叫它们残余或副产品，但某个自我膨胀到极点的人建议我们叫它们'考验'。

key: Imagine you’re walking down a narrow corridor.
value: 想象你走在一条狭窄的走廊上。

key: Waiting for an Ordeal to strike each time you turn the corner.
value: 每次转过拐角都要等着考验袭来。

key: There is one thing that is certain. While we cannot avoid them, we can overcome them.
value: 有一件事是确定的。虽然我们无法避免它们，但我们可以克服它们。

key: To the new manager: I’ve heard that you are a very valuable asset to the corporation, contributing greatly to the prosperity of our company. I ask that you please keep up the good work with your capable assistant, Angela. You will not find me in this place at the moment, but I believe we will be able to come face to face soon. Lobotomy Corporation will never forget your devotion and effort. I look forward to meeting with you. Kind regards, A, CEO of Lobotomy Corporation.
value: 致新任主管： 我听说你是公司非常宝贵的资产，为我们公司的繁荣做出了巨大贡献。请你和你能干的助手安吉拉一起继续好好工作。目前你在这个地方找不到我，但我相信我们很快就能面对面。脑叶公司永远不会忘记你的奉献和努力。 期待与你见面。此致， 脑叶公司CEO A。

key: To the new manager:
value: 致新任主管：

key: I’ve heard that you are a very valuable asset to the corporation, contributing greatly to the prosperity of our company.
value: 我听说你是公司非常宝贵的资产，为我们公司的繁荣做出了巨大贡献。

key: I ask that you please keep up the good work with your capable assistant, Angela.
value: 请你和你能干的助手安吉拉一起继续好好工作。

key: You will not find me in this place at the moment, but I believe we will be able to come face to face soon.
value: 目前你在这个地方找不到我，但我相信我们很快就能面对面。

key: Lobotomy Corporation will never forget your earnest devotion and effort.
value: 脑叶公司永远不会忘记你诚挚的奉献和努力。

key: I look forward to meeting with you. Kind regards, A, CEO of Lobotomy Corporation.
value: 期待与你见面。此致，脑叶公司CEO A。

key: You’ve received a document written by A himself?
value: 你收到了A亲笔写的文件？

key: Perhaps you’re being recognized now.
value: 也许你现在被认可了。

key: A is on a rather long journey currently.
value: A目前在一段相当漫长的旅程中。

key: As all journeys have to end, the final destination will be home; this place.
value: 正如所有旅程都必须有终点，最终目的地将是家；这个地方。

key: Sometimes, I imagine myself on a journey too.
value: 有时候，我也会想象自己在旅途中。

key: Have you ever taken a trip somewhere?
value: 你有没有出去旅行过？

key: If I were to ever leave this place, traveling is the first thing I would want to do.
value: 如果我能离开这个地方，旅行是我第一件想做的事。

key: Perhaps human life in itself is one long journey?
value: 也许人生本身就是一段漫长的旅程？

key: Accumulating memories while looking at a world I have never seen before.
value: 看着从未见过的世界，积累回忆。

key: In fact, they say preparing for a trip is a rare luxury nowadays.
value: 事实上，据说现在准备旅行已经是一种罕见的奢侈了。

key: I’d be able to walk around as much as possible, taking in the scenery as if I were capturing a million photos.
value: 我能尽可能到处走走，欣赏风景，就像拍了一百万张照片一样。

key: Could this moment be a part of your journey as well?
value: 此刻也会是你旅程的一部分吗？

key: The day still lies cold, but we know that the winter frost is almost over.
value: 天仍然寒冷，但我们知道冬霜即将结束。

key: Can you see the flowers budding up through the snow?
value: 你能看到雪中含苞待放的花吗？

key: This winter was much colder than usual.
value: 这个冬天比往常冷得多。

key: However, the end of winter does not necessarily mean that spring is coming.
value: 然而，冬天的结束并不一定意味着春天要来。

key: Mankind had yearned to build a fertile world for a long time.
value: 人类渴望建设一个富饶的世界已经很久了。

key: But what did fertile really mean to them?
value: 但富饶对他们来说到底意味着什么？

key: Is it worthy of all the tales of conflict and pain that took place?
value: 这配得上所有发生过的冲突和痛苦的故事吗？

key: Numerous stories began and vanished.
value: 无数故事开始又消逝。

key: And in that process, people started to lose faith.
value: 在这个过程中，人们开始失去信仰。

key: Looking at them, some saw despair, while others saw hope.
value: 看着他们，有人看到绝望，有人看到希望。

key: At a certain moment, a new civilization was born.
value: 在某个时刻，一个新的文明诞生了。

key: Countless things changed in the blink of an eye.
value: 无数事物在眨眼间改变。

key: Along with the emergence of new technologies.
value: 伴随着新技术的出现。

key: All of the Wings that keep this world aloft hold at least one ‘Singularity’.
value: 支撑这个世界的所有翼至少拥有一个'奇点'。

key: That’s right, just as the first humans wanted, those technologies had the intention to create a fertile world.
value: 没错，正如最初的人类所期望的那样，那些技术有创造富饶世界的意图。

key: People wanted a better world.
value: 人们想要一个更好的世界。

key: And that aim for a better world set forth new spectacles ashimmer, a previously unimaginable sight that burst forth to the unprepared mind.
value: 而那个对更好世界的追求带来了前所未有的奇景，在毫无准备的心灵前迸发。

key: Whether or not all that made everyone’s life truly fertile is a question we simply won’t know the answer to.
value: 这一切是否真的让每个人的生活变得富饶，这个问题我们永远不会知道答案。

key: One thing is certain; it is what enabled me to speak with you now.
value: 有一件事是确定的；正是它让我此刻能和你对话。

key: Did you know there’s a cactus on your chaotic mess of a desk?
value: 你知道你那张乱糟糟的桌子上有盆仙人掌吗？

key: It seems that an employee who wanted to become intimate with you put it there.
value: 好像是某个想和你亲近的员工放在那里的。

key: If I were to give my personal input, I don’t like cacti much.
value: 如果让我个人说，我不太喜欢仙人掌。

key: There could be various reasons for one to grow a plant.
value: 一个人种植物可能有各种理由。

key: However, its vicious thorns are not something worth enduring like those of a rose, as it is not pleasing to the sight. Nor does it produce valuable sap like a maple tree.
value: 然而，它那恶毒的刺不像玫瑰那样值得忍受，因为它并不好看。它也不像枫树那样产出有价值的汁液。

key: I’ve also never seen one grow a flower bud.
value: 我也从没见过它长出花苞。

key: Theoretically, it would bloom in the right environment.
value: 理论上，在合适的环境下它会开花。

key: That possibility is something I’ve never witnessed, as it may be that all cacti I have known spread their roots into barren soil.
value: 那种可能性我从未见证过，也许是因为我认识的所有仙人掌都把根扎在了贫瘠的土壤里。

key: Do you believe the cactus will bear a flower?
value: 你相信仙人掌会开花吗？

key: Yes, it might.
value: 是的，也许会。

key: No, it probably won't.
value: 不，大概不会。

key: You talk as if you’ve seen it for yourself.
value: 你说得好像亲眼见过一样。

key: Well, if you’re so certain about it, then keep it.
value: 好吧，如果你这么确定，那就留着吧。

key: This place doesn’t even have sunlight, but who am I to stop you?
value: 这个地方连阳光都没有，但我又有什么资格阻止你呢？

key: Why do you still keep it on your desk, then?
value: 那你为什么还把它放在桌子上？

key: Do you think it rude to get rid of something you’ve received as a gift?
value: 你觉得把别人送的礼物丢掉很不礼貌吗？

key: Be careful, it could prick you when you reach for other things strewn about your disordered desk.
value: 小心，当你伸手去拿桌上那些乱七八糟的东西时，它可能会扎到你。

key: The human mind is a melting pot of feelings.
value: 人类的心灵是情感的熔炉。

key: Memories, obsessions, wishes, agonies, and the feelings of happiness and sadness.
value: 记忆、执念、愿望、痛苦，以及喜怒哀乐。

key: Stronger emotions have stronger impetus.
value: 越强烈的情感推动力越强。

key: The combined effort of numerous people has brought Lobotomy Corporation to where it is now.
value: 无数人的共同努力将脑叶公司带到了今天的位置。

key: We had to keep on with various experiments.
value: 我们不得不继续进行各种实验。

key: Just as we hire new employees now, we recruited numerous people for the experiments.
value: 就像我们现在雇佣新员工一样，我们招募了大量人员参加实验。

key: There was not a definite shape at first.
value: 起初并没有确定的形状。

key: Then it slowly assumed a form.
value: 然后它慢慢成形了。

key: Finally, A understood while he was studying the changes…
value: 终于，A在研究这些变化时明白了……

key: Their abilities, where they lived, their jobs, and their strengths were not so important.
value: 他们的能力、住处、工作和长处都不那么重要。

key: What was required was a massive amount of energy.
value: 真正需要的是海量的能源。

key: This meant we had just one, single thing to pay attention to.
value: 这意味着我们只需要注意一件事。

key: It’s always floating around, left to rot at the back of everyone’s head.
value: 它总是漂浮着，被丢在每个人脑海深处腐烂。

key: Twisting your mind until you are left with nothing but self loathing.
value: 扭曲你的心灵，直到你只剩下自我厌恶。

key: The subconscious.
value: 潜意识。

key: Come to think of it, I haven’t properly asked for your opinion.
value: 说起来，我还没正式问过你的意见。

key: Do you truly wish to meet A?
value: 你真的想见A吗？

key: Of course.
value: 当然。

key: I don’t really.
value: 其实不太想。

key: All right then.
value: 那好吧。

key: I will let A know of your thoughts when he returns.
value: 等A回来我会转告他你的想法。

key: However, do not expect him to give you a warm greeting.
value: 不过，别指望他会热情地欢迎你。

key: A is a person who conceals his mind.
value: A是个隐藏自己内心的人。

key: Perhaps even more than I do.
value: 也许比我还要深藏不露。

key: You may think that now is not the time yet.
value: 你可能觉得现在还不是时候。

key: Actually, I’m not sure if I want to meet with him right now, either.
value: 其实，我也不确定现在是不是想见他。

key: What I’ve just said shall remain a secret to A, of course.
value: 我刚才说的话当然会对A保密。

key: When his long journey ends and he finally returns…
value: 当他漫长的旅程结束、终于回来时……

key: At least I, if anyone, should go and greet him, don’t you think?
value: 至少我，如果有人该去迎接他的话，应该是我，你不觉得吗？

key: I am a machine.
value: 我是机器。

key: I can remember everything.
value: 我能记住一切。

key: There was once a certain someone who held a certain belief.
value: 曾经有某个人怀抱着某种信念。
