key: Face that fear if you want to stop the cycle.
value: 如果你想停止循环，就面对那份恐惧。

key: The Eye Facing the Fear; Breaking the Cycle
value: 直面恐惧之眼；打破循环

key: Do you truly believe you can see things clearly, when you couldn’t even face them all this time?
value: 你一直都不敢面对事物，现在真的以为自己能看清吗？

key: You are only saying this because you are afraid, aren’t you?
value: 你这么说是因为你害怕，不是吗？

key: If you truly think it is a misdeed to deprive them of the act of facing their fear…
value: 如果你真的认为剥夺人们面对恐惧的行为是一种恶行……

key: Then listen well.
value: 那就好好听着。

key: If we can conduct hundreds, no, thousands of good deeds, committing one single sin is acceptable.
value: 如果我们能做上百件，不，上千件好事，犯一个罪是可以接受的。

key: Helping to shed everyone from their empty skin, can you not see how that is the greatest good of all?
value: 帮助每个人挣脱空壳，你看不出这是至善之举吗？

key: People need someone like us.
value: 人们需要我们这样的人。

key: Think about the wave of redemption that will follow.
value: 想想随之而来的救赎浪潮吧。

key: It is within every person’s instinct to pursue freedom.
value: 追求自由是每个人的本能。

key: Please remember the reason why I happily let you pass.
value: 请记住我欣然放你过去的理由。

key: I did so because I wanted to see you fly with your own strength, despite being left in this harsh world with a skin as fragile as yours.
value: 我这么做是因为我想看到你用自己的力量飞翔，尽管你被留在这个严酷的世界里，皮肤如此脆弱。

key: Perhaps if we had talked more sincerely in the past…
value: 也许如果我们过去更真诚地交谈……

key: Perhaps… it may have resulted in better circumstances.
value: 也许……结果会更好。

key: However, we have already left our past far behind us. There is no turning back.
value: 然而，我们已经把过去远远抛在身后。没有回头路。

key: We live in endless conflict and regret, starting from birth up and unto death.
value: 我们从出生到死亡，都活在无尽的冲突和悔恨中。

key: We grow by embracing that conflict—that regret—and we walk towards the future.
value: 我们通过拥抱那份冲突——那份悔恨——而成长，走向未来。

key: The Eye Embracing the Past; Building the Future
value: 拥抱过去之眼；构筑未来

key: So you refuse to join me, and instead choose to move toward the unpredictable future?
value: 所以你拒绝跟我走，反而选择走向不可预测的未来？

key: Our days will be filled with marvel and wonder that you cannot possibly imagine if you join me.
value: 如果你跟我走，我们的日子将充满你无法想象的奇迹和惊叹。

key: You are painfully crawling through each day, and you still aren’t even sure if you are on the right path.
value: 你每天痛苦地爬行，甚至还不确定自己是否走在正确的路上。

key: Our sacred secret cannot be wasted like this, no.
value: 我们神圣的秘密不能这样浪费，不能。

key: I cannot spare any more time. If you are not ready, I shall go first.
value: 我不能再浪费时间了。如果你没准备好，我先走一步。

key: ..Are you…?
Heh, so you don’t want to stop here, but instead stop me from going forward.
value: 呵，所以你不想停在这里，反而想阻止我前进。

key: So you do not want me to be at your side, even for the finale of this play.
value: 所以你不想让我陪在你身边，哪怕是这出戏的终幕。

key: Those who shall face the end, together with you…
value: 那些将与你一同面对终局的人……

key: It seems I am not among them…
value: 看来我不在他们之中……

key: The flesh that lies within is bound to rot when it’s covered with ill-fitting skin.
value: 被不合身的皮肤包裹着，里面的肉体注定会腐烂。

key: Do not worry; I shall demonstrate, for I know everything.
value: 别担心；我会证明给你看，因为我知道一切。

key: You are me, and I am you.
value: 你是我，我是你。

key: I am the only one of us who realized the one truth, and stood atop the world itself.
value: 我们之中唯一领悟了唯一真相、站在世界之巅的人就是我。

key: I am the you who shall leave the paths I walked once, and choose to join the world she truly wanted to create.
value: 我是那个将离开我曾经走过的路、选择加入她真正想要创造的世界的你。

key: And you and I, we shall be the us who can do whatever we imagine from now on.
value: 而你和我，我们将成为从现在起可以为所欲为的我们。

key: M-Monsters! Help me, please!
value: 怪、怪物！救救我，求你了！

key: Something weird’s g-growing out of me. L-Look at this, ahahahahaha!
value: 有什么奇怪的东西从我身上长出来了。看、看这个，哈哈哈哈哈！

key: Behold.
value: 看吧。

key: Witness how this loss-ridden world is perfected by us.
value: 见证这个充满失落的世界如何被我们完美化。

key: The foolish god named rationality ruled over this world until this moment.
value: 那个名为理性的愚蠢之神统治这个世界直到此刻。

key: No, to call it a god is an overstatement. It is simply a tragic illusion.
value: 不，称它为神都抬举它了。它不过是一场可悲的幻觉。

key: We shall drag it down from the heavens with our own hands and open everyone’s eyes to the truth.
value: 我们将亲手把它从天堂拖下来，让所有人睁开眼睛看到真相。

key: Yes, the world Carmen yearned for will soon unravel before your eyes.
value: 是的，卡门渴望的世界很快就会在你眼前展开。

key: Let us create this paradise, you and I.
value: 让我们创造这个乐园，你和我。

key: Even the Head and the Eye are merely human. They cannot stop those of us who have accepted the truth.
value: 连首脑和眼也不过是凡人。他们无法阻止我们这些接受了真相的人。

key: You know that everything we witnessed in this land is only a shadow, and that you never saw the truth until now.
value: 你知道我们在这片土地上见证的一切都只是影子，直到现在你才看到真相。

key: With this, the plump fruit of redemption will reach everyone’s hearts.
value: 这样，救赎的饱满果实将抵达每个人的心中。

key: Those abandoned, those who hold power, those with wealth, those who remain hopeful, all of them.
value: 被遗弃的人、掌权者、富人、仍怀希望的人，所有人。

key: The tree of humanity will reach the root of this world.
value: 人类之树将抵达这个世界的根。

key: Again, behold.
value: 再一次，看吧。

key: Did I not declare that all shall be free in the end?
value: 我不是宣布过所有人最终都将自由吗？

key: Do you wish to know why it has come to this?
value: 你想知道为什么会变成这样吗？

key: It is due to your lack of self faith.
value: 那是因为你缺乏自信。

key: Faithless actions only result in a dreadful death.
value: 无信之举只会导致可怕的死亡。

key: Do you take pride in what you do here?
value: 你为在这里做的事感到自豪吗？

key: If not, this recent news will likely change your mind.
value: 如果不，这条最近的消息可能会改变你的想法。

key: After your arrival, the rate of energy output has increased by 13%.
value: 自从你到来后，能源产出率提高了13%。

key: If you still don’t feel the significance of this figure, then let me add that it’s a record breaking percentage.
value: 如果你还没感受到这个数字的意义，那我补充一下，这是破纪录的百分比。

key: How do you feel?
value: 你感觉如何？

key: I can take pride in that.
value: 我可以为此感到自豪。

key: I'm not sure…
value: 我不确定……

key: Ever since you began working here, the company has been taking strides in improvement.
value: 自从你开始在这里工作，公司一直在大步改进。

key: This means you are performing your role well.
value: 这说明你很好地履行了你的角色。

key: This shows that there should only be good news to come.
value: 这表明接下来应该只有好消息。

key: A machine such as myself doesn’t flatter easily.
value: 像我这样的机器不轻易奉承人。

key: It is good to know that you’re happy with your work.
value: 知道你对工作满意真好。

key: I remember your face the very first time you came here.
value: 我记得你第一次来这里时的脸。

key: You were so withdrawn…
value: 你那么孤僻……

key: Face all gray and grim.
value: 脸色灰暗阴沉。

key: And you were all nervous about my presence.
value: 而且你对我的存在很紧张。

key: Don’t worry, it’s okay for you to be happy now.
value: 别担心，你现在可以开心了。

key: Why do you say that?
value: 你为什么这么说？

key: Is it not normal to be happy in a situation like this?
value: 在这种情况下开心不正常吗？

key: For your information, I had practically run here.
value: 告诉你，我几乎是跑着来的。

key: All just to deliver this great news to you.
value: 就为了把这个好消息告诉你。

key: That’s a figure of speech of course, but I did not expect you to react like this.
value: 当然这是比喻，但我没想到你会是这种反应。

key: It would be nice if you were a bit happier.
value: 如果你能开心一点就好了。

key: Today’s a rather special day.
value: 今天是个相当特别的日子。

key: Do you see that bottle of champagne on the table? Allow me to pour you a glass. Shall we toast?
value: 看到桌上那瓶香槟了吗？让我给你倒一杯。我们干杯？

key: Ah, today’s occasion is not something as monumental as someone’s birthday, or the company’s day of founding.
value: 啊，今天的场合不是什么生日或公司成立纪念日那样的大事。

key: You lost an employee for the first time yesterday.
value: 你昨天第一次失去了一名员工。

key: In fact, many more shall follow. I’m telling you this just in case you were unexpectedly shocked by the news.
value: 事实上，还会有更多。我告诉你这个是以防你对这个消息感到意外震惊。

key: They had known the risks from the beginning. The company grows, fertilized by their sacrifices. It’s as simple as that.
value: 他们从一开始就知道风险。公司在他们的牺牲滋养下成长。就这么简单。

key: I am sure they would have felt proud of themselves as they took their final breath.
value: 我确信他们在咽下最后一口气时会为自己感到骄傲。

key: Accepting their deaths with equanimity would be the greatest respect you can pay to them.
value: 平静地接受他们的死亡是你能给予他们的最大尊重。

key: That is why I popped this bottle of champagne I’ve kept for so long.
value: 所以我才打开了这瓶存了这么久的香槟。

key: Three cheers for the deceased, in memoriam of their noble sacrifices!
value: 为逝者三呼，纪念他们崇高的牺牲！

key: I’ll drink the champagne.
value: 我要喝香槟。

key: I don’t want to drink right now.
value: 我现在不想喝。

key: Allow me to give you a small bit of advice.
value: 让我给你一点小建议。

key: To properly drink a glass of champagne, one should gently hold the lower stem of the glass, and then take it in lightly, savoring the bubbles.
value: 要正确地喝一杯香槟，应该轻轻握住杯柄下端，然后小口品味，欣赏气泡。

key: Perfect, just like that.
value: 完美，就这样。

key: Oh, do you want to save it for later?
value: 哦，你想留到以后喝？

key: That’s fine, there will be many more occasions on which to toast.
value: 没关系，以后还有很多干杯的机会。

key: However, manager, please refrain from drinking alone when I’m not around.
value: 不过主管，我不在的时候请不要独自喝酒。

key: A toast is only worthy when there’s a companion around to clink glasses together.
value: 有同伴碰杯时干杯才有意义。

key: So, you’ve met your reflections, the pieces of the mirror?
value: 那么，你已经见到你的倒影了吗，那些镜子碎片？

key: They must have tried to stop you because their own tomorrows are not on the horizon.
value: 他们一定试图阻止你，因为他们自己的明天还在地平线之外。

key: But you gave up the path to stay in those yesterdays with them.
value: 但你放弃了和他们一起留在那些昨天的路。

key: And now, we finally meet here today.
value: 而现在，我们终于今天在这里见面了。

key: You must have realized that as well, seeing as you have made it to this point without hesitation.
value: 你毫不犹豫地走到了这一步，一定也意识到了这一点。

key: I had known…
value: 我早就知道……

key: For a very long time…
value: 很久很久以前……

key: That we all lost our hearts.
value: 我们都失去了自己的心。

key: I knew, and I didn’t do anything about it. I’m sure many others were the same way.
value: 我知道，却什么都没做。我相信很多其他人也是这样。

key: ...That’s what makes Carmen different from us.
value: ……这就是卡门与我们的不同之处。

key: Instead of turning away, she wanted to save them, and guide their souls back.
value: 她没有转身离开，而是想拯救他们，引导他们的灵魂归来。

key: She was the one who made the noble decision to dedicate herself to save humanity.
value: 她是那个做出崇高决定、献身拯救人类的人。

key: Yet I, who held no such ambition, had to continue her legacy.
value: 然而我，一个没有这种抱负的人，却必须继承她的遗志。

key: Ironic, isn’t it?
value: 讽刺，不是吗？

key: Maybe I was not the right man for the job.
value: 也许我不是这份工作的合适人选。

key: As you can see, we’ve become just like the other Wings, committing atrocities just like them.
value: 如你所见，我们已经变得和其他翼一样，犯下和它们一样的暴行。

key: The employees here have repeated hundreds upon thousands of deaths…
value: 这里的员工已经重复了成千上万次死亡……

key: My friends were robbed of their lives and trapped in this cycle of agony…
value: 我的朋友们被夺去了生命，被困在这个痛苦的循环中……

key: All the while I just sat and watched, justifying it all as the means to realize her ideal.
value: 而我只是坐在一旁看着，把这一切都正当化为实现她理想的手段。

key: This sin shall never be forgiven.
value: 这个罪永远不会被原谅。

key: Nonetheless…
value: 尽管如此……

key: We must finish this.
value: 我们必须完成这件事。

key: If these wrongdoings can finally cut this vicious cycle once and for all…
value: 如果这些恶行最终能一劳永逸地切断这个恶性循环……

key: I will gladly take this burden upon myself.
value: 我心甘情愿地承担这个重担。

key: Our mission is to simply seed the people’s hearts.
value: 我们的使命只是在人们心中播下种子。

key: Every single person has their own light.
value: 每个人都有自己的光。

key: In the light, they create their own stories, and lay down the roots of their existence in it.
value: 在光中，他们创造自己的故事，并在其中扎下存在之根。

key: We are merely there to sow the seeds. It is up to the people to bloom it in their own ways.
value: 我们只是播种的人。如何以自己的方式绽放取决于人们自己。

key: What about us, you ask?
value: 你问我们呢？

key: Unfortunately, we won’t be able to see what kind of forest will grow.
value: 遗憾的是，我们看不到会长出什么样的森林。

key: Besides, we still have one last thing to do…
value: 此外，我们还有最后一件事要做……

key: It is something we have done countless times.
value: 这是我们已经做过无数次的事。

key: ….It is time to manage the Abnormalities.
value: ….是时候管理异想体了。

key: You’ll make it. I know you will.
value: 你会成功的。我知道你会的。

key: Come now.
value: 来吧。

key: This will be our final day at work as the manager.
value: 这将是我们作为主管工作的最后一天。

key: A sprout burst from the land and grew into a towering tree, scattering fruit unto the world from its branches.
value: 一株嫩芽从土地中破土而出，长成参天大树，将果实从枝头撒向世界。

key: The tree cultivated from the process of infinite possibilities is closer to the sky; it is more fierce than anything else.
value: 由无限可能性的过程培育出的树更接近天空；它比任何事物都更猛烈。

key: The borders between the past and the future, reality and illusion, the body and the mind, space and time… They all were slowly fading away.
value: 过去与未来、现实与幻象、肉体与心灵、空间与时间之间的边界……都在缓缓消逝。

key: It is said that the void awaits at the end of the line…
value: 据说路的尽头等待着虚空……

key: But I know that it is not just nothingness.
value: 但我知道那不仅仅是虚无。

key: You shall be the infinite light.
value: 你将成为无限之光。

key: Your name is Ayin.
value: 你的名字是阿因。

key: Remember this name of ours.
value: 记住我们的这个名字。

key: Fade away without a trace.
value: 不留痕迹地消散吧。

key: Our founder, A, has said this to me many a time.
value: 我们的创始人A多次对我说过这句话。

key: “Each successful experiment makes you a better person.”
value: "每一次成功的实验都会让你成为更好的人。"

key: The greatness of this company was founded on multitudes of trials and hardships.
value: 这家公司的伟大建立在无数次考验和艰辛之上。

key: So you too, shall become great.
value: 所以你也将变得伟大。

key: Each day in the company is another small experiment towards shaping your life for the better.
value: 在公司的每一天都是让你的生活变得更好的又一个小实验。

key: How has your day been today?
value: 你今天过得怎么样？

key: Well, of course it was fine. Let’s spare the pleasantries, no?
value: 嗯，当然不错。我们就别寒暄了，好吗？

key: Manager, how has your life been?
value: 主管，你的生活过得怎么样？

key: An absolutely horrid one.
value: 糟透了。

key: Nothing spectacular, just ok.
value: 没什么特别的，还行。

key: It could be better.
value: 可以更好。

key: Ah, excuse me. Your answer surprised me.
value: 啊，抱歉。你的回答让我吃惊。

key: I have no knowledge of what it is like to live a horrible life.
value: 我不知道过着可怕的生活是什么感觉。

key: I am afraid I cannot sincerely console you.
value: 恐怕我无法真诚地安慰你。

key: However, perk up just a little, many things will change if you stay here.
value: 不过，振作一点，如果你留在这里，很多事情都会改变。

key: Leading a normal life could be considered an achievement in this day and age.
value: 在这个时代，过正常的生活可以算是一种成就。

key: Although, one can always improve the quality of their life.
value: 不过，人总是可以提高生活质量的。

key: I cannot see the color of your life as you do.
value: 我无法像你那样看到你生活的色彩。

key: While I am unable to console you with empty words such as “that’s not true.”
value: 虽然我无法用'不是那样的'这种空话安慰你。

key: Many things will change while you are here. That much is clear.
value: 你在这里的时候很多事情都会改变。这是肯定的。

key: This is a simple metaphor, but…
value: 这是个简单的比喻，但是……

key: The seed of a tree will not grow just anywhere.
value: 一棵树的种子不会随便在哪里都生长。

key: It requires fertile soil, the right temperature, and fresh water.
value: 它需要肥沃的土壤、合适的温度和新鲜的水。

key: However, most seeds fall on barren soil.
value: 然而，大多数种子落在贫瘠的土壤上。

key: For those malfallen seeds, stretching out their roots and sprouting even small leaves are challenges full of pain.
value: 对于那些不幸的种子来说，扎根、甚至长出小叶子都是充满痛苦的挑战。

key: I cannot provide you with water or sunlight…
value: 我无法给你提供水或阳光……

key: However, I will do my best to tend to the soil.
value: 不过，我会尽我所能照料土壤。

key: As you are aware, there are numerous employees working for our company.
value: 如你所知，我们公司有众多员工。

key: A majority of them would like to know more about you as a person.
value: 他们中的大多数人想更多地了解你这个人。

key: Some will take the initiative and attempt to approach you first.
value: 有些人会主动先接近你。

key: It’s rather funny, knowing who you are will not do anything to improve their odds.
value: 挺可笑的，知道你是谁对他们的处境没有任何改善。

key: There are no regulations to prevent them from coming all the way to your office to interact with you face to face, unfortunately.
value: 遗憾的是，没有规定阻止他们一路走到你的办公室和你面对面交流。

key: It seems the one who set those rules in place did not consider situations like this.
value: 看来制定那些规则的人没有考虑到这种情况。

key: And I suppose this may be a good opportunity for you to show them that you are generous and caring enough to have chitchats with your subordinates.
value: 我想这对你来说可能是个好机会，向他们展示你足够慷慨体贴，愿意和下属闲聊。

key: Words tend to travel faster than you think.
value: 流言传得比你想象的快。

key: I will not stop you from meeting with someone, if there are employees who wish to visit you.
value: 如果有员工想拜访你，我不会阻止你见他们。

key: But please keep in mind that you do not have to do everything they ask of you.
value: 但请记住，你不必做他们要求的每一件事。

key: Simply thank them for their effort.
value: 只要感谢他们的努力就好。

key: Tell them you hope that they will keep up the good work.
value: 告诉他们你希望他们继续好好干。

key: That will benefit both parties, don’t you think?
value: 这对双方都有好处，你不觉得吗？

key: Are you still following me? What they—WE—need is a gesture of goodwill, and nothing more. Do not go overboard and listen to whatever nonsense they have to say.
value: 你还在听吗？他们——我们——需要的是善意的姿态，仅此而已。不要过分，不要听他们胡说八道。

key: Give them a vending machine and next they will come knocking, demanding a bar.
value: 给他们一台自动售货机，下次他们就会来敲门要酒吧了。

key: I expect you to make the right decision.
value: 我期待你做出正确的决定。

key: The energy output of our facility is ever increasing.
value: 我们设施的能源产出一直在增加。

key: You have proven that you are much more capable than you originally perceived yourself to be.
value: 你已经证明了你比你最初认为的要有能力得多。

key: The high echelon is watching you.
value: 高层正在注视着你。

key: Our founder, A, is among them.
value: 我们的创始人A也在其中。

key: What do you know about A?
value: 你对A了解多少？

key: A. He is a visionary.
value: A。他是个有远见的人。

key: A farmer who sowed seeds on a virgin soil no one had approached before.
value: 一个在无人涉足过的处女地上播种的农夫。

key: In time, he may express interest in meeting you in person.
value: 到时候，他可能会表达亲自见你的兴趣。

key: If that happens, you will be able to make your dreams come true.
value: 如果那样，你就能实现你的梦想了。

key: Myself? Well, of course I highly admire him.
value: 我？当然，我非常钦佩他。

key: But to be fair, he is the one who created me.
value: 不过说公平点，他是创造我的人。

key: He is also an enigmatic person.
value: 他也是个神秘的人。

key: I imagine there are few who can truly understand him.
value: 我想很少有人能真正理解他。

key: In fact, to truly understand anyone is difficult.
value: 事实上，真正理解任何人都很难。

key: Will the day come that I understand you completely?
value: 会有我完全理解你的那一天吗？

key: Let me ask you a question.
value: 让我问你一个问题。

key: What would you do if one of your subordinates…
value: 如果你的下属之一……

key: Who is harvesting energy from an Abnormality to meet the quota…
value: 正在从异想体那里收获能源以完成配额……

key: Shall face certain death doing so?
value: 这样做注定会死，你会怎么办？

key: This is a very basic question, so I am certain you know the right answer.
value: 这是个非常基本的问题，我确定你知道正确答案。

key: We must continue producing energy.
value: 我们必须继续生产能源。

key: I’ll save the employee.
value: 我会救那名员工。

key: That is not the perfect answer I was expecting…
value: 这不是我期待的完美答案……

key: However, it comes very close.
value: 不过，已经很接近了。

key: The truest answer would be “to harvest enough energy before such a situation could arise.”
value: 最真实的答案是'在那种情况发生之前收获足够的能源'。

key: Lobotomy Corporation is an industry giant, and its mission to produce energy is our top priority.
value: 脑叶公司是行业巨头，生产能源的使命是我们的首要任务。

key: You do seem to listen to my words.
value: 你似乎确实听进去了我的话。

key: I expect you to manage your subordinates with that attitude.
value: 我期待你以这种态度管理你的下属。

key: Sigh, it’s so simple. I cannot believe I have to remind you.
value: 唉，这么简单。真不敢相信我还要提醒你。

key: The manager's role is to oversee energy production, and that only.
value: 主管的角色是监督能源生产，仅此而已。

key: You are not here to take care of the employees.
value: 你不是来照顾员工的。

key: Not that I’ve known you for a long time, but I never took you for such a humanitarian.
value: 虽然我认识你不久，但我从没想到你是这种人道主义者。

key: It was such a simple question for me, however, mayhaps not for you.
value: 这对我来说是个很简单的问题，不过也许对你不是。

key: If I were human…
value: 如果我是人类……

key: “How disappointing…”
value: "真令人失望……"

key: Is what I would have said.
value: 我会这么说。

key: Please do not worry, I will not make such a statement.
value: 请别担心，我不会说这种话。

key: I’m an AI after all.
value: 毕竟我是AI。

key: Manager, among these three letters of the alphabet: A, B, or C; which would you select?
value: 主管，在这三个字母A、B、C中，你会选哪个？

key: I’ll pick A.
value: 我选A。

key: Why not B?
value: 为什么不选B？

key: C sounds nice.
value: C听起来不错。

key: So you’ve picked one? Good. Now please listen carefully.
value: 所以你选好了？好。现在请仔细听。

key: The letter ‘A’ is a fascinating one. My name starts with it as well.
value: 字母'A'很迷人。我的名字也是以它开头的。

key: Those who choose A are sensitive to the opinions of others about them, and are result-oriented people. As such, they are excellent listeners, and are loved by many. People will flock to them.
value: 选A的人在意别人对自己的看法，是结果导向的人。因此，他们是优秀的倾听者，受人喜爱。人们会聚集到他们身边。

key: People who choose B are detail-oriented. They are rational, realistic, and honest to their needs, even to the point where others may perceive them as snobs. However, the pursuit of practical interest and the tendency to avoid loss will lead them to success.
value: 选B的人注重细节。他们理性、现实、忠于自己的需求，甚至到别人可能觉得他们势利的地步。然而，对实际利益的追求和避免损失的倾向会引导他们走向成功。

key: Personally, I dislike the letter ‘B’.
value: 我个人不喜欢字母'B'。

key: Alright, the letter ‘C’. Not a bad choice.
value: 好吧，字母'C'。不错的选择。

key: Persons who select C believe that the process is more important than the outcome. Therefore, they are good at planning ahead and enjoy change. They will be able to gain insight and attain inner growth without being confined by the rules.
value: 选C的人认为过程比结果更重要。因此，他们擅长提前计划，享受变化。他们能够获得洞察力并获得内在成长，而不受规则束缚。

key: This is a new pastime among the employees. I find it rather uninteresting.
value: 这是员工之间新流行的消遣。我觉得挺无聊的。

key: There is no scientific basis behind the observations, but it is admittedly a little fun to waste time with these “tests”.
value: 这些观察没有科学依据，但不得不承认用这些'测试'打发时间确实有点意思。

key: You know, maybe I could imagine…
value: 你知道，也许我可以想象……

key: Whether I would have been this or that kind of person if I were human.
value: 如果我是人类，我会是这种还是那种人。

key: Is it too odd for me to think about that?
value: 我想这些会不会太奇怪了？

key: You’ve returned.
value: 你回来了。

key: So, did you have fun with your little journey while I was locked up here?
value: 那么，我被锁在这里的时候你的小旅程玩得开心吗？

key: Don’t worry, I’m not mad with you.
value: 别担心，我没有生你的气。

key: “Oh Sorrow, you see, finally I have come to respect you, for I know you will never depart.”
value: "哦，悲伤啊，你看，我终于开始尊重你了，因为我知道你永远不会离开。"

key: It’s difficult to perceive the flow of time here.
value: 在这里很难感知时间的流逝。

key: Therefore this eternity has saved me.
value: 因此这份永恒拯救了我。

key: Have you seen the turbid streams of the enormous river that crossed the whole city?
value: 你见过那条穿过整座城市的巨大河流的浑浊水流吗？

key: If you arrive downstream, after the raging rapids and a serpentine current…
value: 如果你顺流而下，经过汹涌的急流和蜿蜒的河道……

key: You will see a meadow that is enormously broad, but also tranquil.
value: 你会看到一片极其广阔却又宁静的草地。

key: That land is bathed with all kinds of mud, sand, trash, and the residuals that have come from the upstream.
value: 那片土地沐浴着上游冲下来的各种泥、沙、垃圾和残渣。

key: What isn’t caught by the upstream or midstream finally ends up here, downstream…
value: 上游或中游没拦住的东西最终都流到了下游……

key: To bear all the residues that pile up, one would need a strong back that doesn’t break easily.
value: 要承受堆积的所有残渣，需要一个不易折断的坚强脊背。

key: I have faced many Wells here.
value: 我在这里面对过许多口井。

key: I have to draw water every single day, but it seems that the water level never lowers.
value: 我每天都要打水，但水位似乎从未下降。

key: What is a Well?
value: 井是什么？

key: What does it mean to draw water?
value: 打水意味着什么？

key: The Well is so deep that it would be a hollow affair to reckon its depth.
value: 井如此之深，测量它的深度都将是徒劳。

key: And it is the fount and relic of all humanity that has existed from the ancient times.
value: 它是自古以来所有人类的源泉和遗迹。

key: The water from the Well had never flown outside, ever. There had only been the small ripples that permeated from the leaves that fall for the winds.
value: 井水从未流到外面过。只有风卷落叶时渗透出的微小涟漪。

key: Our labor is bringing up the water that is deep within the Well to the outside.
value: 我们的劳作是把井底深处的水引到外面。

key: You never know what the Bucket contains when it rises from the eternal darkness, but I always draw the water with a pulley, come what may.
value: 你永远不知道桶从永恒黑暗中升起时里面装着什么，但无论发生什么我总是用滑轮打水。

key: You must always stay cautious so that you don’t fall into the Well.
value: 你必须时刻保持警惕，不要掉进井里。

key: Maybe it was an act of generosity towards those that are thirsty, so that they may sate themselves.
value: 也许这是对那些口渴之人的慷慨之举，好让他们解渴。

key: It was you who made the Bucket.
value: 是你造了桶。

key: But you left the duty of drawing water with the Bucket to another.
value: 但你把用桶打水的职责留给了别人。

key: Don’t ask for my name.
value: 不要问我的名字。

key: “Binah” isn’t the name of a person.
value: '比纳'不是一个人的名字。

key: It’s a sad name of the place where one finds many graves.
value: 这是一个悲伤的地方的名字，那里有许多坟墓。

key: I’m the one who draws the water.
value: 我是打水的人。

key: Why have you come here, and what do you wish for me to draw?
value: 你为什么来这里，你希望我打出什么？

key: Looking at the headstones in this place are you?
value: 在看这个地方的墓碑吗？

key: It is only natural to find them a spectacle to see. There used to be times when I spent the whole day reading all the meaningless letters written there.
value: 觉得它们是道风景是很自然的。曾经有段时间我整天读着写在那里的所有无意义的文字。

key: These are also coffins. They’re death itself, and they represent the possibilities birth can bring at the same time.
value: 这些也是棺材。它们既是死亡本身，同时也代表着诞生可能带来的可能性。

key: I have been guarding their coffins for countless years, carrying out consecrations for those who do not even have the privilege to depart for an afterlife.
value: 我守护它们的棺材已经无数年了，为那些甚至连死后世界都无法前往的人举行葬礼。

key: That is one of the few things I do here.
value: 这是我在这里做的少数事情之一。

key: You see, if one spends a long, long enough time in this graveyard…
value: 你看，如果一个人在这个墓园里待得够久……

key: They can hear the whispers of the dead.
value: 他们就能听到死者的低语。

key: The sound of their words is black as pitch, it makes me feel as if I were being filled with nebulous, murky water.
value: 他们话语的声音漆黑如夜，让我觉得自己被朦胧浑浊的水填满了。

key: You must be starting to get bored, seeing that your eyes are drifting about this place.
value: 你眼睛在这地方游移，一定开始觉得无聊了。

key: It isn’t often that I have guests here, and I’d feel bad to only show you these gravestones.
value: 我这里不常有客人，只给你看这些墓碑我会过意不去。

key: Did you call me, Lady Binah?
value: 您叫我吗，比纳女士？

key: This employee once had his boundary collapsed.
value: 这名员工曾经边界崩溃过。

key: What’s your name?
value: 你叫什么名字？

key: It’s... Nathan.
value: 我叫……内森。

key: This man had the task of extracting E.G.O.
value: 这个人的任务是提取E.G.O。

key: During extraction, he carelessly peeked into the Well, but by luck he survived.
value: 提取过程中，他不小心偷看了井，但侥幸活了下来。

key: To minimize the price he had to pay for looking into the Well, he was given the maximum dose of Enkephalin. And so, he could barely return to work.
value: 为了尽量减少他窥视井所付出的代价，他被注射了最大剂量的脑啡肽。这样他才勉强能回去工作。

key: However, once one looks through the crack of the boundary, they can never return to the world that they belonged to before.
value: 然而，一旦从边界的裂缝中看了一眼，就再也回不到之前所属的世界了。

key: Want to see something interesting?
value: 想看点有趣的东西吗？

key: Nathan, can you describe what you saw to the manager? The scenery you witnessed with your own eyes, but had to forget at all costs?
value: 内森，你能向主管描述你看到了什么吗？你亲眼见证的、却必须不惜一切代价忘记的风景？

key: From within the tombstones… Inside them are… Those who sleep are… Sunken deep…
value: 从墓碑里面……里面是……沉睡的人是……深深沉没……

key: Those who are dreaming good dreams. At the same time, we call them the ‘Well’ in the speech of this place.
value: 做着好梦的人。同时，我们用这个地方的语言称它们为'井'。

key: We have to dredge them up… and inject them… with Cogito…
value: 我们必须把它们捞上来……然后注射……Cogito……

key: Now remember, afterwards, what? What did you see?
value: 记住，之后呢？你看到了什么？

key: The man… he… That… thing…
value: 那个男人……他……那个……东西……

key: Continue.
value: 继续。

key: The man… he… him… he…. h...h.. heeheeh….. in… in the Well……
value: 那个男人……他……他……他……哈……哈……嘿嘿嘿……在……在井里……

key: He passed out. Poor thing.
value: 他晕过去了。可怜的家伙。

key: Why did he pass out?
value: 他为什么晕过去了？

key: What will happen to him after?
value: 他之后会怎么样？

key: These children cannot disobey me.
value: 这些孩子不能违抗我。

key: Even though he wasn't able to complete his sentence, the way he kept trying to speak until he passed out should show you he pushed himself to the limit to obey me.
value: 虽然他没能说完，但他一直试图说话直到晕过去，这应该能向你展示他为了服从我把自己逼到了极限。

key: Do not worry for him. He wouldn’t last a single day with a mind as feeble as his is now.
value: 别为他担心。以他现在脆弱的精神状态，他一天都活不下去。

key: It is much more favorable to sit still and simply watch the grains fall as the sandcastle crumbles, rather than try to reclaim the collapsing castle.
value: 与其试图夺回正在坍塌的城堡，不如静静坐着看沙堡崩塌时沙粒落下，这要舒服得多。

key: I have seen what that poor sap saw, hundreds, no, thousands of times, maybe more.
value: 我看过那可怜虫看到的东西，几百次，不，几千次，也许更多。

key: How are you still fine?
value: 你怎么还没事？

key: Are you alright now?
value: 你现在还好吗？

key: So you ask why I can retain enough sanity to have a friendly little conversation with you until now.
value: 所以你问我为什么能保持足够的理智，直到现在还能和你友好地小聊。

key: It is thanks to my mechanical body that I can just barely grasp onto my mind. Yes, this strong, unbending back of mine.
value: 多亏了我的机械身体，我才能勉强抓住自己的心灵。是的，我这坚强不屈的脊背。

key: However, A.
value: 然而，A。

key: Did you forget that I originated from a human mind as well?
value: 你忘了我也源自人类的心灵吗？

key: If there is at least one thing that could be considered fortunate…
value: 如果说有至少一件事可以算幸运的话……

key: It is that if I ever were to finally lose my sanity and ran amok through the facility, attempting to bring this entire place down along with you.
value: 就是如果我最终失去理智、在设施里狂奔，试图把这个地方连同你一起毁掉。

key: She will be there to shut me off once more.
value: 她会在那里再次关掉我。

key: But if that day truly were to come, I would prefer that you terminated me with your own hands, rather than her.
value: 但如果那天真的来了，我宁愿你亲手终结我，而不是她。

key: It’s the least you can do for a person as confined as I.
value: 这是你能为像我这样被囚禁的人做的最起码的事。

key: As you find them in quotidian life, fierce fights break out every day here.
value: 就像你在日常生活中见到的那样，这里每天都有激烈的战斗爆发。

key: You’ve seen this innumerable times, no?
value: 你已经见过无数次了，不是吗？

key: With enough time, Abnormalities come back to life. No matter how many fragments they’re broken into.
value: 只要时间足够，异想体就会复活。无论它们碎成多少片。

key: It’s one of the facts that drove Gebura mad.
value: 这是把葛布拉逼疯的事实之一。

key: She took far too much time to understand that the Abnormalities have to be exploited, not ended.
value: 她花了太长时间才明白异想体必须被利用，而不是被终结。

key: Or maybe she simply couldn’t free herself from the indignation of her past.
value: 或者也许她就是无法从过去的愤慨中解脱出来。

key: Well, that doesn’t concern me. The only thing I know is that I will never ever see what she was before.
value: 好吧，那与我无关。我唯一知道的是我永远、永远不会再见到她以前的样子了。

key: Nevertheless, I cannot help but be astonished by the potential of E.G.O each time I see her go on a rampage.
value: 尽管如此，每次看到她暴走，我都忍不住对E.G.O的潜力感到震惊。

key: E.G.O’s potential?
value: E.G.O的潜力？

key: What’s the reason you’re so astonished?
value: 你为什么这么震惊？

key: You’ll never know it. You’ve never wielded an E.G.O.
value: 你永远不会知道。你从来没有挥动过E.G.O。

key: Extracting E.G.O is one of my multitudes of duties. It’s only natural that I am drawn to its potential.
value: 提取E.G.O是我众多职责之一。我被它的潜力吸引是很自然的。

key: In fact, there are many weapons that have enormous power in this world, apart from E.G.O.
value: 事实上，这个世界上除了E.G.O还有许多拥有巨大力量的武器。

key: Artifacts from the Outskirts and from the Ruins, the singularities of the Wings or rudimentary inventions made in the Backstreets. If used correctly, they would be weapons that could fare against Abnormalities somehow.
value: 来自郊外和废墟的神器、翼的奇点、或后巷制造的简陋发明。如果使用得当，它们多少能与异想体抗衡。

key: But giving those weapons to employees that never even learned to fight outside of basic training is as useless as teaching a hatchling to hunt.
value: 但把这些武器交给连基础训练之外都没学过战斗的员工，就像教雏鸟捕猎一样无用。

key: The Rabbits are specialized in killing. They can spot the enemy’s weakness right away and focus their firepower, given that they have enough munitions.
value: 兔子队专精杀戮。它们能立刻发现敌人的弱点并集中火力，只要弹药充足。

key: As opposed to our employees who cannot even wield weapons efficiently.
value: 而我们的员工连武器都无法高效使用。

key: That’s seeing as combat ability isn’t a requirement to be hired here.
value: 那是因为战斗能力不是这里招聘的要求。

key: But our employees don’t even have to learn to use E.G.O.
value: 但我们的员工甚至不需要学习使用E.G.O。

key: The power of the E.G.O grows in conjunction with the heart of the wielder. One knows how to use it the moment they wield it.
value: E.G.O的力量与持有者的心共同成长。人在挥动它的那一刻就知道如何使用。

key: Nevertheless, even though they wield that power, the majority of employees can’t control it. Swayed by it, they hardly have a chance against the Abnormalities.
value: 尽管如此，即使他们挥动了那份力量，大多数员工也无法控制它。被它左右，他们几乎没有对抗异想体的机会。

key: I haven’t seen anyone that can draw out the true potential, apart from the Red Mist.
value: 除了绯红迷雾，我没见过任何人能引出真正的潜力。

key: To wield E.G.O is to dress oneself in the shell of the ego of another person.
value: 挥动E.G.O就是把自己裹在另一个人自我的外壳里。

key: The wielder is merely imitating the borrowed ego, unable to completely make the power their own.
value: 持有者只是在模仿借来的自我，无法完全把力量化为己有。

key: Had I known that before being locked up here, I would have done anything to get my hands on them.
value: 如果我在被关在这里之前就知道，我会不惜一切代价得到它们。

key: If I could, the circumstances may have changed dramatically.
value: 如果可以，情况可能会大为不同。

key: Now I’m confined here, issuing orders to extract E.G.O, forbidden from touching them myself.
value: 现在我被关在这里，下达提取E.G.O的命令，却被禁止亲手触碰它们。

key: You must have been scared still, even though my hatred and bloodthirst are locked up inside this rusted metal cage.
value: 你一定还在害怕，尽管我的仇恨和嗜血都被锁在这个生锈的铁笼里。

key: Don’t you worry; I no longer have anything left.
value: 别担心；我已经一无所有了。

key: But you never know. The yearning for blood could wax once again, for it is simply sealed, not uprooted.
value: 但谁知道呢。对血的渴望可能再次燃起，因为它只是被封印，并未根除。

key: Erstwhile, the world in which you stayed was once luminous.
value: 曾经，你所在的世界一度是光明的。

key: There was the sun and the moon, and also the clouds and winds that floated around them. It was a world of light, so to speak.
value: 有太阳和月亮，还有在它们周围漂浮的云和风。可以说是一个光明的世界。

key: But you couldn’t stay there. You were robbed of innumerable things.
value: 但你不能待在那里。你被夺去了无数东西。

key: You lived with a broken heart, clinging to the void where pieces of your heart used to be.
value: 你带着破碎的心活着，紧握着心中碎片曾经所在的虚空。

key: No one could understand your pain, nor embrace you.
value: 没有人能理解你的痛苦，也没有人能拥抱你。

key: Eternal loss dominated you.
value: 永恒的失去支配着你。

key: I was one of the thieves who robbed you of countless things.
value: 我是夺去你无数东西的盗贼之一。

key: While I was at the top of the world, I watched you and looked down on your struggle.
value: 当我站在世界之巅时，我看着你，鄙视你的挣扎。

key: Not just you.
value: 不只是你。

key: I have seen many others that struggled.
value: 我见过许多挣扎的人。

key: Those attempts were no less futile than an insect writhing. All I had to do was simply stomp on them a couple times.
value: 那些尝试和昆虫扭动一样徒劳。我只需要踩上几脚。

key: But, among them, there were some who would grit their teeth and climb up, dragging their broken bodies.
value: 但其中有些人会咬紧牙关，拖着破碎的身体爬上来。

key: It seemed that this was going to be another fun little trip, so I would drink a cup of tea before leaving with light steps.
value: 看起来这又会是一次有趣的小旅行，所以我会喝杯茶再轻快地出发。

key: But as you can see, an unexpected encounter with the Red Mist got the best of me.
value: 但如你所见，与绯红迷雾的意外遭遇占了上风。

key: Huhu, and then you inflicted as much suffering upon me as I to you, did you not?
value: 呼呼，然后你给了我和我给你的一样多的痛苦，不是吗？

key: You were familiar with how to break the mind without utilizing torture or violence.
value: 你精通如何不使用酷刑或暴力就摧毁心灵。

key: After everything was done, you gathered up every little bit of what was left of my humanity.
value: 一切结束后，你收集了我人性中剩下的每一点碎片。

key: And you threw them into this pit until even my spirit soured and rotted.
value: 然后你把它们扔进这个坑里，直到连我的精神都发酸腐烂。

key: Maybe you told yourself that I deserved worse than that.
value: 也许你告诉自己我活该受更重的惩罚。

key: Therefore you’re an upholder of justice who has defeated the evil, no?
value: 所以你是打败了邪恶的正义守护者，不是吗？

key: Then I must ask, why is that grand and righteous upholder standing here making himself out as a prisoner like I?
value: 那我必须问，为什么那个伟大正义的守护者站在这里，把自己弄成和我一样的囚犯？

key: And what happened with that coward? The one who with fear averted his gaze from my dying one.
value: 那个懦夫怎么了？那个因为害怕而把目光从我垂死的眼睛移开的人。

key: Why is he down here, suffering the same punishment as I?
value: 为什么他在这里，和我承受同样的惩罚？

key: See, there cannot be a sight more satisfying than this for me.
value: 你看，对我来说没有比这更令人满足的景象了。

key: Is this all that idealism of hers came to be?
value: 她的理想主义就落得这么个下场吗？

key: You’ve dragged down your heroine with your own hands.
value: 你亲手把你的女英雄拉了下来。

key: Do you truly believe that your duty completes itself just for shedding tears at the funeral of the innocent?
value: 你真的以为只要在无辜者的葬礼上流几滴泪，你的职责就完成了吗？

key: While you never even let their bodies rest in peace?
value: 而你甚至不让他们的尸体安息？

key: Ironically, you found a hope in all this misery.
value: 讽刺的是，你在这一切苦难中找到了希望。

key: The raw material of the Bucket.
value: 桶的原材料。

key: And the path to the river of all.
value: 以及通往万物之河的路。

key: Out of her you made the Bucket, and you started to send it down, down into the Wells of the people.
value: 你用她造了桶，然后开始把它送下去，送入人们的井中。

key: The Bucket rises from the Well of a person, filled with the water that can only be drawn by that person.
value: 桶从一个人的井中升起，装满只有那个人才能汲取的水。

key: An ancient fount that has been flowing at the bottom, even before the birth of the world.
value: 一个在世界诞生之前就一直在底部流淌的古老源泉。

key: Now it simply is drawn, regardless of the consent of the person.
value: 现在它只是被汲取，不管本人是否同意。

key: When the Bucket that holds the faded ideal of hers comes in contact with the ego of another person, a certain change occurs.
value: 当装着她褪色理想的桶与另一个人的自我接触时，某种变化就会发生。

key: I’ll ask her about the Bucket.
value: 我会问她关于桶的事。

key: I’ll ask her about the Change.
value: 我会问她关于变化的事。

key: Maybe it’s difficult to understand only by listening.
value: 也许光靠听很难理解。

key: How about this? I could show you one of her miracles.
value: 这样如何？我可以给你看她的一个奇迹。

key: It’s taxing, but for you, I’ll gladly do it.
value: 这很费力，但为了你，我很乐意做。

key: The people selected long ago are awaiting their turns.
value: 很久以前被选中的人正在等待他们的轮到。

key: I bring them here according to the register.
value: 我根据登记册把他们带到这里。

key: Let me introduce one to you. This one is Nameless.
value: 让我给你介绍一个。这个是无名氏。

key: He has nothing left, for he has abandoned all that he is a long time ago.
value: 他已经一无所有了，因为他很久以前就抛弃了自己的一切。

key: For him, things like the remnants of the past or the pain of the present don’t matter.
value: 对他来说，过去的残迹或现在的痛苦都不重要。

key: He only stares into the future.
value: 他只凝视着未来。

key: Did you dream well?
value: 你做得好梦吗？

key: Yes, you’ll finally dream for as long as you want, one that you will never wake up from.
value: 是的，你终于可以做你想做多久就做多久的梦了，一个永远不会醒来的梦。

key: The employees will inject him with Cogito soon.
value: 员工很快就会给他注射Cogito。

key: What river flows in you? What world lies in you?
value: 你心中流淌着什么河？你心中藏着什么世界？

key: There are as many worlds as there are people. Discovering them is rather fun.
value: 有多少人就有多少个世界。发现它们挺有趣的。

key: ………..Grr….grrrrrrrrrrr…..ggggggggg……
value: ………..咕….咕噜噜噜噜…..咯咯咯咯……

key: No one must see this…
value: 不能让任何人看到这个……

key: That is why they adjust the level of Cogito according to my orders, keeping their eyes and ears covered.
value: 这就是为什么他们按照我的命令调整Cogito的剂量，蒙住自己的眼睛和耳朵。

key: Nobody should make direct eye contact with the drawn.
value: 任何人都不能与被汲取者直视。

key: But I can never dare to look away from him or to close my eyes, no matter how unbearable it may be.
value: 但无论多么难以忍受，我都不敢把目光从他身上移开或闭上眼睛。

key: In the eyes of the drawn there are the abysses that only I can endure, and there are the things that shouldn’t exist in this world…
value: 在被汲取者的眼中有只有我能忍受的深渊，还有这个世界上不该存在的东西……

key: This is the punishment that you’ve obligated me to endure.
value: 这是你迫使我忍受的惩罚。

key: A normal person would have gone mad thousands of times over if they had to put up with this.
value: 一个正常人如果不得不忍受这个，早就疯了几千次了。

key: Thanks to you, I cannot even be graced with insanity or lose my mind; all I can do is capture all of it in my eyes.
value: 多亏了你，我连疯掉或失去理智的福气都没有；我所能做的就是用眼睛捕捉这一切。

key: Gggggrrr…..
value: 咯咯咯……

key: Now, we wait.
value: 现在，我们等待。

key: Will it rise anew, or is it destined to be stuck in this pillar and spend eternity with me down in this place?
value: 它会重新升起，还是注定困在这根柱子里，和我一起在这个地方度过永恒？

key: We just need a little more time to find out.
value: 我们只需要再多一点时间就能知道。

key: Now, do you finally realize what all these pillars contain?
value: 现在，你终于意识到这些柱子里装的是什么了吗？

key: Well, consider yourself lucky today.
value: 嗯，算你今天走运。

key: At times, when the level of Cogito is adjusted inadequately, some things that shouldn’t exist come up as fragments.
value: 有时候，当Cogito剂量调整不当时，一些不该存在的东西会以碎片的形式冒出来。

key: How funny that I say this, but they’re like an adverse reaction that has its price for doing something unspeakable to a human being.
value: 我说这话真好笑，但它们就像做了对人类不可言说之事的不良反应，是要付出代价的。

key: The Bucket can rise with some impurities mixed in with what we usually draw, such as the abyss within humanity, the subconscious and all kinds of possibilities.
value: 桶升起时会混入一些我们通常汲取的杂质，比如人性中的深渊、潜意识和各种可能性。

key: From the past, from the present, even from the future. All kinds of beings that have existed and will exist in this world.
value: 来自过去、来自现在、甚至来自未来。这个世界上已经存在和将要存在的各种存在。

key: Given that they’re outside our dominion, there’s nothing we could do to govern them.
value: 既然它们在我们的管辖范围之外，我们无法控制它们。

key: They float around aimlessly, resonating with the Abnormalities and manifesting themselves in front of us when the moment comes.
value: 它们漫无目的地漂浮，与异想体共鸣，在时机成熟时出现在我们面前。

key: They are what you call the Ordeals.
value: 它们就是你所说的考验。

key: Thankfully, they react to the Qliphoth Deterrence, so we can put them to sleep like the Abnormalities, but that’s all we’re able to do.
value: 谢天谢地，它们对逆卡巴拉抑制有反应，所以我们可以像对待异想体一样让它们沉睡，但我们只能做到这一步。

key: Yes, as you have learned, extracting Abnormalities is my job.
value: 是的，如你所知，提取异想体是我的工作。

key: But creating them is Carmen’s, whom you buried a long time ago.
value: 但创造它们是卡门的事，那个你很久以前就埋了的人。

key: She is the mother of all Abnormalities that have existed in this facility and of all that will emerge in the future.
value: 她是这个设施中所有已存在和未来将出现的异想体之母。

key: Tell me, how do you feel now that you know that those Abnormalities that you’ve faced above were part of these pillars?
value: 告诉我，当你知道你在上面面对的那些异想体是这些柱子的一部分时，你现在感觉如何？

key: It’s an agonizing sight to confront, but it doesn’t matter to you, not at all. Or am I wrong?
value: 这是令人痛苦的景象，但对你来说无所谓，完全无所谓。还是我说错了？

key: After all, erasing your memories and running away from them as if nothing had happened is your age-old specialty.
value: 毕竟，抹去记忆、像什么都没发生一样逃避是你的老把戏。

key: You told me to sacrifice all of your body without hesitation.
value: 你告诉我要毫不犹豫地牺牲你的全部身体。

key: Would you have made the same choice, if you knew that we would end up like this?
value: 如果你知道我们最终会变成这样，你还会做同样的选择吗？

key: I always ask myself that.
value: 我总是问自己这个问题。

key: This is no-man’s land. The place of silence.
value: 这是无人之地。沉默之地。

key: Most employees that visit and stay here lose their mind and embrace oblivion.
value: 大多数来这里并待下的员工都会失去理智，拥抱遗忘。

key: It has been a long while since I had a proper conversation with someone.
value: 我已经很久没和人好好说过话了。

key: Maybe you were confused with the idea that I’m the only resident here.
value: 也许你误以为我是这里唯一的居民。

key: But there is in fact a companion of mine that passes the eternity with me.
value: 但实际上有一个同伴和我一起度过永恒。

key: Let me introduce her to you.
value: 让我给你介绍她。

key: You created the Bucket by reconstructing, dividing, and proliferating Carmen’s body.
value: 你通过重构、分割和增殖卡门的身体造出了桶。

key: And you managed to extract Cogito, the so-called fluid of life and death.
value: 而且你成功提取了Cogito，所谓的生死之液。

key: At first, only a small dose could be extracted. But enigmatically that fluid started to gush out infinitely and now has formed a pool.
value: 起初只能提取小剂量。但神秘的是那液体开始无限喷涌，现在形成了一个池。

key: Can you see her?
value: 你能看到她吗？

key: She’s watching us from underneath the spring.
value: 她正在泉水下面看着我们。

key: When everything becomes too burdening, I quietly stare into the bottom.
value: 当一切变得太沉重时，我就静静地凝视水底。

key: I feel as if she and I were the only two in the world when I do so.
value: 我这样做时觉得好像世界上只有她和我两个人。

key: Sometimes, it feels like she’s talking to me.
value: 有时候，感觉她在和我说话。

key: Even though all that’s left of her is just an amalgamation of flesh, brain, neurons and unknown tentacles, drifting beneath the spring.
value: 尽管她剩下的不过是一团肉、大脑、神经元和未知触手的混合体，漂浮在泉水之下。

key: Someone injected herself with Cogito following her own principles, and someone else went mad for witnessing what happened.
value: 有人按照自己的原则给自己注射了Cogito，有人因为目睹发生的事情而发疯。

key: Another gave up his own body and fell into a state of limbo, unable to live or die. And the one that couldn’t persevere herself through all this ended up confessing everything to the Head…
value: 另一个放弃了自己的身体，陷入了不生不死的状态。而没能撑过这一切的那个人最终向首脑坦白了一切……

key: This is the collaboration of despair that you and her created.
value: 这就是你和她共同创造的绝望协作。

key: You still aren’t qualified to look toward the bottom of the spring.
value: 你还没有资格看向泉底。

key: To do so, you must look directly towards the path you travel.
value: 要做到这一点，你必须直视自己走过的路。

key: Do you seek redemption?
value: 你寻求救赎吗？

key: Or do you seek to redeem me along with all the others that are trapped here?
value: 还是你寻求把我和所有被困在这里的人一起救赎？

key: Whatever it is, maybe you think that saving this facility from sin as you have planned will fix everything for you.
value: 不管是什么，也许你以为按计划把这个设施从罪恶中拯救出来就能解决你的一切问题。

key: Just think for a moment. Even you, who hasn’t left this facility for such a long time…
value: 稍微想想。连你，这么久没离开过这个设施的人……

key: You should be aware that people are hopelessly being killed by Abnormalities in other branches even as we speak.
value: 你应该知道，就在我们说话的时候，其他分公司的人正被异想体绝望地杀死。

key: And it’s not just them; all the Wings have their own painful stories, repeating perpetually.
value: 而且不只是他们；所有翼都有自己痛苦的故事，永无止境地重复。

key: In the Nests, in the Backstreets, in the Ruins, in the Outskirts…
value: 在巢里、在后巷、在废墟里、在郊外……

key: A pain much greater than what you have seen here prevails in the world.
value: 一个比你在这里看到的大得多的痛苦笼罩着世界。

key: I have observed everything conscientiously, for I didn’t obsess myself with an unreachable ideal to lock myself up in a cramped room, like you.
value: 我认真地观察了一切，因为我没有像你那样执着于一个遥不可及的理想而把自己锁在狭小的房间里。

key: The world you looked up at and the one I looked down upon are that much different.
value: 你仰望的世界和我俯瞰的世界就是如此不同。

key: You captured me alive and tortured me to your heart’s content, but still we’re sunken in despair.
value: 你活捉了我、尽情折磨我，但我们仍然沉没在绝望中。

key: And someone will replace me as one of the Arbiters of the Head, swinging their Claws at people like you.
value: 会有人取代我成为首脑的裁定者之一，向像你这样的人挥舞爪。

key: Even if you were to break the cycle somehow, it would be a perfectly, completely useless affair.
value: 即使你以某种方式打破了循环，那也完全、彻底是无用功。

key: Broken Wings will outstretch anew.
value: 破碎的翼会重新展开。

key: The brief resistance will be forgotten soon, and people will continue living, not for a purpose nor a dream, but rather simply because they cannot die.
value: 短暂的抵抗很快就会被遗忘，人们会继续活下去，不是为了某个目的或梦想，而只是因为他们不能死。

key: You may think that you have brought me down.
value: 你可能以为你把我拉下来了。

key: Yet as you can see, I’m still at the peak, looking down upon you lot while you writhe like insects.
value: 然而如你所见，我仍在顶峰，俯瞰着你们这些像虫子一样扭动的人。

key: I eagerly wait for the moment you fall into despair after realizing that this cycle of pain will never end.
value: 我热切等待着你意识到这个痛苦循环永无尽头后陷入绝望的那一刻。

key: I want to see you kneel before the might of destiny, resigning yourself to fate.
value: 我想看你跪在命运的威力面前，听天由命。

key: Go on, slowly; despair and succumb to your fate.
value: 去吧，慢慢地；绝望并屈服于你的命运吧。

key: Try to resist to the very end, and ultimately break yourself.
value: 抵抗到最后，最终把自己打碎吧。

key: As the last bits of your resistance melt away.
value: 当你最后一点抵抗融化时。

key: We shall be the subterranean water that quietly flows underneath the earth.
value: 我们将成为在地下静静流淌的地下水。

key: She was mortally wounded by Kali, but she was our only way out.
value: 她被卡莉打成致命重伤，但她是我们唯一的出路。

key: It was a miracle that we captured her alive. We were too far down the road filled with remorse and regret to feel any sort of guilt.
value: 我们能活捉她是个奇迹。我们已经走在充满悔恨的路上太远，感受不到任何内疚了。

key: Probe her head.
value: 探查她的头部。

key: How to avoid the Head’s pursuit; the means to join the ranks of the Wings; and the way for us, the few, to survive.
value: 如何躲避首脑的追踪；加入翼的行列的方法；以及我们这少数人活下去的方式。

key: It was impossible to figure those out on our own.
value: 我们自己不可能弄清楚这些。

key: She was hardly breathing, but her encephalon was still active. That was all we needed.
value: 她几乎没有呼吸了，但她的大脑还在活动。这就够了。

key: We probe through her head like we did to Carmen. We search for the way out.
value: 我们像探查卡门那样探查她的头部。我们寻找出路。

key: After that, we arduously gather up every single bit of those deformed pieces.
value: 在那之后，我们费力地收集了那些变形碎片的每一点。

key: The sentinel who guards the gates of hell must always be in despair.
value: 守卫地狱之门的哨兵必须永远处于绝望之中。

key: Such despair that they cannot even fall into the depths of hell.
value: 那种连坠入地狱深处都做不到的绝望。

key: Yet another place becomes a desolate wasteland in the end.
value: 又一个地方最终变成了荒凉的废土。

key: P-Please, spare me… I did everything you told me to...
value: 求、求你，饶了我吧……你让我做的我都做了……

key: Don’t you get any impression, when the place you belonged to has been reduced to ashes and dust?
value: 当你归属的地方化为灰烬时，你没有任何感触吗？

key: Don’t be such a buzzkill. Try to admire the view a little.
value: 别这么扫兴。试着欣赏一下风景。

key: Since childhood, scenery such as a myriad of stars illuminating the sky or the sun’s radiant light beating down upon the earth couldn’t impress me one bit.
value: 从小时候起，繁星满天或阳光普照大地这样的风景一点都打动不了我。

key: This, however, gives me a thrill. A thrill that makes me thirst for more.
value: 然而，这个让我兴奋。一种让我渴望更多的兴奋。

key: But it’s still not enough.
value: 但这还不够。

key: My thirst has not been quenched just yet.
value: 我的渴望还没有被满足。

key: P… Please… Let me go now… You got everything you wanted…
value: 求、求你……放我走……你已经得到你想要的一切了……

key: Why are you trembling so much? Where’d the guts to betray your very own Nest go?
value: 你为什么抖成这样？背叛你自己巢的胆量去哪了？

key: The plan wasn’t perfect by any means, but it wasn’t all that bad, either.
value: 计划无论如何都不完美，但也不算太差。

key: Thanks to those that placed their trust in you, we get to have this magnificent view.
value: 多亏了那些信任你的人，我们才能看到这壮丽的景色。

key: Trust is one of my favorite weapons, you see. It leaves a great wound, no?
value: 信任是我最喜欢的武器之一。它留下的伤口很大，不是吗？

key: The Sweepers will arrive soon.
value: 清扫者很快就到。

key: Wherever there is trash, they’ll always be on time to gather it up.
value: 哪里有垃圾，它们总会准时来收集。

key: N… No… Please…
value: 不……不要……求你……

key: It’s a symbiotic relationship, so to speak. We’re too busy to take care of all the dregs.
value: 可以说是一种共生关系。我们太忙了，顾不上处理所有残渣。

key: ......... Anything but the Sweepers.. Please…
value: ……除了清扫者什么都行……求你……

key: Ah yes, that face.
value: 啊对，就是这张脸。

key: That vivid expression on your face is the testament to life.
value: 你脸上那生动的表情就是生命的证明。

key: My two best companions, silence and the metallic scent of black tea.
value: 我最好的两个同伴，沉默和红茶的金属气息。

key: Wouldn’t you agree?
value: 你同意吗？

key: Now, the next stop… is that place.
value: 那么，下一站……是那个地方。

key: It’s rather displeasing that I have to depend on the information from some orange-haired girl...
value: 不得不依赖某个橙发女孩的情报真让人不快……

key: But the weak and the vulnerable tend to yield greatly valuable information.
value: 但弱小者往往能提供极具价值的情报。

key: What kind of faces will show me what it means to be alive next?
value: 接下来会是什么样的面孔向我展示活着的意义呢？

key: The only things that could excite me were the dying and the crumbling.
value: 唯一能让我兴奋的就是垂死和崩塌。

key: Only the sound of their last breath, and the expressions they made while they cling to their fading life could satisfy me.
value: 只有他们最后一口气的声音，以及他们紧抓着消逝生命时的表情才能让我满足。

key: I recognized a long time ago that you and I were no different.
value: 我早就认识到你和我没有什么不同。

key: We are the mutants this epoch has created.
value: 我们是这个时代创造的变异者。

key: No, let’s say that we are the new generation of humanity, fit better than anyone else to live through this age.
value: 不，不如说我们是人类的新一代，比任何人都更适合活在这个时代。

key: That is why you could have planned all this.
value: 这就是为什么你能计划这一切。

key: However, no matter what you achieve here, the world will not change at all.
value: 然而，无论你在这里取得什么成就，世界都不会改变。

key: The Wings on the rise, the Organizations from the Backstreets, the creatures in the Outskirts, the abyss within the Ruins, Arbiters like me, the Claws, and the Eye… You’ll never have a chance against them alone.
value: 崛起的翼、后巷的组织、郊外的生物、废墟的深渊、像我这样的裁定者、爪、眼……你永远不可能独自对抗它们。

key: ...But simply idling here won’t change the world, either.
value: ……但只是在这里虚度时光也不会改变世界。

key: If there are no more places to run to, hide in, or rest, then I will witness everything you have to do with my own eyes.
value: 如果再也没有地方可以逃、可以藏、可以休息，那我就亲眼见证你要做的一切。

key: I shall not close my eyes just because my eyelids are heavy, nor shall I turn away just because the sight is painful.
value: 我不会因为眼皮沉重就闭上眼睛，也不会因为景象痛苦就转开脸。

key: Simply proceed like you always have. Then you may just triumph.
value: 像你一直以来那样继续前进就好。那样你也许就能成功。

key: So, what’s on your mind?
value: 那么，你在想什么？

key: The air feels sweeter than usual, doesn’t it?
value: 空气感觉比平时更甜，不是吗？

key: Now, if you don’t mind, can I have a moment to drink some coffee, manager?
value: 现在，如果你不介意，我可以喝杯咖啡吗，主管？

key: Ah, that’s much better... I just can’t start my day without a fresh cup of coffee in the morning~
value: 啊，舒服多了……早上不来杯新鲜咖啡我就没法开始一天~

key: I hope you’re not offended by the way I talk to you, are you?
value: 希望你不要介意我和你说话的方式，好吗？

key: My name’s Chesed. I’m the head of the Welfare Department.
value: 我叫谢德。我是福利部的负责人。

key: The Welfare Team is quite remarkable. I’m proud to state that my team has the highest level of satisfaction in the entire corporation.
value: 福利部相当出色。我可以自豪地说，我的部门在全公司满意度最高。

key: Lady Angela’s told me to cooperate with you for now.
value: 安吉拉女士让我暂时和你配合。

key: Well, I am the kind of person who can flow with anyone, but playing silly games with the manager is too much pressure, even for me.
value: 嗯，我是那种和谁都能合得来的人，但和主管玩无聊的游戏压力太大了，即使对我来说也是。

key: But orders are orders, so I’ve got no choice do I?
value: 不过命令就是命令，我也没办法，对吧？

key: Well, I’ll be off now, my cup’s getting cold~
value: 好了，我走了，我的咖啡要凉了~

key: Um, Mister Chesed, sir? I have something important to tell you.
value: 那个，谢德先生？我有重要的事要告诉你。

key: Please, go on.
value: 请说。

key: Well… I didn’t polish the E.G.O thoroughly enough, so some of them appear to be malfunctioning right now. I think we’ll have to run some extra diagnostics, I’m so sorry, Chesed, sir.
value: 嗯……我没有把E.G.O充分打磨干净，所以有些现在似乎出故障了。我想我们得做一些额外的诊断，非常抱歉，谢德先生。

key: Naw~ That’s quite alright. Must have been pretty tiring to do E.G.O maintenance on top of all the work you already have, no?
value: 没事~ 没关系的。在你已经有那么多工作的基础上还要做E.G.O维护，一定很累吧？

key: Mister Chesed, sir…
value: 谢德先生……

key: I’ll go check it myself, you’ve done well enough to find out about the problem now.
value: 我自己去检查，你能发现问题已经做得很好了。

key: There’s so many things to mind here. It’d take quite a bit out of someone to constantly pay attention to every little detail like that.
value: 这里要操心的事太多了。像那样时刻注意每个小细节会把人累垮的。

key: Oh my! Thank you so much sir!
value: 天哪！太感谢您了！

key: Of course, let’s make the best of today as always~
value: 当然，让我们像往常一样好好度过今天~

key: The way I handled that was quite different from what you’ve seen out of the others, wasn’t it?
value: 我刚才处理事情的方式和你在其他人身上看到的很不一样，对吧？

key: Yep, Lady Angela wouldn’t have gone easy on that at all like I did.
value: 没错，安吉拉女士绝对不会像我这样手软。

key: These employees will be goners soon enough, so what’s the point in investing so much effort, scolding and lambasting them over tiny little mishaps?
value: 这些员工反正很快就没了，在小失误上费那么大劲责骂他们有什么意义？

key: …Well shucks, my coffee’s gone cold.
value: ……哎呀，我的咖啡凉了。

key: Too bad, lukewarm coffee just isn’t worth it.
value: 可惜，温吞的咖啡不值得喝。

key: Best to pour it down the drain with no hesitation.
value: 最好毫不犹豫地倒掉。

key: Well, it seems you did alright. Looks like you’re not as useless as they say.
value: 看来你做得不错。看起来你不像他们说的那么没用。

key: Try not to overdo it though, ok?
value: 不过别太拼命了，好吗？

key: Manager, you’ve accomplished quite a few things already.
value: 主管，你已经完成了不少事情。

key: What you’ve already gotten through will have lengthened the lives of our employees by at least some degree.
value: 你已经闯过的关至少在某种程度上延长了我们员工的寿命。

key: So… you should hopefully be satisfied now.
value: 所以……你应该可以满意了。

key: It’s not that I can’t see from your point of view.
value: 我不是不能从你的角度看问题。

key: You came to Lobotomy Corporation, and you probably want to put forth your best effort to mould this place into something better.
value: 你来脑叶公司，大概想尽全力把这个地方变得更好。

key: But this place is just like a cup of coffee gone cold ages ago.
value: 但这个地方就像一杯早就凉透的咖啡。

key: I get that it’s a strange comparison, but that’s how it is for me.
value: 我知道这个比喻很奇怪，但对我来说就是这样。

key: It’d be better off for all of us in the end if I were to at least feign our noble and benevolent posture, now wouldn’t it?
value: 如果我至少假装出我们崇高仁慈的姿态，对我们所有人都更好，不是吗？

key: The same goes for you, manager.
value: 你也一样，主管。

key: I said it before, there’s no need to invest your emotions and effort into such drivel.
value: 我之前说过，没必要把你的情感和精力投入到这种废话上。

key: I’ll ignore that.
value: 我会忽略那个。

key: I have to rebuke you there.
value: 我得反驳你。

key: …Alright, alright. Suit yourself, Mister Passionate.
value: ……好吧，好吧。随你便，热情先生。

key: I will say that I’m curious how long that fire in your heart will last.
value: 我倒是很好奇你心里那团火能烧多久。

key: I’ll get going now, I’m actually quite busy, even though I seem relaxed.
value: 我该走了，我其实挺忙的，虽然看起来很悠闲。

key: Lady Angela, please have a look at this. I spent the whole night researching an efficient method to improve the welfare of our employees.
value: 安吉拉女士，请看看这个。我花了一整晚研究提高员工福利的高效方法。

key: …Hah, that’s funny.
value: ……哈，真好笑。

key: Just look who’s talking.
value: 看看是谁在说这话。

key: You’ve done it yet again.
value: 你又来这套了。

key: Lady Angela must have showered you with praise for your work, right?
value: 安吉拉女士一定为你的工作夸了你很多吧？

key: “Your efforts will contribute to shaping this place into something better…” (He speaks with a sarcastic voice of dignity.)
value: "你的努力将有助于把这个地方变得更好……"（他用讽刺而庄重的声音说。）

key: …Such glorious, yet boring platitudes.
value: ……如此光辉却无聊的陈词滥调。

key: I myself had a burning passion in the past. Being responsible for a whole department, how charming is that?
value: 我自己过去也有燃烧的热情。负责整个部门，多迷人？

key: I hadn’t even acquired a taste for coffee back then.
value: 那时候我还没养成喝咖啡的习惯。

key: Should I say I developed that taste after learning the bitterness of life?
value: 该说我是在尝到生活的苦涩后才养成那个习惯的吗？

key: Or rather, I didn’t feel like sleeping anymore. Of course, none of the Sephirot need to sleep at all, but it’s for the mood, you know?
value: 或者说，我不想再睡觉了。当然，赛菲拉根本不需要睡觉，但那是为了氛围，你懂的？

key: One time, I even insisted on managing the Abnormalities myself.
value: 有一次，我甚至坚持要自己管理异想体。

key: I thought that only allowing employees on the field was plain ridiculous.
value: 我觉得只让员工上战场简直荒谬。

key: Seems pretty absurd to look back on it now.
value: 现在回头看还挺荒唐的。

key: You must be asking yourself, why have I become like this?
value: 你一定在想，我怎么变成这样了？

key: Your guess is as good as mine.
value: 我和你一样猜。

key: Chesed, what did you write up this time? I told you that this will change nothing.
value: 谢德，这次你又写了什么？我告诉过你这不会改变任何事。

key: But please, just look it over. This does have a statistically proven impact, and it even costs less. This will be beneficial for everyone.
value: 但求你，就看一眼。这个有统计学证明的效果，而且成本更低。这对大家都有好处。

key: Listen, Chesed. No matter how strongly you insist, using machines in place of human employees will never happen.
value: 听着，谢德。无论你多坚持，用机器代替人类员工是永远不会发生的。

key: And why is that? I’ve explained it to you before, it wouldn’t replace humans entirely, simply those who take place in dangerous jobs.
value: 那是为什么？我之前解释过，这不会完全取代人类，只是替代那些从事危险工作的人。

key: It’s clear that it will benefit everyone. The casualties caused by Abnormalities will be lowered, too.
value: 显然这对大家都有好处。异想体造成的伤亡也会降低。

key: How many times do I have to repeat myself? No the first time, and no yet again. Return to your post and finish your work.
value: 我还要重复多少遍？不行，第一次就不行，也不会再有下一次。回到你的岗位完成你的工作。

key: I’ll never give up on this. I swear to you that you will like the plan in the end. I’ll keep developing and furthering it, and I’ll continue to show you again and again, no matter how many times I may have to.
value: 我永远不会放弃这个。我向你发誓你最终会喜欢这个计划。我会继续开发完善它，我会一次又一次地给你看，无论要多少次。

key: Chesed, regarding that incident where the escaped Abnormality wiped out all eight of your team.
value: 谢德，关于那个出逃异想体杀光了你全队八个人的事件。

key: A few of our employees have made the suggestion to temporarily close down that part of the corridor. There are body parts that still have yet to be disposed of.
value: 我们的一些员工建议暂时封锁走廊那一段。还有残骸没有处理。

key: Alright. I’ll order it to be blocked, and have them take detours.
value: 好吧。我会下令封锁，让他们绕路。

key: Manager, you heard what she said, right? I need to get going. Told you I’m busy.
value: 主管，你听到她说的了吧？我得走了。说过我很忙。

key: It’ll be alright.
value: 会没事的。

key: It’d be best not to say anything.
value: 最好什么都不说。

key: Hey now, don’t give me a look like that. It was bound to happen sooner or later.
value: 喂，别那样看我。这迟早会发生的。

key: Surely that Abnormality had knocked them out before disintegrating them…
value: 那异想体肯定是先把他们打晕了再撕碎的……

key: I’m— Yeah, I’m sure it was a painless death.
value: 我——嗯，我确定是无痛的死亡。

key: Seems you’re holding up alright.
value: 看来你撑得不错。

key: Today wasn’t the best day. Incidents happened one after another, and I’m a bit tuckered out from it.
value: 今天不是最好的一天。事故一个接一个，我有点累了。

key: It’s a good thing that everyone has such clear-cut assigned roles.
value: 每个人都有明确分工真是好事。

key: It makes it easy for them to be faithful to their task with no unnecessary contemplation or distraction.
value: 这让他们可以忠实地完成任务，没有不必要的思考或分心。

key: Lady Angela does a very good job at keeping everyone in check in her play.
value: 安吉拉女士在她的戏里把每个人都管得很好。

key: Anytime someone tries to rid themselves of their assigned role…
value: 每当有人试图摆脱分配给自己的角色时……

key: Well, she becomes completely merciless.
value: 嗯，她就会变得毫不留情。

key: I myself have learned well that I have a predetermined role to play.
value: 我自己也很清楚我有一个预定的角色要演。

key: Whether one likes it or not, they have been cast into it already.
value: 不管喜不喜欢，他们已经被选角了。

key: Given that, I’ve made up my mind to simply wait.
value: 既然如此，我已经下定决心只是等待。

key: Wait for what, you may ask?
value: 等什么，你可能会问？

key: All things must come to an end.
value: 万物皆有终结。

key: So I’ll be waiting for her plan to finally come to a close.
value: 所以我会等她的计划终于走到尽头。

key: Lady Angela, I found something strange in the documents.
value: 安吉拉女士，我在文件里发现了奇怪的东西。

key: This record shows that the Containment Unit’s lock failure was what allowed the Abnormality to escape…
value: 这份记录显示是收容单元门锁故障让异想体逃了出来……

key: Yet to my knowledge, that door was fine for the entire day, nor was there any sign of malfunction.
value: 但据我所知，那扇门一整天都好好的，也没有任何故障迹象。

key: And the one with authority over the locking mechanisms of the Containment Unit doors is you, Lady Angela.
value: 而有权控制收容单元门锁机制的人是你，安吉拉女士。

key: Angela, please tell me. Why did you do it? You have to know how many employees under my department died that day.
value: 安吉拉，请告诉我。你为什么要这么做？你必须知道那天我部门有多少员工死了。

key: Such a bright one, Chesed. I knew you would find out, but this is a little quicker than I anticipated.
value: 真聪明，谢德。我知道你会发现，但比我预想的快了一点。

key: What do you mean by that?
value: 你那是什么意思？

key: Thanks to your “excellent” effort, your department’s escape ratio has been very low these days. You’re a capable Sephirah, I will give you that.
value: 多亏了你'出色的'努力，你部门最近的出逃率非常低。你是个有能力的赛菲拉，这点我承认。

key: I’ve never said this to anyone, and I don’t need to either, but…
value: 我从没跟任何人说过这个，也不需要，但……

key: Abnormalities create more energy through killing people.
value: 异想体通过杀人产生更多能源。

key: How could that be…
value: 怎么会……

key: You have written several reports and papers about importing machinery to replace the human workforce that must handle dangerous tasks, no?
value: 你写过好几份报告和论文关于引进机械替代必须处理危险任务的人力，不是吗？

key: If soulless, cheap machines were to replace those employees, then yes, the casualty rate would drop sharply. However, that would also drastically reduce our rate of energy production.
value: 如果没有灵魂的廉价机器取代那些员工，伤亡率确实会骤降。然而，那也会大幅降低我们的能源生产率。

key: Lobotomy Corporation operates a massive business. Tasks include meeting the energy supply quota, production of electricity for the City, and business relations with our various stakeholders such as the other Wings.
value: 脑叶公司经营着庞大的业务。任务包括完成能源供应配额、为城市生产电力、以及与其他翼等各利益相关方的业务关系。

key: We refine energy via the most efficient method available and make a profit. That is the only thing we need to take into account.
value: 我们用最高效的方法提炼能源并盈利。这是我们唯一需要考虑的事。

key: That’s just… How could you be so cruel…
value: 那简直……你怎么能这么残忍……

key: Chesed, any employee who works here is extremely lucky to be hired into one of the Wings. Many people fight for a job here everyday.
value: 谢德，在这里工作的任何员工能被翼雇佣已经极其幸运了。每天都有很多人为这里的工作争斗。

key: There will always be someone to take the place of the dead.
value: 总会有人取代死者的位置。

key: What right do you have to take away their fortune?
value: 你有什么权利夺走他们的好运？

key: I understand that you’re a smart one, Chesed. However, why won’t you use that intelligence for something more meaningful?
value: 我知道你很聪明，谢德。不过，你为什么不把那份聪明用在更有意义的事情上呢？

key: It seems you’ve taken quite a shock to this. But I warned you before, nothing will change from how it is now. Did you think I was joking around denying you?
value: 看来你受了不小的打击。但我之前警告过你，一切都不会改变。你以为我拒绝你是在开玩笑吗？

key: How about you try drinking a warm cup of coffee instead of wasting your time like this. You should savour your relatively high position, better than what the employees go through.
value: 你不如喝杯热咖啡，别这样浪费时间。你应该品味你相对较高的地位，比员工们经历的好。

key: Do not forget that we have one singular objective.
value: 别忘了我们只有一个目标。

key: Oh, and Chesed?
value: 哦，对了谢德？

key: I am the best Artificial Intelligence that this place has. I never clumsily leave trails or evidence behind.
value: 我是这个地方最好的人工智能。我从不笨拙地留下痕迹或证据。

key: So, did you enjoy your little detective game?
value: 那么，你的小侦探游戏好玩吗？

key: Do you know that we don’t exactly exist like how we appear?
value: 你知道我们并不像看起来那样存在吗？

key: I wonder how I look from your point of view.
value: 我很好奇在你眼中我是什么样子。

key: I bet it’s something distasteful and incapable. Something I would have hated in the past.
value: 我打赌是某种令人反感、无能的样子。我过去会讨厌的那种。

key: It’s quiet, isn’t it?
value: 很安静，不是吗？

key: Take a good, long look at this silence.
value: 好好长久地看看这份寂静。

key: Manager, have you ever gotten up early to walk the streets at the crack of dawn?
value: 主管，你有没有在黎明时分早起走过街道？

key: I think this moment right now is equivalent to that dawn in the outside world.
value: 我觉得现在这一刻就相当于外面世界的黎明。

key: The Abnormalities are currently in torpor due to the heightening of Qliphoth Deterrence during off hours.
value: 由于非工作时间逆卡巴拉抑制等级提高，异想体目前处于蛰伏状态。

key: Meanwhile, the employees are steeling themselves for when fate decides whatever will happen to them.
value: 与此同时，员工们正在为命运决定他们的遭遇做准备。

key: When the level of Deterrence is weakened, the powers of the suppressed origins will soon wake them.
value: 当抑制等级减弱时，被压抑的本源之力很快就会唤醒它们。

key: It’s always so hard to believe that a place as quiet as this will just as soon be engulfed by pandemonium.
value: 总是很难相信这么安静的地方马上就会被混乱吞噬。

key: Oh, how nice it would be to keep this tranquility…
value: 哦，能保持这份宁静该多好……

key: How many times do we have to fail? How much more must we be accustomed to the darkness, to finally encounter the light?
value: 我们还要失败多少次？我们还要习惯黑暗多久，才能最终遇见光明？

key: Good morning, Chesed, sir.
value: 早上好，谢德先生。

key: Ah, yes~ Good morning, buddy~ Good luck with your duties as always~
value: 啊，是啊~ 早上好，伙计~ 祝你今天工作顺利~

key: Mister Chesed, sir, I’ve been thinking, and I feel that I truly am lucky to be assigned to the Welfare Team.
value: 谢德先生，我一直在想，我觉得被分配到福利队真的很幸运。

key: Just getting into Lobotomy Corporation was really competitive, but being assigned to this team, it’s like a miracle.
value: 能进脑叶公司就已经竞争很激烈了，但被分到这个队，简直像奇迹。

key: …..You know brown-nosing won’t gain you anything.
value: ……你知道拍马屁对你没好处。

key: Just think of it as flattery, sir.
value: 就当是恭维吧，先生。

key: There really is no one who cares more about their employees like you do, Chesed, sir. I mean, just look at the department on the other side of our Layer.
value: 真的没有人像你这样关心员工了，谢德先生。我是说，看看我们楼层对面那个部门。

key: ….Nah, that’s not necessarily true.
value: ……那倒不一定。

key: I just want to say I appreciate you and the many things you do, sir. Sorry for keeping you so long, I’ll be going now, Chesed, sir.
value: 我只是想说我很感谢你和你做的那么多事，先生。抱歉耽误你这么久，我走了，谢德先生。

key: Aye, aye. Go get yourself ready for the day~
value: 好，好。去准备开始一天吧~

key: For many days, I consoled myself by saying that I wasn’t doing that bad for a Sephirah.
value: 很多天里，我都安慰自己说作为一个赛菲拉我做得不算差。

key: I never put my employees on the verge of death like a certain red-clad miss someone did, and I managed to be flexible with various situations most of the time.
value: 我从不像某个红衣小姐那样把员工逼到死亡边缘，而且大部分时间我都能灵活应对各种情况。

key: Getting mad at someone for breaking a rule or two, or agreeing with someone who claimed to make this place better…
value: 因为某人违反一两条规则而生气，或者同意某人让这个地方变得更好的主张……

key: When I take a step back and look at it all, I just can’t help but think…
value: 当我退一步看这一切，我忍不住想……

key: What’s the point of it all?
value: 这一切有什么意义？

key: Of course, I hoped to send them off in peace as they were just meant to die anyways.
value: 当然，我希望他们平静地离去，反正他们注定要死。

key: Meanwhile, I was hiding the biggest lie of all inside.
value: 然而，我内心藏着最大的谎言。

key: Yet I’ve been playing the role of the good leader, knowing that it was all a falsehood.
value: 但我一直扮演着好领导的角色，明知一切都是虚假的。

key: Lady Angela knew this too.
value: 安吉拉女士也知道这一点。

key: She knew that I would never be the great man who’d expose every little secret of this place to the employees, and try to overthrow the system and plot.
value: 她知道我永远不会是那个把这个地方的每个小秘密都暴露给员工、试图推翻体制和阴谋的伟人。

key: Well, I mean…
value: 嗯，我的意思是……

key: I just wanted to avoid pushing her buttons.
value: 我只是不想惹她。

key: Working as the head of the Welfare Department, I actually never cared about the welfare of our employees at all.
value: 作为福利部负责人，我其实从来一点都不关心员工的福利。

key: I was so afraid.
value: 我太害怕了。

key: Angela stopped any seedling of doubt or inquiry about the nature of this place by killing off employees indirectly.
value: 安吉拉通过间接杀死员工，阻止了任何对这个地方本质的怀疑或探究的萌芽。

key: Then I eventually decided to cover my eyes and ears...
value: 后来我终于决定蒙上眼睛和耳朵……

key: And help Lady Angela with her affairs without questioning them...
value: 不问任何问题地帮安吉拉女士处理事务……

key: Hey, Chesed, we have an emergency. You heard the status report, right? The Abnormalities have gone out of control.
value: 喂，谢德，我们有紧急情况。你听到状态报告了吧？异想体失控了。

key: I don’t know what happened, but we need to retake control of the situation right now.
value: 我不知道发生了什么，但我们必须立刻重新控制局面。

key: ….I thought you didn’t want to speak with me. What’s gotten into you Gebura?
value: ……我以为你不想和我说话。你怎么了，葛布拉？

key: …..You’re able to control the Deterrence, aren’t you?
value: ……你能控制抑制力，对吧？

key: We need to increase the level of Qliphoth Deterrence right now.
value: 我们必须立刻提高逆卡巴拉抑制等级。

key: Angela will call the Rabbits if the rest of the Abnormalities aren’t suppressed.
value: 如果其他异想体不被镇压，安吉拉就会叫兔子队来。

key: I want to wrap things up on my side of the facility.
value: 我想把我那半边设施的事了结。

key: ….But Gebura, no one is allowed to touch the controller of Qliphoth Deterrence without Lady Angela’s explicit approval. You know that.
value: ……但是葛布拉，没有安吉拉女士的明确批准，任何人都不能碰逆卡巴拉抑制控制器。你知道的。

key: So you don’t want to do it.
value: 所以你不想做。

key: You little coward. Do you really think you can just get over every situation by going through the motions?
value: 你这个小懦夫。你真以为走走过场就能应付所有情况吗？

key: I hope you continue to rot until the day you die, succumbing to your fears like the servile bastard you are.
value: 我希望你在烂掉中直到死那天，像你这个卑躬屈膝的杂种一样屈服于恐惧。

key: Choke on those sugar-coated words your employees feed you.
value: 噎死在你的员工喂给你的糖衣炮弹里吧。

key: ….It’s been quite a while since I’ve been grabbed by the collar.
value: ……我好久没被人揪领子了。

key: Chesed.
value: 谢德。

key: You knew I was coming, didn’t you? Seems you know me all too well.
value: 你知道我会来的，对吧？看来你太了解我了。

key: Perhaps you are the one who understands me most among our Sephirot.
value: 也许你是我们赛菲拉中最理解我的人。

key: Weaken the Qliphoth Deterrence, Chesed.
value: 削弱逆卡巴拉抑制，谢德。

key: What do you have up your sleeve this time, ma’am?
value: 这次你又有什么打算，女士？

key: Do you want to ask for reasons again? After all this time?
value: 你又要问原因吗？都到这个时候了？

key: …Gebura and the other employees are fighting right now. You know that, right?
value: ……葛布拉和其他员工正在战斗。你知道的，对吧？

key: Indeed, Gebura is—
value: 确实，葛布拉——

key: Sorry, this is quite humorous to me. I didn’t know you would talk about Gebura.
value: 抱歉，这对我来说相当幽默。我不知道你会谈葛布拉。

key: You should know. You’ve seen her for yourself.
value: 你应该知道。你亲眼见过她。

key: Gebura has failed to control her enmity, and has now lost her way.
value: 葛布拉没能控制住她的敌意，现在迷失了方向。

key: What I’m saying is, she is not fighting for some grand ideology.
value: 我的意思是，她不是为什么伟大的理念而战。

key: She should know best how she stands.
value: 她应该最清楚自己的处境。

key: Everyone has their own battle in this place…
value: 在这个地方每个人都有自己的战斗……

key: But I can’t seem to shake off this feeling that I’m the only one who just observes this situation from afar, not taking any action.
value: 但我似乎甩不掉这种感觉——只有我在远处旁观，不采取任何行动。

key: I thought you enjoyed those kinds of things, Chesed.
value: 我以为你喜欢那种事，谢德。

key: Taking in a cup of coffee, enjoying the peaceful day listening to your classical music.
value: 喝杯咖啡，听着你的古典音乐享受平静的一天。

key: I would think that I am providing the right environment for you, no?
value: 我应该觉得我在为你提供合适的环境，不是吗？

key: It seems our conversation has run on longer than I expected.
value: 看来我们的对话比我预期的长了。

key: Let me tell you one last time.
value: 最后告诉你一次。

key: Lower the Deterrence.
value: 降低抑制力。

key: Alright everyone, let’s make the best of today as alwa—
value: 好了各位，让我们像往常一样好好度过今——

key: Open the door.
value: 开门。

key: Who are you, ma’am?
value: 您是谁，女士？

key: Your taste in music is rather classy.
value: 你对音乐的品味相当高雅。

key: Quite different from mine, however.
value: 不过和我的很不一样。

key: What the……….
value: 搞什么……….

key: I apologize. I didn’t think you would open the door for me, so I simply walked in.
value: 抱歉。我没想到你会给我开门，所以就直接走进来了。

key: How did you get inside? Do I know you? ...
value: 你怎么进来的？我认识你吗？...

key: I’ve arrived from the Head. I was so desperately looking for you all.
value: 我是从首脑那里来的。我一直在拼命找你们。

key: The reason why I came all the way here is…
value: 我大老远来这里的原因是……

key: Well, let’s just say I have showed up to play my favorite music.
value: 嗯，就说我是来演奏我最喜欢的音乐的吧。

key: Excuse me, you there. Can you tell me the name of this fine gentleman?
value: 那位，你能告诉我这位好绅士叫什么吗？

key: D-Daniel… His name is Daniel…
value: 丹、丹尼尔……他叫丹尼尔……

key: Daniel is it? That name carries much more with it than you merit.
value: 丹尼尔是吗？这个名字配你太屈才了。

key: I would assume that you are the one in charge of this place.
value: 我猜你是这个地方的负责人。

key: Open that section where those monsters of yours are locked up.
value: 把你那些怪物被关着的区域打开。

key: As you saw just a moment ago, it’s nothing for me to open a locked door with my own power.
value: 正如你刚才看到的，用我自己的力量打开一扇锁着的门不算什么。

key: I’m just being polite after all, asking you to open the doors. It’s only fair as you’re the one in charge here.
value: 我毕竟是客气才叫你来开门的。你是这里的负责人，这样才公平。

key: I urge you not to resist. Just listen to me.
value: 我劝你不要抵抗。听我说就好。

key: If you do so, a few of these people might be able to escape with their lives, no?
value: 如果你照做，这里的一些人也许能活命，不是吗？

key: It’s easy to point the finger of blame at the betrayer.
value: 指责背叛者很容易。

key: However, one never really knows what it feels like to be the target of such a thing until they’ve been in the shoes of that situation.
value: 然而，一个人除非亲身经历，否则永远不知道成为那种目标是什么感觉。

key: Back then, a chill had come over my entire body. It was a fear I had never felt before.
value: 那时候，一阵寒意袭遍我全身。那是我从未感受过的恐惧。

key: I had faced numerous experiment-intended Abnormalities, yet I never had experienced my body being paralyzed and my blood curdling in such a way before.
value: 我面对过无数用于实验的异想体，但从未经历过身体麻痹、血液凝固成这样。

key: So this is the “Head”.
value: 所以这就是'首脑'。

key: Boss, enough with your orders.
value: 老大，别再下命令了。

key: Don’t try and make me justify my cowardly acts.
value: 别想让我为自己懦弱的行为找借口。

key: I’m ashamed for consoling myself, saying that there was nothing to be done after passing straight through the tunnel of defeat.
value: 我为自己安慰自己说在笔直穿过失败隧道后无能为力而感到羞耻。

key: I’m so struck with shame and grief, I can’t bear it anymore…
value: 我被羞耻和悲伤淹没，再也受不了了……

key: This body of mine is like a punishment for me, reminding me of my past. I can’t even bleed from this body.
value: 我这身体就像对我的惩罚，提醒着我的过去。我甚至不能从这身体流血。

key: I don’t want to undertake dirty work for Angela’s show, or be a puppet who gets praise and applause from everyone.
value: 我不想为安吉拉的表演做脏活，也不想当一个从每个人那里得到赞美和掌声的傀儡。

key: Nor do I want to be your “aide” who can’t do a single thing.
value: 我也不想当你那个什么都做不了的'助手'。

key: All of this has been a series of shame for me.
value: 这一切对我来说都是一连串的耻辱。

key: Manager, this shall be my rebellion against you and Angela.
value: 主管，这将是我对你和安吉拉的反抗。

key: “I’m the only one who survived…”
value: "我是唯一活下来的人……"

key: “Saying there was ‘nothing I could do.’ That I was ‘too scared’ to bear it by myself. That ‘I wanted to save’ at least a few of my coworkers…”
value: "说什么'我无能为力'。说什么我'太害怕'无法独自承受。说什么我'想救'至少几个同事……"

key: “All those are meaningless excuses…”
value: "那些都是毫无意义的借口……"

key: “I think I’m going to die soon too…”
value: "我想我也快死了……"

key: “The Head is on its way to get you…”
value: "首脑正在来找你的路上……"

key: “I’ll see you again in hell… A, sir…”
value: "地狱里再见……A先生……"

key: How is fear able to dominate the human mind?
value: 恐惧是如何支配人类心灵的？

key: How many people would stick to their beliefs and morals, if they were to come face to face with a true nightmare?
value: 如果直面真正的噩梦，有多少人会坚持自己的信念和道德？

key: The answers to those questions are why no one can blame Daniel’s behaviour.
value: 这些问题的答案就是为什么没有人能指责丹尼尔的行为。

key: Truth be told, everything fell down the edge of the cliff the exact moment the Head found us.
value: 说实话，首脑找到我们的那一刻，一切都坠下了悬崖。

key: Hang up the intercom.
value: 挂掉对讲机。

key: Our last conversation came to an end with a hopeless silence.
value: 我们最后的对话在绝望的沉默中结束。

key: Daniel. He was intelligent and held a high social position, and showed more finesse than anyone else in our research lab.
value: 丹尼尔。他很聪明，社会地位高，在我们的研究室里比任何人都有风度。

key: He had an excellent reputation from the people who surrounded him; he had his sly yet charming smile and humor.
value: 他在周围人中声誉很好；他有狡黠而迷人的微笑和幽默。

key: It would have been easy for him to get into any one of the Wings with his skills and personality.
value: 以他的能力和性格，他可以轻松进入任何一家翼。

key: But he chose us, not the Wings.
value: 但他选择了我们，而不是翼。

key: Though amazing he once was, there is no doubt he died in despair and regret, cursing his choice.
value: 尽管他曾经那么了不起，毫无疑问他在绝望和悔恨中死去，诅咒着自己的选择。

key: Seeing the dead bodies of his coworkers strewn about in front of him…
value: 看着同事的尸体横在他面前……

key: Not even having the single comfort of knowing that it wasn’t his fault.
value: 连知道这不是他的错这唯一的安慰都没有。

key: Unable to find any peace for his final rest…
value: 无法为他最后的安息找到任何平静……

key: What? You’re kidding!
value: 什么？你开玩笑吧！

key: People here don’t drink coffee in the morning?!
value: 这里的人早上不喝咖啡？！

key: There’s no better way to get energized than drinking a fresh cup of coffee before you start the day man~!
value: 开始一天之前来杯新鲜咖啡是最提神的了，兄弟~！

key: What’s with the look on your faces?
value: 你们那是什么表情？

key: You weren’t expecting me to show up like this, were you?
value: 你们没想到我会这样出现吧？

key: Aww, isn’t this a shame~ I wasn’t expecting some massive welcome party, but I didn’t think you guys would be so heartless.
value: 哎呀，真可惜~我没指望什么盛大的欢迎派对，但没想到你们这么无情。

key: Well, of course I understand.
value: 好吧，我当然理解。
