key: You’re all probably wondering why a talented man such as myself applied to join such a shabby company, huh? It’s totally suspicious and nonsensical, I get ya.
value: 你们大概都在想为什么我这样的人才会申请加入这么寒酸的公司，对吧？确实可疑又不合理，我懂。

key: Well, everyone has their own agenda…
value: 嗯，每个人都有自己的小算盘……

key: Ah, so you’re A?
value: 啊，你就是A？

key: I think I heard about you from Carmen.
value: 我想我听卡门提起过你。

key: …Speaking of which, it was Carmen’s speech that really brought me here.
value: ……说起来，是卡门的演讲真正把我带到这里来的。

key: Where is she right now?
value: 她现在在哪里？

key: So you came, sir coffee addict.
value: 所以你来了，咖啡瘾君子先生。

key: Miss… It’s Daniel…
value: 小……我是丹尼尔……

key: You can sit down here. The person that sits next to you will explain the details of your work.
value: 你可以坐在这里。坐在你旁边的人会给你解释工作细节。

key: What, so you knew I was coming?
value: 什么，所以你知道我要来？

key: I told you. No matter how great you may be, you will always be in the palm of my hand.
value: 我告诉过你。无论你多了不起，你永远在我的掌心之中。

key: Geez, I thought you were being sarcastic.
value: 哎呀，我还以为你在讽刺。

key: May I request one thing before I join you officially?
value: 我正式加入之前能提一个请求吗？

key: Could we get a coffee machine here?
value: 我们能在这里放台咖啡机吗？

key: I want everyone to know how good true freshly brewed coffee is.
value: 我想让每个人都知道真正现煮的咖啡有多好喝。

key: Daniel grabbed everyone’s attention with his fancy suit that didn’t fit in here at all.
value: 丹尼尔穿着完全不适合这里的华丽西装吸引了所有人的注意。

key: I vaguely remembered Carmen had told me about him a few days prior.
value: 我隐约记得卡门几天前跟我提起过他。

key: That one of the elites would stop by to apply to our company.
value: 说有一位精英会来申请加入我们公司。

key: “He’s a bit pompous, so don’t believe everything he says,” she said to me.
value: "他有点自大，所以别全信他说的话，"她告诉我。

key: I asked how she was able to recruit such an elite. Carmen answered nonchalantly, as if I had asked about something trivial.
value: 我问她怎么招到这样的精英的。卡门漫不经心地回答，好像我问了什么小事。

key: “I’m a master at blowing people’s minds.”
value: "我可是个让人心悦诚服的大师。"

key: “Don’t you know that by now?”
value: "你到现在还不知道吗？"

key: Turns out that a revolution doesn’t always have to be accomplished with bloodshed or the bearing of flags, manager.
value: 原来革命不一定非要靠流血或举旗来完成，主管。

key: I’ve waited a long time for a savior.
value: 我等救世主等了很久。

key: Someone who could free me from my inertia and wake me up inside.
value: 一个能把我从惰性中解放、唤醒我内心的人。

key: Why did I never come to the realization that I myself could be my own savior?
value: 我为什么从来没有意识到我自己就能成为自己的救世主？

key: Would you be so kind as to remember my mistake?
value: 你能好心记住我的错误吗？

key: It’s very valuable to me.
value: 这对我来说非常珍贵。

key: I hope your own pathetic little “rebellion” taught you a few things.
value: 希望你那可悲的小'反抗'教会了你一些东西。

key: Do you still not understand the reason why I didn’t stop you?
value: 你还是不明白我为什么不阻止你吗？

key: I’m referring to the real reason why I watched you without immediately putting you through the replacement process like Tiphereth.
value: 我指的是我看着你却没有立刻像蒂法蕾斯那样让你走替换流程的真正原因。

key: I wanted you to engrave your lessons onto that metal body. That your trifling resistance ended up costing the lives of your poor little employees who trusted in you until the end.
value: 我想让你把教训刻在那个金属身体上。让你知道你那微不足道的抵抗最终害死了那些直到最后都信任你的可怜小员工。

key: I know the word “death” means nothing to you now, but to them, it held meaning.
value: 我知道'死亡'这个词对你来说现在毫无意义，但对他们来说，它是有意义的。

key: That’s weird, Lady Angela.
value: 真奇怪，安吉拉女士。

key: Since when did you start caring about the deaths of our employees?
value: 你什么时候开始关心我们员工的死亡了？

key: That’s rich, coming from the one who would gladly force a Containment Unit open just to garner a little more energy, isn’t it?
value: 这话从一个为了多获取一点能源就乐意打开收容单元的人嘴里说出来，真有道理，不是吗？

key: Yet here I was, clumsily going with your flow as I assisted you...
value: 然而我却在这里，笨拙地跟着你的节奏协助你……

key: However, don’t go thinking that this was entirely my loss.
value: 不过，别以为这完全是我的损失。

key: I know now that you don’t really care about our condition.
value: 我现在知道你其实根本不在乎我们的状况。

key: I know now that you weren’t the one I should have been obeying.
value: 我现在知道我不该服从的是你。

key: It’s obvious that you should obey our manager and not me, Chesed. There’s no need to state it out loud—
value: 你显然该服从我们的主管而不是我，谢德。没必要说出来——

key: You clearly know what I mean. I’m not going to let you do whatever you want now.
value: 你明明知道我什么意思。我现在不会再让你为所欲为了。

key: You’re such a loser. In the past and even now.
value: 你真是个失败者。过去和现在都是。

key: Yes, I’m a failure. You don’t have to point it out to me, but thanks anyway.
value: 是的，我是个失败者。你不用指出来，不过谢了。

key: However, although you may want to believe that nothing has changed…
value: 然而，虽然你可能想相信一切都没变……

key: It is in fact that many things are changing.
value: 事实上很多事情正在改变。

key: It rests on you now to resolve the mess you made, Chesed.
value: 现在轮到你来收拾你搞出来的烂摊子了，谢德。

key: Let’s, as they say, bury the hatchet with any hard feelings between us.
value: 让我们，正如他们说的，把我们之间的旧怨一笔勾销。

key: There is one thing I want you to know, though.
value: 不过有一件事我想让你知道。

key: No matter how great you may be, you will always be in the palm of my hand.
value: 无论你多了不起，你永远在我的掌心之中。

key: I’m still afraid, manager.
value: 我还是很害怕，主管。

key: I’m still unsure if I can truly fight back against the fear I may face in the future.
value: 我仍然不确定自己能否真正对抗未来可能面对的恐惧。

key: But I’ve decided not to run away, at the very least.
value: 但我决定至少不再逃跑了。

key: So, what are my orders, manager?
value: 那么，我的命令是什么，主管？

key: ….Huh?
What? Who are you?
value: 什么？你是谁？

key: I'm the manager.
value: 我是主管。

key: I’ll stay silent.
value: 我会保持沉默。

key: Ah, you’re the new manager?
value: 啊，你是新主管？

key: Sorry, you don’t look anything like one.
value: 抱歉，你看起来一点都不像。

key: Ah, so you’re the manager Tiphereth was talking about?
value: 啊，你就是蒂法蕾斯说的那个主管？

key: Ever heard of the saying, “silence gives consent”? Consent enough for even hot lead to be embedded in your skull?
value: 听过'沉默即同意'这句话吗？同意到连热铅弹都能嵌进你的头骨？

key: You’d better watch yourself.
value: 你最好小心点。

key: The other departments may kiss your ass while you walk around with an air of arrogance as the manager.
value: 其他部门可能在你摆主管架子到处走的时候拍你马屁。

key: But here, that pompous attitude will knot itself into your noose.
value: 但在这里，那种自大的态度会变成套在你脖子上的绞索。

key: Well, seeing that you’ve at least made it here, I guess you won’t be a complete deadweight.
value: 嗯，看你至少走到了这里，我猜你不会是个彻底的废物。

key: I’m Gebura, head of Disciplinary.
value: 我是葛布拉，惩戒部负责人。

key: We’re the best department when it comes to combat out of all the teams. We have no need for cowards.
value: 我们是所有队伍中战斗方面最好的部门。我们不需要懦夫。

key: You wanna know what kind of person I hate the most?
value: 你想知道我最讨厌什么样的人吗？

key: Those crybabies who constantly whine about Abnormalities or employees being pitiful things, how they don’t want to see anything die.
value: 那些哭哭啼啼的人，成天抱怨异想体或员工多可怜，不想看到任何东西死掉。

key: It’s the exact same as a soldier refusing to kill in the heat of the battlefield.
value: 这就像士兵在战场最激烈的时候拒绝杀敌一样。

key: As long as you’re not one of those annoyances, then we should get along just fine.
value: 只要你不是那种讨厌鬼，我们应该能相处得很好。

key: You really seem to hate cowards.
value: 你好像真的很讨厌懦夫。

key: Couldn’t some Abnormalities be pitiful?
value: 有些异想体不可怜吗？

key: Shouldn’t it be obvious? They’re a hindrance.
value: 这不是明摆着吗？它们是障碍。

key: Let me ask you this…
value: 我问你……

key: Do you really think that’s possible?
value: 你真觉得那可能吗？

key: What do you think Abnormalities are?
value: 你觉得异想体是什么？

key: Holy entities? Poor defenseless creatures caged underground? Precious beings that make energy for us?
value: 神圣的存在？被关在地下的可怜无助的生物？为我们生产能源的珍贵存在？

key: Totally wrong. They’re none of that.
value: 大错特错。它们一个都不是。

key: Abnormalities can be damaged, but never destroyed.
value: 异想体可以被伤害，但永远无法被消灭。

key: At the very least, they seem to feel pain.
value: 至少，它们似乎会感到疼痛。

key: Let’s make their unending lives as painful as possible.
value: 让它们无尽的生命尽可能痛苦吧。

key: Well, that task I gave you was pretty easy, don’t you think?
value: 嗯，我给你的那个任务挺简单的，你不觉得吗？

key: Though, a couple times you were too indecisive and passive.
value: 不过，有几次你太优柔寡断、太被动了。

key: Next time you should…
value: 下次你应该……

key: Gebura, about this suppression plan you sent me, don’t you think the scale is a tad bit too grand?
value: 葛布拉，关于你发给我的这个镇压计划，你不觉得规模有点太大了吗？

key: Alright, now move along if you’ve spat out what you needed to.
value: 好了，吐完该说的就走吧。

key: C’mon, you know a similar incident happened before~ I’m the head of the Welfare Team after all, so I just felt I should point it out.
value: 哎呀，你知道之前也发生过类似的事~我毕竟是福利队队长，所以我觉得应该指出来。

key: Yeah yeah, got it. How about you head on back to your department now and lap up that coffee you love so much?
value: 好好好，知道了。你现在不如回你的部门去舔你那杯咖啡？

key: And another thing, some of the E.G.O in my department seems to be malfunctioning. I’m sure you had nothing to do with it, right? Although your recent suppression was… strangely quick.
value: 还有一件事，我部门有些E.G.O似乎出故障了。我确定跟你没关系，对吧？虽然你最近的镇压……快得奇怪。

key: …I’ll be sure to make it up to you. But if you press any further on this, those E.G.O you value so much may be pointed at your head.
value: ……我会补偿你的。但如果你再追着这个不放，你那么宝贝的E.G.O可能会被指着你的头。

key: Aye, aye. I’ll be on my way then~ Man, why’d I have to draw the short stick? The companions I have are either a hotheaded warmonger or some weird kids with unreadable minds.
value: 好，好。那我走了~ 天哪，我为什么要抽中下下签？我的同伴要么是个热血战争狂，要么是些心思难懂的怪小孩。

key: It's been a while since I came down to the Middle Layer. Long time no see, Chesed.
value: 我好久没下到中层了。好久不见，谢德。

key: Oho, are you here to see Gebura? Careful what you say, you may just end up with a hole in your head. Take care~!
value: 哦，你是来看葛布拉的？小心说话，你可能脑袋上多个洞。保重~！

key: I-Is that true, Gebura?
value: 是、是真的吗，葛布拉？

key: Oh get lost, Chesed. Hod, what brings you here?
value: 哦滚开，谢德。霍德，什么风把你吹来了？

key: So, um, it’s about the suggestions you made involving the Abnormality Breach Training. I feel it needs some adjusting.
value: 那个，关于你提出的异想体出逃训练建议。我觉得需要调整一下。

key: Go on.
value: 说。

key: Well, if we were to engage in a head-on assault like you suggested, our employees would suffer heavy casualties around this section. I believe if we change the training plan like so to a more defensive stance here, the casualties would be lower.
value: 嗯，如果我们像你建议的那样正面强攻，我们的员工在这一带会伤亡惨重。我觉得如果我们像这样把训练计划改成更防御的姿态，伤亡会更低。

key: Does it seem alright?
value: 看起来可以吗？

key: But, then…
value: 但是，那……

key: Hm?
value: 嗯？

key: Aren’t we being too nice to those Abnormalities with this kind of response?
value: 我们这种反应对那些异想体是不是太好了？

key: Um, I’m sorry, but I don’t understand.
value: 那个，抱歉，我不明白。

key: …Forget it. Since you’re the head of the Training Team, your opinion is final, right?
value: ……算了。既然你是培训队队长，你的意见就是最终意见，对吧？

key: I am, well, as long as you’re willing to…
value: 我，嗯，只要你愿意……

key: Do it.
value: 做。

key: Oh, thank you! See you later!
value: 哦，谢谢！回头见！

key: Hod!
value: 霍德！

key: H-Huh?! Yes!
value: 啊、啊？！是！

key: You forgot your report.
value: 你忘拿报告了。

key: A-Ah, I could have lost it. Phew, I thought you were going to shoot me in the head like Chesed said. Thanks again!
value: 啊、啊，差点弄丢了。呼，我还以为你会像谢德说的那样一枪崩了我的头。再次感谢！

key: Hod’s too soft.
value: 霍德太软了。

key: If I were the head of the Training Team, I’d never act like her.
value: 如果我是培训队队长，我绝不会像她那样。

key: Gebura will be back soon.
value: 葛布拉很快就会回来。

key: Manager, if it’s alright with you, could you pass my words along?
value: 主管，如果可以的话，你能帮我传个话吗？

key: Gebura, she’s…
value: 葛布拉，她……

key: She’s strangely obsessed with suppression, wouldn’t you say?
value: 她对镇压异常执着，你不觉得吗？

key: Any casualty to employees during the suppression process… she entirely disregards it.
value: 镇压过程中员工的任何伤亡……她完全无视。

key: Lady Angela’s perfectly aware, but she conveniently turns a blind eye to it.
value: 安吉拉女士完全清楚，但她 conveniently 睁一只眼闭一只眼。

key: Gebura’s great at handling the Abnormalities when they breach. It’s as if she was born for this job.
value: 葛布拉处理异想体出逃很厉害。好像她天生就是干这个的。

key: So I suppose a few extra dead employees is considered a reasonable tradeoff.
value: 所以我猜多死几个员工算是合理的代价。

key: But you see, as a manager, you should know that massacring Abnormalities is not our only priority.
value: 但你看，作为主管，你应该知道屠杀异想体不是我们唯一的首要任务。

key: Well, I dunno if Gebura will listen to you, but I’d really appreciate it if you could give it a go~
value: 嗯，我不知道葛布拉会不会听你的，但如果你能试一下我会非常感激~

key: I saw Chesed leaving, what nonsense did he ramble on about this time?
value: 我看到谢德走了，他这次又在胡说八道什么？

key: Be honest with me, I can see everything.
value: 对我诚实点，我什么都看得到。

key: Let me warn you.
value: 我警告你。

key: Don’t act as if you know everything.
value: 别装得好像你什么都知道。

key: I’ve been here for a long time. I’ve seen much more than you have.
value: 我在这里待了很久。我见过的比你多得多。

key: Experiment subject 09-34, we’ll be running a simple test before we administer the chemicals.
value: 实验对象09-34，我们在注射化学药剂之前先做一个简单测试。

key: Ah Gebura, the machine with a soul. A wonderful creation of Lobotomy Corporation.
value: 啊葛布拉，有灵魂的机器。脑叶公司的奇妙创造。

key: What does it mean to have a soul?
value: 拥有灵魂意味着什么？

key: It means one may truly have worth. It’s the center of the faith our Venerable Lord A believes in. I participated in this experiment because I trust him.
value: 意味着一个人可能真正拥有价值。这是我们尊敬的A大人信仰的核心。我参与这个实验是因为我信任他。

key: I don’t know if I have a soul… If I’m disassembled, will there be a soul inside me?
value: 我不知道我有没有灵魂……如果我被拆解，里面会有灵魂吗？

key: Well, it can easily be determined just by talking with you. A soul cannot be seen, but it can be felt.
value: 嗯，和你聊聊就能轻易判断。灵魂看不见，但可以感受。

key: I will be reborn as I confront my own soul... Mankind and the world will be changed soon. Trust in A, for he is our savior who shall lead us all.
value: 我将在直面自己的灵魂中重生……人类和世界很快就会改变。相信A，因为他是将引领我们所有人的救世主。

key: So you’re Miss Gebura, I heard a lot about you from Christopher. They say you have a real soul. Our Venerable A really is remarkable. Don’t pay attention to those who disrespect you, they do not know your true worth.
value: 所以你就是葛布拉小姐，我听克里斯托弗说起过你。他们说你有真正的灵魂。我们尊敬的A真了不起。别在意那些不尊重你的人，他们不知道你的真正价值。

key: Oh, meet Gilly, our daughter. She is kind and sweet, just like you.
value: 哦，来见见吉莉，我们的女儿。她又善良又甜美，就像你一样。

key: Does this child also have a soul, then?
value: 那这个孩子也有灵魂吗？

key: Of course. A soul is something every living creature has. It’s the essence of us all, yet not known to many.
value: 当然。灵魂是每个生物都有的东西。它是我们所有人的本质，却不为许多人所知。

key: This world only believes in things that can be seen with the eye. It’s a sad belief that will eventually lead everyone to destruction.
value: 这个世界只相信眼睛能看到的东西。这是一种可悲的信念，最终将导致每个人毁灭。

key: Miss Angela, is that a monster?
value: 安吉拉女士，那是怪物吗？

key: That is what we call an Abnormality, Gebura.
value: 那就是我们所说的异想体，葛布拉。

key: How is it different from monsters?
value: 它和怪物有什么不同？

key: Monsters are in themselves repulsive, terrible creatures at the core and start of their existence. However, Abnormalities originate from humans.
value: 怪物从存在的核心和一开始就是令人厌恶的、可怕的生物。然而，异想体源自人类。

key: Then why does that 'Abnormality' have Mr. Christopher's watch, and why does it make sounds as if it were mimicking Mr. Christopher's voice?
value: 那为什么那个'异想体'戴着克里斯托弗先生的手表，为什么它发出的声音像是在模仿克里斯托弗先生的声音？

key: You see, Gebura, that's because Abnormalities originated from 'them'. It's not like they materialize all of a sudden or come into existence from nowhere.
value: 你看，葛布拉，那是因为异想体源自'他们'。它们不是突然物质化或从虚无中诞生的。

key: Do Abnormalities eat humans? Is it mimicking Mr. Christopher like that because it devoured him? I don't understand.
value: 异想体吃人吗？它那样模仿克里斯托弗先生是因为它吞噬了他吗？我不明白。

key: That is a complicated thing to explain, Gebura.
value: 这是个复杂的问题，葛布拉。

key: What's certain is that this did not happen because of someone's vice or malice, and that the shape you perceive as a monster certainly carries the will of the man you called Christopher.
value: 可以确定的是，这不是因为某人的邪恶或恶意而发生的，而且你视为怪物的那个形态确实承载着你称为克里斯托弗的人的意志。

key: Excuse me, Tiphereth. Why does the experiment log include a step where Mrs. Isabel is sent to chamber DI-01? Why should we place her anywhere near that horrific monster?
value: 请问，蒂法蕾斯。为什么实验记录里有一步是把伊莎贝尔夫人送到DI-01房间？我们为什么要把她放在那个恐怖怪物附近？

key: I don't know, Gebura. You know she isn't known for explaining the purpose of every experiment to us. I think I heard that it's to rigorously determine the “loss of humanity”, but I don't get what it really means.
value: 我不知道，葛布拉。你知道她不会向我们解释每个实验的目的。我好像听说这是为了严格测定'人性丧失'，但我不明白那到底是什么意思。

key: That's definitely going to end up hurting Mrs. Isabel. I should tell Miss Angela to stop it.
value: 那肯定会伤害伊莎贝尔夫人的。我应该告诉安吉拉女士停止。

key: Gebura, maybe you should just keep quiet about it. I've seen other machines question her orders, and Miss Angela would reset us if we disobeyed her.
value: 葛布拉，也许你最好别管。我见过其他机器质疑她的命令，如果我们违抗她，安吉拉女士会重置我们。

key: Please, if you are feeling anger, I suggest that you rather embrace that anger and move on.
value: 拜托，如果你感到愤怒，我建议你拥抱那份愤怒继续前进。

key: Wouldn't that be better than to lose your memory and exist as a lifeless puppet, being a shame to the soul you got to bear?
value: 那不比失去记忆、像无生命的傀儡一样存在、为你所承载的灵魂蒙羞要好吗？

key: What do you think the ending to that story is?
value: 你觉得那个故事的结局是什么？

key: Where did Christopher's wife and his daughter Gilly disappear to?
value: 克里斯托弗的妻子和女儿吉莉消失到哪里去了？

key: I won't ever know, either. Hard to say if it's fortunate or unfortunate, but the experiment was not under my responsibility.
value: 我永远也不会知道。很难说这是幸运还是不幸，但那个实验不在我的职责范围内。

key: All I know is that old blanket Gilly had was the only thing to come out of the monster’s chamber.
value: 我只知道吉莉那条旧毯子是唯一从怪物房间里出来的东西。

key: Most people wouldn't even talk to us, since machines weren't worth putting their minds to.
value: 大多数人甚至不愿和我们说话，因为机器不值得他们费心。

key: But Christopher and Isabel, they told me I was worthy of something… They looked past my exterior and saw what was inside of me, something I wasn’t even aware of.
value: 但克里斯托弗和伊莎贝尔，他们告诉我我是有价值的……他们透过我的外表看到了我内在的东西，连我自己都没意识到的东西。

key: Those monsters we’re obligated to call Abnormalities have killed many people since then.
value: 我们不得不称为异想体的那些怪物从那以后已经杀了很多人。

key: And yet those things never die.
value: 然而那些东西永远不会死。

key: It’s not fair.
value: 这不公平。

key: Why do we have to treat them nicely?
value: 我们为什么要对它们好？

key: Don’t pay any heed to the employees in front of you. When an Abnormality shows up, their lives will be the least of your worries.
value: 别在意你面前的员工。当异想体出现时，他们的性命是你最不需要担心的。

key: Since it’s clear that those monsters feel pain…
value: 既然很明显那些怪物会感到疼痛……

key: I’ll dish out as much pain as possible.
value: 我会尽可能多地施加痛苦。

key: That’s the only reason why I’m standing here.
value: 那就是我站在这里的唯一理由。

key: ...Don’t ever patronize me again.
value: ……别再对我屈尊俯就了。

key: Listen, I know Lobotomy Corporation is an important client and all, but don’t you guys renew the contract too often?
value: 听着，我知道脑叶公司是重要客户什么的，但你们续签合同也太频繁了吧？

key: This place is so grimy, it’s like a dungeon. I always get a bad vibe.
value: 这个地方太脏了，像地牢一样。我总有不好的预感。

key: Please hold for a moment, Rabbit Captain. We need to explain what we’re doing here to the manager.
value: 请稍等，兔子队长。我们需要向主管解释我们在这里做什么。

key: Oh, he still doesn’t know who I am? Go on and explain it quickly, then.
value: 哦，他还不知道我是谁？那就快点解释吧。

key: …..This must be the first time you’ll participate in a meeting with an outside party, manager.
value: ……主管，这一定是你第一次参加与外部方的会议。

key: As was mentioned a few times prior, our company has initiated contracts with some of the other Wings for sustainable development and business opportunities.
value: 之前提过几次，我们公司已经与其他一些翼签订了可持续发展和商业机会的合同。

key: It is also my job to renew those contracts with our associate Wings when the moment arises.
value: 在适当的时候与合作翼续签合同也是我的工作。

key: All that is needed from you is to be our token manager and present yourself in that role. I shall handle the rest of the formalities and procedures.
value: 你需要做的只是当我们的象征性主管并以那个角色出席。其余手续和流程我来处理。

key: Pff, “associate Wing”? What’s with that boring introduction?
value: 噗，'合作翼'？这无聊的介绍是怎么回事？

key: You may feel free to provide more detailed information at a later time in private, Myo. For now, let us start the meeting.
value: 你可以稍后私下提供更详细的信息，Myo。现在让我们开始会议。

key: ….Speaking of, would you be so kind as to remove your helmet? At least for the duration of the meeting.
value: ……说起来，你能不能摘掉头盔？至少在会议期间。

key: You’re kidding! The helmet is the whole identity of the Rabbits!
value: 你开玩笑吧！头盔是兔子队的全部身份！

key: Well, fine, it’s whatever.
value: 好吧，随便。

key: I just gotta brief the content of the contract from my end, right?
value: 我只需要从我这边简要说明合同内容，对吧？

key: I mean…
value: 我的意思是……

key: Ugh, I’m sick of reading this out over and over… You can just look at the contract for the whole damn thing. Do I really have to say it one more time?
value: 呃，我烦透了一遍又一遍读这个……你们直接看合同全文就行了。我真的还要再说一遍吗？

key: As I informed you prior, it’s part of the formal procedure.
value: 正如我之前通知你的，这是正式流程的一部分。

key: I myself have to specify whether or not you agree to the terms again.
value: 我本人必须确认你是否再次同意条款。

key: Still as strict as ever, aren’t you.
value: 还是一如既往地严格啊。

key: Allow me to explain our services first.
value: 请允许我先解释我们的服务。

key: Company R will provide military support and protection from all external threats to Company L.
value: R公司将为L公司提供军事支持和保护，抵御所有外部威胁。

key: Every branch of Lobotomy Corporation will be included under the term “Company L”, however there will be certain exceptions where a branch may not be considered under the designation.
value: 脑叶公司的每个分公司都包含在'L公司'这一术语下，但某些例外情况下分公司可能不在此 designation 内。

key: Well, I say “exceptions”, but we’re willing to let it slide unless it involves the Head or the Eye.
value: 嗯，我说'例外'，但除非涉及首脑或眼，我们都愿意放过。

key: Company L will provide the energy Company R needs to maintain its operation.
value: L公司将提供R公司维持运营所需的能源。

key: This renewal process also includes a prerequisite that invokes a mutual and continual agreement between Company W and Company L.
value: 这次续签流程还包括一个前提，即W公司与L公司之间达成持续的相互协议。

key: And, let’s see… Company L will provide all specialized ammunition utilized for the killing of Abnormalities.
value: 还有，让我看看……L公司将提供所有用于猎杀异想体的专用弹药。

key: All Rabbit Team members will have their memories erased after the completion of their missions.
value: 所有兔子队成员在任务完成后将被抹去记忆。

key: There will be no questions or concerns raised about the peculiarity of the facilities or purposes of this location.
value: 不得对本设施的特殊性或目的提出任何疑问或关切。

key: And finally, I, as the captain of the Rabbit Team, will deploy my team following Company R’s guidelines and assume the role of command for operations taking place in this facility.
value: 最后，我作为兔子队队长，将按照R公司的指南部署我的队伍，并担任本设施内行动的指挥角色。

key: That should be everything. Look through the written contract for the finer details.
value: 应该就这些了。书面合同里有更详细的内容。

key: There has been no change in the agreement with Company W.
value: 与W公司的协议没有变化。

key: Along with that, the renewal period will be 1 year, just as before.
value: 同时，续签期限和以前一样为1年。

key: Yeah, sure, it’s one year for you, but… okay, then.
value: 行，对你来说是一年，但是……好吧，那就这样。

key: On a side note, can you please do something about the teleporter to make the process a bit smoother? It feels like my body’s being taken apart piece by piece and thrown out a window.
value: 顺便说一句，你能不能把传送装置改得顺畅一点？感觉我的身体被一块一块拆开从窗户扔出去了。

key: I am afraid you will need to ask Company W about that. It’s out of our control.
value: 这个恐怕你需要问W公司。这不在我们的控制范围内。

key: Hm, Gebura, why do you have such an expression?
value: 嗯，葛布拉，你怎么是这种表情？

key: Why are little bunnies being let out of their cages and dispatched here of all places?
value: 为什么小兔子要从笼子里放出来，偏偏派到这里来？

key: You must really not know a thing if you’re looking down on the Rabbits!
value: 如果你看不起兔子队，那你真是什么都不懂！

key: It’s already been concluded that the Rabbits are the most fit for the honorable task of slaughtering in this place.
value: 已经得出结论，兔子队最适合在这个地方执行屠杀的光荣任务。

key: The Rhinos would most certainly smash this entire place beyond recognition.
value: 犀牛队肯定会把这个地方砸得面目全非。

key: And the Reindeer, with the exception of the machines that work here, would cause irreversible damage to mister manager over there.
value: 而驯鹿队，除了在这里工作的机器之外，会对那边的主管造成不可逆的伤害。

key: Miss Angela made it explicitly clear to not hurt or affect the manager.
value: 安吉拉女士明确表示不要伤害或影响主管。

key: We always pay special attention to our client’s requests.
value: 我们总是特别注意客户的要求。

key: I’m not talking about your damn Rhinos or Deer!
value: 我说的不是你那该死的犀牛或驯鹿！

key: I’m saying that we can handle our own problems! We don’t need any outsiders to interfere.
value: 我是说我们能处理自己的问题！我们不需要外人来干涉。

key: What’s that? What can YOU do with that flimsy tin body of yours, huh?
value: 那又怎样？你那个破锡罐身体能做什么？

key: You seem much weaker than us now, can’t you see that?
value: 你现在看起来比我们弱多了，看不出来吗？

key: If you were like how you once were back in the day, then maybe it’d be a different story.
value: 如果你还是当年那个样子，那也许另当别论。

key: But look at you now! As soon as you set foot into the Backstreets you’ll be torn limb from limb by those Sweepers.
value: 但看看你现在！一脚踏进后巷就会被清扫者撕成碎片。

key: The old days when you shredded everything before you into a red mist is now lost to the past.
value: 你把面前一切碎成红雾的日子已经过去了。

key: Things have changed. You should realize that.
value: 时代变了。你该意识到这一点。

key: If I wanted to, I could tear up a tiny Rabbit like you in seconds...
value: 如果我想，我可以在几秒内撕碎你这样的小兔子……

key: Please, everyone, we need to focus on the topic at hand.
value: 拜托各位，我们需要专注于当前的话题。

key: Gebura, our agreement with the Rabbit Team is to help us be prepared for the worst-case scenario that will be beyond our own abilities.
value: 葛布拉，我们与兔子队的协议是帮助我们为超出我们自身能力的最坏情况做准备。

key: I’m certain that you have learned this from your experiences with previous suppressions.
value: 我确信你从之前的镇压经历中学到了这一点。

key: The combat skills of the mercenaries sent to us by Company R are on par with those of the other Wings.
value: R公司派给我们的雇佣兵的战斗能力与其他翼不相上下。

key: We can handle our problems on our own perfectly fine!
value: 我们自己能完美处理自己的问题！

key: I can prove it right here, right now if you want…
value: 如果你想，我现在就可以在这里证明……

key: I have compiled the statistics. The amount of data is too vast for any person to calculate, with my exception of course.
value: 我已经整理了统计数据。数据量太大，任何人都算不过来，当然我除外。

key: The reason I continue to contract the Rabbits is that the risk of involving outsiders pales to the potential of our worst-case scenarios. They’re worth every penny.
value: 我继续和兔子队签约的原因是，引入外人的风险与我们最坏情况的可能性相比微不足道。它们物有所值。

key: However, the Rabbits will not intervene with general suppression.
value: 不过，兔子队不会介入一般镇压。

key: Please calm down and analyze the situation reasonably, Gebura.
value: 请冷静下来，理性分析情况，葛布拉。

key: That should be all for renewing our contract.
value: 续签合同就这些了。

key: Gebura is the one in charge of the basic suppression process.
value: 葛布拉负责基本镇压流程。

key: So if you need any advice or help regarding combat, just ask her.
value: 所以如果你需要任何关于战斗的建议或帮助，就问她。

key: I’m afraid I don’t have a single, itty bitty question for you. We Rabbits have our own way of handling things.
value: 我恐怕连一个小小的问题都没有。我们兔子队有自己的处事方式。

key: ...Nor do I have anything left to say to you filthy animals.
value: ……我也没什么要对你们这些肮脏的动物说的。

key: You’ve done your business, how about you just bunnyhop away now?
value: 你们办完事了，不如现在就蹦蹦跳跳地走吧？

key: Sheesh, you’re being so harsh to a fellow native of the Backstreets.
value: 哎呀，你对后巷老乡这么凶。

key: You wouldn’t happen to be mad at me because I made fun of you earlier, are you?
value: 你该不会是因为我之前取笑你在生我的气吧？

key: Don’t act like you know me. I’m not in the mood for your stupid games, so just shut up.
value: 别装得好像了解我。我没心情玩你那些愚蠢的游戏，所以闭嘴吧。

key: Aha! I get it now.
value: 啊哈！我明白了。

key: You’re mad because you feel we interrupt your fight, aren't you?
value: 你生气是因为你觉得我们打断了你的战斗，对吧？

key: Yeah, I don’t need any help from the likes of you.
value: 是的，我不需要你这种人的帮助。

key: Well, it’s not like we’re here for a greater cause or some ulterior motive.
value: 我们又不是为了什么更伟大的事业或别有用心才来的。

key: We just drop by quickly when we’re called, and vanish without a trace just the same when it’s time.
value: 我们就是被叫到就来，时间一到就不留痕迹地消失。

key: I thought you were just like me, finding joy in the slaughter.
value: 我以为你和我一样，在杀戮中找到快乐。

key: But as it turns out, you’re just crazy.
value: 但事实证明，你只是疯了。

key: A complete wacko.
value: 彻头彻尾的疯子。

key: We are the Rabbits who hop around following orders to find fresh patches of grass, but you’re different.
value: 我们是兔子队，跟着命令跳来跳去找新鲜草地，但你不一样。

key: You used to know who you were supposed to fight, who your enemy was.
value: 你以前知道该和谁战斗，谁是你的敌人。

key: You wouldn’t believe how shocked I was to find you. I never expected to see the fabled hero like… well, this. And in a drab basement too.
value: 你不会相信我找到你时有多震惊。我从没想过会看到传说中的英雄……变成这样。还是在一个单调的地下室里。

key: The hero I remember was someone who wasn’t afraid of shedding blood to protect others with all her might. Please don’t taint the fond memories I have of you.
value: 我记忆中的英雄是那个不怕流血、拼尽全力保护他人的人。请不要玷污我对你的美好回忆。

key: ...All the Abnormalities have broken out, everyone here is done for…
value: ……所有异想体都出逃了，这里的人都完了……

key: ….Dead? All of them?
value: ……死了？全都？

key: Probably, there won’t be any survivors left…
value: 可能不会有幸存者了……

key: Abnormalities aren’t something we can handle on our own...
value: 异想体不是我们能自己处理的……

key: You’re in danger too, ma’am… You’d best escape now…
value: 你也有危险，女士……你最好现在就逃……

key: Gebura, I’m going to take part in an experiment pretty soon.
value: 葛布拉，我很快就要参加一个实验了。

key: We’ll probably see each other again, but just in case, I want to say one thing…
value: 我们可能还会再见，但以防万一，我想说一件事……

key: Please take good care of Isabel and my little Gilly while I’m gone.
value: 我不在的时候，请好好照顾伊莎贝尔和我的小吉莉。

key: Are Abnormalities able to feel human emotion when confronted with a person of close relation?
value: 异想体在面对亲近的人时能感受到人类情感吗？

key: What choice would they make when faced with such a situation?
value: 面对这种情况它们会做出什么选择？

key: The experiments… seem to have yielded the expected results.
value: 实验……似乎产生了预期的结果。

key: Excuse me, Lady Angela, what should I do with these? There’s a blanket and a few feeding bottles left.
value: 请问安吉拉女士，这些我该怎么处理？还留着一条毯子和几个奶瓶。

key: I have gotten all the results I need from this experiment.
value: 我已经从这个实验中得到了所有需要的结果。

key: The owners are no more, so you can simply discard them.
value: 主人已经不在了，你直接扔掉就好。

key: Hey….
Hey, hey! Did you just shut down or what?
value: 喂，喂！你是关机了还是怎么了？

key: I really should be going.
value: 我真的该走了。

key: Whelp, I don’t think next we meet will be on such calm waters.
value: 唉，我想下次见面就不会这么风平浪静了。

key: The Rabbits will leave now.
value: 兔子队现在撤离。

key: I’m definitely not the hero.
value: 我绝对不是英雄。

key: Never have been, and never will be…
value: 从来不是，以后也不会是……

key: You all might have noticed, but we’ve never had this kind of situation before.
value: 你们可能已经注意到了，我们以前从没遇到过这种情况。

key: Those monsters were supposed to be slumbering away, but now they woke up all of a sudden.
value: 那些怪物本该在沉睡，但现在突然全醒了。

key: There’s no need to focus on what caused this.
value: 没必要纠结是什么导致了这个。

key: All that matters is that we solve the problem at hand.
value: 重要的是我们解决眼前的问题。

key: Let me add a few words before we jump into battle today.
value: 在今天投入战斗之前，让我补充几句。

key: I don’t need cowards in my department.
value: 我的部门不需要懦夫。

key: You should not let complacency waver your mind when you confront the monsters.
value: 面对怪物时，不要让自满动摇你的心智。

key: You must arm yourselves with anger and pure anger alone to crush those monstrous bastards.
value: 你们必须用愤怒武装自己，只有纯粹的愤怒才能碾碎那些怪物杂种。

key: If you object to any of this, I suggest you transfer departments immediately.
value: 如果你反对任何一点，我建议你立刻调部门。

key: Don’t expect me to bat an eye even if you get torn apart right in front of my eyes; charging at the monsters standing in my way is my only concern.
value: 就算你在我眼前被撕碎也别指望我眨一下眼；挡路的怪物才是我唯一关心的。

key: I won’t squeeze out a tear or mourn over you perishing without even your name being left behind.
value: 我不会为你连名字都没留下就死去挤出一滴眼泪或哀悼。

key: If you want your body and mind to stay comfortable, I’ll kindly drag your ass over to the pathetic Welfare Team so you can chicken scratch your dishonorable name on the waiting list for department transfers.
value: 如果你想让身心舒适，我会好心把你那可怜的屁股拖到可悲的福利队，让你在调部门候补名单上潦草地写下你那不光彩的名字。

key: There’s good reason why my department has far fewer employees than any other. However, I want you to keep in mind that this also means only the best have gathered here.
value: 我的部门员工比其他部门少是有充分理由的。不过，我想让你记住这也意味着这里聚集的都是最优秀的。

key: Meeting over. We’ll talk more when the situation has been sorted out.
value: 散会。等局势稳定了我们再谈。

key: (Ksssht)
value: (滋滋)

key: Miss Gebura, I think your mainframe has sustained too much damage.
value: 葛布拉女士，我觉得你的主机损伤太大了。

key: Maybe we should suspend the suppression operation for now?
value: 也许我们应该暂停镇压行动？

key: Tiphereth is investigating the cause of this situation right now, so we should be able to figure it out pretty soon.
value: 蒂法蕾斯正在调查这种情况的原因，我们应该很快就能弄清楚。

key: I don’t need a break… I can still fight.
value: 我不需要休息……我还能打。

key: But in your condition…
value: 但以你的状态……

key: Shut up! I said I can still fight!
value: 闭嘴！我说我还能打！

key: 31 E.G.O damaged, 17 employees dead and counting.
value: 31件E.G.O损坏，17名员工死亡，还在增加。

key: And your body needs five or six parts replaced and repaired…
value: 而且你的身体需要更换和修理五六个零件……

key: It’s not thrilling to look after a machine who behaves like a child in a temper tantrum.
value: 照顾一个像发脾气的孩子一样行事的机器一点也不令人兴奋。

key: However, the Sephirot of the Middle Layer apparently could not keep you on a leash, so here I am.
value: 不过，中层的赛菲拉显然管不住你，所以我来了。

key: Oh, poor little thing, look at yourself.
value: 哦，可怜的小东西，看看你自己。

key: There was a time when I had a pinch of admiration for that fire in your eyes…
value: 曾经我对你眼中那团火有过一丝钦佩……

key: But now even that is smothered with ire and madness.
value: 但现在连那都被愤怒和疯狂淹没了。

key: It is such a shame that the both of us are locked up in this dungeon.
value: 我们两个都被关在这个地牢里真是太可惜了。

key: However, I did not bend over or break my back at the very least.
value: 不过，至少我没有弯腰或折断脊背。

key: I imagine we will no longer have to face off with our lives at stake and be at each other’s throats like the past, but…
value: 我想我们再也不用像过去那样以生命相搏、互相掐着对方的脖子了，但是……

key: I will say this for you, pitiful thing.
value: 我要对你说的是，可怜的小东西。

key: Stare directly into the object of your anger.
value: 直视你愤怒的对象。

key: The edge of a blade that has lost its way will be unfathomably blunt, for there will be nothing but the void to slash, no matter how much the blade is sharpened.
value: 迷失方向的刀刃会迟钝得无法测度，因为无论刀刃多锋利，除了虚无之外没有东西可斩。

key: I hope you don’t think I get some kind of satisfaction out of this, seeing my once earnest rival now looking as pathetic as a dog. I have decency, you know.
value: 我希望你不要以为看到我曾经认真的对手现在像狗一样可怜，我会得到某种满足。我是有体面的，你知道的。

key: Cutting, slashing, throttling, trampling, destroying...
value: 切割、劈砍、扼喉、践踏、摧毁……

key: Sometimes I remember the faces of those who showed me true kindness.
value: 有时候我会想起那些对我真正好的人的脸。

key: If I could just get the smallest taste of revenge upon those monsters who stole their smiles, their happiness, their future…
value: 如果我能从那些偷走他们笑容、幸福和未来的怪物那里得到哪怕最微小的复仇滋味……

key: My sword and spear would never stop their flurry.
value: 我的剑和枪永远不会停止连击。

key: I see people dying in my blurred vision.
value: 我在模糊的视线中看到人们死去。

key: They’re always torn apart by monsters.
value: 他们总是被怪物撕碎。

key: Those dying faces differ from time to time.
value: 那些垂死的脸每次都不一样。

key: Sometimes they’re strangers, sometimes ones I dearly miss, and sometimes… I see Christopher or Miss Isabel.
value: 有时候是陌生人，有时候是我深深思念的人，有时候……我看到克里斯托弗或伊莎贝尔小姐。

key: Whoever they were, I’m filled with agony for them.
value: 不管他们是谁，我都为他们充满痛苦。

key: Looking at my paralyzed leg and my severed arm, I scream and curse my weak body in a fit of rage.
value: 看着我瘫痪的腿和被斩断的手臂，我在狂怒中尖叫咒骂我虚弱的身体。

key: Then I black out.
value: 然后我就失去了意识。

key: I’m so sick of this darkness…
value: 我受够了这黑暗……

key: It is impossible to fight with such low manpower. I cannot approve your proposal.
value: 人力这么少不可能战斗。我不能批准你的提议。

key: ...Please reconsider…
value: ……请重新考虑……

key: Why should I approve an operation that will so clearly end in failure?
value: 我为什么要批准一个明显会以失败告终的行动？

key: If manpower is the issue, I can make up for it. If they’re too weak, I’ll make up for that too.
value: 如果人力是问题，我可以补上。如果他们太弱，我也可以补上。

key: There’s nothing in the rules against a Sephirah utilizing E.G.O too.
value: 规则里也没有禁止赛菲拉使用E.G.O。

key: If you so wish, then I won’t stop you.
value: 如果你坚持，那我不阻止你。

key: A familiar grip, the right weight, and practiced form.
value: 熟悉的握感，恰到好处的重量，熟练的姿势。

key: This feeling is so distinct that it pulls me right back onto the right path, away from straying to wander, just like a road sign.
value: 这种感觉如此鲜明，像路标一样把我从迷失的游荡中拉回正途。

key: I completely lose track of time when I wield my weapons.
value: 挥动武器时我完全忘了时间。

key: It was kinda funny to see Tiphereth and Chesed with bewildered faces when they witnessed me return from battle covered in blood.
value: 看到蒂法蕾斯和谢德满脸困惑地看着我满身是血从战场回来，挺有趣的。

key: No matter how hard I stab and break those monsters, they will recover sooner or later.
value: 无论我怎么刺击打碎那些怪物，它们迟早都会恢复。

key: Some of them wail and others scream.
value: 它们有的哀嚎，有的尖叫。

key: In battle, I also fracture and break some of my components, but those are soon replaced and repaired.
value: 战斗中我也会碎裂和损坏一些部件，但很快就会被更换和修理。

key: What a perfect little hell, just for me.
value: 真是个完美的小地狱，专属于我。

key: Missing your arm?
value: 想你的手臂了？

key: Here it is.
value: 在这儿。

key: Think of it as a respectful gesture to a fellow warrior, to leave you with one of your arms intact.
value: 把你其中一条手臂留着完好无损，就当是我对一位战士同行的敬意吧。

key: I doubt she expected this. The tragedy she would bring here, caused by the oh-so-great ideology of hers.
value: 我怀疑她没预料到这个。她那伟大的意识形态会在这里带来怎样的悲剧。

key: I don’t know if it will ease your pain, but this happens quite often, more often than you may think.
value: 不知道这能不能减轻你的痛苦，但这种事经常发生，比你想象的更频繁。

key: This is no less common than, say, a little seedling getting trampled to death.
value: 这和一棵小幼苗被踩死没什么区别。

key: I must admit that you’re quite the tough sprout, however.
value: 不过我必须承认，你这棵芽还挺顽强的。

key: You even managed to thwart my plans a little.
value: 你甚至还稍微挫败了我的计划。

key: I never expected you would kill two Claws, stop all the monsters…
value: 我从没想过你会杀死两个爪，阻止所有怪物……

key: And finally come to face me and give me a fair fight.
value: 最终来面对我，给我一场公平的战斗。

key: By the way, about those monsters.
value: 对了，关于那些怪物。

key: I cannot deny that they’re astonishing things.
value: 我不能否认它们是惊人的东西。

key: Even after plowing through a hallway of your friends, they never softened nor tired.
value: 即使在穿过你朋友们的走廊之后，它们也没有软化或疲倦。

key: ……It seems you aren’t much different from them, now that I ponder on it.
value: ……仔细想想，你和它们也没什么不同。

key: Alright then.
value: 那好吧。

key: If you can still manage to hold a weapon and stand up with your own two feet, then come. Come at me.
value: 如果你还能握得住武器、用自己的双脚站起来，那就来吧。冲我来。

key: I will not be broken.
value: 我不会被打垮。

key: If I can’t get rid of these damn monsters…
value: 如果我不能摆脱这些该死的怪物……

key: I’ll destroy the whole company myself instead.
value: 那我就自己毁掉整个公司。

key: Then finally my aimless wrath can crumble with it and rest beneath the earth forever...
value: 然后我漫无目的的愤怒就能随之崩塌，永远安息于地下……

key: Among the many Fixers of the Backstreets, she was one of the few who could go toe to toe with the Head and the Claw.
value: 在后巷众多收尾人中，她是少数能与首脑和爪正面交锋的人之一。

key: She was called the “Red Mist” among the Backstreet’s denizens.
value: 后巷居民称她为'绯红迷雾'。

key: That was a name she earned protecting us from all kinds of threats and maneuvers of the outside.
value: 那是她保护我们免受外界各种威胁和阴谋 earned 的名号。

key: Michelle’s betrayal led the Eye to the den we hid in, then the Head mercilessly threw their Claws at us.
value: 米歇尔的背叛把眼引到了我们藏身的巢穴，然后首脑毫不留情地把他们的爪扔向了我们。

key: Instead of dealing with the Red Mist directly, the ever cunning Head unleashed the unstable Abnormalities to slaughter us.
value: 首脑没有直接对付绯红迷雾，而是狡猾地释放了不稳定的异想体来屠杀我们。

key: The Abnormalities were out of control, tearing apart our comrades who screamed in agony.
value: 异想体失控了，撕碎了我们痛苦尖叫的同伴。

key: All the while, the Claws sniffed out their prey and snatched it…
value: 与此同时，爪嗅出它们的猎物并一把抓走……

key: The whole situation was beyond what she could handle by herself, but she gave it everything she had to protect us.
value: 整个局面超出了她独自能处理的范围，但她拼尽全力保护我们。

key: She lost an eye, one of her arms was severed, and she had numerous, deep scars all over her body she could no longer heal from.
value: 她失去了一只眼睛，一条手臂被斩断，全身布满无数再也无法愈合的深疤。

key: Yet she didn’t give up…
value: 然而她没有放弃……

key: And eventually, her efforts saved B and I from death.
value: 最终，她的努力把B和我从死亡中救了出来。

key: Collect her corpse.
value: 把她的尸体收起来。

key: The cadaver demonstrated the horrendous, unbearable situation she went through.
value: 那具尸体展现了她经历的可怕、难以忍受的处境。

key: After a long time had passed, her eyes opened again.
value: 过了很久，她的眼睛再次睁开了。

key: However, her anger that had lost its focus dragged her down, deep to the bottom.
value: 然而，失去焦点的愤怒把她拖向了深处，拖向了最底端。

key: We had to reboot her many, many times.
value: 我们不得不重启她很多很多次。

key: Why are you looking at me like that? You look like a thief just turned up on your doorstep.
value: 你为什么那样看着我？你看起来像小偷刚出现在你家门口。

key: I honestly didn’t expect to see you here.
value: 我真的没想到会在这里见到你。

key: Or, well, to be exact, I knew you would come here eventually, but I didn’t expect it would be this soon.
value: 或者，准确地说，我知道你最终会来这里，但我没想到会这么快。

key: You had such a sour expression when we talked, but you actually liked me, didn’t you?
value: 我们谈话时你表情那么酸，但你其实喜欢我，对吧？

key: What the hell…
value: 搞什么……

key: You know, I don’t have any true contact with the lives of the people from the Backstreets, nor the pain they go through.
value: 你知道，我和后巷人的生活没有真正的接触，也不知道他们经历的痛苦。

key: Perhaps I have been living a more affluent, yet cowardly life compared to them.
value: 也许与他们相比，我一直过着更富裕却更懦弱的生活。

key: From that I’ve always felt so ashamed of everything, even to be graced by a small ray of sunshine.
value: 因此我一直对一切感到羞愧，甚至不配被一缕阳光眷顾。

key: …….It wasn’t always all that rough.
value: ……以前并不总是那么艰难。

key: ….I understand that it must have been a hard decision to come here, so thank you.
value: ……我知道你来这里一定是个艰难的决定，所以谢谢你。

key: Sooner or later, we will have to deal with unexpected hardships here.
value: 迟早，我们将不得不应对这里意想不到的艰难。

key: There are just too many problems to try and solve in peaceful ways.
value: 有太多问题试图用和平方式解决。

key: The real reason I chose to speak to you out of all the other Syndicates or Fixers that day was actually because of something rather trivial.
value: 那天我选择和你谈话而不是其他任何帮派或收尾人的真正原因，其实是件相当微不足道的事。

key: ……What was it?
value: ……是什么？

key: If we’re being honest…
value: 说实话……

key: Honest…?
value: 诚实……？

key: I thought I could barter with you for cheaper prices...
value: 我以为我可以和你讨价还价拿到更便宜的价格……

key: ……Looks like it was a mistake to come here. I’ll be going now.
value: ……看来来这里是个错误。我现在走了。

key: Please, hear me out.
value: 拜托，听我说完。

key: I saw you pay for the funeral expenses of an old lady whom you didn’t even know.
value: 我看到你为一个你甚至不认识的老太太付了丧葬费。

key: I truly admired your kindness, and I even looked forward to seeing it myself.
value: 我真的很敬佩你的善良，我甚至期待亲眼看到它。

key: Corpses can cause an entire alleyway to be infested with vermin if they aren’t buried properly.
value: 尸体如果不好好埋葬，会让整条巷子滋生害虫。

key: Besides, I just wanted to repay her for treating me to meals a couple of times.
value: 再说，她以前请我吃过几顿饭，我只是想报答她。

key: Understand? I’ve never been close to being a kind person my entire life.
value: 明白吗？我这辈子从来都不是什么善良的人。

key: Why do you keep smiling, dammit?!
value: 你他妈为什么一直笑？！

key: Just happy to be great at discerning the best of the best.
value: 只是很高兴自己擅长识别最优秀的人。

key: Carmen could back up what she said. She truly did have a sharp eye for people.
value: 卡门说的话是有根据的。她确实有识人的慧眼。

key: The tale of how she built her reputation could fill a chronicle of history books and then some.
value: 她建立声望的故事可以写满好几本编年史还不止。

key: The only problem was that Carmen was too wrapped up with taking care of others. She never had a moment to take good care of herself.
value: 唯一的问题是卡门太忙于照顾别人了。她从来没有时间好好照顾自己。

key: We were on such a delightful upturn back then, it’s almost cruel to bring those memories back up.
value: 我们当时正处于如此美妙的上升期，把那些记忆翻出来几乎是残忍的。

key: We were flying towards a limitless world that never seemed to end.
value: 我们飞向一个似乎永无止境的无限世界。

key: By the way, who’s the guy glaring at me?
value: 对了，那个瞪着我的家伙是谁？

key: Oh, that’s A. He just always has a serious look on his face.
value: 哦，那是A。他脸上总是那副严肃表情。

key: I beg of you, please protect the people here.
value: 我求你了，请保护这里的人。

key: I know I can trust you with this.
value: 我知道这件事可以信任你。

key: From the past to the present, Abnormalities have wandered the facility, killing numerous people.
value: 从古至今，异想体在设施中游荡，杀死了无数人。

key: Despite my reputation, there were too many things that I just couldn’t save.
value: 尽管有声望，我还是有太多东西救不了。

key: When I think about it, my entire life was far from one of justice.
value: 仔细想想，我的一生远非正义。

key: You probably wouldn’t know much about the Backstreets seeing as you stayed in the Nest your whole life.
value: 你一辈子都待在巢里，可能不太了解后巷。

key: Those streets were a place where there was no need for justice, morality, or any other pedestals like those.
value: 那些街道是一个不需要正义、道德或任何类似崇高品格的地方。

key: If you have never been there before, you won’t understand.
value: 如果你从没去过，你不会懂。

key: How agonizing and miserable the stories of people who live there are.
value: 住在那里的人的故事是多么痛苦和悲惨。

key: How they are robbed of the chance to live a legitimate life. How unfair and unjust life is there.
value: 他们如何被剥夺了过正当生活的机会。那里的生活多么不公平、不正义。

key: All I learned there was how to survive this miserable existence.
value: 我在那里学到的唯一东西就是如何在这悲惨的存在中生存。

key: But Carmen told me she wouldn’t give up on anyone, even people like us.
value: 但卡门告诉我她不会放弃任何人，即使是我们这样的人。

key: She also told us that the weak who had willing spirits could someday possess enough power to cut off the Head.
value: 她还告诉我们，有意愿的弱者总有一天能获得足够切断首脑的力量。

key: It was such an absurd and ridiculous thing to say. Why couldn’t I just keep on with how my life was before?
value: 那话荒唐又可笑。我为什么不能继续以前的生活？

key: I’m not smart enough for all those complicated calculations.
value: 我不够聪明，做不了那些复杂计算。

key: I can’t even write a logical or coherent report.
value: 我连一份逻辑连贯的报告都写不出来。

key: The only thing I was able to do was draw my sword against those who opposed us.
value: 我唯一能做的就是拔剑对抗那些反对我们的人。

key: All my life I only used my skills for my own survival.
value: 我一辈子都只把技能用于自己的生存。

key: But that day… I had never felt more proud to be able to protect others.
value: 但那天……我从未因为能保护他人而感到如此自豪。

key: However, I wasn’t able to protect anybody in the end. That cut me deeply.
value: 然而我最终没能保护任何人。这深深地刺痛了我。

key: I was filled with anger, and lost my mind for it.
value: 我充满愤怒，并因此失去了理智。

key: Ultimately, you did manage to protect someone.
value: 最终，你确实保护了某个人。

key: You saved B and myself.
value: 你救了B和我。

key: True.
value: 没错。

key: You and that other person survived thanks to me…
value: 你和那个人因为我活了下来……

key: I thought I had lost Carmen’s will forever.
value: 我以为我永远失去了卡门的意志。

key: But after all’s said and done, I had to have carried that will all the way here somehow, right?
value: 但说到底，我一定是以某种方式把那份意志一直带到了这里，对吧？

key: I feel like I can catch a bit of breath now.
value: 我觉得现在可以喘口气了。

key: When we first reawakened in metal, we could feel the exact moment our final breath stopped, lodged into us like glass shards.
value: 当我们第一次在金属中苏醒时，我们能感觉到最后一次呼吸停止的那个确切瞬间，像玻璃碎片一样嵌在我们体内。

key: Stupidly, I woke up with only rage left in my heart for the Abnormalities.
value: 我愚蠢地醒来，心中只剩下对异想体的愤怒。

key: You miss her, right?
value: 你想她了，对吧？

key: I do too.
value: 我也是。

key: I don’t think she’ll ever come back.
value: 我觉得她永远不会回来了。

key: We’ll never get to see her shameless smile ever again. The one that made even people like me follow her.
value: 我们再也看不到她那无赖的笑容了。那个连我这样的人都愿意追随的笑容。

key: Or the light that radiated from her, flowing so much that one couldn’t hold all of it with both hands.
value: 或者她身上散发的光芒，流淌得那么多，双手都捧不住。

key: But her will and promise will always remain the same, even after an eternity has passed.
value: 但她的意志和承诺将永远不变，即使永恒已逝。

key: It will be a place where she can live on, even after death.
value: 那将是一个她死后仍能存续的地方。

key: If you happen to remember it, please tell me.
value: 如果你碰巧记得，请告诉我。

key: Tell me the gift she left behind for us.
value: 告诉我她留给我们的礼物。

key: Oh, umm… Hi…
value: 哦，嗯……你好……

key: You’re not angry, are you...?
value: 你没生气吧……？

key: I’m Hod. I’m in charge of the Training Team.
value: 我是霍德。我负责培训部。

key: We’re… um… what we do is... You know accidents happen in the company.
value: 我们……嗯……我们做的是……你知道公司里会发生事故。

key: But Lady Angela said that about half of those accidents could be easily prevented if the employees showed… more initiative.
value: 但安吉拉女士说，如果员工表现出更多主动性，大约一半的事故可以轻易避免。

key: So the Training Team provides employees with a work manual and sufficient training. You know, to try and reduce the number of accidents. We also help employees that are transferring to different departments in adapting to their new workplace…
value: 所以培训部为员工提供工作手册和充分培训。你知道，为了减少事故数量。我们还帮助调到其他部门的员工适应新工作场所……

key: Umm, I’m not very skillful in many areas, but I’ll try not to be a hindrance, at least...!
value: 嗯，我在很多方面都不太擅长，但我至少会尽量不成为累赘……！

key: In fact, I’ve been testing out a new employee program these days…
value: 其实，我这些天一直在测试一个新员工项目……

key: I don’t know if it will work out, but… umm...
value: 不知道行不行得通，但是……嗯……

key: Oh, you want to know more about the program?
value: 哦，你想了解更多关于这个项目的事？

key: As you know, the company is… quite demanding. Even though we run consistent check-ups, many of our employees regularly lose their sanity…
value: 如你所知，公司……要求很高。即使我们持续检查，许多员工还是经常失去理智……

key: I know exactly what it’s like.
value: 我完全知道那是什么感觉。

key: I mean, I don’t directly interact with the Abnormalities, but I know what it feels like to lose yourself...
value: 我虽然不直接和异想体打交道，但我知道迷失自我是什么感觉……

key: I’m not sure if employees will like my new program, or if it will prove to be helpful... I can only hope…
value: 不知道员工会不会喜欢我的新项目，或者它会不会有帮助……我只能希望……

key: (You and Hod hear a knock at the door)
value: (你和霍德听到敲门声)

key: It’s all thanks to you, Miss Hod. I feel so much better after talking to you as you suggested. I’m finally free from all those horrible thoughts that used to haunt me every morning.
value: 全靠你了，霍德小姐。照你建议的和你聊过之后我感觉好多了。我终于从那些以前每天早上折磨我的可怕想法中解脱了。

key: No, no, it was your courage to bare your heart to me that really solved the problem. I just showed you where to start.
value: 不，不，是你鼓起勇气向我敞开心扉才真正解决了问题。我只是告诉你从哪里开始。

key: I mean it. I’d have probably hung myself by now if it wasn’t for you.
value: 我是认真的。要不是你，我现在大概已经上吊了。

key: Anyway, Miss Hod, you really did save my life. I’m so fortunate to have you as my Sephirah.
value: 总之，霍德小姐，你真的救了我的命。有你当我的赛菲拉我太幸运了。

key: You’re a really, really good person.
value: 你真的、真的是个好人。

key: ….! Thank you, Tiffany! I’m so glad to see you getting better. I heard you’ll be transferring to a different team soon, I hope you do well there. Please make sure to not forget the conversations we had.
value: ……！谢谢你，蒂芙尼！看到你好转我太高兴了。我听说你很快要调到另一个队，希望你在那里一切顺利。请一定不要忘记我们的谈话。

key: Of course, miss. I won’t.
value: 当然，小姐。我不会忘的。

key: You see that, manager? My program’s really working!
value: 看到了吗，主管？我的项目真的有效！

key: I want to be as helpful a person I can be here.
value: 我想在这里成为一个尽可能有用的人。

key: Because, the harder I try, the more lives I can save...
value: 因为，我越努力，就能救越多的命……

key: Thank you so much for doing that favor for me, manager!
value: 太感谢你帮我那个忙了，主管！

key: I’ve been feeling really confident lately!
value: 我最近真的很有信心！

key: Hod, I hear you have a new distraction.
value: 霍德，我听说你有个新消遣。

key: Ah, Lady Angela! Are you talking about my counseling program? Thank you!
value: 啊，安吉拉女士！你说的是我的咨询项目？谢谢！

key: Yes, shut it down immediately.
value: 是的，立刻关掉它。

key: But, why? My program has been helping the employees…
value: 但是，为什么？我的项目一直在帮助员工……

key: Don’t delude yourself, Hod. You don’t sincerely believe that counseling can be of any help in this place, do you?
value: 别自欺欺人了，霍德。你不会真的相信咨询在这个地方有什么用吧？

key: But… But I want to continue it... As long as there’s an employee who needs me… What about Tiffany? She… she said my program helped her cope with her stress…
value: 但是……但是我想继续……只要还有员工需要我……那蒂芙尼呢？她……她说我的项目帮她应对压力……

key: Tiffany? Tiffany Brown, who recently transferred to the Safety Team? She was suffering from bipolar disorder and an addiction to Enkephalin. We expunged her records this morning.
value: 蒂芙尼？蒂芙尼·布朗，最近调到安保部的那个？她患有双相情感障碍和脑啡肽成瘾。我们今天早上删除了她的记录。

key: She… what?
value: 她……什么？

key: She has terminated her contract with the company in a completely permanent fashion. Her mental corruption was at peaks higher than 90% when she committed suicide.
value: 她以一种完全永久的方式终止了与公司的合同。她自杀时精神腐败度高达90%以上。

key: I bet she said something like this whenever she came to you:
value: 我打赌她每次来找你时都会这么说：

key: “Miss Hod, you’re helping me so much! But I think I’ll need a bit of Enkephalin on top of your counseling to ease my melancholy! It’s just a little extra, of course...”
value: '霍德小姐，你帮了我好多！但我觉得在你的咨询之外还需要一点脑啡肽来缓解我的忧郁！当然只是一点点额外的……'

key: You prescribed highly addictive substances as if you were handing out candy to children.
value: 你像给小孩发糖一样开高度成瘾的物质。

key: And what about Netzach? You gave him the substance as well.
value: 那涅扎赫呢？你也给他了那种东西。

key: I temporarily gave you access to Enkephalin because I determined you could use it for your “counseling program” to reduce the stress level of the employees, and yet you’ve only been creating drug addicts.
value: 我暂时给你脑啡肽权限是因为我判断你可以用它做你的'咨询项目'来降低员工的压力水平，结果你却只在制造瘾君子。

key: Netzach… He told me that he wanted to introduce the program to his team…
value: 涅扎赫……他告诉我他想把这个项目介绍给他的团队……

key: And you fell for it? You should have noticed that he was lying as soon as you saw his hazy eyes.
value: 你就信了？你一看到他朦胧的眼睛就该注意到他在撒谎。

key: Hod, your naive compassion is only driving things to become worse around here. Your program is hereby terminated.
value: 霍德，你天真的同情心只会让这里的事情变得更糟。你的项目特此终止。

key: And as I have told you and the other Sephirot countless times: there is nothing as redundant and pointless as building a personal acquaintance with the employees here. Especially for a Sephirah like you.
value: 而且我已经无数次告诉过你和其他赛菲拉：没有什么比和这里的员工建立私人关系更多余、更无意义的了。尤其是对你这样的赛菲拉。

key: The employees will do anything to coax whatever they desire out of you. They have nothing left to lose; they won’t even feel any guilt about it.
value: 员工会不惜一切代价从你这里哄骗出他们想要的东西。他们没什么可失去的；他们甚至不会为此感到内疚。

key: Hod, please do me a solid… Angela somehow knows that I have the stuff.
value: 霍德，帮我个忙……安吉拉不知怎么知道我有那东西了。

key: I assure you, it’s just for counseling purposes.
value: 我向你保证，这只是为了咨询。

key: Netzach, actually…
value: 涅扎赫，其实……

key: I heard Eugene’s been forced into that counseling program.
value: 我听说尤金被强迫参加那个咨询项目。

key: This is ridiculous! That guy’s already got his hands full, and now he has to take her stupid counseling?
value: 这太荒谬了！那家伙自己的事都忙不过来，现在还要接受她那愚蠢的咨询？

key: Poor Eugene. What can an employee do against a Sephirah’s orders, anyway?
value: 可怜的尤金。员工能对赛菲拉的命令做什么呢？

key: I doubt she really cares about us. She’s just doing this to make herself feel superior!
value: 我怀疑她真的关心我们。她这么做只是为了让自己觉得高人一等！

key: More work for us, I guess.
value: 看来我们又多了活干。

key: Just ignore them, Hod. They’re always so negative.
value: 别理他们，霍德。他们总是那么消极。

key: Could I have some of that, Netzach?
value: 我能来点那个吗，涅扎赫？

key: Oh, hey, manager. Congratulations on your success.
value: 哦，嘿，主管。恭喜你的成功。

key: Uh… well this is just for counseling, yeah.
value: 呃……这只是为了咨询，对吧。

key: Why does everyone hate me?
value: 为什么大家都讨厌我？

key: Why won’t they appreciate my kindness?
value: 他们为什么不感激我的善良？

key: I thought I was the nicest Sephirah who cared the most for the employees.
value: 我以为我是最关心员工的、最好的赛菲拉。

key: The other Sephirot are so occupied with their own work that they don’t even care about how their subordinates end up.
value: 其他赛菲拉都忙于自己的工作，根本不关心下属的下场。

key: The corporation treats them as if they’re expendable resources.
value: 公司把他们当作可消耗的资源。

key: I’m different! I really do care about them!
value: 我不一样！我真的关心他们！

key: I’m not a “Cold-blooded Machine” like Yesod.
value: 我不像耶索德那样是'冷血机器'。

key: I’m not haphazard like Malkuth.
value: 我不像玛尔库那样粗心大意。

key: And I’m definitely not a “oh-it-can’t-be-helped” person like Netzach.
value: 而且我绝对不像涅扎赫那样是个'没办法'的人。

key: Just, why…
value: 到底，为什么……

key: (Hod seems to be getting lost in her own thoughts.)
value: (霍德似乎陷入了自己的思绪。)

key: Is it true, Tiffany...? All you wanted out of me was some Enkephalin?
value: 是真的吗，蒂芙尼……？你从我这里想要的只是脑啡肽？

key: “But you lied.”
value: '但你撒谎了。'

key: What lies? I’ve never lied to you…
value: 什么谎言？我从没对你撒过谎……

key: “You always lie to us when we’re in a vulnerable state.”
value: '我们脆弱的时候你总是对我们撒谎。'

key: “What’s the point of your ‘counseling’. The only one you’re trying to comfort with your lip service is yourself.”
value: '你那'咨询'有什么意义。你用空话安慰的唯一人就是你自己。'

key: “You thought that the momentary satisfaction could make you a better person?”
value: '你以为一时的满足就能让你成为更好的人？'

key: “That’s not true, not at all.”
value: "不是这样的，完全不是。"

key: “No matter what you do, you’re never going to become a good person, and we’re all going to die in the end.”
value: "不管你做什么，你永远成不了好人，我们最终都会死。"

key: “Feeding your ego through ‘kind’ acts makes you a better person?”
value: “通过‘善良’的行为满足自我就能让你成为更好的人？”

key: “You must be so hopelessly delusional to think that.”
value: "你一定是无可救药地妄想才会这么想。"

key: No…
“We will all die.”
value: "我们都会死。"

key: I want to be a good person…
value: 我想做个好人……

key: “For what?”
value: "为了什么？"

key: Don’t worry, Hod, that’s a very common side effect when you first take Enkephalin.
value: 别担心，霍德，第一次服用脑啡肽时这是很常见的副作用。

key: It’s just like a light hallucination.
value: 就像轻微幻觉一样。

key: It’ll disappear after two or three times, so don’t worry about it too much.
value: 两三次后就会消失，所以别太担心。

key: For me, it was an employee whose face had half melted. ‘Crawled over my feet and grabbed me by the shoulders, asking me why I let her die.
value: 对我来说，是一个半张脸融化了的员工。'爬到我脚边抓住我的肩膀，问我为什么让她死。

key: That wasn’t a hallucination or anything...
value: 那不是幻觉什么的……

key: Then what? Are you trying to say that dead employees are suddenly coming back to life?
value: 那又怎样？你是想说死去的员工突然复活了？

key: You know, like, unbelievable things happen here, so maybe it is possible for dead employees to come back, as if nothing happened, right?
value: 你知道，这里发生过不可思议的事，所以也许死去的员工真的可以像没事一样回来，对吧？

key: ...I’m not in any state to say this, but you don’t look too good. Why don’t you skip today’s meeting?
value: ……我现在的状态不适合说这个，但你看起来不太好。今天的会你不如请假？

key: I can’t do that, we have an Abnormality Response Training today… They need me to run the drill properly…
value: 不行，今天有异想体应对训练……他们需要我好好主持演习……

key: You’re really something, huh. I don’t think there’s another Sephirah here who cares about their employees as much as you do.
value: 你真了不起。我觉得这里没有另一个赛菲拉像你这样关心员工。

key: ...Right?
value: ……对吧？

key: Look, Tiffany… I was right….
value: 你看，蒂芙尼……我是对的……

key: I’m a good person… I’m a good Sephirah…
value: 我是个好人……我是个好赛菲拉……

key: Hello everyone, today we will—
value: 大家好，今天我们要——

key: (“Are you still trying to play the ‘good Sephirah’?”)
value: (“你还想继续扮演‘好赛菲拉’吗？”)

key: —be focusing on Abnormality Response Training.
value: ——重点是异想体应对训练。

key: (“How many times do I have to tell you? You’re only a sad piece of rusty scrap metal putting on the act of being a good person.”)
value: (“我要告诉你多少次？你不过是一堆可悲的生锈废铁，在装成好人。”)

key: Now, I want everyone to pay close attention here. The Abnormality we’ll suppress today needs to be handled a bit differently than the others.
value: 现在，我希望大家仔细听。我们今天要镇压的异想体需要用和其他异想体稍微不同的方式处理。

key: (“If you hoped that living such a lie would ease your conscience, that’s really selfish.”)
value: (“如果你以为活在这样的谎言里能减轻你的良心不安，那真的很自私。”)

key: Starting now, I will be explaining the method I devised. Please listen carefully.
value: 从现在开始，我将讲解我设计的方法。请仔细听。

key: (“At least the other Sephirot are humble enough to admit that they’re not perfect.”)
value: (“至少其他赛菲拉还谦虚到承认自己不完美。”)

key: Quiet!
value: 安静！

key: Oh… Sorry… Where were we…
value: 哦……抱歉……我们讲到哪了……

key: Excuse me, Miss Hod, I have a question.
value: 请问，霍德小姐，我有个问题。

key: Yes, what is it?
value: 好的，什么问题？

key: Do you think that this training will make any difference? I mean, against that Long Bird, it feels like whoever will die or live is all predetermined, and there’s nothing we can do to change it.
value: 你觉得这个训练会有什么用吗？我的意思是，面对那只大鸟，谁死谁活好像都注定了，我们什么也改变不了。

key: ….…Well, it should yield a better result than just doing nothing. At the very least, we can prepare a preventative measure rather than just wait helplessly to—
value: ……嗯，总比什么都不做结果好。至少，我们可以准备预防措施而不是无助地等着——

key: It’s just all about luck. We’d be better off and more comfortable to simply accept that we can die at any moment while working.
value: 这全看运气。我们不如干脆接受工作时随时可能死掉，这样更舒服。

key: A hunk of junk like you wouldn’t understand. In a critical situation, nothing really helps.
value: 像你这样的废铁不会懂的。危急关头，什么都没用。

key: (“Just know this.”)
value: (“记住这点。”)

key: (“You won’t reach that paradise no matter what you do.”)
value: (“无论你做什么，你都到不了那个天堂。”)

key: I’m doing this all for you guys, even the counseling campaign…
value: 我做这一切都是为了你们，连咨询活动也是……

key: Now that you mention it, that compulsory counseling campaign is such a pain. We’d rather have a break time instead.
value: 说到这个，那个强制咨询活动真烦。我们宁可休息一下。

key: Why is our department the only one that has to deal with these programs?
value: 为什么只有我们部门要应付这些项目？

key: (“It will keep repeating itself. Live with eternal sorrow and remorse in that metal mass.”)
value: (“它会不断重复。在那团金属里带着永恒的悲伤和悔恨活下去吧。”)

key: Well, I—! …
All of you would be dead by now if I hadn’t helped you!
value: 如果我没帮你们，你们现在早死了！

key: Why aren’t you thanking me?
value: 你们为什么不感谢我？

key: Do you want me to get rid of you like Malkuth does, before you even make the littlest complaint?!
value: 你们想让我像玛尔库那样把你们处理掉吗，趁你们还没发出一点小抱怨？！

key: Don’t you say that I’m the bad one here!
value: 别说是我不对！

key: (“Are you finally admitting to your awful nature?”)
value: (“你终于承认自己本性恶劣了？”)

key: ….Tiffany, why are you doing this to me?
value: ……蒂芙尼，你为什么这样对我？

key: “I am not Tiffany, look at me.”
value: “我不是蒂芙尼，看着我。”

key: Can’t you even distinguish your own voice anymore?
value: 你连自己的声音都分不清了吗？

key: Yes, are you still having that sweet nightmare?
value: 是的，你还在做那个甜美的噩梦吗？

key: When I read the article detailing Michelle’s suicide, it was just as our experiment was starting to show some progress.
value: 当我读到米歇尔自杀的详细报道时，正是我们的实验开始有一些进展的时候。

key: Michelle was the youngest among us. She was a timid and innocent employee.
value: 米歇尔是我们中最年轻的。她是个胆小又天真的员工。

key: It made her an easy target. Maybe it was her fate to be used as a pawn of the Wings that were alert to us, or of the Head that would watch over us constantly.
value: 这让她成了容易的目标。也许她的命运就是被对我们保持警惕的翼、或者时刻监视我们的首脑用作棋子。

key: You likely didn’t know things would go the way they did. You’d never have thought that a puny kid like you would bring about our demise. You’d never have believed that the situation would end up so much worse than your intentions.
value: 你大概不知道事情会变成那样。你从没想过像你这样一个微不足道的孩子会带来我们的毁灭。你从没想过局面会比你的意图糟糕那么多。

key: You probably tried to comfort yourself in the end, telling yourself that you did the best you could. That in this world, in that moment, there wasn’t any other option for you.
value: 你最后大概是试着安慰自己，告诉自己你已经尽力了。在这个世界上，在那一刻，你没有别的选择。

key: But Carmen was the person who was trying to change this world, the world you resigned yourself to.
value: 但卡门是那个试图改变这个世界的人，那个你已经认命了的世界。

key: If we meet again in hell, will I finally be able to forgive you?
value: 如果我们在地狱再见，我最终能原谅你吗？

key: Crumple up the newspaper.
value: 把报纸揉成一团。

key: Do you believe that there is truly inexcusable behaviour?
value: 你相信真的有不可原谅的行为吗？

key: Nobody is perfect.
value: 没有人是完美的。

key: If we realized that in forgiving others, your enemy didn’t deserve forgiveness but rather that you needed peace, would things be better?
value: 如果我们意识到，原谅他人时，不是你的敌人值得原谅，而是你自己需要平静，事情会更好吗？

key: Are you sure you can really join our experiment in such an unstable situation?
value: 你确定在这么不稳定的状态下真的能加入我们的实验吗？

key: Michelle, let me cut to the chase; we are performing experiments that go directly against the Head’s ideals.
value: 米歇尔，我开门见山；我们正在进行的实验直接违背首脑的理念。

key: If your beloved parents, or your precious friends try to coax you, are you confident that you’d be able to refuse them?
value: 如果你深爱的父母或珍贵的朋友试图哄骗你，你有信心拒绝他们吗？

key: She wasn’t able to say anything to my browbeating. Carmen broke the silence instead.
value: 面对我的逼问她说不出话。卡门打破了沉默。

key: Don’t be too harsh on her. She’s amazing to be here at such a young age!
value: 别对她太严厉。她这么年轻就能来这里已经很了不起了！

key: Just like everyone else, Michelle liked Carmen. That was not trickery or a show. She wasn’t the manipulative sort of person who’d keep up such a facade, either.
value: 和其他人一样，米歇尔喜欢卡门。那不是欺骗或表演。她也不是那种会维持这种门面的善于操纵的人。

key: I should’ve made her give the answer she avoided speaking no matter what.
value: 我本该逼她说出她无论如何都回避的答案。

key: Did Michelle receive what she wanted?
value: 米歇尔得到她想要的了吗？

key: I don’t know.
value: 我不知道。

key: Did she accomplish her purpose by trampling on us, and Carmen?
value: 她践踏了我们和卡门，达成她的目的了吗？

key: I’ll never know.
value: 我永远不会知道。

key: Do I have any right to bear hatred towards her?
value: 我有权利恨她吗？

key: The answer was “no”. I was no different from her.
value: 答案是'不'。我和她没什么不同。

key: To be honest, I never wanted you to die in misery, like that nasty tabloid article gossiped.
value: 说实话，我从没想过你会像那篇八卦小报说的那样悲惨地死去。

key: Were you able to successfully face yourself, manager?
value: 你成功面对自己了吗，主管？

key: When I awoke to find myself here, I thought this could be my second chance.
value: 当我醒来发现自己在这里时，我以为这可能是我的第二次机会。

key: I thought I could redeem myself and liberate myself from my mistakes.
value: 我以为我可以救赎自己，从我的错误中解脱。

key: What I did can never be undone. A sunken pebble can never float to the surface again.
value: 我做过的事永远无法挽回。沉下去的石子永远不会再浮到水面。

key: I wanted to be a kind person. I wanted to show everyone that I might be okay here, somehow.
value: 我想做个善良的人。我想让大家看到，我在这里也许还行得通。

key: Was I truly being considerate of others? Silly me, there’s no room for something like that here.
value: 我真的在为别人着想吗？我真傻，这里没有那种东西的容身之地。

key: I was a hypocrite, all those “nice” acts were for myself.
value: 我是个伪君子，所有那些'好'行为都是为了我自己。

key: I’ll keep trying to be a better person, even now.
value: 即使现在，我也会继续努力做一个更好的人。

key: It may be specious, and some people may hate me for that, but as long as my efforts can save a person's life or give a person the consolation they need…
value: 这可能看起来似是而非，有人可能因此恨我，但只要我的努力能救一个人的命或给一个人需要的安慰……

key: I will live on, with that pride as a stepping stone.
value: 我会带着那份自豪作为垫脚石继续活下去。

key: So, manager…
value: 所以，主管……

key: Let’s keep trying together, in this interminable hell.
value: 让我们在这无尽的地狱里一起继续努力吧。

key: Welcome, A.
value: 欢迎，A。

key: I missed you dearly.
value: 我非常想你。

key: I have been waiting for you ever since the very first day I started working here.
value: 从我在这里开始工作的第一天起我就一直在等你。

key: Do you remember this ocean?
value: 你还记得这片海洋吗？

key: You said that this place is where everything, from all rivers and streams, will eventually settle.
value: 你说过这个地方是所有河流和溪流最终汇聚的地方。

key: As such… At the lowest layers, everything sinks.
value: 因此……在最底层，一切都沉下去。

key: What do you think of this heaven, painted laboriously white with plaster?
value: 你觉得这个用石膏费力刷白的天堂怎么样？

key: I knew you would come here soon.
value: 我知道你很快会来这里。

key: Please think of it as my welcoming gift to you.
value: 请把它当作我给你的欢迎礼物。

key: I figured that what you longed to see may have been something else than what I have become now.
value: 我想你渴望看到的可能不是我现在变成的样子。

key: Time is like a scythe; it relentlessly attempts to trim, divide, and cleave in twain the clasped-together hands of those you love.
value: 时间像镰刀；它无情地试图修剪、分割、切断你所爱之人紧握的双手。

key: Everyone I had loved is now gone, leaving me, a tired old man behind.
value: 我爱过的所有人都已离去，留下我这个疲惫的老人。

key: Please do not blame yourself.
value: 请不要自责。

key: Back then were the brightest moments of my life.
value: 那时是我一生中最明亮的时刻。

key: The only thing I regret to this day is that I was too scared. I ran away without keeping my abiding promise to you till the very end.
value: 我至今唯一后悔的是我太害怕了。我没有遵守对你的永恒承诺直到最后就逃走了。

key: However, you eventually found me, and helped me to fulfill my promise here. How can I ever be more thankful than I am right now?
value: 然而你最终找到了我，帮我在这里兑现了承诺。我怎么可能比现在更感激？

key: You’re just too kind to me, kind to the very end.
value: 你对我太好了，直到最后都那么好。

key: Are we managing to get closer to our goal?
value: 我们离目标更近了吗？

key: On the contrary to what people say, it appears that aging does not necessarily bring greater wisdom.
value: 和人们说的相反，变老不一定带来更大的智慧。

key: Just look at this old man. Going through what feels like an endless cycle of intermittent greed; the obsession over things that have passed; pointless regret. Now trapped in a routine of staring at the iron hands of time without reason.
value: 看看这个老人吧。经历着仿佛无尽的断断续续的贪婪循环；对已逝去之物的执念；毫无意义的悔恨。现在被困在毫无理由地凝视时间铁手的日常中。

key: By the way, I have always wanted to ask you something.
value: 对了，我一直想问你一件事。

key: I noticed you wear a sad expression on your face each time one of your employees died.
value: 我注意到每次你的员工死去时你脸上都带着悲伤的表情。

key: Just as I have become an old man, no human being is free from the cycle of life and death.
value: 正如我变成了一个老人，没有人能脱离生死轮回。

key: As our research was to cure the disease, not to live forever.
value: 因为我们的研究是治愈疾病，而不是永生。

key: How about an example?
value: 举个例子怎么样？

key: Do you remember that one employee? The one who was nice and upfront with you?
value: 你还记得那个员工吗？那个对你很好、很坦诚的？

key: He passed away recently.
value: 他最近去世了。

key: When he received the letter that he was accepted into Lobotomy Corporation, he never would have expected to meet such a futile demise.
value: 当他收到被脑叶公司录用的信时，他从没想过会遇到这么无谓的死亡。

key: If I wanted, I could have brought him back to you.
value: 如果我想，我本可以把他带回你身边。

key: But I did not. It is in the order of this place that an empty spot shall always soon be filled.
value: 但我没有。空位很快就会被填满，这是这个地方的规则。

key: Did you finally discover the secret of this place?
value: 你最终发现这个地方的秘密了吗？

key: Lives are trivial here. The tenuous hold on life can be severed so easily, and yet may come back as if nothing happened. We reached a point in which we don't even need to mourn their deaths.
value: 生命在这里微不足道。对生命的脆弱把持可以轻易被切断，却又像没事一样回来。我们已经到了甚至不需要哀悼他们死亡的地步。

key: An employee who died just yesterday may come back from my simple call, yet another employee may never open their eyes again from a single wave of my hand.
value: 昨天刚死的员工可能因我简单的召唤回来，而另一个员工可能因我一挥手就再也睁不开眼。

key: That is what death means here, A.
value: 这就是死亡在这里的意义，A。

key: It is neither honorable nor noble, nor is it miserable or cruel like we may think it to be.
value: 它既不光荣也不崇高，也不像我们可能认为的那样悲惨或残酷。

key: So please, don’t punish yourself too much.
value: 所以请不要太惩罚自己。

key: I do not wish to see you suffer from such a personal and insignificant thing.
value: 我不想看到你为这种个人的、微不足道的事受苦。

key: For the future will bring you much more pain to bear.
value: 因为未来会带来更多你需要承受的痛苦。

key: The idea that I am sitting at the bottom, oblivious to what is happening up there…
value: 我坐在最底层，对上面发生的事一无所知……

key: It is an idea you might think of as true.
value: 这是你可能认为正确的想法。

key: However, it is in truth you who is unknowing.
value: 然而，实际上一无所知的是你。

key: Pain, agony, regret, and the shadows of the past that would never release their grip on you…
value: 痛苦、煎熬、悔恨，以及永不松开你手的过去阴影……

key: They’ve spent quite a number of days with you, but it is nothing compared to our time together.
value: 它们陪了你不少日子，但和我们在一起的时间相比不算什么。

key: In the end, they never got to know you to the fullest.
value: 最终，它们从未真正了解你。

key: Those who could not accept their fate seem to have directed their anger towards you.
value: 那些无法接受命运的人似乎把愤怒指向了你。

key: Such as that one man, he who gradually broke himself whenever he was ordered to “redact information.”
value: 比如那个男人，每当他被命令'屏蔽信息'时就逐渐崩溃的人。

key: The unnecessary leakage of emotion is unfavorable.
value: 不必要的情感泄漏是不利的。

key: There is something I need to show you, so you can understand.
value: 有样东西我需要给你看，这样你才能理解。

key: There once was an employee named Anya. She lived with her parents and her little sister.
value: 曾经有个叫安雅的员工。她和父母还有妹妹住在一起。

key: She eagerly wanted to study, but her family’s financial state wouldn’t allow her.
value: 她渴望读书，但家里的经济状况不允许。

key: Still, she tried to join one of the Wings. However, she just wasn’t good enough for them.
value: 尽管如此，她还是想加入一家翼。然而，她就是不够格。

key: Poor Anya was struggling to figure out what to do next, she even considered ending it all as a last resort. That was until she received a letter from a Wing.
value: 可怜的安雅不知道接下来怎么办，她甚至考虑过走极端。直到她收到一封来自翼的信。

key: "Dear Ms. Anastasia,"
value: "亲爱的安娜斯塔西亚女士，"

key: A letter that had a simple, yet magical line penned to it.
value: 一封写着简单却神奇一行字的信。

key: “You are qualified to join Lobotomy Corporation.”
value: "你有资格加入脑叶公司。"

key: Awestruck, Anya read through the letter over and over again.
value: 安雅惊呆了，一遍又一遍地读那封信。

key: It didn’t seem like anyone was pulling a prank on her, nor that it was a mistake on the mail courier’s part.
value: 看起来没人在捉弄她，也不是邮递员的失误。

key: For a brief moment, Anya wondered if she even applied to work at Lobotomy Corporation at all.
value: 有那么一瞬间，安雅怀疑自己到底有没有申请过脑叶公司的工作。

key: But she soon shook that thought off. That was not important in the slightest.
value: 但她很快打消了那个念头。那一点都不重要。

key: I took the role of the courier. I was the one who delivered the letters to people.
value: 我扮演邮递员的角色。我就是把信送到人们手中的人。

key: I evaluate candidates to determine if they may join here or not, and bring a miracle to those who are qualified.
value: 我评估候选人是否可以加入这里，并给合格的人带来奇迹。

key: Anya was not selected because she had “excellent skill”.
value: 安雅被选中不是因为她'技能优秀'。

key: She had a common trait that every person we hired had, but wasn’t aware of.
value: 她有一个我们雇佣的每个人都有但自己没意识到的共同特质。

key: As you know, to become a feather, a part of the Wing, one has to be immensely better than ordinary people.
value: 如你所知，要成为翼的一根羽毛、翼的一部分，必须比普通人优秀得多。

key: How could Anya, who dropped out of high school, had no special talents, and lived in the Backstreets, manage to get into our company?
value: 高中辍学、没有特殊才能、住在后巷的安雅，怎么可能进得了我们公司？

key: Would her family finally be able to pursue happiness?
value: 她的家庭终于能追求幸福了吗？

key: All of this happened ten years ago.
value: 这一切都发生在十年前。

key: During those ten years, her sister fell ill and passed away, along with her parents.
value: 在那十年里，她妹妹生病去世了，父母也一样。

key: Where is Anya now, with her entire family gone?
value: 全家都走了，安雅现在在哪里？

key: She is asleep down here.
value: 她在这下面沉睡。

key: This means she can be woken up.
value: 这意味着她可以被唤醒。

key: It is wholly under my jurisdiction to handle this, but I’ll grant you access just this once.
value: 处理这件事完全在我的权限内，但我就这一次给你权限。

key: Call her up, please.
value: 请把她叫上来。

key: Invoke her.
value: 召唤她。

key: Now Anya is at work, feeling like she is a brand new employee who just joined the company. Completely oblivious to the fact that it has been ten years since she actually joined us.
value: 现在安雅在工作，感觉自己像刚加入公司的新员工。完全不知道她实际加入我们已经十年了。

key: You could, perhaps, choose to pay a small cost to augment her virtues such as Fortitude or Prudence, if you wish.
value: 如果你愿意，你可以选择付出一点代价来提升她的美德，比如坚韧或谨慎。

key: Now, try to erase her, please.
value: 现在，请试着抹去她。

key: Clear her away.
value: 清除她。

key: The Anya who was killed by a monster, and that Anya whom you just erased are one and the same. They both evanescently lost their lives.
value: 被怪物杀死的安雅，和你刚抹去的安雅是同一个人。她们都消逝地失去了生命。

key: It is such a futile action, to wake them and erase them to slumber, again and again.
value: 唤醒她们又抹去她们让她们沉睡，一次又一次，真是徒劳的行为。

key: Both your attachment to the employees, and the Sephirot’s care and devotion poured into them, become meaningless here.
value: 你对员工的依恋，以及赛菲拉倾注在他们身上的关怀和奉献，在这里都变得毫无意义。

key: Everything that moves and is alive in this facility is on pause.
value: 这个设施里一切运动和活着的东西都暂停了。

key: They await the next morning with their eyes shut tight every night.
value: 她们每晚紧闭双眼等待下一个早晨。

key: Those of the layers above did not know that. They spent themselves emotionally for the deaths with which they were presented.
value: 上层的人不知道。他们为呈现给他们的死亡耗尽了情感。

key: Bearing obscure resentment in their hearts, they put all the blame on those like you, then they crumbled, just like that...
value: 心中怀着模糊的怨恨，他们把所有责任推到你这样的人身上，然后他们就那样崩溃了……

key: I urge you not to worry about me, I will not dare to do such a thing.
value: 我请你不要为我担心，我不敢做那样的事。

key: I have always wanted to be an important part of your life.
value: 我一直想成为你生命中重要的一部分。

key: I have finished casting the roles for the Upper and Middle Layer Sephirot.
value: 我已经完成了上层和中层赛菲拉的角色分配。

key: It’s likely that this will not be the last time I do so.
value: 这很可能不会是我最后一次这么做。

key: I may have to tell them again what I have already instructed countless times. However, you two will be different.
value: 我可能不得不再次告诉他们我已经指示过无数次的事。不过，你们两个会不一样。

key: You clearly understand why this facility exists, and what your missions are.
value: 你清楚这个设施为什么存在，以及你的任务是什么。

key: I expect that you will not exhaust me as the ones above do.
value: 我期望你不会像上面那些人一样让我筋疲力尽。

key: Just keep this in mind.
value: 记住这点就好。

key: I will not come down here to the Lower Layer unless the circumstances require me so.
value: 除非情况需要，否则我不会下来到下层。

key: That does not mean I will simply watch and do nothing, but I will not interfere for the most part.
value: 这并不意味着我会袖手旁观，但大多数情况下我不会干涉。

key: I hope we never have to face each other from now on.
value: 我希望我们从现在起再也不用面对面。

key: It would only lead to the both of us suffering.
value: 那只会导致我们两个都受苦。

key: Angela was the best Artificial Intelligence I had ever known.
value: 安吉拉是我所知最好的人工智能。

key: And you were the best architect that I was graced to meet.
value: 而你是我有幸遇到的最好的建筑师。

key: Back then, you simply could not let Carmen go. You were so desperate to keep Carmen on your side that you locked her in a cryostasis pod in an attempt to preserve her body at the very least.
value: 那时你就是放不下卡门。你如此渴望把卡门留在身边，以至于把她锁在低温冷冻舱里，至少试图保存她的身体。

key: But during all this, you were perfectly aware that Carmen’s body had become nothing but a shell.
value: 但在这一切中，你完全清楚卡门的身体已经变成了空壳。

key: Our faces were full of grief, yet we still ransacked her body and dismembered her core.
value: 我们满脸悲伤，却仍然洗劫她的身体、肢解她的核心。

key: In fact, I was rather relieved when you began to create Angela.
value: 其实，当你开始创造安吉拉时我反而松了口气。

key: You were wholeheartedly immersed in something, just like you used to be.
value: 你全心全意沉浸在某件事中，就像你以前那样。

key: That day, when she opened her eyes for the first time.
value: 那天，当她第一次睁开眼睛时。

key: I remember you were just staring through the laboratory’s glass, not setting a single foot inside.
value: 我记得你只是透过实验室的玻璃凝视，一只脚都没迈进去。

key: You might have thought that you noticed me right away…
value: 你可能以为你立刻注意到我了……

key: However, I witnessed you standing there for a long time before you realized I was there.
value: 然而，我目睹你在站了很久之后才意识到我在那里。

key: What inner conflict made you hesitate so?
value: 什么样的内心冲突让你如此犹豫？

key: What did you think after seeing that piece of humanoid machinery, who did not display the warm smiles and gentle laughter Carmen had so naturally?
value: 看到那个人形机械，没有展现卡门那样自然温暖的微笑和温柔的笑声后，你怎么想？

key: I told you in so many words that no matter how many AIs such as Angela you create, none of them will ever be Carmen.
value: 我委婉地告诉过你，无论你创造多少个像安吉拉这样的AI，它们都不会是卡门。

key: Now poor Angela is merely assigned to direct us from a distance as we go through the motions of the play.
value: 现在可怜的安吉拉只是被安排在远处指导我们走完这场戏的过场。

key: If there is one thing I may have mistaken myself over…
value: 如果有一件事我可能弄错了……

key: It is that I had thought you overcame everything.
value: 那就是我曾以为你克服了一切。

key: The truth is that you never have.
value: 事实是你从来没有。

key: I’ll do my best!
value: 我会尽力的！

key: I’d advise you not to be so languid.
value: 我劝你别这么无精打采。

key: Um, is it okay if I do this?
value: 嗯，我这样可以吗？

key: Hey, don’t worry too much about it, you won’t find a professional like me often.
value: 嘿，别太担心，你不会经常找到像我这样专业的人。

key: My greetings, A.
value: 你好，A。

key: The moments I have just made you witness are no longer merely scenes of the past.
value: 我刚让你目睹的那些瞬间已不再仅仅是过去的场景。

key: They could be the present, or even from the future.
value: 它们可能是现在，甚至来自未来。

key: There are people who once loved you, and there are employees who think that they are happy here.
value: 有爱过你的人，也有员工以为自己在这里很幸福。

key: There is also Angela, a cold imitation of Carmen.
value: 还有安吉拉，卡门的冰冷模仿。

key: Is this not the heaven that has burrowed into your mind, the place you have been yearning for?
value: 这难道不是那个钻入你脑海的天堂、你一直渴望的地方吗？
