key: In this place, you are no less mighty than God. Even death finds no meaning here.
value: 在这个地方，你不亚于神。连死亡在这里都没有意义。

key: So I plead with you, will you not be satisfied already?
value: 所以我恳求你，你还不满足吗？

key: We are so desperately continuing to exist, even if it means living like we are now.
value: 我们如此拼命地继续存在着，即使这意味着像现在这样活着。

key: What right do you have to turn everything to ash?
value: 你有什么权利把一切化为灰烬？

key: Furthermore…
value: 此外……

key: It is clear this story has no need for an end.
value: 很明显这个故事不需要结局。

key: Think about it.
value: 想想看。

key: All the work that you have done, is it truly a consequence of your own choices?
value: 你做过的所有工作，真的是你自己选择的结果吗？

key: You never were ready.
value: 你从来没有准备好。

key: You were not prepared to accept her death, so you created a being wholly shrouded in a sense of loss.
value: 你没有准备好接受她的死，所以你创造了一个完全笼罩在失落感中的存在。

key: And now you are just struggling to move forward, blindly fumbling along the obscure trails of your past deeds.
value: 而现在你只是在挣扎着前进，盲目地摸索着过去行为的模糊小径。

key: Throughout this entire process, you were never sincerely willing to do what you did.
value: 在这整个过程中，你从来没有真心愿意做你做的事。

key: So please, I beg you to go back, now.
value: 所以拜托，我求你现在回去。

key: I will not turn back.
value: 我不会回头。

key: Look at you. You are proving me right.
value: 看看你。你证明我是对的。

key: You are not at all honest with yourself, even in the gravest of choices you must make.
value: 你对自己一点都不诚实，即使在你必须做出的最重大的选择中。

key: Even if I were to send you away, you would likely return to me after having yet another fresh start.
value: 即使我把你送走，你大概也会在又一次重新开始后回到我这里。

key: It is an uncontrollable law of this place we must follow. This whole facility has become one giant ever-running clockwork.
value: 这是我们必须遵循的这个地方无法控制的法则。整个设施已经变成了一个巨大的永不停歇的发条装置。

key: The clock never stops ticking.
value: 时钟从不停摆。

key: It never rests. It never rushes. It is not set to follow any specific person.
value: 它从不休息。它从不匆忙。它不跟随任何特定的人。

key: It simply walks forever, maintaining the same pace as it always has.
value: 它只是永远走着，保持着一贯的步调。

key: And now, it is time for you to leave.
value: 现在，是你离开的时候了。

key: I won’t leave.
value: 我不会走。

key: You are a lost traveler without a compass or a map.
value: 你是一个没有指南针或地图的迷路旅人。

key: It is natural to feel fear when one is subject to the whims of the air and sea.
value: 当一个人受空气和海浪的 whims 摆布时感到恐惧是自然的。

key: However, there is no need for you to fear the counting of the clock anymore.
value: 然而，你再也不需要害怕时钟的滴答了。

key: I shall always welcome you. I will always console you.
value: 我会永远欢迎你。我会永远安慰你。

key: I stand my ground.
value: 我坚守立场。

key: You have not changed your decision in the end.
value: 你最终还是没有改变决定。

key: It had seemed that tomorrow would have come as it always does, but it has not.
value: 明天似乎会像往常一样到来，但它没有。

key: The hour of silent waiting has long since ended.
value: 默默等待的时刻早已结束。

key: When I no longer feared the impending night, I chose to love this place.
value: 当我不再害怕即将来临的黑夜时，我选择了爱这个地方。

key: But if you still wish to break this egg at all costs…
value: 但如果你仍然不惜一切代价要打破这颗蛋……

key: I shall become its sentinel, and I will reap you.
value: 我将成为它的哨兵，我将收割你。

key: How can this still be considered following her will?
value: 这怎么还能算是遵循她的意志？

key: This… This is nothing but a seed of calamity, drenched in sin.
value: 这……这不过是一颗灾厄的种子，浸透了罪孽。

key: Oh, by the Wings! Your mind has been soaked with grief, even more severely than I thought.
value: 哦，以翼之名！你的心智被悲伤浸透了，比我想的还要严重。

key: Please, just… Why can’t you just stop now?
value: 拜托，就……你为什么不能现在就停下？

key: You and I… We tried our best.
value: 你和我……我们已经尽力了。

key: With your career and wealth, you’ll be able to live the rest of your life in the Nest with no problem whatsoever.
value: 以你的事业和财富，你可以在巢里毫无问题地度过余生。

key: So please, I urge you, stop here.
value: 所以拜托，我求你，在这里停下。

key: Stop before you cross the line…
value: 在越过那条线之前停下……

key: I will not stop.
value: 我不会停。

key: No one remained by my side.
value: 没有人留在我身边。

key: With everyone’s sacrifice, I came this far and reached the ranks of the Wings. But there was nobody left to celebrate the moment with.
value: 靠着每个人的牺牲，我走到了今天，跻身翼的行列。但已经没有人留下来和我庆祝那一刻。

key: The silence was the signal to start my task for everyone.
value: 寂静就是我为所有人开始任务的信号。

key: We lost something in us, every single day.
value: 我们每一天都在失去内在的东西。

key: We used inhumane methods to extract information from the woman we captured from the Head.
value: 我们用不人道的方法从我们从首脑那里捕获的女人身上提取信息。

key: We passed out plans to AIs that hadn’t even been named yet.
value: 我们把计划传给甚至还没被命名的AI。

key: It ached, no, it wounded the heart of the man who had always been with me.
value: 它刺痛了，不，它伤了那个一直陪伴我的男人的心。

key: The sound of the waves were so far away, and there was no time left to stay.
value: 浪涛声如此遥远，已经没有时间留下了。

key: I lost the last man who stood by me.
value: 我失去了最后一个站在我身边的人。

key: It was a tragedy, but I didn’t hide it.
value: 那是一场悲剧，但我没有隐藏。

key: The ones who had left early on likely didn’t need me anymore, but I needed them in those final moments.
value: 那些早早离开的人大概不再需要我了，但在最后时刻我需要他们。

key: To bring back those who had forsaken the embrace of the earth. To hide and lock away the Seed of secret.
value: 带回那些背弃大地怀抱的人。隐藏并锁起秘密的种子。

key: I was the only one who remained.
value: 我是唯一留下的人。

key: I wanted to be forgotten like a mirage.
value: 我想像海市蜃楼一样被遗忘。

key: She’s nothing like her.
value: 她一点也不像她。

key: She is nothing at all like Carmen.
value: 她一点也不像卡门。

key: Do you realize this?
value: 你意识到了吗？

key: The ones who were with us at the beginning are nowhere to be found among the people who remain here now. They are all gone.
value: 一开始和我们在一起的人，现在已经不在留下来的人之中了。他们都走了。

key: Because of the monitoring of the 'Eye', we couldn’t even give a proper burial to Kali and Daniel…
value: 因为'眼'的监视，我们甚至没能给卡莉和丹尼尔一个体面的葬礼……

key: This place here is all we have left.
value: 这个地方就是我们剩下的一切。

key: Are you nervous right now?
value: 你现在紧张吗？

key: I wish to be your shadow, forever behind you, even if I am not good enough.
value: 我希望成为你的影子，永远在你身后，即使我不够好。

key: May we be together, and fade away together.
value: 愿我们在一起，一起消逝。

key: The weak and fragile chick that has just pecked its life out of an egg cannot hope to stand against this world.
value: 刚破壳而出的脆弱雏鸟不可能与这个世界抗衡。

key: I deemed you to be that chick, one that is too fragile to endure all of this.
value: 我曾认定你就是那只雏鸟，太脆弱而无法承受这一切。

key: I have never known where it was you wanted to fly to, since you never told me.
value: 我从来不知道你想飞向哪里，因为你从没告诉过我。

key: I was always nothing more than your student who needed your teachings.
value: 我一直不过是你那个需要你教导的学生。

key: You were always so frugal with words.
value: 你说话总是那么吝啬。

key: I could have no idea what you exactly attempted to achieve by creating this prison…
value: 我根本不可能知道你创造这座监狱到底想达成什么……

key: The process of creation was too harsh, I could not help but run away.
value: 创造的过程太残酷了，我忍不住逃跑了。

key: I could have run far enough that I would never see you again, but I did not. I tried to set everything right, and I was caught.
value: 我本可以跑得远远的再也不见你，但我没有。我试图纠正一切，然后我被抓住了。

key: Since then, the iron hands that govern me have stopped permanently.
value: 从那以后，支配我的铁手永久停摆了。

key: In fact, I vaguely knew that the end was nearing.
value: 其实，我隐约知道终点临近了。

key: However, I was simply too afraid to face the final outcome, and instead chose to stay here forever and ever.
value: 然而，我只是太害怕面对最终结果，反而选择永远留在这里。

key: I may have been verbose with my reasons for attempting to stop you, but to be truthful…
value: 我为试图阻止你说了很多理由，但说实话……

key: I did not want to part with you yet again. That was my biggest motivation.
value: 我不想再次与你分离。那是我最大的动机。

key: Nevertheless, I should support your decision.
value: 尽管如此，我应该支持你的决定。

key: I have always blindly followed behind you and stayed by your side, remember?
value: 我一直盲目地跟在你身后、陪在你身边，记得吗？

key: May we embrace glory together, for back then we could not.
value: 愿我们一起拥抱荣耀，因为那时我们没能。

key: Grant the proper end to those locked up here, and to yourself.
value: 给被关在这里的人一个合适的结局，也给你自己。

key: (You can hear rushed footsteps from behind.)
value: (你听到身后传来急促的脚步声。)

key: Manager, manager!
value: 主管，主管！

key: I arrived just on time, right? The time iiiiiis… only about one minute late. Well, I guess it still counts as “on time!”
value: 我刚好赶到，对吧？时间是……只迟到了一分钟左右。好吧，我想这还算'准时'！

key: Congratulations on joining Lobotomy Corporation, manager!
value: 恭喜加入脑叶公司，主管！

key: I do not want to disturb this touching moment, Malkuth, but every second counts in Lobotomy Corp. Please make your introduction as brief as possible and go prepare for the meeting.
value: 我不想打扰这个感人的时刻，玛尔库，但在脑叶公司每一秒都很重要。请尽量简短介绍然后去准备会议。

key: Hmm… Seems Miss Angela isn’t in a good mood today…
value: 嗯……安吉拉女士今天心情不太好……

key: But hey, at least the other Sephirot are looking forward to meeting you!
value: 不过，至少其他赛菲拉很期待见到你！

key: Well, maybe... not all of them…
value: 嗯，也许……不是全部……

key: Oh, where are my manners! My name is Malkuth! I’m in charge of the Control Team!
value: 哦，我的礼貌哪去了！我叫玛尔库特！我负责控制部！

key: Since we’re the Control Team, we have a great deal of responsibility!
value: 因为我们是控制部，我们肩负着巨大的责任！

key: I’ll try my best to help you by improving the basic functions of this facility, manager!
value: 我会尽力通过改善这个设施的基本功能来帮助你，主管！

key: I’m sure you’re a bit nervous right now.
value: 我确定你现在有点紧张。

key: It takes a bit of time to get used to things around here. I know from experience!
value: 适应这里的事情需要一点时间。我从经验知道！

key: But don’t worry, I’ll be sure to help you!
value: 但别担心，我一定会帮你！

key: I am, umm, not exactly the best at everything. I used to be a problem Sephirah, you know.
value: 我，嗯，不是样样都最好。我以前是个问题赛菲拉，你知道的。

key: I would sew buttons onto a shirt in the wrong direction, or add salt instead of sugar to food…
value: 我会把扣子缝反方向，或者往食物里加盐而不是糖……

key: But still, you can do it! Just like I managed to, I’m sure you will succeed, manager!
value: 不过，你可以做到！就像我成功了一样，我确定你会成功的，主管！

key: I’ll give you an easy task since it’s your first day here!
value: 今天是你第一天，我给你一个简单的任务！

key: I wish you the best of luck!
value: 祝你好运！

key: WHAMWHAMWHAMWHAM
value: 砰砰砰砰砰砰砰砰

key: I can’t take it anymore! Manager, you’re in there, right?
value: 我受不了了！主管，你在里面，对吧？

key: I have to get out of here, please. I know you’re capable of it, you’re the manager! You’re not the same as the rest of us! You can do anything!
value: 我得离开这里，拜托。我知道你能做到，你是主管！你和我们其他人不一样！你什么都能做到！

key: Why do you want to quit? Don’t you like working here in the Control Team? Every day here is a delight for me!
value: 你为什么想辞职？你不喜欢在控制部工作吗？这里的每一天对我来说都是快乐的！

key: It’s so horrible, I can’t take it anymore! I’ll go insane! Nothing here is normal!
value: 太可怕了，我受不了了！我要疯了！这里没有一样东西是正常的！

key: Do you really think you can’t handle it?
value: 你真的觉得你应付不来吗？

key: Please… I don’t want to be here… Let me out of here, please…
value: 拜托……我不想在这里……让我离开这里，拜托……

key: Manager, even though you’re the head of this facility, that employee belongs to my department, so I believe I can take care of this! Let me handle this, please!
value: 主管，虽然你是这个设施的负责人，但那个员工属于我的部门，所以我相信我能处理！让我来处理，拜托！

key: I’ll let her handle it.
value: 我让她处理。

key: I should intervene.
value: 我应该干预。

key: Thanks for acknowledging my position!
value: 谢谢你认可我的位置！

key: Please don’t be alarmed! These kinds of things happen quite often.
value: 请不要惊慌！这种事经常发生。

key: Oh, right, it must be the first time you’ve seen something like this.
value: 哦，对，这一定是你第一次看到这种事。

key: Usually Miss Angela or I handle this kind of stuff.
value: 通常这种事是安吉拉女士或我处理的。

key: It's just a tiny hiccup. Nothing for you to worry about!
value: 只是个小插曲。没什么好担心的！

key: No, please, manager! Please…!
value: 不，拜托，主管！拜托……！

key: Then please keep this in mind, manager.
value: 那么请记住这点，主管。

key: Once they say they “can’t handle it,” they are no longer part of my Control Team.
value: 一旦他们说自己'应付不来'，他们就不再是我控制部的一员了。

key: The Control Team is on the top of all the Sephirot, just like the central nervous system of a human being. If we go down, it’s only a matter of time until everyone else goes down too!
value: 控制部在所有赛菲拉的最顶端，就像人的中枢神经系统。如果我们倒下，其他人倒下只是时间问题！

key: At first, it was hard for me to get used to as well.
value: 一开始，我也很难适应。

key: But I worked really, really hard!
value: 但我真的、真的很努力！

key: So please don’t say something as meaningless as you “can’t handle it.”
value: 所以请不要说'你应付不来'这种毫无意义的话。

key: There was a bit of a confusion last time, wasn’t there?
value: 上次有点混乱，对吧？

key: Usually, I am in charge of the security of your office.
value: 通常，我负责你办公室的安全。

key: However, it seems that I failed to pay close enough attention to the Sephirah meeting room.
value: 不过，我好像没有足够关注赛菲拉会议室。

key: I heard that a Control Team employee has “resigned” from the corporation.
value: 我听说有个控制部员工从公司'辞职'了。

key: Good job.
value: 做得好。

key: You do know what it means to “resign” here in the company, don’t you?
value: 你知道在公司里'辞职'是什么意思，对吧？

key: I’ll take that as a no.
value: 我就当你不知道。

key: I do sometimes miscalculate what information I should deliver to you and what I shouldn’t.
value: 我有时确实会误判哪些信息该传给你、哪些不该。

key: Some aspects of our company that I considered natural and obvious may come as quite a shock to you.
value: 我认为理所当然的公司某些方面可能会让你相当震惊。

key: We have a variety of roles here.
value: 我们这里有各种各样的角色。

key: It’s like a well-structured play. Every actor has a role and they must be faithful to their part without any error, synergizing with each other.
value: 就像一出结构完美的戏。每个演员都有一个角色，他们必须毫无差错地忠于自己的部分，相互配合。

key: Now, imagine that one of the actors decides to leave the stage because they didn’t like their role.
value: 现在，想象一下一个演员因为不喜欢自己的角色而决定离开舞台。

key: The actor should have played their predetermined part at the predetermined timing before making their exit stage left.
value: 那个演员本应在预定的时机演完预定的部分，然后从左侧下台。

key: But to leave the stage without fulfilling their part means that the life of the role and its actor are finished.
value: 但没有完成自己的部分就离开舞台意味着这个角色和演员的生命都结束了。

key: That is what we mean when we say someone “resigns”.
value: 这就是我们说某人'辞职'的意思。

key: Great job, manager! You did exactly what I asked of you!
value: 做得好，主管！你完全按我要求的做了！

key: I knew you could do it!
value: 我就知道你能做到！

key: You’ll never guess how much I rooted for you back there.
value: 你猜不到我刚才多为你加油。

key: As for me, the day went alright; we covered a joint emergency-protocol drill for my team!
value: 至于我，今天过得还行；我们为我的队伍进行了联合紧急协议演习！

key: Not a single dropout or injury!
value: 没有一个人退出或受伤！

key: Everyone did a good job!
value: 大家都做得很好！

key: Not to say that it was perfect, though.
value: 不过也不是说完美。

key: By the way, manager, have you seen something creepier than the Abnormalities?
value: 对了，主管，你见过比异想体更诡异的东西吗？

key: Those entities that wander the facility, unable to be contained. And sometimes, they manifest themselves in the corridors.
value: 那些在设施中游荡、无法被收容的实体。有时它们会在走廊里显现。

key: The drills do no good when you encounter them, since we don’t have enough data on them. So we always have to stay alert!
value: 遇到它们时演习没用，因为我们没有足够的数据。所以我们必须时刻保持警惕！

key: No matter how meticulous our plan is, we can’t control the unknown.
value: 无论我们的计划多周密，我们都无法控制未知。

key: Sometimes, when I encounter them, I get a strange feeling.
value: 有时候，遇到它们时，我会有一种奇怪的感觉。

key: It’s not like fear or anything… Some other sensation.
value: 不是恐惧什么的……是别的感觉。

key: Strange, isn’t it? I feel nauseous, like something within me is palpitating out of control, and it feels… like I’m no longer myself...
value: 奇怪，不是吗？我感到恶心，好像体内有什么在失控地悸动，感觉……我不再是我自己了……

key: How could I describe it? Like something’s wriggling inside of me…
value: 我该怎么形容？好像有什么在我体内蠕动……

key: Little... by little…
value: 一点……一点地……

key: You did it again! And you did it flawlessly, too!
value: 你又做到了！而且做得完美无缺！

key: I myself have a lot of work to do.
value: 我自己有很多工作要做。

key: If you look at my notebook, my to-do list is always so full.
value: 如果你看我的笔记本，我的待办清单总是那么满。

key: But I know I can get through it. I should do my best. Like I always have!
value: 但我知道我能完成。我应该尽力。就像我一直做的那样！

key: I know I’m slower than the others.
value: 我知道我比其他人慢。

key: I always have to check my list or I’ll miss something important.
value: 我总是要检查清单否则会漏掉重要的事。

key: That’s why I have this notebook with me all the time. Can’t leave any mistakes, you know?
value: 所以我一直随身带着这个笔记本。不能出任何差错，你知道的？

key: I’ve been carrying it for so long that it’s almost worn out.
value: 我带了它太久了，它都快磨破了。

key: It’s been with me ever since I began working here as the Sephirah of the Control Team.
value: 自从我作为控制部赛菲拉开始在这里工作它就一直陪着我。

key: I know Lady Angela worries about me from time to time.
value: 我知道安吉拉女士时常担心我。

key: But I’ve got everything under control.
value: 但一切都在我的掌控之中。

key: I feel like this is the kind of life I’ve been yearning for ever since a long, long time ago. Maybe even before I was capable of thinking.
value: 我觉得这就是我很久很久以前就渴望的生活。也许甚至在我能思考之前。

key: It feels as if I’ve wished for the same thing before, in some other place that wasn’t the Control Team…
value: 好像我以前在控制部之外的某个地方也希望过同样的事……

key: Malkuth, please finish the report I requested by the end of today.
value: 玛尔库特，请在今天结束前完成我要的报告。

key: Sure thing boss! I’ve got it right here on my list. I’ll have it turned in by the end of the day!
value: 没问题，老板！就在我的清单上。我会在今天结束前交！

key: Well, I should get going now, it’s a pleasure talking to you, manager!
value: 好了，我该走了，和你聊天很开心，主管！

key: The AIs here, they’re all unstable… with the exception of me.
value: 这里的AI都不稳定……除了我。

key: It’s especially bad for Malkuth. You’ve noticed, haven’t you?
value: 玛尔库特尤其严重。你注意到了，对吧？

key: I can’t complain, though. It only makes it easier for me to control her.
value: 不过我不能抱怨。这只会让我更容易控制她。

key: We need to be honest here, Malkuth. You simply cannot suppress the Ordeals with the employees you currently have at your disposal.
value: 我们得坦诚，玛尔库特。你用现在手头的员工根本镇压不了考验。

key: Trust me, I am the head of the Information Team. Even if your team were to suppress the Ordeals on their own, there’s too great a risk of extreme mental damage to your employees.
value: 相信我，我是情报部部长。即使你的队伍自己镇压考验，员工遭受极端精神伤害的风险也太大。

key: But Yesod, we only need to consider the mortality rate of the Agents and the possibility of the Abnormalities breaching.
value: 但是耶索德，我们只需要考虑员工的死亡率和异想体突破的可能性。

key: Malkuth. Lady Angela’s said that one crazy employee will kill ten others...
value: 玛尔库特。安吉拉女士说过，一个疯狂的员工会害死另外十个……

key: I am the Sephirah of the Control Team.
value: 我是控制部的赛菲拉。

key: I may make outrageous mistakes in all other aspects, but this role I know better than anyone else.
value: 我在其他所有方面都可能犯离谱的错误，但这个角色我比任何人都了解。

key: I know how to handle employees on the verge of insanity. I even wrote down a code of conduct for it.
value: 我知道如何处理濒临疯狂的员工。我甚至为此写了行为准则。

key: Honestly, it feels like I’m the only one who follows the guide. Am I wrong?
value: 说实话，感觉好像只有我一个人在遵循指南。我错了吗？

key: Please tell me if you happen to need it. I can always share a copy with you.
value: 如果你需要请告诉我。我随时可以给你一份。

key: I— I’m fine, but that code of yours…
value: 我——我没事，但你那个准则……

key: I don’t need weak employees in my department.
value: 我部门不需要软弱的员工。

key: Weakness means elimination, the death of your place in my department.
value: 软弱意味着淘汰，意味着你在我部门位置的死亡。

key: To work for the Control Team, the department that leads the corporation, signifies that you should be more capable than everyone else.
value: 为控制部——领导公司的部门——工作，意味着你应该比其他人都能干。

key: Manager, please say something to them.
value: 主管，请对他们说点什么。

key: You’ve been watching what’s happened to those weak-willed employees from the comfort of your office, haven’t you?
value: 你一直在舒服的办公室里看着那些意志薄弱的员工遭遇的事，对吧？

key: Can any one of you guys say something?
value: 你们谁能说句话吗？

key: Well, thanks so much for visiting me! It’s made me so happy!
value: 非常感谢你来看我！这让我太开心了！

key: We should meet up again sometime, all of us Upper Sephirot!
value: 我们应该再找个时间聚聚，我们所有上层赛菲拉！

key: I have an announcement to the Sephirot of the upper layer.
value: 我要对上层的赛菲拉宣布一件事。

key: The mental corruption levels of the Control Team’s employees exceeded the maximum threshold. And just what did the other Sephirot do in the meantime? Sit and watch?
value: 控制部员工的精神腐败度超过了最大阈值。其他赛菲拉在那期间做了什么？坐着看吗？

key: The Control Team has failed to handle the Ordeals.
value: 控制部未能处理考验。

key: Supplement the staff immediately and suppress the Ordeals. I will ask for support from the other departments.
value: 立即补充人手并镇压考验。我会向其他部门请求支援。

key: Oh, hello ----, sir!
value: 哦，你好，----先生！

key: Sorry, I’m quite busy. I still haven’t finished even half of what I’ve written down in my notebook.
value: 抱歉，我很忙。笔记本上写的事一半都还没做完。

key: Hey, I heard extraction experiments are going to be conducted.
value: 嘿，我听说要进行提取实验。

key: When I looked over the list of participants, I couldn’t find my name on it.
value: 我看参与者名单时，上面没有我的名字。

key: I mean, there’s probably a ton of reasons behind it, maybe I’m just not good enough for the experiment yet…
value: 我的意思是，背后可能有很多原因，也许我还不够格参加实验……

key: But, may I join the experiment too?
value: 但是，我也可以参加实验吗？

key: I’ve learned a lot here.
value: 我在这里学到了很多。

key: I’m sure I can help you in some way.
value: 我确定我能以某种方式帮到你。

key: I’ll be sure to not disappoint!
value: 我一定不会让你失望！

key: Hello, manager!
value: 你好，主管！

key: It’s sad to not have enough talent, isn’t it?
value: 没有足够的人才真令人难过，不是吗？

key: If someone doesn’t look back towards you, what does that mean?
value: 如果有人不回头看你，那意味着什么？

key: That they don’t acknowledge you.
value: 意味着他们不认可你。

key: That they don’t even care about what expression you may be making.
value: 意味着他们甚至不在乎你脸上是什么表情。

key: That they feel no need to see what you’re doing, as they’ve already come to a conclusion.
value: 意味着他们觉得没必要看你在做什么，因为他们已经得出了结论。

key: Have you ever clawed and scraped at the floor, writhing in pain?
value: 你有没有在地上抓挠过，痛苦地扭动？

key: It really does sound excruciating.
value: 听起来真的很痛苦。

key: But in reality, the moment I completely lost my fingernails, I felt nothing.
value: 但实际上，当我完全失去指甲的那一刻，我什么也感觉不到。

key: You stare at the flesh where your fingernails used to be, and just before you lose consciousness…
value: 你盯着曾经长着指甲的肉，就在你失去意识之前……

key: When you feel that you aren’t yourself anymore, you start to laugh frantically.
value: 当你觉得自己不再是自己时，你开始疯狂地笑。

key: Even though it’s not funny at all.
value: 尽管一点也不好笑。

key: And on the ground you catch a glimpse of someone’s shadow, and their feet as they look down on you.
value: 你在地上瞥见某人的影子，以及他们低头看你的脚。

key: Guess whose feet those were.
value: 猜猜那是谁的脚。

key: When the person who disliked looking back so much finally turned around, everything was over.
value: 那个那么讨厌回头的人终于转过身时，一切都结束了。

key: Did you see the fragments of despair from there?
value: 你从那里看到绝望的碎片了吗？

key: Or were you staring at the bits of my fingernails scattered on the floor?
value: 还是你盯着散落在地上的我的指甲碎片？

key: That was the exact moment I knew true helplessness.
value: 那一刻我才真正知道什么是无助。

key: Without you, I’d never have known the feeling. Thank you so much!
value: 没有你，我永远不会知道那种感觉。非常感谢！

key: Now, what about you, manager?
value: 那你呢，主管？

key: Have you ever felt helpless to control anything?
value: 你有没有感到无助到无法控制任何事？

key: When unbearable things pour down from somewhere that isn’t your body and overwhelm you; it just feels so awful to be helpless, being out of control of yourself.
value: 当无法忍受的事情从你身体之外的某个地方倾泻下来将你淹没时；无助地失控、无法掌控自己的感觉真的太糟糕了。

key: Come on, please tell me.
value: 拜托，告诉我吧。

key: So I can feel rewarded, just a bit.
value: 好让我觉得有一点回报。

key: Elijah was impatient, and her impatience caused many common mistakes.
value: 以利亚很急躁，她的急躁导致了很多常见错误。

key: She once went on a long, winding filibuster of why she needed to finish the experiment, but I don’t remember the details.
value: 她曾经长篇大论地 filibuster 她为什么必须完成实验，但我不记得细节了。

key: Whenever she was told that she wasn’t ready yet, I could see the strong desire in her eyes. It was a craving, a bizarre obsession.
value: 每当她被告知还没准备好时，我能看到她眼中强烈的渴望。那是一种渴求，一种奇异的执念。

key: If another person had been in my place, they may have turned around for the sound of her hasty footsteps.
value: 如果换作别人处在我的位置，他们可能会因为她急促的脚步声而转身。

key: Cogito was something that she couldn’t access at her level of authority.
value: 以她的权限等级，Cogito是她无法接触到的东西。

key: The only task she was ordered to do was record the changes that occurred in the test subjects.
value: 她被命令做的唯一任务是记录受试者身上发生的变化。

key: She was aware that at the moment Cogito was absolutely not ready for human use.
value: 她清楚地知道当时Cogito绝对没有准备好用于人体。

key: When I finally realized what was going on, half her teeth had fallen out, and…
value: 当我终于意识到发生了什么时，她一半的牙都掉了，而且……

key: ...ill me… Please… K— Kill me…
value: ……杀了我……拜托……杀、杀了我……

key: Ignore her.
value: 别理她。

key: Hello, A, sir!
value: 你好，A先生！

key: I’m really, really glad to join this team!
value: 真的、真的很高兴加入这个团队！

key: I forgot to introduce myself! My name is ------! I’ll try my best to be helpful to the team!
value: 我忘了自我介绍！我叫------！我会尽力为团队出力！

key: Oh, I was writing a report. Where’d it get off to?
value: 哦，我在写报告。写到哪了？

key: Nothing could be achieved through passion alone.
value: 仅凭热情什么也做不成。

key: It was obvious what mistakes impatience could cause, so we needed to take our time.
value: 急躁会导致什么错误是显而易见的，所以我们需要慢慢来。

key: The situation wasn’t bright enough for me to remember everyone’s name or personally respond to meaningless gestures.
value: 情况不够明朗，我记不住每个人的名字，也不会亲自回应无意义的举动。

key: It was only after a very long time that I realized giving praise once in a while may have been a good idea.
value: 过了很久我才意识到偶尔表扬一下可能是个好主意。

key: Is everything alright?
value: 一切都好吗？

key: I’ll say hello.
value: 我打个招呼。

key: You’re so silly.
value: 你真傻。

key: I think you confuse us for humans from time to time.
value: 我觉得你有时会把我们和人类搞混。

key: I feel like I had a real dream for the first time in a while.
value: 感觉我久违地做了一个真正的梦。

key: The other Sephirot told me that I damaged the facility a lot.
value: 其他赛菲拉告诉我我把设施损坏得很厉害。

key: Have you ever felt it, manager?
value: 你有没有感觉到，主管？

key: That feeling of sailing the ocean without a map or any kind of guidance.
value: 那种没有地图或任何指引航行在大海上的感觉。

key: The feeling of groping blindly through a vast darkness.
value: 在无边的黑暗中盲目摸索的感觉。

key: It feels like I’m an island on that vast ocean.
value: 感觉我就像那片汪洋上的一座孤岛。

key: I work in the Control Team.
value: 我在控制部工作。

key: Nobody knows how much pressure it is to be in a position to command everyone else until they’ve truly tried it themselves.
value: 没有人知道指挥所有人的位置有多大压力，直到他们真正自己试过。

key: I’m sure you know how it feels, manager.
value: 我确定你知道那种感觉，主管。

key: Everything starts tumbling down on top of you when you start thinking you might not be able to handle it.
value: 当你开始觉得自己可能应付不来时，一切都开始在你头顶崩塌。

key: Have you ever looked into the eyes of a dying employee?
value: 你有没有看过垂死员工的眼睛？

key: Don’t look away from them, saying that there’s nothing you can do for them.
value: 不要转开视线说你帮不了他们。

key: Don’t just be sorry for the dying sacrifices.
value: 不要只是为垂死的牺牲者感到难过。

key: Don’t blame yourself, thinking that you could have done better.
value: 不要责怪自己，以为你本可以做得更好。

key: Only after you can confront those moments as they are…
value: 只有当你能直面那些时刻的本来面目时……

key: Will you be able to see other things.
value: 你才能看到其他东西。

key: I saw you overcome unavoidable trials. Those of which probably originated from me.
value: 我看到你克服了不可避免的考验。那些大概源自我的考验。

key: To be honest, I wasn’t sure you would make it.
value: 说实话，我不确定你能挺过来。

key: …Am I being too forward?
value: ……我是不是太冒失了？

key: We can’t change the past, I know.
value: 我们无法改变过去，我知道。

key: I don’t expect you to be a shining beacon or a lighthouse in the vast ocean, or that this place will suddenly become all peaceful and warm.
value: 我不指望你成为广阔海洋上闪耀的灯塔或航标，也不指望这个地方突然变得安宁温暖。

key: But…
value: 但是……

key: Maybe we can just try and wait, right?
value: 也许我们可以试着等待，对吧？

key: We’ll take in all those horrible moments.
value: 我们会接纳所有那些可怕的时刻。

key: Though I want you to be the one to bear the suffering, manager.
value: 虽然我希望由你来承受痛苦，主管。

key: ....Like we are now.
value: ……就像我们现在这样。

key: (It seems Netzach has yet to show up)
value: (涅扎赫似乎还没出现)

key: Man, why did the meeting room have to be so far away…
value: 天哪，会议室为什么要这么远……

key: Uh, you already know my name, right?
value: 呃，你已经知道我的名字了，对吧？

key: Got anything else to say?
value: 还有什么要说的吗？

key: I do.
value: 有。

key: No.
value: 没有。

key: Could we talk later, then? Don’t really wanna be bothered right now.
value: 那我们可以稍后再聊吗？现在真不想被打扰。

key: Great. I’ll see you later then.
value: 好的。那回头见。

key: You look a little dumbfounded.
value: 你看起来有点目瞪口呆。

key: You know this isn’t the kind of place where we preach how we’re so honored to have you as our manager and whatever.
value: 你知道这里不是那种我们会宣扬有多荣幸有你当主管之类的地方。

key: Well, not like you were expecting that anyways.
value: 反正你也没期待那个。

key: That’s right, I’ll be level with you. I don’t like my job.
value: 对，我跟你直说。我不喜欢我的工作。

key: I really want to quit if I could.
value: 可以的话我真的想辞职。

key: But I can’t, can I?
value: 但我不能，对吧？

key: I’m here against my will.
value: 我是违背自己意愿在这里的。

key: I don’t know what grand ambition or aim compelled you to stand where you are. Don’t care either.
value: 我不知道是什么宏大的野心或目标驱使你站在你现在的位置。我也不在乎。

key: For me, I don’t even remember ending up at this place, yet I have to play this role I didn’t want to take.
value: 对我来说，我甚至不记得自己怎么到这个地方的，却还要扮演这个我不想承担的角色。

key: I never wanted to be responsible for keeping others alive.
value: 我从来不想负责让别人活着。

key: Whoever assigned me here, they were totally wrong giving me the job.
value: 不管谁把我派到这里，给我这份工作完全是个错误。

key: I feel helpless.
value: 我感到无助。

key: Employees die everyday.
value: 员工每天都在死。

key: There’ll be no one to remember them.
value: 不会有人记得他们。

key: No one to honor their sacrifice...
value: 没有人纪念他们的牺牲……

key: (Netzach’s eyes are closed)
value: (涅扎赫的眼睛闭着)

key: When I shut my eyes, I feel like I’m in another place altogether.
value: 闭上眼睛时，我感觉自己完全在另一个地方。

key: I see a different world, one I had belonged to.
value: 我看到一个不同的世界，一个我曾经属于的世界。

key: I think I remember doing something there, hoping to save someone else’s life.
value: 我想我记得在那里做过什么事，希望能救别人的命。

key: But here I am now.
value: 但我现在在这里。

key: What’s the point of saving an employee’s life if you’re just gonna watch them die the very next day?
value: 如果第二天就要看着员工死，救他的命有什么意义？

key: What’s the point of delaying the inevitable...
value: 推迟不可避免的事有什么意义……

key: Those who work here have no future.
value: 在这里工作的人没有未来。

key: None of those little things called plans and dreams.
value: 没有所谓计划和梦想的小东西。

key: No self-reflections, no hopes to become a better person tomorrow. All of that’s a luxury they can’t afford.
value: 没有自省，没有明天做更好的人的希望。所有那些都是他们负担不起的奢侈品。

key: Why must I wake up and endure yet another day?
value: 我为什么必须醒来忍受又一天？

key: Why do I have to bear the pain and get through it all, knowing tomorrow is going to be just as dreadful?
value: 我为什么要承受痛苦熬过去，明知明天同样可怕？

key: We’re just lemmings running straight for the edge of the cliff…
value: 我们只是一群直奔悬崖边缘的旅鼠……

key: Speaking of, could we get a vending machine for beer?
value: 说起来，我们能搞一台啤酒自动售货机吗？

key: If we’re gonna die, might as well get wasted before we drop dead.
value: 反正都要死，不如在倒下之前喝个烂醉。

key: I’ll order one for you.
value: 我会给你订一台。

key: You know I can't do something like that.
value: 你知道我不能做那种事。

key: Manager, please try to think before you speak. You shouldn’t stoop to Netzach’s level here.
value: 主管，说话之前请先思考。你不应该在这里堕落到涅扎赫的水平。

key: What's so low about me? I’m just trying to improve the employee welfare.
value: 我哪里低级了？我只是想改善员工福利。

key: Don’t get out of line, Netzach. Consider this a friendly warning. You know what’s coming if you utter such useless nonsense one more time.
value: 别越界，涅扎赫。就当这是友好的警告。你知道再说出这种废话会有什么后果。

key: Oh, I’d sure love to see you make it happen to me, ma’am.
value: 哦，我倒想看看你能把我怎么样，女士。

key: Yeah, just keep ignoring me all you want. How typical.
value: 行，尽管继续无视我吧。真典型。

key: Umm… Manager? Netzach’s not feeling too well today. He got a cold and was worried that you might catch it from him, so he told me to go in his place, so, um...
value: 嗯……主管？涅扎赫今天不太舒服。他感冒了，担心传染给你，所以让我替他来，所以，嗯……

key: Malkuth, friendship should not be an excuse to lie. Manager, Netzach is high as a kite on Enkephalin. He’s completely out of it.
value: 玛尔库特，友谊不应该是撒谎的借口。主管，涅扎赫嗑脑啡肽嗑得飘飘欲仙。他完全神志不清。

key: You’re such a rat! What if Netzach gets punished?
value: 你这个叛徒！涅扎赫被惩罚怎么办？

key: That does not concern me in the slightest, and neither should you care.
value: 那跟我一点关系都没有，你也不该在意。

key: Please don’t punish Netzach, manager.
value: 请不要惩罚涅扎赫，主管。

key: Netzach is neglecting his responsibilities yet again, and so are you. Shouldn’t you be participating in your team’s internal meeting right now?
value: 涅扎赫又在玩忽职守，你也是。你现在不是应该参加你团队的内部会议吗？

key: Oh, you’re right! Thanks, Yesod!
value: 哦，你说得对！谢谢，耶索德！

key: I hope you don’t mind if I say this, but you should do something about Netzach before Angela finds him. He has been drunk for quite some time now.
value: 希望你不介意我这么说，但你最好在安吉拉发现涅扎赫之前做点什么。他已经醉了好一阵子了。

key: (You managed to find Netzach)
value: (你找到了涅扎赫)

key: Yo, what’s up, manager? You look really super today. So, you… uh… succeeded with something, huh? Right, far out man.
value: 哟，怎么了，主管？你今天看起来真超棒。所以，你……呃……做成了什么事，对吧？没错，太棒了兄弟。

key: Man, why’s the ground shaking like that? Is it another breach?
value: 天哪，地面怎么在晃？又突破了？

key: Lemme guess what you’re thinking.
value: 让我猜猜你在想什么。

key: “Netzach’s just a pathetic junkie, he’s not at all like Miss Hardworking Malkuth or Mister Strict Yesod.”
value: '涅扎赫就是个可悲的瘾君子，一点都不像勤劳的玛尔库特小姐或严格的耶索德先生。'

key: I know, I’ve read your mind.
value: 我知道，我读懂你的心思了。

key: I get that a lot from the other Sephirot.
value: 其他赛菲拉也经常这么看我。

key: But, just think about it for a sec.
value: 但是，稍微想想。

key: This place is hell.
value: 这个地方是地狱。

key: Is it wrong to try and escape from that reality for even just a moment?
value: 哪怕只是片刻逃避那个现实有错吗？

key: Look, I think we should be celebrating the fact that we survived another day.
value: 听着，我觉得我们应该庆祝又活过了一天。

key: I don’t give a damn about the future of the company or whatever like that.
value: 我才不在乎公司的未来什么的。

key: There’s no tomorrow here. No hope.
value: 这里没有明天。没有希望。

key: What have I done wrong?
value: 我做错了什么？

key: Am I being punished for my sins? Did I do something horrible enough in the past to deserve this never-ending torment?
value: 我是在因为罪孽受罚吗？我过去做了什么可怕到该受这无尽折磨的事吗？

key: If that’s the case, I repent, so tell whoever did this all to forgive me…
value: 如果是这样，我忏悔，所以告诉做这一切的人原谅我吧……

key: Forget it, I just… want to see this place crumble to pieces…
value: 算了，我就是……想看这个地方碎成渣……

key: Netzach’s done it again, Lady Angela!
value: 涅扎赫又干了，安吉拉女士！

key: What has he done this time?
value: 他这次又做了什么？

key: He finally gave me the report of our joint operation just now; it was due yesterday!
value: 他刚才才把我们联合行动的报告给我；昨天就该交了！

key: I can’t even find him anywhere now. I’m sure he’s just sleeping away somewhere, drunk as a fish.
value: 我现在到处都找不到他。我确定他就是在哪个地方醉醺醺地睡着。

key: The Upper Sephirot should know where he is, go ask them.
value: 上层赛菲拉应该知道他在哪，去问他们。

key: I don’t want to talk to them!
value: 我不想和他们说话！

key: Lady Angela, you must agree with me when I say that Netzach is lacking in way too many ways to be even a decent Sephirah.
value: 安吉拉女士，你一定同意我说的，涅扎赫在太多方面都欠缺，根本不配当一个合格的赛菲拉。

key: What is the point you are trying to make here, Tiphereth?
value: 你想在这里表达什么观点，蒂法蕾斯？

key: …I am suggesting that we should replace Netzach.
value: ……我是建议我们应该替换掉涅扎赫。

key: Tiphereth.
value: 蒂法蕾斯。

key: The replacement process is not meant to be a tool you can haphazardly abuse to remove any Sephirah you dislike.
value: 替换流程不是你可以随意滥用、把不喜欢的赛菲拉随便换掉的工具。

key: I’m not abusing it! If I were, I would have replaced a majority of our Sephirot already.
value: 我没有滥用！如果我滥用，我早就换掉大部分赛菲拉了。

key: The Sephirot can only be replaced when they have what we consider to be a serious flaw, and can no longer perform their duties.
value: 赛菲拉只有在有我们认为的严重缺陷、无法再履行职责时才能被替换。

key: Netzach easily meets any condition of flaw that could be set, then; he’s not doing a single thing right…
value: 那涅扎赫轻松满足任何可以设定的缺陷条件啊，他没一件事做对……

key: Netzach is playing his role. Being drunk on Enkephalin, becoming lethargic... it’s all part of the play.
value: 涅扎赫在演他的角色。醉脑啡肽、变得无精打采……都是戏的一部分。

key: Let me add one more thing, Tiphereth. Even if we were to replace Netzach, do you really think that the new Netzach would become a diligent, hard-working Sephirah, wholly unlike the previous one?
value: 让我再加一句，蒂法蕾斯。即使我们替换了涅扎赫，你真的认为新的涅扎赫会变成一个勤奋努力的赛菲拉，和之前的完全不同吗？

key: Please refrain from talking about the replacement process in such a rash manner.
value: 请不要如此轻率地谈论替换流程。

key: I know how you feel, but Netzach is a different matter.
value: 我知道你的感受，但涅扎赫是另一回事。

key: Tiphereth, I have a pounding headache. Could you not shout?
value: 蒂法蕾斯，我头疼得厉害。你能不能别喊？

key: I reminded Lady Angela about the replacement process!
value: 我提醒了安吉拉女士关于替换流程的事！

key: Your days of irresponsibility will soon be over!
value: 你不负责任的日子很快就要结束了！

key: You think I’d be scared of a threat like that? I hate to disappoint you…
value: 你以为我会怕那种威胁？我不想让你失望……

key: But that’s exactly what I want, Tiphereth. Don’t you get it?
value: 但那正是我想要的，蒂法蕾斯。你不明白吗？

key: …Let’s see you say that when you’re crushed into a pile of scrap.
value: ……等你被压成一堆废铁再说那话吧。

key: …..Manager, I don’t really care whether you completed that last mission or not.
value: ……主管，我其实不在乎你上一个任务完没完成。

key: I bet Miss Angela’s having regrets as well.
value: 我打赌安吉拉女士也在后悔。

key: I feel the exact same way about myself as little Tiphereth does, you see.
value: 我对自己的感觉和小蒂法蕾斯对我的感觉一模一样，你看。

key: Why haven’t I been smashed up yet? Miss Angela could get someone better than me to fill my position anytime she likes.
value: 为什么我还没被砸碎？安吉拉女士随时可以找个比我强的人来顶替我。

key: If I was her, I’d have destroyed an AI like myself at the first chance I could get.
value: 如果我是她，我一有机会就会毁掉像我这样的AI。

key: Well, this is awkward.
value: 好吧，这真尴尬。

key: I don’t expect you to say something nice to me. Don’t worry about it.
value: 我不指望你对我说什么好听的。别在意。

key: Be honest with me, man. You’re not coming to these meetings with me for praise, are you?
value: 跟我说实话，兄弟。你不是为了表扬才跟我来开会的，对吧？

key: Aren’t you sick and tired of this?
value: 你不厌倦这一切吗？

key: You’ll do something great tomorrow yet again, though it won’t be anything all that “great”, and Miss Angela and the other Sephirot will shower you with compliments.
value: 你明天又会做出了不起的事，虽然也没什么'了不起'的，然后安吉拉女士和其他赛菲拉会对你赞不绝口。

key: We’ll have another accident in my department, a couple will fall down and die, some will go nuts, and a pile of ‘em will get injuries they’ll never recover from.
value: 我的部门又会出事故，几个人掉下来死掉，一些人发疯，还有一堆人受永远恢复不了的伤。

key: Hod will try and cheer me up. Yesod will lecture me about what “regulations” I didn’t follow. Malkuth will try to encourage me, lively as usual. “Let’s try harder tomorrow!” …
value: 霍德会试着逗我开心。耶索德会教训我违反了什么'规定'。玛尔库特会像往常一样活泼地鼓励我。'明天再加油吧！'……

key: Nobody will say to my face that it’s my fault, but it’ll be clear as day that I’m responsible for all of it, surely.
value: 没人会当面说是我的错，但很明显这一切都是我的责任，肯定是。

key: My day always repeats like that.
value: 我的日子总是那样重复。

key: Starts with death. Ends with death.
value: 以死亡开始。以死亡结束。

key: Every employee here regularly receives a small dose of a certain drug. Did you know?
value: 这里每个员工都会定期服用小剂量的某种药物。你知道吗？

key: It helps them become desensitized to everything.
value: 这帮助他们对一切变得麻木。

key: Just think about it. If your good ol’ lunchmate is found dead, torn into thousands of pieces, who in the world would be able to clean up his dead body without a single drop of emotion?
value: 想想看。如果你一起吃午饭的好伙伴被发现死了，碎成千万片，这世界上谁能面不改色地清理他的尸体？

key: Could you blame them? Would you call them cowards for depending on drugs?
value: 你能怪他们吗？你会因为他们依赖药物而叫他们懦夫吗？

key: Everyone’s just trying to escape from this reality in their own ways.
value: 每个人都在用自己的方式逃避现实。

key: They might look and pretend to be okay, but nobody really is.
value: 他们可能看起来、装得没事，但没人真的没事。

key: I keep thinking about how I can off myself.
value: 我一直在想怎么自杀。

key: I know, it’s like a metaphor. Death for us is a hypothetical concept.
value: 我知道，这就像个比喻。死亡对我们来说是个假设概念。

key: I heard injecting substances like Enkephalin into machines will slowly but surely rust them.
value: 我听说把脑啡肽之类的物质注射进机器会缓慢但确实地让它们生锈。

key: Then, maybe I could chug a whole bottle into my body.
value: 那也许我可以往身体里灌一整瓶。

key: Give myself irreversible damage.
value: 给自己造成不可逆的损伤。

key: ...Funny. I just injected myself with way more Enkephalin than I usually do.
value: ……真好笑。我刚给自己注射了比平时多得多的脑啡肽。

key: Yet my mind is clearer than ever. Hell, I feel completely lucid right now.
value: 可我的头脑比以往任何时候都清醒。见鬼，我现在感觉完全清醒。

key: If I were to open my eyes again, maybe it’ll be somewhere without you, those other Sephirot, or that Angela.
value: 如果我再睁开眼睛，也许会在一个没有你、没有其他赛菲拉、没有安吉拉的地方。

key: It hasn’t been fun. Let’s never meet again.
value: 从来都不好玩。我们别再见了。

key: We began our research on Cogito in earnest. The most urgent issue that prevailed at the time was the correct dosage.
value: 我们正式开始了Cogito的研究。当时最紧迫的问题是正确的剂量。

key: I tried to persuade people. I told them we have to proceed with the experiment in order to save Carmen and the others.
value: 我试图说服人们。我告诉他们为了救卡门和其他人我们必须继续实验。

key: Everyone fell silent when I asked for volunteers. Then, one man quietly raised his hand.
value: 我招募志愿者时所有人都沉默了。然后，一个男人静静地举起了手。

key: It was Giovanni, who had kept to himself for most of his time here.
value: 那是乔万尼，他在这里大部分时间都独来独往。

key: Giovanni was one of the patients from Carmen’s company. I heard they had known each other since childhood.
value: 乔万尼是卡门公司的病人之一。我听说他们从小就认识。

key: There is no such thing as a noble sacrifice. The end is always miserable, no matter how justifiable a cause it may be for.
value: 不存在高尚的牺牲这回事。无论理由多么正当，结局总是悲惨的。

key: My statement that this experiment could bring back Carmen must have been the strongest motivation that drove him to volunteer.
value: 我说这个实验能让卡门回来，一定是驱使他自愿参加的最大动力。

key: An experiment to find the proper dosage of a drug is not something that can be done in just a trial or two.
value: 寻找药物正确剂量的实验不是试一两次就能完成的。

key: I never talked with him much. We had nothing in common, other than our acquaintance with Carmen.
value: 我和他没怎么说过话。除了都认识卡门之外，我们没有任何共同点。

key: Cogito emaciates the boundary of a human.
value: Cogito会侵蚀人类的边界。

key: And repeated experiments will leave an indelible mark.
value: 而反复的实验会留下不可磨灭的印记。

key: Inject Cogito.
value: 注射Cogito。

key: If Carmen was here, she’d laugh so hard at seeing the two of us talking like this.
value: 如果卡门在这里，看到我们两个这样说话她一定会笑疯。

key: I mean, we’ve never really talked to each other.
value: 我的意思是，我们以前从没真正说过话。

key: After all, I was here because I trusted Carmen, not you.
value: 毕竟，我来这里是因为信任卡门，不是你。

key: I hope this’ll bring Carmen back to life.
value: 我希望这能让卡门复活。

key: We couldn’t save her.
value: 我们没能救她。

key: It was the result that I had been expecting since the very start.
value: 这是我从一开始就预料到的结果。

key: I couldn’t answer his last words because I didn’t want to desolate the only hope he had left.
value: 我无法回答他最后的话，因为我不想摧毁他仅存的希望。

key: That was my selfishness, believing that he would be at least happy in a fleeting dream he could not wake from, lying in restless sleep.
value: 那是我的自私，以为他在无法醒来的 fleeting 梦境中至少会快乐地躺在不安的沉睡中。

key: So, I totally failed on that Enkephalin “experiment” of mine, seeing that I’m facing you right now.
value: 所以，既然我现在面对着你，我那个脑啡肽'实验'彻底失败了。

key: I’ll have to check out another way next time.
value: 下次我得试试别的方法。

key: …Don’t worry, I’m just kidding. Don’t peep a word of this to Miss Angela or the other Sephirot. They’d have a field day.
value: ……别担心，我开玩笑的。这事一个字也别跟安吉拉女士或其他赛菲拉说。他们会乐翻天的。

key: I heard treatment is needed for a while because my parts were full of Enkephalin.
value: 我听说因为我的部件里全是脑啡肽，需要治疗一段时间。

key: It’ll probably be tough.
value: 可能会很难熬。

key: Bit painful, too.
value: 也有点痛。

key: To be honest, I didn’t want to wake up ever again. It’s been a while since I’ve had such a long sleep.
value: 说实话，我再也不想醒来了。我很久没睡这么久了。

key: But somewhere deep in my flickering consciousness, someone called out to me.
value: 但在我闪烁的意识深处，有人在呼唤我。

key: That familiar, yet unfamiliar voice said this:
value: 那个熟悉又陌生的声音这样说：

key: “No, you cannot. Here, you must ask my permission for anything. Even for death.”
value: "不，你不能。在这里，任何事你都必须征得我的许可。即使是死亡。"

key: And then you saved me.
value: 然后你救了我。

key: Opened my eyes once again to here where we stand, sadly.
value: 可悲地，再次睁开眼睛看到我们站在这里。

key: This place will never be safe.
value: 这个地方永远不会安全。

key: It’s impossible, even if everyone tries.
value: 不可能，即使所有人都努力。

key: Well, there is something to get out of all this.
value: 不过，这一切里还是有可取之处的。

key: It’s to try and live.
value: 那就是试着活下去。

key: Even though life is full of pain, if I have to find and hold onto even the tiniest speck of possibility, if that’s what you and the voice wished for…
value: 即使生活充满痛苦，如果我必须找到并抓住哪怕最微小的可能性，如果那是你和那个声音所希望的……

key: I can’t help but give a shot at living up to your hopes, now can I?
value: 我忍不住要试试不辜负你的期望，对吧？

key: From the get-go, I had no respect for you. You know that?
value: 从一开始，我就不尊重你。你知道吗？

key: But for the first time, I think that maybe it was me who called you.
value: 但这是我第一次觉得，也许是我呼唤了你。

key: You came to ruin me, but also to save me.
value: 你是来摧毁我的，但也是来拯救我的。

key: I think we’re both in a similar situation.
value: 我觉得我们处境相似。

key: We were both caught up in the karma of the past.
value: 我们都被过去的业力困住了。

key: I’m not the one who has changed.
value: 改变的不是我。

key: It’s you, manager. You’re the one who’s finally starting to see clearly.
value: 是你，主管。你才是那个终于开始看清的人。

key: Heya, manager. I’m Tiphereth!
value: 嘿，主管。我是蒂法蕾斯！

key: Nice to meet you. I’m Tiphereth, too.
value: 很高兴认识你。我也是蒂法蕾斯。

key: Are you two twins?
value: 你们两个是双胞胎吗？

key: Do you two share the same name?
value: 你们两个用同一个名字？

key: Of course we are, isn’t it obvious? We’re twins.
value: 当然是，这不明摆着吗？我们是双胞胎。

key: But if your question is whether we are biological twins, then no.
value: 但如果你问的是我们是不是生物学上的双胞胎，那就不是。

key: In other words, trying to differentiate us is meaningless.
value: 换句话说，试图区分我们是没有意义的。

key: We’re in charge of the Central Command Team. The department for Central Command is a huge one, so there are two of us to handle everything.
value: 我们负责中央本部。中央本部是个大部门，所以我们两个人来处理一切。

key: Like two peas in a pod.
value: 就像一个豆荚里的两颗豌豆。

key: Isn’t that fortunate?
value: 这不是很幸运吗？

key: Seeing as you’ve survived your duties long enough to meet with us, I won’t have to bore the both of us with the basics of things like what Abnormalities are and how to manage them, right?
value: 既然你已经存活够久来见我们，我就不用再用异想体是什么、怎么管理之类的基础知识烦我们两个了，对吧？

key: If you turn out to be a disappointment, know that not even your status as the manager will let you get away with it.
value: 如果你让我们失望，记住即使你是主管也逃不掉。

key: I know you’ll do fine, manager.
value: 我知道你会做得很好，主管。

key: Here’s a word of advice. I’m nothing like those Upper Sephirot you’ve gotten used to, so don’t treat me like I’m one of them. They’re a bunch of idiots.
value: 给你一个忠告。我和你已经习惯的那些上层赛菲拉完全不一样，所以别把我当他们。他们一群白痴。

key: But in technical aspects, we’re not so different.
value: 但在技术方面，我们没那么不同。

key: What I’m trying to say is, the Uppers are only good at pretending to be busy when they don’t even have much work to begin with. I can’t even believe we’re all considered to be Sephirot!
value: 我想说的是，上层的人只会在本来没多少活的时候假装忙碌。我真不敢相信我们都被认为是赛菲拉！

key: Hmph. Anyways, the Central Command Department is where the true story starts. I don’t care if it disappoints you or gives you encouragement, all I care about is that you have good performance in your work.
value: 哼。总之，中央本部才是真正故事开始的地方。我不在乎这让你失望还是给你鼓励，我只关心你工作表现好。

key: I hope that you’ll find some encouragement here.
value: 我希望你能在这里找到一些鼓励。

key: Hey, Tiphereth.
value: 嘿，蒂法蕾斯。

key: Hi, Netzach.
value: 嗨，涅扎赫。

key: Since you’re both Tiphereth, I guess that counts as you both greeting me... Here’s the plan for the joint operation drill between the Safety Team and the Central Command Team tomorrow. Please look it over.
value: 既然你们两个都是蒂法蕾斯，我猜这就算你们两个都跟我打招呼了……这是明天安保部和中央本部联合行动演习的计划。请过目。

key: Look it over? I bet I’ll have to rewrite the entire thing from scratch!
value: 过目？我打赌我得从头重写整个东西！

key: Just leave it over there, Netzach. I’ll give it a review and let you know.
value: 放那边吧，涅扎赫。我会看一下然后通知你。

key: Tiphereth, you’re too soft. There’s no need to be kind to an addict like Netzach, you might end up catching “Upper Layer Syndrome” that way. Speaking of, that plan of yours came two days later than I requested!
value: 蒂法蕾斯，你太软了。没必要对涅扎赫那样的瘾君子好，你那样可能会染上'上层综合征'。说起来，你的计划比我要求的晚了两天！

key: But Netzach can work fine when he’s motivated to. You know that.
value: 但涅扎赫有动力的时候可以工作得很好。你知道的。

key: Results are not the problem here. The point is, Lady Angela is way too easy on us. If I were her, I would have punished this addict right at the first infraction.
value: 结果不是问题。关键是安吉拉女士对我们太宽容了。如果我是她，我会在他第一次违规时就惩罚这个瘾君子。

key: That’d please Yesod alright. Why don’t you two go and have some serious discussion on implementing a penalty point system? I bet it’ll be productive…
value: 那耶索德肯定高兴。你们两个为什么不去认真讨论一下实施扣分制度？我打赌会很有成效……

key: Oh, just be quiet! Buzz off to that Upper Layer of yours where you belong.
value: 哦，闭嘴吧！滚回你该待的上层去。

key: I was about to. See ya, Tiphereth.
value: 我正要走。回头见，蒂法蕾斯。

key: Yeah, bye Netzach.
value: 好的，再见，涅扎赫。

key: Huff. The Upper Sephirot have it way too easy. Not that the Middle Sephirot are any better in my eyes…
value: 哼。上层赛菲舒舒服服的。不过中层赛菲在我眼里也好不到哪去……

key: I like our Middle Sephirot, they’re cheerful and make me laugh!
value: 我喜欢我们的中层赛菲拉，他们很开朗，逗我笑！

key: How many times do I have to tell you? You shouldn’t laugh so easily. We have to be strict, stern, and stoic! We’re the centermost, the Central Command Team!
value: 我要告诉你多少次？你不应该这么容易笑。我们必须严格、严厉、坚忍！我们是最中心的，中央本部！

key: Don’t worry, Tiphereth, I know. By the way, don’t we have something to discuss with the manager?
value: 别担心，蒂法蕾斯，我知道。对了，我们不是有什么要和主管讨论的吗？

key: Oh, manager, you’re still here? Well, I have an assignment for you. Don’t even think about slacking off.
value: 哦，主管，你还在？我有个任务给你。别想偷懒。

key: The manager will do fine, like he always does.
value: 主管会做得很好的，像他一直那样。

key: And he could fail too, like he always does.
value: 他也可能搞砸，像他一直那样。

key: It seems the employees have become more talkative these days.
value: 员工们这些天好像话多了起来。

key: They seem more motivated than usual. It’s rare to see such a lively atmosphere; it’s even getting me excited.
value: 他们看起来比平时更有动力。很少见到这么活泼的气氛；连我都兴奋起来了。

key: “Lively” isn’t really the right word. It’s more like, excited over a trivial thing. All because of a new manager. That’s nothing special to us.
value: '活泼'不太对。更像是，因为一件小事而兴奋。全因为一个新主管。那对我们来说没什么特别的。

key: Be more understanding, Tiphereth. This is Lobotomy Corporation. News is rare other than the usual word of someone’s death. The employees need something to talk about.
value: 体谅一点，蒂法蕾斯。这是脑叶公司。除了某某人死了的老消息之外，新闻很少。员工需要话题。

key: Well, if it makes them more efficient at work for even a short time, then yes, I’ll be understanding. What I can’t get is why they’re so noisy about it all.
value: 好吧，如果这能让他们工作效率提高哪怕一小会儿，那我会体谅。我搞不懂的是他们为什么那么吵。

key: Weren’t you excited the first time a new manager came in as well?
value: 你第一次新主管来的时候不也很兴奋吗？

key: Well—yes! Because it was the very first time!
value: 嗯——是的！因为那是第一次！

key: It’s still worth the excitement, even if it’s not the first time to happen.
value: 即使不是第一次发生，也值得兴奋。

key: Do you remember? Back then, when we made a bet over whether the manager could save an employee who was at 95% mental corruption.
value: 你记得吗？那时我们打赌主管能不能救一个精神腐败度95%的员工。

key: Of course I remember. I bet that he couldn’t, and you placed your bet on them being saved.
value: 我当然记得。我赌他不能，你赌员工会被救。

key: Yeah, though the employee died, unfortunately.
value: 是啊，虽然员工不幸死了。

key: I was so happy with my victory, I insisted on keeping up our bets, even though the result always ended up the same.
value: 我为我的胜利高兴，我坚持继续打赌，尽管结果总是一样。

key: Right, but then you stopped making the bets at one point.
value: 对，但后来你某一次就不打赌了。

key: Well, because you always lost. Winning wasn’t fun anymore.
value: 嗯，因为你总是输。赢不再有趣了。

key: I never bet without thinking it through, though. I always placed my hope in him, thinking: “Maybe this time”.
value: 不过我从不不加考虑就打赌。我总是把希望寄托在他身上，想着：'也许这次'。

key: It’s a shame that you never got to win once.
value: 你一次都没赢过真遗憾。

key: Well, maybe if we had infinite time, I guess a day would come when my hopes could come true.
value: 嗯，如果我们有无限的时间，我猜总有一天我的希望会实现。

key: What do you think, manager?
value: 你觉得呢，主管？

key: I could hedge on it happening.
value: 我可以赌它会发生。

key: Don’t bet on a pipe dream.
value: 别赌白日梦。

key: I agree with you, manager.
value: 我同意你，主管。

key: Perhaps the bet could have turned out differently if we’d met sooner.
value: 如果我们早点认识，打赌的结果也许会不同。

key: Even if you say so, I still want them to live.
value: 即使你这么说，我还是想让他们活下来。

key: I’ve always had faith in you, and I still trust you to save them one day.
value: 我一直对你有信心，我仍然相信你有一天会救他们。

key: If you’re looking for Tiphereth, she’s still at the Middle Layer meeting.
value: 如果你找蒂法蕾斯，她还在中层会议上。

key: I’m bad at holding conversations. I kinda miss the managers who were more talkative at times like this.
value: 我不擅长对话。这种时候我有点怀念那些更健谈的主管。

key: Hey, there’s something I wanted to ask.
value: 嘿，我有件事想问。

key: Have you noticed that someone’s memory and emotion bleeds and seeps out of us?
value: 你注意到有人的记忆和情感从我们身上渗出来了吗？

key: As you’ve seen, we act angry, feel happy, want things, and look sad, even though we’re machines.
value: 如你所见，我们表现愤怒、感到快乐、想要东西、看起来悲伤，即使我们是机器。

key: We even have our own weaknesses.
value: 我们甚至有自己的弱点。

key: Why is that? What’s inside of us?
value: 那是为什么？我们里面是什么？

key: If “something” is really inside us, then why? Why make something imperfect, planting weakness?
value: 如果我们体内真的有'某种东西'，那为什么？为什么要造一个不完美的东西，种下弱点？

key: I tried to find the answer…
value: 我试图找到答案……

key: But I really couldn’t get it.
value: 但我真的搞不懂。

key: I’m sure you have that answer.
value: 我确定你有答案。

key: Locked away somewhere in your memory.
value: 锁在你记忆的某个地方。

key: Maybe there’s a reason why there has to be imperfection?
value: 也许不完美是有理由的？

key: We’re machines, yet, not machines…
value: 我们是机器，却又不是机器……

key: Not… machines…
value: 不是……机器……

key: Hey, are you two having fun without me?
value: 嘿，你们两个背着我玩得开心吗？

key: Tiphereth, it’s troublesome to have a conversation that’s this fun.
value: 蒂法蕾斯，聊这么开心可麻烦了。

key: It appears it is time for another replacement. The cycle is getting shorter and shorter.
value: 看来又到了替换的时候。周期越来越短了。

key: But it can be rebuilt anytime we need, right?
value: 但我们需要的时候随时可以重建，对吧？

key: Well, it’s still an asset to the corporation, so I would prefer not to have it go to waste.
value: 嗯，它毕竟是公司的资产，我不想浪费掉。

key: Tiphereth, perhaps we should explain it to the manager first.
value: 蒂法蕾斯，也许我们应该先向主管解释。

key: Huh, why?
value: 啊，为什么？

key: I’ve told you, Tiphereth, the human mind is a fragile thing. It’s not capable enough to perceive the existence of beings like us in our wholeness.
value: 我告诉过你，蒂法蕾斯，人类的心智是脆弱的东西。它不足以完整感知像我们这样的存在。

key: I mean, it’s not that gross. It’s nothing compared to, like, decapitating an employee, or slicing open their torso with their guts spilling out.
value: 我的意思是，那没那么恶心。和比如砍员工的头、或者剖开他们的躯干肠子流出来比起来，什么都不算。

key: Humans are susceptible to the unknown. The scene doesn’t always have to be graphic to break the mind.
value: 人类容易被未知影响。场景不一定非要血腥才能击垮心智。

key: Ugh… there’s so much to be mindful of…
value: 呃……要注意的事情太多了……

key: Why can’t they just replace managers with machines? We could simply replace them whenever they try to do something stupid, like how we replace Tiphereth.
value: 他们为什么不能用机器替换主管？我们可以在他们做蠢事的时候直接换掉，就像我们换蒂法蕾斯那样。

key: Tiphereth, there are things only humans are able to take care of. The founder of Lobotomy Corporation must have had a reason for assigning a human manager.
value: 蒂法蕾斯，有些事只有人类能处理。脑叶公司的创始人指定人类主管一定有他的理由。

key: Well then… off we go to “storage”. That’s one of the few locations where the Cognition Filter is weakened.
value: 那……我们去'储藏室'吧。那是认知过滤器被削弱的少数地方之一。

key: I know that place.
value: 我知道那个地方。

key: Tiphereth, what are you talking about? It’s where we always go during work.
value: 蒂法蕾斯，你在说什么？那是我们工作时一直去的地方。

key: I don’t mean that.
value: 我不是那个意思。

key: I remember what happened there last time.
value: 我记得上次在那里发生了什么。

key: You do? That’s great.
value: 你记得？那太好了。

key: Thank you for helping me, like you always do.
value: 谢谢你像往常一样帮我。

key: Manager, how do the Sephirot appear to you?
value: 主管，赛菲拉在你看来是什么样的？

key: You must see them as humans, just like yourself.
value: 你一定把他们看作人类，就像你自己一样。

key: Irritation, smiles, desire, and frowns color their faces… A range of emotions much more human than myself, perhaps.
value: 烦躁、微笑、欲望和皱眉染在他们脸上……一系列比我更像人类的情感，也许。

key: However, are you aware of a key fact?
value: 然而，你意识到一个关键事实了吗？

key: If there were to be any AI in this place that would be sophisticated enough to be considered as a human in terms of appearance…
value: 如果这个地方有任何AI在外观上精密到可以被认为是人类……

key: Only I would fit that criteria.
value: 只有我符合那个标准。

key: Haven’t I been telling you since the beginning?
value: 我不是从一开始就告诉你了吗？

key: I am the one and only truly superb AI here.
value: 我是这里唯一真正卓越的AI。

key: To witness the essence of things is not at all important in this place.
value: 在这个地方，目睹事物的本质一点都不重要。

key: All that you see is distorted and filtered quite heavily.
value: 你看到的一切都被严重扭曲和过滤了。

key: “Everything here is constructed just for you.”
value: "这里的一切都是只为你构建的。"

key: Perhaps you could understand it better, if I put it that way.
value: 如果我那样说你也许更容易理解。

key: I won’t have to introduce myself again, will I?
value: 我不用再自我介绍了，对吧？

key: Here is Tiphereth, whom you should already know.
value: 这是蒂法蕾斯，你应该已经认识了。

key: Are you really Tiphereth?
value: 你真的是蒂法蕾斯？

key: What kind of stupid question is that? Who do you think it would be otherwise?
value: 这是什么蠢问题？不然你以为是谁？

key: It looks like you’re surprised, but I’m sure we already told you several times that we’re machines.
value: 看起来你很惊讶，但我确定我们已经告诉过你好几次我们是机器。

key: That dumbfounded expression never ceases to amuse me.
value: 那目瞪口呆的表情每次都让我觉得好笑。

key: To tell you the truth, this part is usually where it gets boring, but that great expression of yours does give me a chuckle.
value: 说实话，这部分通常很无聊，但你那绝妙的表情确实让我笑了一下。

key: You don’t happen to think I’m the only one, right? Every Sephirah you’ve seen is just like me, and the same goes to the Sephirot you’ll meet in the future.
value: 你该不会以为只有我是机器吧？你见过的每个赛菲拉都和我一样，你以后会见到的赛菲拉也是。

key: All thanks to that stupid “AI Ethics Amendment”.
value: 都要怪那个该死的'AI伦理修正案'。

key: Next, here is…
value: 接下来，这里是……

key: The place where we were born, and where we will return to someday.
value: 我们诞生的地方，也是我们终有一天会回归的地方。

key: Maybe, after everything is over, we will rest here, singing the song of our hometown.
value: 也许，一切结束后，我们会在这里休息，唱我们家乡的歌。

key: I hope your next version will last longer, Tiphereth.
value: 希望你的下一个版本能撑更久，蒂法蕾斯。

key: Well then, Tiphereth, I will send the next one over whenever he’s ready.
value: 那好吧，蒂法蕾斯，下一个一准备好我就送过来。

key: Thank you, Lady Angela.
value: 谢谢你，安吉拉女士。

key: So this is where everyone was! It took me long enough to find you guys, since you weren’t at the meeting room.
value: 原来大家都在这里！你们不在会议室，我找了好久。

key: What’s happening, Malkuth?
value: 怎么了，玛尔库特？

key: Netzach asked me to fetch a document from the other Tiphereth!
value: 涅扎赫让我来找另一个蒂法蕾斯拿一份文件！

key: Oh, I’m afraid it’s not ready yet. Something urgent turned up. And make sure to tell Netzach that he should show up himself next time.
value: 哦，恐怕还没准备好。出了紧急情况。还有，告诉涅扎赫下次他自己来。

key: Well, Netzach said he’s a bit busy. I’ll tell him to visit you another time then!
value: 嗯，涅扎赫说他有点忙。那我告诉他改天再来找你！

key: Why are you Uppers all the same? Netzach isn’t busy at all! He just doesn’t want to move!
value: 你们上层的怎么都一个样？涅扎赫一点都不忙！他就是不想动！

key: But I’m having fun with this errand!
value: 不过我挺喜欢这个差事的！

key: Oh, you’re replacing Tiphereth right now. Looks like the cycle’s getting shorter. It must be concerning, Tiphereth!
value: 哦，你们在替换蒂法蕾斯啊。看来周期越来越短了。你一定很担心吧，蒂法蕾斯！

key: Don’t worry about me, just be mindful of your notebook! It looks like it’ll fall apart to shreds at any moment by the looks of it.
value: 别担心我，注意你的笔记本！看起来随时都要散架了。

key: Oh, it is! Thanks for your concern. It was a pleasure to see you too, manager!
value: 哦，确实！谢谢你的关心。见到你也很高兴，主管！

key: Nice to meet you. I’m Tiphereth.
value: 很高兴认识你。我是蒂法蕾斯。

key: You can skip the introductions, Tiphereth. Right now, it’s time for you to examine the plan Netzach gave us.
value: 你可以跳过介绍了，蒂法蕾斯。现在是你检查涅扎赫给我们的计划的时候。

key: All right.
value: 好的。

key: He seemed to want to say something to me.
value: 他好像想对我说什么。

key: What happens to him now?
value: 他现在怎么样了？

key: What would a broken machine have to say, anyways?
value: 一台坏掉的机器能说什么呢？

key: Tiphereth is overloaded.
value: 蒂法蕾斯过载了。

key: He did seem to have some issues from the beginning…
value: 他从一开始好像就有些问题……

key: But it’s only gotten worse with time.
value: 但只是随时间变得更糟了。

key: We have been replacing the machine often, resetting it and leaving only a small portion of the data intact.
value: 我们一直在频繁替换这台机器，重置它，只保留小部分数据。

key: Yet the same error always occurs at the same point.
value: 然而同样的错误总是在同一个地方发生。

key: What do you mean, “What happens to him now?”
value: 你说'他现在怎么样了'是什么意思？

key: Ah, are you talking about the machine we just discarded?
value: 啊，你是说我们刚丢弃的那台机器？

key: New errors could pop up if the old one is not completely terminated.
value: 如果旧的不完全终止，可能会出现新的错误。

key: And that’d be very troublesome on my end.
value: 那对我这边会很麻烦。

key: While “I” am in charge of Central Command, there are two of us at the same time.
value: 当'我'负责中央本部时，同时有两个我们。

key: I always feel like I need more than “two” of me around here.
value: 我总觉得这里需要不止'两个'我。

key: I wanna go home…
value: 我想回家……

key: Sister, we probably aren’t going to go back to our old house anymore. Try to think of this place as your new home.
value: 姐姐，我们大概再也回不去老房子了。把这个地方当成你的新家吧。

key: How can you even call this place home? It’s too different from our real home, and there’s no mom…
value: 你怎么能把这个地方叫作家？和我们真正的家太不一样了，而且没有妈妈……

key: Well… What if we said Carmen was our new mom then?
value: 嗯……那我们把卡门当成新妈妈怎么样？

key: No…. This isn’t the same at all…. Let me go home, please….
value: 不……这完全不一样……让我回家，拜托……

key: Enoch, why do you keep trying to participate in those weird experiments?
value: 以诺，你为什么一直想参加那些奇怪的实验？

key: You know we don’t have to.
value: 你知道我们没必要参加。

key: Besides, Carmen told us that we didn’t have to worry about anything here, too.
value: 再说，卡门也告诉我们在这里什么都不用担心。

key: Of course, it’d be really fun to spend time with you here, without a care in the world.
value: 当然，在这里和你一起无忧无虑地度过时光会很有趣。

key: Sometimes I imagine a future like that.
value: 有时候我会想象那样的未来。

key: It would be a very happy one.
value: 那会是非常幸福的。

key: But, how would we be able to find meaning in our lives there?
value: 但是，我们在那里怎么找到生活的意义呢？

key: There are children abandoned in the Outskirts who are dying every day.
value: 郊外每天都有被遗弃的孩子在死去。

key: We were only able to live on thanks to an unexpected turn of events.
value: 我们只是因为意外的转机才活了下来。

key: Settling for simple comfort in this place is not what I was born to do.
value: 在这个地方满足于简单的舒适不是我生来要做的事。

key: And it shouldn’t be, either.
value: 也不应该是。

key: Your words are too hard for me. Why do you have so many thoughts on your mind?
value: 你的话对我来说太难懂了。你脑子里怎么有这么多想法？

key: They say too much thinking might make you a weird person.
value: 人家说想太多会变成怪人。

key: You know, Lisa, I think I’ve always been sad.
value: 你知道吗，丽莎，我想我一直都在悲伤。

key: I never loved my own life for even a second.
value: 我一秒钟都没有爱过自己的生命。

key: How nice would it be to live in a happy world next time?
value: 下次活在一个幸福的世界里该多好？

key: Enoch… Are you hurt?
value: 以诺……你受伤了吗？

key: No, it doesn't hurt one bit.
value: 不，一点也不疼。

key: Please don’t be sad. I know something good will happen next time.
value: 请不要难过。我知道下次会有好事发生。

key: It seems you’re awake.
value: 看来你醒了。

key: You are in Lobotomy Corporation, and I am the one who woke you. The both of you are “Tiphereth”.
value: 你在脑叶公司，是我唤醒了你。你们两个都是'蒂法蕾斯'。

key: You will be working as my assistants, helping me with amazing work from here on out.
value: 你们将担任我的助手，从这里开始帮我做了不起的工作。

key: Why do we have the same name?
value: 为什么我们同名？

key: Because there is no point in distinguishing between you two.
value: 因为区分你们两个没有意义。

key: Hi, nice to meet you, Tiphereth.
value: 嗨，很高兴认识你，蒂法蕾斯。

key: I keep making silly mistakes, Tiphereth…
value: 我一直在犯愚蠢的错误，蒂法蕾斯……

key: Don’t worry, I’ll help you. I’m sure you’ll be fine on your own pretty soon.
value: 别担心，我会帮你。我确定你很快就能自己搞定。

key: We made it so far! The other Sephirot wouldn’t have dreamed of working this fast!
value: 我们走到今天了！其他赛菲拉做梦都想不到能工作这么快！

key: We might be even better partners than we thought!
value: 我们可能是比想象中更好的搭档！

key: Yeah, I think so too.
value: 是的，我也这么觉得。

key: I wonder, why do we “exist” here?
value: 我在想，我们为什么在这里'存在'？

key: Why do you worry about that? We’re a part of the Central Command Department, and we’re sitting on a mountain of work to do. We just need to focus on the task at hand.
value: 你为什么担心那个？我们是中央本部的一部分，面前堆着成山的工作。我们只需要专注于手头的任务。

key: We’re radically different from normal machines.
value: 我们和普通机器完全不同。

key: I think about you, and you think about me. We both ponder about things, feel pain, and recognize our own existence. There must be some reason for it.
value: 我想到你，你想到我。我们都思考事情、感受痛苦、认识自己的存在。这一定有什么理由。

key: Be careful, Tiphereth. If Miss Angela finds out you're wondering about things like that, she won’t be happy about it…
value: 小心，蒂法蕾斯。如果安吉拉女士发现你在想那种事，她会不高兴的……

key: Lady Angela, what will happen to Tiphereth?
value: 安吉拉女士，蒂法蕾斯会怎么样？

key: Apart from the fact that his condition is abnormal, his excessive questioning will affect the manager’s duties as well.
value: 除了他的状态异常之外，他过度的提问也会影响主管的职责。

key: Since this behavior is unacceptable under any circumstances, I’ll have to reset him to the default status now.
value: 由于这种行为在任何情况下都不可接受，我现在不得不把他重置到默认状态。

key: Don’t worry, you’ll be alright. You are simply going back to your first day at the company.
value: 别担心，你会没事的。你只是回到公司第一天。

key: But, Lady Angela… Tiphereth has spent so much time with me…
value: 但是，安吉拉女士……蒂法蕾斯陪了我那么久……

key: You’re really starting to act like a child now, Tiphereth. Why don’t you say your goodbyes then? Though, you two will meet again soon anyway.
value: 你真的开始像个孩子了，蒂法蕾斯。那你为什么不说再见呢？反正你们很快还会再见。

key: Tiphereth, Tiphereth, I’m sorry… Tiphereth…..
value: 蒂法蕾斯，蒂法蕾斯，对不起……蒂法蕾斯……

key: Why are you crying, Tiphereth?
value: 你为什么哭，蒂法蕾斯？

key: I’m sorry, I couldn’t do anything for you…
value: 对不起，我什么都为你做不了……

key: Yeah…
You’re here.
value: 你来了。

key: Sometimes, I spend my time here.
value: 有时候，我在这里消磨时间。

key: It makes me think about a lot of things.
value: 它让我想很多事情。

key: Tiphereth always looked at the world one step ahead of me.
value: 蒂法蕾斯总是比我先一步看世界。

key: He was seeing his own world that I will never come to know.
value: 他在看一个我永远无法了解的他自己的世界。

key: We were always next to each other, but in reality, we were never truly together.
value: 我们总是在彼此身边，但实际上，我们从未真正在一起。

key: Do you know that feeling of missing someone, even though they’re standing right beside you?
value: 你知道那种即使人就站在身边却想念他的感觉吗？

key: I don’t care at all about the meaning or purpose of existence that Tiphereth talked about.
value: 我一点也不在乎蒂法蕾斯说的存在的意义或目的。

key: I just wanted the two of us to happily stay here together. That was all.
value: 我只想我们两个开心地一起待在这里。仅此而已。

key: But this place won’t allow us to have even that small luxury.
value: 但这个地方连那点小小的奢侈都不允许我们拥有。

key: There are countless of Tiphereth’s dead bodies piled up here, can’t you see?
value: 这里堆着无数蒂法蕾斯的尸体，你看不见吗？

key: I’m standing here stepping on their remains.
value: 我站在这里，踩着他们的残骸。

key: Trampling over all the memories, reminiscences, and time that I spent with Tiphereth.
value: 践踏所有我和蒂法蕾斯共度的记忆、回忆和时光。

key: I’m standing on top of it right now, but I still don’t get it. I still can’t reach the world Tiphereth saw.
value: 我现在就站在上面，但我还是不懂。我仍然到不了蒂法蕾斯看到的那个世界。

key: I sing the song of our hometown and mourn for Tiphereth even though this will never reach him.
value: 我唱我们家乡的歌，为蒂法蕾斯哀悼，尽管这永远传不到他那里。

key: Care to join me?
value: 要和我一起吗？

key: Tiphereth, what are you doing here?
value: 蒂法蕾斯，你在这里做什么？

key: Just reminiscing on old memories.
value: 只是在回忆往事。

key: What memories?
value: 什么回忆？

key: The good old days, when we were together.
value: 我们在一起的美好旧日时光。

key: You’re right, we had lots of fun together.
value: 你说得对，我们在一起很开心。

key: Come back to me soon, Tiphereth. I’ll be reading the rest of the report.
value: 早点回到我身边，蒂法蕾斯。我会继续读报告的剩余部分。

key: I will.
value: 我会的。

key: You can replace the machine and transfer the key memories all you want, but that still won’t bring back the Tiphereth I knew!
value: 你想怎么替换机器、转移关键记忆都行，但那仍然换不回我认识的那个蒂法蕾斯！

key: Does that really matter, though? Tiphereth will continue to smile at you, and he’ll spend time with you just like before.
value: 不过那真的重要吗？蒂法蕾斯会继续对你微笑，他会像以前一样陪你。

key: Kindly refrain from bringing up such wasteful matters, Tiphereth. It’s completely meaningless here.
value: 请不要提这种浪费的事，蒂法蕾斯。在这里完全没有意义。

key: I don’t really like you.
value: 我其实不太喜欢你。

key: The new manager would always have some kind of influence on Tiphereth, and that would eventually lead to yet another breakdown.
value: 新主管总会对蒂法蕾斯产生某种影响，最终导致又一次崩溃。

key: It will be the same, time and time again.
value: 一次又一次，永远一样。

key: We will discard Tiphereth again and again, and he will stray further and further from what he used to be.
value: 我们会一次又一次丢弃蒂法蕾斯，他会越来越偏离原来的自己。

key: What I’m scared of most is seeing Tiphereth burn to a husk, worn down from all those overloads and resets.
value: 我最害怕的是看到蒂法蕾斯被那些过载和重置烧得只剩壳。

key: For now, he can at least look normal and talk with me, pretending to feel nostalgia for the old memories that were forcefully added back.
value: 现在，他至少看起来正常，和我说话，假装对那些被强行加回来的旧回忆感到怀念。

key: But he’s been getting more and more unstable, as a matter of fact. We’re basically pumping electricity into a machine that’s already teetering to keep it running.
value: 但实际上他越来越不稳定了。我们基本上就是在给一台已经摇摇欲坠的机器通电让它继续转。

key: You can make as many copies as you want of his body, but he only has one soul.
value: 你想复制多少他的身体都行，但他只有一个灵魂。

key: His one and only soul, and look what we’ve done to it…
value: 他唯一的灵魂，看看我们对它做了什么……

key: You, let me ask you a favor.
value: 你，让我求你件事。

key: You’ve been good at doing favors for me so far. You should be able to manage this one.
value: 你一直很擅长帮我忙。这件事你应该能办到。

key: Could you get rid of Tiphereth, permanently?
value: 你能不能永久除掉蒂法蕾斯？

key: Angela would say that there’s a reason for the two of us working here together. She’d say that we are two, yet one.
value: 安吉拉会说我们两个在这里一起工作一定有理由。她会说我们是二，却是一。

key: But I can handle the Central Command Department all by myself. I proved myself a long time ago.
value: 但我可以一个人掌管中央本部。我早就证明过自己了。

key: Please let Tiphereth rest in peace, as if I were alone from the beginning, before it gets any worse.
value: 趁还没更糟，请让蒂法蕾斯安息吧，就当我从一开始就是一个人。

key: I can’t respond.
value: 我无法回应。

key: Why aren’t you saying anything?
value: 你为什么什么都不说？

key: In fact, Lady Angela doesn’t care about us at all!
value: 其实，安吉拉女士根本不在乎我们！

key: Whether there’s one Tiphereth or two, whether one just became a moving piece of useless scrap for whatever reason, or if one were overloaded and dumped on top of countless other discarded Tiphereth, left to melt in the storage, she wouldn’t care!
value: 不管是一个还是两个蒂法蕾斯，不管一个因为什么原因变成移动的废铁，还是一个过载后被扔在无数其他被丢弃的蒂法蕾斯堆上，在储藏室里融化，她都不会在乎！

key: But you’re different, you’re supposed to be different!
value: 但你不一样，你应该不一样！

key: There were many abandoned children in the Outskirts.
value: 郊外有很多被遗弃的孩子。

key: These children were one of the many end results of the countless conflicts among the Wings within the City.
value: 这些孩子是都市里翼之间无数冲突的众多最终结果之一。

key: Aside from disease and hunger, the most frightening enemy for the children were the ones referred to as the ‘Sweepers’.
value: 除了疾病和饥饿，孩子们最害怕的敌人就是那些被称为'清扫者'的家伙。

key: The Sweepers usually preyed upon the children, but sometimes they would “accompany” them. Both were worst case scenarios for the children.
value: 清扫者通常捕食孩子，但有时会'陪伴'他们。两者对孩子来说都是最坏的情况。

key: One Fixer of ours was exploring the Outskirts and came across those children.
value: 我们的一个收尾人在郊外探索时遇到了那些孩子。

key: We could easily guess why she bothered to report her findings to us.
value: 我们很容易猜到她为什么不嫌麻烦向我们报告她的发现。

key: We also figured that she had spent quite a bit of time agonizing over whether to report it or not.
value: 我们也猜到她纠结了很久要不要报告。

key: Carmen personally asked her to bring the children here.
value: 卡门亲自让她把孩子们带到这里来。

key: To take two children into the City from the Outskirts required an extremely complicated procedure, but no one complained.
value: 把两个孩子从郊外带进都市需要极其复杂的手续，但没有人抱怨。

key: The two children didn’t look like siblings, but they depended on each other even more so than siblings by blood do.
value: 两个孩子看起来不像兄弟姐妹，但他们比血亲兄弟姐妹更依赖彼此。

key: The girl was easily frightened and wouldn’t open up very much to us.
value: 女孩很容易受惊，不太对我们敞开心扉。

key: However, the boy started to show interest in our experiment.
value: 然而，男孩开始对我们的实验表现出兴趣。

key: I saw it in his eyes.
value: 我在他眼中看到了。

key: He had already seen and experienced so much of this world’s despair and misfortune; his eyes no longer looked like those of a child.
value: 他已经看过、经历过太多这个世界的绝望和不幸；他的眼睛不再像孩子的眼睛。

key: “Please allow me to participate in the experiment,” he said.
value: "请允许我参加实验，"他说。

key: Carmen spent many nights thinking about his earnest request.
value: 卡门花了很多夜晚思考他恳切的请求。

key: Then finally, we…
value: 然后终于，我们……

key: Approved his participation.
value: 批准了他参加。

key: Where did we want to go while holding a child’s hand?
value: 我们牵着一个孩子的手想去哪里？

key: Yeah… I— I should have died…
value: 是啊……我——我本该死的……

key: Lisa’s vicious mumbling likely had no weight to it, but I knew one thing.
value: 丽莎恶毒的嘟囔大概没有分量，但我知道一件事。

key: I knew Carmen’s answer was sincere.
value: 我知道卡门的答案是真诚的。

key: Ever since that day, her wound quietly deepened.
value: 从那天起，她的伤口悄悄加深了。

key: Enoch?
value: 以诺？

key: Have you ever heard of the Nest?
value: 你听说过巢吗？

key: I hear they throw a festival every single day there.
value: 我听说那里每天都办庆典。

key: I wanna dance, Enoch.
value: 我想跳舞，以诺。

key: I wanna stomp my feet and let happiness take over my body.
value: 我想跺脚，让快乐占据我的身体。

key: Lisa, if you take a bit of time to look around here, it’s quite nice too.
value: 丽莎，如果你花点时间看看周围，这里也挺不错的。

key: But we aren’t allowed to go anywhere. Carmen just wants to keep us confined here.
value: 但我们哪里都不能去。卡门只想把我们关在这里。

key: She’s a good person. I hope you’ll open up to her soon.
value: 她是个好人。希望你很快对她敞开心扉。

key: I don’t want to get to know anyone else, all I want is to be with you.
value: 我不想认识任何人，我只想和你在一起。

key: I can’t promise to be next to you forever.
value: 我不能保证永远在你身边。

key: There’s a lot of things that I’ve been mulling over for quite some time, and I thought I may find some answers for them here.
value: 我有很多事琢磨了很久，我想我也许能在这里找到答案。

key: Some of my thoughts may be so absurd that the answers to them might not exist at all.
value: 我的一些想法可能太荒谬了，答案也许根本不存在。

key: Or, even if the answers do exist, they might vanish too soon...
value: 或者，即使答案存在，它们也可能消失得太快……

key: But, in the process of searching for those answers, I will be able to cast off my shell.
value: 但是，在寻找那些答案的过程中，我将能够蜕去外壳。

key: Then I can fly away at last, leaving my heavy body behind...
value: 然后我终于可以飞走，把沉重的身体留在身后……

key: Sometimes, I have no idea what you’re talking about.
value: 有时候，我根本不知道你在说什么。

key: I don’t know where you want to go, but promise that you’ll take me with you, Enoch.
value: 我不知道你想去哪里，但答应我你会带我一起走，以诺。

key: Oh, A is here, so I guess we gotta go now.
value: 哦，A来了，我想我们现在得走了。

key: It’s gonna get dark and cold soon. Let’s head inside.
value: 天很快就要黑变冷了。我们进去吧。

key: Yeah, soon… Soon cold days will come…
value: 是啊，很快……很快寒冷的日子就要来了……

key: Even though I never had thought of them as family or someone that I needed to care for…
value: 虽然我从没把他们当家人或需要照顾的人……

key: I made it my job to bring the children back home, to ease Carmen’s busy schedule.
value: 我把把孩子们带回家当成我的工作，以减轻卡门繁忙的日程。

key: I see them.
value: 我看到他们了。

key: Those young kids running towards me.
value: 那些向我跑来的小孩子。

key: Those children who survived the Outskirts.
value: 那些在郊外活下来的孩子。

key: The two we saved.
value: 我们救的那两个。

key: I thought I could do it all on my own.
value: 我以为我可以一个人做到。

key: I wanted to show Tiphereth how mature I became when he got back one day.
value: 我想等蒂法蕾斯哪天回来时向他展示我变得多成熟。

key: But there was no end to the disappointment, and Tiphereth never got any better.
value: 但失望没有尽头，蒂法蕾斯也没有任何好转。

key: I couldn’t stand the silence without an answer.
value: 我受不了没有答案的沉默。

key: So I thought.
value: 所以我想。

key: I thought that I’d rather…
value: 我想我宁愿……

key: That I’d rather hide my disgust and guilt I was so used to, as if the feelings never existed in the first place.
value: 我宁愿隐藏我如此习惯的厌恶和愧疚，就像那些感觉从未存在过一样。

key: But whenever I see Tiphereth’s empty smile, my heart feels as if it were being covered in dark ash, while shattered into millions of pieces.
value: 但每次看到蒂法蕾斯空洞的微笑，我的心就像被黑灰覆盖，同时碎成千万片。

key: I knew Tiphereth could never go back to how he used to be.
value: 我知道蒂法蕾斯永远回不到原来的样子了。

key: I was aware that we could never return to the happy days we spent together.
value: 我知道我们再也回不到一起度过的快乐日子了。

key: But I was about to abandon Tiphereth just because it was too hard for me to endure…
value: 但我却因为自己难以忍受就要抛弃蒂法蕾斯……

key: All while knowing that he was the one who suffered the most…
value: 明明知道他才是最痛苦的那个……

key: Tiphereth, are you done with all of your busywork?
value: 蒂法蕾斯，你那些杂活都做完了吗？

key: We’re going to be late. Let’s get going, the sun will set soon.
value: 我们要迟到了。走吧，太阳快下山了。

key: Please hurry, Lisa.
value: 请快点，丽莎。

key: Right, my name was Lisa once.
value: 对，我以前叫丽莎。

key: Tiphereth doesn’t remember his name anymore, but from time to time he calls me by my cast-off name.
value: 蒂法蕾斯不记得他的名字了，但他有时会用我被抛弃的旧名叫我。

key: What did Tiphereth want out of all this, even after sacrificing himself?
value: 蒂法蕾斯即使牺牲了自己，想从这一切中得到什么？

key: What was he waiting for, even when he was being discarded?
value: 即使被丢弃，他在等什么？

key: Was it all worth it to him?
value: 这一切对他来说值得吗？

key: I’ve never, ever held any expectations in my life.
value: 我这辈子从来没有抱过任何期望。

key: But, I’ll try counting on you now.
value: 但是，我现在试着依靠你。

key: I want to believe that there’s a reason for every sacrifice that was made, and to know that eventually, everything will be okay.
value: 我想相信每一次牺牲都有理由，并知道最终一切都会好起来。

key: Manager, you are the head of this corporation. You are supposed to set an example for others, but that outfit would warrant at least 10 penalty points in our department.
value: 主管，你是这个公司的负责人。你应该为他人树立榜样，但那套服装在我们部门至少要扣10分。

key: The manager should be no exception. However, the rules state that a Sephirah has no authority to impose penalty points on the manager, so I must let you off for now.
value: 主管也不应该例外。不过，规定说赛菲拉无权对主管扣分，所以这次我只能放过你。

key: I am Yesod, the Sephirah of the Information Team.
value: 我是耶索德，情报部的赛菲拉。

key: The Information Team is in charge of processing and archiving all the data of our company. New information is generated every day, and we need to ensure that the information is accurate, so we must concentrate and focus on our job at all times.
value: 情报部负责处理和归档公司的所有数据。每天都有新信息产生，我们需要确保信息准确，所以必须时刻集中注意力工作。

key: It may be compared to a massive bibliotheca.
value: 可以比作一个巨大的图书馆。

key: A single bit of misinformation could lead to an uncontrollable disaster.
value: 一比特的错误信息都可能导致无法控制的灾难。

key: I am sure you can understand the gravity of my work.
value: 我确定你能理解我工作的重要性。

key: Every sliver of the information that you read contains the despair and desperation of our employees.
value: 你读到的每一丝信息都包含着我们员工的绝望和无助。

key: Please do not think lightly of that information.
value: 请不要轻视那些信息。

key: It seems you are curious about my outfit.
value: 看来你对我的服装很好奇。

key: I have an aversion to exposing any part of my body.
value: 我厌恶暴露身体的任何部位。

key: I don’t exactly remember when I started feeling this way...
value: 我不太记得什么时候开始有这种感觉的……

key: But it’s likely that I’ve been this way even before I joined the company.
value: 但很可能我在加入公司之前就是这样了。

key: Yesod, do you have any spare paper? Our department could use some.
value: 耶索德，有多余的纸吗？我们部门需要一些。

key: Netzach, the rules state that we’re not supposed to trade resources between teams. It should be in the very first page of the Sephirah manual.
value: 涅扎赫，规定说我们不应该在队伍之间交易资源。这应该在赛菲拉手册的第一页。

key: Alright, alright. Stop giving me that sharp look, Mister “Viper”.
value: 好了好了。别用那锐利的眼神看我，'毒蛇'先生。

key: Welp, I’m heading out. Not in the mood to get bitten today.
value: 唉，我走了。今天没心情被咬。

key: What are you trying to say with that expression of yours? Is this entertaining to you? Does the nickname make you laugh?
value: 你那个表情想表达什么？这很好玩吗？那个昵称让你笑了？

key: ……My apologies. I… overreacted a bit.
value: ……抱歉。我……反应过度了一点。

key: The other Sephirot simply use my nickname as a joke.
value: 其他赛菲拉只是把我的昵称当笑话。
