key: But others use it in a more serious manner.
value: 但其他人用得更严肃。

key: I know there are many employees who genuinely despise me.
value: 我知道有很多员工真的鄙视我。

key: Nicknames may be a childish thing, but there’s no better way to describe a person in such few words.
value: 昵称可能是幼稚的东西，但没有比这更少的词来描述一个人更好的方式了。

key: I personally like my nickname.
value: 我个人喜欢我的昵称。

key: What’s your opinion, manager?
value: 你怎么看，主管？

key: I like the sound of it.
value: 我喜欢这个发音。

key: Doesn’t have a nice ring to it.
value: 听起来不怎么好。

key: Seems we’re in agreement then.
value: 看来我们意见一致了。

key: Is that so? Well, it may sound odd, but I’m still satisfied with it.
value: 是吗？嗯，听起来可能奇怪，但我还是满意。

key: I should get going now.
value: 我该走了。

key: I need to finish today’s work.
value: 我需要完成今天的工作。

key: Oh, and I must send you the next assignment.
value: 哦，我必须给你下一个任务。

key: You’ve exceeded my expectations, despite your first impression.
value: 尽管你第一印象不怎么样，但你超出了我的预期。

key: Allow me to explain your next—
value: 请允许我解释你的下一——

key: Yesod! I just heard that your team had a ton of casualties!
value: 耶索德！我刚听说你的队伍伤亡惨重！

key: How many times has it been now?
value: 这已经是第几次了？

key: Shouldn’t you… be at your team’s side? It looked super depressing over there.
value: 你不该……在你队伍那边吗？那边看起来超压抑的。

key: Accidents happen. I want them to understand that it’s not a big fuss. Dwelling on it only encourages them to cry more, and it will eventually tire them out.
value: 事故难免。我想让他们明白这没什么大不了。沉湎于此只会让他们哭得更多，最终会让他们筋疲力尽。

key: But… people have died. Maybe you should say something, like, at least some half-hearted commemorative speech to cheer the employees up…? I mean, we should lead our departments and all...
value: 但是……人死了。也许你应该说点什么，比如至少说半心半意的纪念演讲来鼓舞员工……？我的意思是，我们应该领导我们的部门……

key: Perhaps your aim is different from mine, then. I see no point in being sentimental. Caring too much about the respect of employees or the little complaints they make will steer you away from what’s truly important.
value: 也许你的目标和我的不同。我不觉得多愁善感有意义。太在意员工的尊重或他们的小抱怨会让你偏离真正重要的事。

key: Well, I’m just saying… I guess there’s no right answer, is there? We’re both busy, so I’ll see you later!
value: 嗯，我只是说说……我猜没有正确答案，对吧？我们都忙，回头见！

key: What do you think, manager? Should I go comfort them for the sake of the department’s morale?
value: 你怎么看，主管？为了部门士气我应该去安慰他们吗？

key: Yes, you should.
value: 是的，你应该去。

key: No, it’s not a necessity.
value: 不，不是必须的。

key: I’m honestly surprised to hear that from you.
value: 从你嘴里听到这个我真的很惊讶。

key: Do you think it’s realistic for you to show up in every department every single time an accident occurs?
value: 每次出事你都出现在每个部门，你觉得现实吗？

key: You, the man who spends the whole day incessantly watching employees die through that shiny monitor of yours?
value: 你，那个整天通过你那闪亮的显示器不停看着员工死去的人？

key: I take it that you are only saying this because you’re inexperienced and are still clinging onto the vague sense of goodwill, manager.
value: 我想你这么说是因为你缺乏经验，还抱着模糊的善意，主管。

key: Such shallow sympathy does no good in the corporation, so I urge you to be rid of it.
value: 这种肤浅的同情在公司里没用，我劝你丢掉它。

key: A gesture of “goodwill” without sincerity is nothing more than an act of diplomacy, after all.
value: 没有真诚的'善意'姿态不过是外交辞令。

key: We're not the ones whose lives are on the line.
value: 我们不是性命攸关的人。

key: We don’t live with the risk of every moment possibly being the last.
value: 我们不是活在每一刻都可能是最后一刻的风险中。

key: Nor are we always so close to death’s touch as to not have any attachment to life or worldly values.
value: 我们也不总是如此接近死亡的触碰，以至于对生命或世俗价值毫无留恋。

key: I disagree with the way Hod copes with it. She just seeks to comfort her own mind and turns a blind eye to reality.
value: 我不认同霍德应对的方式。她只是寻求安慰自己的内心，对现实视而不见。

key: It’d be much more helpful to work hard to find ways to minimize casualties in the future.
value: 努力寻找未来减少伤亡的方法会更有帮助。

key: The letter Z… Hmm... Zoo!
value: 字母Z……嗯……动物园！

key: O… Ox!
value: O……牛！

key: Hey, that’s cheating! That’s not a place at all! Doesn’t count.
value: 嘿，那是作弊！那根本不是个地方！不算。

key: Oops, I didn’t know you were here, Sephirah Yesod, sir!
value: 哎呀，我不知道你在这里，耶索德赛菲拉大人！

key: Sorry, I know we aren’t supposed to slack during work hours… But he insisted we…
value: 抱歉，我知道工作时间不该偷懒……但他坚持要我们……

key: What?! You started it! You wanted to get back at me for last time, remember?
value: 什么？！是你先开始的！你想报复上次，记得吗？

key: Shut it, you dork!
value: 闭嘴，你这呆子！

key: I’ll think about the appropriate response for this case later. You two, focus on your work.
value: 我稍后再考虑这件事的适当回应。你们两个，专注工作。

key: O-Of course, Sephirah, sir! We’re sorry!
value: 当、当然，赛菲拉大人！我们错了！

key: Looks like word chaining is starting to become one of the more popular pastimes here again.
value: 看来接龙游戏又开始成为这里比较受欢迎的消遣之一了。

key: Do you happen to enjoy word chaining, manager?
value: 你喜欢玩接龙吗，主管？

key: (Yesod begins to get lost in thought.)
value: (耶索德开始陷入沉思。)

key: James, you know you can’t enter the cell for work when your mental corruption level is above 80%. It’s against the rules.
value: 詹姆斯，你知道精神腐败度超过80%时不能进收容单元工作。这是规定。

key: I know, I know. Just this once, please? You know what happens if I fail to finish the assigned work regime! Besides, you know how Sally went in at 82% one time and came out fine? And I’m only at 81%! Please?
value: 我知道，我知道。就这一次，拜托？你知道完不成指定工作会怎么样！再说，萨莉有一次82%进去了不也没事吗？我才81%！拜托？

key: Come on, what are friends for? Act so strict and the employees will end up isolating you. It’ll be so lonely.
value: 拜托，朋友是干嘛的？太严格了员工最后会孤立你。会很孤单的。

key: Just kidding! Even if all the employees were to hate you, I’ll still be your playmate!
value: 开玩笑的！即使所有员工都恨你，我还是你的玩伴！

key: You know that the word “playmate” has no place in this corp—
value: 你知道'玩伴'这个词在这个公司里没有位置——

key: Whoops! My bad, my bad! Anyway, can I please get to work now, my lord Yesod~? Don’t forget that I cut you some slack yesterday when we were playing word chain.
value: 哎呀！我的错，我的错！总之，我现在可以开始工作了吗，耶索德大人~？别忘了昨天玩接龙时我让过你。

key: ...Fine, but just this once.
value: ……好吧，但就这一次。

key: And make sure to take a psychological examination right afterwards.
value: 之后一定要做心理检查。

key: You bet! Thank you, Yesod! See you in a bit!
value: 当然！谢谢，耶索德！回头见！

key: At times, I see hallucinations when I change my clothes.
value: 有时候，我换衣服时会看到幻觉。

key: Through the clothing, I can see my skin covered with festering boils.
value: 透过衣服，我能看到我的皮肤布满溃烂的疮。

key: Of course, my body is perfectly fine when I open my eyes.
value: 当然，睁开眼睛时我的身体完全正常。

key: It has come to a point where I’ve begun to find the sight of my normal skin strange and unnatural.
value: 已经到了我开始觉得自己正常的皮肤奇怪又不自然的地步。

key: I cannot help but ask myself, “Why is my body intact? Why is it not rotting?”
value: 我忍不住问自己：'为什么我的身体完好无损？为什么它没有腐烂？'

key: I’ve asked the other Sephirot about those visions, but it seems I’m the only one who experiences this.
value: 我问过其他赛菲拉那些幻象，但好像只有我经历这个。

key: That day, James released two Abnormalities on purpose, and eventually three clerks and four agents were killed.
value: 那天，詹姆斯故意放出了两只异想体，最终三名职员和四名员工死亡。

key: As you may know, having two Abnormalities breach and losing four agents is a rather significant loss of manpower.
value: 如你所知，两只异想体突破、损失四名员工是相当大的人力损失。

key: Of course, it was I who ordered for James to be gunned down.
value: 当然，是我下令枪杀詹姆斯的。

key: I know the kind of place we work in.
value: 我知道我们在什么样的地方工作。

key: I am not regretful for the fact that I was unable to stop him.
value: 我对没能阻止他这件事不后悔。

key: It’s that I regret having developed a personal relationship with him.
value: 我后悔的是和他建立了私人关系。

key: I was careless with my position and let my subordinate exploit me.
value: 我对自己的位置粗心了，让下属利用了我。

key: Chatting, games, yes—all of it was fun.
value: 聊天、游戏，是的——都很有趣。

key: James was a good joker too.
value: 詹姆斯也是个很好的玩笑人。

key: Of course I had fun playing word chain.
value: 我当然喜欢玩接龙。

key: We grew so intimate that I would forgive his “trivial” rule violations.
value: 我们变得如此亲密，以至于我会原谅他'微不足道'的违规。

key: But the price I had to pay for the error I made was not trivial in any way.
value: 但我为这个错误付出的代价绝不微乎其微。

key: Manager, this is Lobotomy Corporation.
value: 主管，这里是脑叶公司。

key: We see body bags every single day.
value: 我们每天都看到尸体袋。

key: It’s a lonely place.
value: 这是个孤独的地方。

key: Sometimes, you will feel the urge to share the distress and anxiety with someone else; to have a friend.
value: 有时候，你会有和别人分享痛苦和焦虑的冲动；想要一个朋友。

key: But manager, whenever you feel lonely, please remember what happened to me. And try not to make the same mistake as I did.
value: 但是主管，每当你感到孤独时，请记住我发生了什么。尽量不要犯和我一样的错误。

key: You will be able to get over the meaningless deaths that way.
value: 那样你就能克服那些无意义的死亡。

key: I envy Angela. She is truly a heartless monster.
value: 我羡慕安吉拉。她真是个无情的怪物。

key: People say that I am too rational.
value: 人们说我太理性。

key: “Yesod the Cold-blooded Machine”, “Yesod the Viper”, “Yesod the Cruel and Emotionless”. A frigid being who won’t even bat an eye at the deaths of dozens of employees...
value: '冷血机器耶索德'、'毒蛇耶索德'、'残忍无情的耶索德'。一个对几十名员工的死连眼睛都不眨一下的冰冷存在……

key: I won’t deny that I deserve the reputation.
value: 我不会否认我配得上这个名声。

key: However, whoever built this place has to be a much more cruel person than I am.
value: 然而，建造这个地方的人一定比我残忍得多。

key: Sometimes, I wish I were an AI without emotion.
value: 有时候，我希望自己是个没有情感的AI。

key: A vague sense of sympathy will only cloud your judgement. You are bound to make mistakes that way.
value: 模糊的同情只会模糊你的判断。你一定会犯错。

key: Why would they place AIs with emotion to handle the facility, if they were well aware that emotion would only get in the way?
value: 如果他们明知道情感只会碍事，为什么要把有情感的AI放在这里管理设施？

key: Do you know the answer?
value: 你知道答案吗？

key: Yesod, do you really feel nothing about this?
value: 耶索德，你真的对此毫无感觉吗？

key: Try drinking some Enkephalin. Close your eyes, and open them again.
value: 试试喝点脑啡肽。闭上眼睛，再睁开。

key: I am glad to see that you are not as feeble-minded as the other Sephirot. It is important to keep a clear mind in any situation.
value: 我很高兴你不像其他赛菲拉那样意志薄弱。在任何情况下保持清醒的头脑很重要。

key: …....Gabriel, why are you scratching yourself so much?
value: ……加百列，你为什么抓成这样？

key: Seeing as we’re meeting again, you must have completed your tasks, manager.
value: 既然我们又见面了，你一定完成了任务，主管。

key: I’d give you a compliment if I didn’t have so much work to do.
value: 如果我不是有这么多工作要做我会夸你的。

key: The Information Team has a task they must do periodically.
value: 情报部有一项必须定期做的任务。

key: You must have realized that there are some blanks in the Abnormality Records.
value: 你一定注意到异想体记录中有一些空白。

key: Among the tremendous amount of information we gather, there are some that should remain off limits to the employees for security reasons.
value: 在我们收集的大量信息中，有些出于安全原因不应对员工开放。

key: The names of the employees are one such thing.
value: 员工的名字就是其中之一。

key: Any trace of them. What happened, their gruesome death, their desperate will to live, all of that has been stripped from the records on the false pretense of “expunging information.”
value: 他们的任何痕迹。发生了什么、他们可怕的死状、他们求生的绝望意志，所有这些都以'删除信息'的虚假借口从记录中剥离了。

key: There is no way for me to know what the criteria for stripping the records are. They are set by another department, not us.
value: 我无法知道剥离记录的标准是什么。它们由另一个部门设定，不是我们。

key: We only manipulate the information we receive, per orders.
value: 我们只是按命令处理收到的信息。

key: Isn’t it funny?
value: 不可笑吗？

key: We’ve degenerated into a department that destroys and manipulates information as ordered, yet somehow we’re still called the “Information Team”.
value: 我们已经退化成一个按命令销毁和操纵信息的部门，却不知怎么还叫'情报部'。

key: Whenever I introduce myself as the Sephirah of the Information Team…
value: 每当我自我介绍说是情报部的赛菲拉……

key: I sometimes feel something bubbling up inside of me.
value: 我有时感到有什么在我体内冒泡。

key: Yesod, did you receive the documents to expunge?
value: 耶索德，你收到要删除的文件了吗？

key: You will get the list of employees soon as well. Please do not forget to review it after you have finished expunging the documents.
value: 你很快也会收到员工名单。删除完文件后请记得审查。

key: Ms. Angela, what do you think it means to remember someone’s name?
value: 安吉拉女士，你觉得记住一个人的名字意味着什么？

key: This is a work you regularly do. Why are you so emotional about it today?
value: 这是你定期做的工作。你今天为什么这么多愁善感？

key: Maybe names were marks atypical beings gave each other, to engrave each other upon their memories.
value: 也许名字是非典型存在给彼此的标记，把彼此刻在记忆里。

key: Someone might have named you Angela following the same concept.
value: 有人可能出于同样的概念给你取名安吉拉。

key: Yesod, if you happen to be too tired, please take a break.
value: 耶索德，如果你太累了，请休息一下。

key: I knew you would say that.
value: 我就知道你会这么说。

key: I’m glad you know.
value: 我很高兴你知道。

key: Referring to employees by name is not recommended here.
value: 这里不建议用名字称呼员工。

key: When employees first enter the company, each one receives their own unique identification number.
value: 员工第一次进公司时，每个人都会收到自己唯一的识别编号。

key: This is to allow the company to identify them using the minimum amount of personal information.
value: 这是为了让公司用最少的个人信息识别他们。

key: We have their numbers in our data storage devices.
value: 我们的数据存储设备里有他们的编号。

key: Malkuth has never called the employees by their names ever since she started working here.
value: 玛尔库特从开始在这里工作起就从没叫过员工的名字。

key: Maybe she is the most ideal Sephirah amongst all us Sephirot.
value: 也许她是我们所有赛菲拉中最理想的赛菲拉。

key: This is not to say that Malkuth deserves to take all the pain as well.
value: 这并不是说玛尔库特也该承受所有痛苦。

key: None of us do.
value: 我们谁都不该。

key: What kind of poor taste is that, to lock us inside metal bodies, and throw us into an endless loop of days that feel just the same as yesterday?
value: 把我们锁在金属身体里，扔进和昨天一模一样的无尽日子循环里，这品味多差？

key: I’m talking to you. What’s with that oblivious expression?
value: 我在跟你说话。那漠不关心的表情是怎么回事？

key: I heard you might be one of the architects responsible for our creation.
value: 我听说你可能是负责创造我们的建筑师之一。

key: The only thing I could do here is remember the names of a few forgotten employees, and eternally despair…
value: 我在这里唯一能做的就是记住几个被遗忘员工的名字，并永远绝望……

key: Feeling nauseous from even a single breath of air…
value: 哪怕呼吸一口空气都感到恶心……

key: Have you had fun watching your guinea pigs run around in circles?
value: 看着你的小白鼠绕圈跑好玩吗？

key: See, I told you, I have been rotting from the inside for a long time…
value: 看吧，我告诉过你，我从里面腐烂很久了……

key: Gabriel was more rational than anyone else.
value: 加百列比任何人都理性。

key: He was unmoved, even after hearing about what happened to Elijah.
value: 即使听到以利亚发生了什么他也无动于衷。

key: Some said he lacked empathy.
value: 有人说他缺乏同理心。

key: But nobody realized that his emotions were festering on the inside.
value: 但没人意识到他的情感在内部溃烂。

key: Maybe he began falling apart from long ago, ever since Carmen left this world.
value: 也许他从很久以前就开始崩溃了，从卡门离开这个世界开始。

key: He slowly became expressionless. He wouldn’t allow himself to have even a paltry joy.
value: 他慢慢变得面无表情。他不允许自己有哪怕一点点快乐。

key: He also couldn’t stand having even the smallest part of his body exposed.
value: 他也受不了身体哪怕最小的部位暴露。

key: We made a monster that was not supposed to exist in this world. We went too far to ever turn back.
value: 我们制造了一个本不该存在于这个世界的怪物。我们走得太远，再也回不去了。

key: To not let what Elijah did be in vain, instead of taking the time to grieve, everyone knew they needed to utilize this result to the fullest.
value: 为了不让以利亚的牺牲白费，大家没有花时间哀悼，而是都知道需要充分利用这个结果。

key: He tried to maintain a facade of level-headedness, but his attempts to remain rational slowly morphed into an obsession.
value: 他试图维持冷静的外表，但他保持理性的努力慢慢变成了执念。

key: He started to wear long sleeved clothing that also covered his neck. Not much later, he started to scratch himself harshly.
value: 他开始穿长袖衣服，还遮住脖子。不久后，他开始用力抓挠自己。

key: We suggested he receive a complete medical examination to see whether he was contaminated or had an infection, but he refused.
value: 我们建议他做全面体检看是否被污染或感染，但他拒绝了。

key: Enforce the procedure.
value: 强制执行流程。

key: Health check-ups were needed to prevent further damage. Persuasion became coercion, and coercion led to the use of physical force.
value: 需要健康检查以防止进一步损伤。劝说变成了强迫，强迫导致使用武力。

key: He was tied and bound for the check-up, but he resisted so desperately that it was hard for us to watch him.
value: 他被绑起来做检查，但他拼命反抗，我们都不忍心看他。

key: Eventually, it turned out that he wasn’t infected at all.
value: 最终，结果显示他根本没有感染。

key: Was that really fortunate, though?
value: 但那真的幸运吗？

key: No, it wasn’t. The examination did not resolve anything. He kept scratching himself. So harshly… Even worse than before…
value: 不，不是。检查没有解决任何问题。他继续抓自己。那么用力……比以前更糟……

key: When I saw him last, he wasn’t lucid or cognizant to any human speech, and his body was completely covered in scratches.
value: 我最后一次见到他时，他已经神志不清，听不懂任何人话，全身都是抓痕。

key: No one has seen him since then.
value: 从那以后再没人见过他。

key: ....I heard about Elijah, I’m sorry.
value: ……我听说以利亚的事了，对不起。

key: I guess now everyone should know that there are consequences to forcefully entering a laboratory with restricted access.
value: 我想现在大家都该知道强行进入限制访问的实验室是有后果的。

key: Also, you were very careless not to put the supply room key back in its proper place.
value: 还有，你把补给室钥匙没放回原位也太粗心了。

key: You may think I am being too strict, but I can’t help it. I’m not saying anything false.
value: 你可能觉得我太严格了，但我没办法。我说的不是假话。

key: We should set up a time for when keys must be returned to prevent people like you from causing this again.
value: 我们应该设定钥匙必须归还的时间，防止像你这样的人再造成这种事。

key: I wore this to prevent chemicals from splashing on my body.
value: 我穿这个是为了防止化学品溅到身上。

key: Don’t worry, I’m just a little tired.
value: 别担心，我只是有点累。

key: No need to show concern. I’ll go prepare for the upcoming experiment.
value: 不需要关心。我去准备即将开始的实验。

key: Wounds have a way of revealing themselves, even for those who wish to keep them concealed.
value: 伤口总有显露自己的方式，即使对那些想隐藏它们的人也是如此。

key: For Gabriel, it was the change in his clothes.
value: 对加百列来说，就是衣服的变化。

key: Maybe it was easier on his mind to conclude that Elijah’s death was caused by a violation of the rules.
value: 也许认定以利亚的死是违反规定造成的，对他的心理来说更容易接受。

key: He tried harder to stick to his principles. He tried to maintain his objectivity.
value: 他更努力坚持原则。他试图保持客观。

key: But perhaps his excessive rationality is what destroyed him.
value: 但也许正是他过度的理性毁了他。

key: His earnest hope to not see anyone else die couldn’t reach me.
value: 他不想再看到任何人死的热切希望传达不到我这里。

key: No, there is no point in lying anymore. I pretended that I didn’t hear his desperate cry.
value: 不，撒谎已经没有意义了。我假装没听到他绝望的哭喊。

key: There’s no need to ask if I’m doing alright.
value: 没必要问我好不好。

key: I heard about what you and I did yesterday.
value: 我听说了你和我昨天做的事。

key: I felt like it was the first time I lost myself.
value: 我感觉那是我第一次迷失自我。

key: It was not quite pleasant, but it was not as terrible as I expected it to be, either.
value: 不太愉快，但也没有我预想的那么可怕。

key: Rather, I feel relieved.
value: 相反，我感到解脱。

key: Not to say that all the hatred that surrounds me has completely washed away.
value: 不是说我周围所有的仇恨都完全消失了。

key: I’ll still see that rotting hallucination, and sometimes I’ll feel disgusted, and have an unbearable anger towards you.
value: 我还是会看到那腐烂的幻觉，有时会感到恶心，对你产生无法忍受的愤怒。

key: However, if there is one aspect that has changed...
value: 然而，如果有一个方面改变了……

key: It’s that I can be in as much despair as I want to now.
value: 那就是我现在可以尽情绝望了。

key: Someday, a hope will painfully grow out of the rotten wound.
value: 总有一天，希望会从腐烂的伤口中痛苦地生长出来。

key: What you gave to us was a seed of hope.
value: 你给我们的是希望的种子。

key: It seems that you’re also on the way to embracing your painful past.
value: 看来你也在拥抱痛苦过去的路上。

key: It’s always the beginning that’s difficult.
value: 最难的永远是开始。

key: And your outfit still isn’t up to the company standard.
value: 而且你的着装仍然不符合公司标准。

key: I suppose I should seriously consider having penalty points apply even to the manager.
value: 我想我该认真考虑把扣分制也应用到主管身上。

key: Start a new game with the current Abnormality observation levels.
value: 以当前的异想体观察等级开始新游戏。

key: Restart from Checkpoint
value: 从检查点重新开始

key: Restart Challenge Mode
value: 重新开始挑战模式

key: Exit Game
value: 退出游戏

value: 挑战模式

故事到此结束。
挑战模式没有新部门可解锁。

存活并管理设施99天！

key: I’m ready for the challenge!
value: 我准备好了！

key: Get me out of here!
value: 让我离开这里！

key: Oops! You’ve found a hidden button!
value: 哎呀！你发现了一个隐藏按钮！

key:
Your employees, every Encyclopedia entry, and all other game progression will be lost, even your precious memories with me.
Do you really want to restart everything from scratch?
value:
你的员工、每一条百科条目和所有其他游戏进度都会丢失，包括你和我珍贵的回忆。
你真的想从头开始吗？

key: Let’s erase all the memories.
value: 让我们抹去所有回忆。

key: There’s no need to start from scratch.
value: 不需要从头开始。

value: 员工信息

value: 空闲员工

value: 镇压员工

value: 镇压异想体

value: 嗨，主管！你想研究这个项目吗？

value: 你将可以暂停游戏。

value: 控制部监控员工和异想体并计划最佳行动方案。

key: The Control Team monitors the employees and Abnormalities and plans out the best course of action. They give immediate orders to other employees while watching the CCTV feeds. They tend to be quite bossy and assertive, making them unpopular with other teams.
value: 控制部监控员工和异想体并计划最佳行动方案。他们一边看监控画面一边向其他员工下达即时命令。他们往往相当专横自信，因此不受其他队伍欢迎。

key: So… You wanna do this research?
value: 那……你想做这个研究吗？

key: You will be able to access the Team Rosters.
value: 你将可以查看队伍名册。

value: 安保部列表

key: Safety Team
value: 安保部

key: The Safety Team gives safety training to new employees and responds to potential incidents and threats to the company.
value: 安保部为新员工提供安全培训，并应对公司潜在的事件和威胁。

key: The Safety Team gives safety training to new employees and develops action plans for all kinds of potential emergencies that can occur in the company. They establish strategies for situations such as escaping Abnormalities, panicking employees and security breaches, as well as setting up safety guidelines for others to follow. They are notably meticulous and punctual.
value: 安保部为新员工提供安全培训，并为公司可能发生的各种紧急情况制定行动计划。他们为异想体出逃、员工恐慌和安保漏洞等情况制定策略，并设立安全指南供他人遵循。他们以极其细致和守时著称。

key: Hiya manager, do you want to proceed with this research project?
value: 嗨，主管，你想继续这个研究项目吗？

value: 培训部列表

key: Training Team
value: 培训部

key: The Training team is in charge of composing and regulating company policies and various management procedures.
value: 培训部负责编写和规范公司政策及各种管理流程。

key: The Training team is in charge of composing and regulating company policies and various management procedures. They also run general-purpose training programs to help employees adapt well to their new departments.
value: 培训部负责编写和规范公司政策及各种管理流程。他们还开展通用培训项目，帮助员工适应新部门。

key: Do you plan to proceed with this research project, manager?
value: 你打算继续这个研究项目吗，主管？

key: You will be able to see the HP and SP of the Agents.
value: 你将可以查看员工的HP和SP。

key: The Information Team analyzes the Abnormalities, profiles them, and devises solutions to possible issues based on the data.
value: 情报部分析异想体、记录它们的档案，并根据数据为可能出现的问题设计解决方案。

key: The Information Team analyzes the Abnormalities, profiles them, and devises solutions to issues the Abnormalities may cause based on the data. They are in charge of collecting, analyzing, and archiving observation data and interview logs provided by the Welfare Team. The vast library of data is the basis for finding “solutions” to various problems encountered in the energy harvesting process; they often conduct experiments to determine the consistency and safety of the solution. All of the invaluable information could be gathered thanks to long-term observations and numerous sacrifices made by the team, not armchair theorizing as some suspect… is what they asked us to write here.
value: 情报部分析异想体、记录它们的档案，并根据数据为异想体可能引起的问题设计解决方案。他们负责收集、分析和归档福利部提供的观察数据和访谈记录。庞大的数据库是为能源采集过程中遇到的各种问题寻找'解决方案'的基础；他们经常进行实验以确定解决方案的一致性和安全性。所有这些宝贵的信息都要归功于队伍长期的观察和无数的牺牲，而不是某些人怀疑的纸上谈兵……这是他们让我们写在这里的。

Employees in the lower half of Central Command take great pride in their aesthetic sense; some say they spend a majority of their time in the morning debating on what to wear for the day. key: With the goal of preventing epidemics and secondary infection caused by Abnormalities, the Welfare Team puts preventative measures into action and works on programs that benefit the physical fitness and mental health of employees. In-house welfare is one of the highest values Lobotomy Corporation pursues; for the protection of our valuable resources… ah, no, I mean the lives of our employees.

The Disciplinary Team is the best at handling and sanctioning any situation, no matter if it is with an Abnormality or one of our own employees.
